Namespace ExcelCommon
    ''' <summary>Post-conversion observation axis. Never parses, filters, coerces, sorts or re-pairs.
    ''' Cell/subject values are detached primitive host values; arrays are copied without string conversion.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AgreementInputAxis
        Private ReadOnly firstValues As Double(), secondValues As Double(), categoryFirst As Object(), categorySecond As Object(), subjects As Object()
        Public Sub New(count As Integer, names As IEnumerable(Of String), sourceRows As IEnumerable(Of Integer),
                       Optional first As Double() = Nothing, Optional second As Double() = Nothing,
                       Optional subjectIds As Object() = Nothing, Optional categoricalFirst As Object() = Nothing,
                       Optional categoricalSecond As Object() = Nothing, Optional header As Boolean? = Nothing)
            Me.Count = count : Me.Names = Array.AsReadOnly(If(names, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()).ToArray()) : Me.Header = header
            firstValues = Clone(first) : secondValues = Clone(second)
            categoryFirst = CloneObjects(categoricalFirst) : categorySecond = CloneObjects(categoricalSecond) : subjects = CloneObjects(subjectIds)
            IsCategorical = categoricalFirst IsNot Nothing OrElse categoricalSecond IsNot Nothing
            Dim rows = If(sourceRows Is Nothing, Nothing, sourceRows.ToArray())
            Dim mapped As New List(Of Integer?), issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            For i = 0 To count - 1
                Dim physical As Integer? = Nothing
                If rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length Then physical = rows(i)
                mapped.Add(physical)
            Next
            If rows IsNot Nothing Then
                'Identity-only reuse of the accepted alignment contract, no new range grammar.
                Alignment = New SpreadsheetRowAlignment(rows, rows)
                If rows.Length <> count Then issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("agreement.axis.shape", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, "Source row count differs from observations; candidate only.", "input.rows"))
            End If
            PhysicalRows = mapped.AsReadOnly() : CandidateDiagnostics = New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Count As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Names As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public ReadOnly Property PhysicalRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer?)
        Public ReadOnly Property Alignment As SpreadsheetRowAlignment
        Public ReadOnly Property Header As Boolean?
        Public ReadOnly Property IsCategorical As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property CandidateDiagnostics As SpreadsheetValidationReport
        Public Function First() As Double()
            Return Clone(firstValues)
        End Function
        Public Function Second() As Double()
            Return Clone(secondValues)
        End Function
        Public Function FirstCategories() As Object()
            Return CloneObjects(categoryFirst)
        End Function
        Public Function SecondCategories() As Object()
            Return CloneObjects(categorySecond)
        End Function
        Public Function SubjectIds() As Object()
            Return CloneObjects(subjects)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Clone(value As Double()) As Double()
            Return If(value Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(value.Clone(), Double()))
        End Function
        Private Shared Function CloneObjects(value As Object()) As Object()
            Return If(value Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(value.Clone(), Object()))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function FromBlocks(blocks As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks) As AgreementInputAxis
            If blocks Is Nothing Then Return New AgreementInputAxis(0, Nothing, Nothing)
            Return New AgreementInputAxis(blocks.Blocks.Count, blocks.Names, blocks.Blocks.Select(Function(b) b(0).WorksheetRow))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryGetById(id As String, ByRef descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor) As Boolean
            descriptor = Nothing

            Return _byId.TryGetValue(id, descriptor)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function GetById(id As String) As IAnalysisDescriptor
            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
            If Not TryGetById(id, descriptor) Then Throw New KeyNotFoundException("Unknown analysis ID: " & If(id, "(null)"))

        Public Shared Function GetByLegacyKind(kind As SpreadsheetAnalysisKind) As IAnalysisDescriptor
            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
            If Not TryGetByLegacyKind(kind, descriptor) Then
                Throw New KeyNotFoundException("Unknown legacy analysis kind: " & CInt(kind).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            End If
            Return descriptor
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryGetLegacyKind(id As String, ByRef kind As SpreadsheetAnalysisKind) As Boolean
            kind = CType(0, SpreadsheetAnalysisKind)

    ''' <summary>Immutable catalog entry. Each defaults request gets a new options instance.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AnalysisDescriptor
        Implements IAnalysisDescriptor

        Private ReadOnly _inputTypes As IReadOnlyList(Of Type)
        Private ReadOnly _requiredCapabilities As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Private ReadOnly _createOptions As Func(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions)

        Public Sub New(id As String,
                       displayName As String,
                       category As String,
                       description As String,
                       helpUrl As String,
                       contractVersion As Integer,
                       inputSchemaId As String,
                       optionsSchemaId As String,
                       inputTypes As IEnumerable(Of Type),
                       optionsType As Type,
                       createOptions As Func(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions),
                       outputKinds As AnalysisOutputKinds,
                       availability As AnalysisAvailability,
                       estimatedCost As AnalysisExecutionCost,
                       requiredCapabilities As IEnumerable(Of String),
                       legacyKind As Nullable(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisKind))
            If Not IsStableId(id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Analysis IDs must be lowercase ASCII segments separated by '.' or '-'.", NameOf(id))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Display name is required.", NameOf(displayName))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Category is required.", NameOf(category))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Description is required.", NameOf(description))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(helpUrl) OrElse Not Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(helpUrl, UriKind.Absolute) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("An absolute help URL is required.", NameOf(helpUrl))
            End If
            If contractVersion <= 0 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(contractVersion))
            If Not IsStableId(inputSchemaId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Input schema ID is invalid.", NameOf(inputSchemaId))
            If Not IsStableId(optionsSchemaId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Options schema ID is invalid.", NameOf(optionsSchemaId))
            If optionsType Is Nothing OrElse Not GetType(SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions).IsAssignableFrom(optionsType) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("OptionsType must derive from SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions.", NameOf(optionsType))
            End If
            If createOptions Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(createOptions))
            If inputTypes Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(inputTypes))
            If requiredCapabilities Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(requiredCapabilities))

            Dim typeList As New List(Of Type)()
            For Each inputType As Type In inputTypes
                If inputType Is Nothing OrElse Not GetType(SpreadsheetAnalysisInput).IsAssignableFrom(inputType) OrElse typeList.Contains(inputType) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Input types must be unique SpreadsheetAnalysisInput types.", NameOf(inputTypes))
                End If
                typeList.Add(inputType)
            Next
            If typeList.Count = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("At least one input type is required.", NameOf(inputTypes))
            _inputTypes = typeList.AsReadOnly()

            Dim caps As New List(Of String)()
            For Each capability As String In requiredCapabilities
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(capability) OrElse caps.Contains(capability) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Capability IDs must be nonblank and unique.", NameOf(requiredCapabilities))
                End If
                caps.Add(capability)
            Next
            _requiredCapabilities = caps.AsReadOnly()

            Me.Id = id
            Me.DisplayName = displayName
            Me.Category = category
            Me.Description = description
            Me.HelpUrl = helpUrl
            Me.ContractVersion = contractVersion
            Me.InputSchemaId = inputSchemaId
            Me.OptionsSchemaId = optionsSchemaId
            Me.OptionsType = optionsType
            Me.OutputKinds = outputKinds
            Me.Availability = availability
            Me.EstimatedCost = estimatedCost
            Me.LegacyKind = legacyKind
            _createOptions = createOptions
        End Sub

        Public Function CreateDefaultOptions() As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions Implements IAnalysisDescriptor.CreateDefaultOptions
            Dim options As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions = _createOptions()
            If options Is Nothing OrElse Not OptionsType.IsInstanceOfType(options) Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("The options factory returned an incompatible type for " & Id & ".")
            End If
            Return options
        End Function

        Private Shared Function IsStableId(value As String) As Boolean
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return False
            Dim precedingSeparator As Boolean = True
            For Each ch As Char In value
                If (ch >= "a"c AndAlso ch <= "z"c) OrElse (ch >= "0"c AndAlso ch <= "9"c) Then
                    precedingSeparator = False
                ElseIf (ch = "."c OrElse ch = "-"c) AndAlso Not precedingSeparator Then
                    precedingSeparator = True
                Else
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            Return Not precedingSeparator
        End Function

Public NotInheritable Class AnalysisDescriptor
        Implements IAnalysisDescriptor

        Private ReadOnly _inputTypes As IReadOnlyList(Of Type)
        Private ReadOnly _requiredCapabilities As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Private ReadOnly _createOptions As Func(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions)

        Public Sub New(id As String,
                       displayName As String,
                       category As String,
                       description As String,
                       helpUrl As String,
                       contractVersion As Integer,
                       inputSchemaId As String,
                       optionsSchemaId As String,
                       inputTypes As IEnumerable(Of Type),
                       optionsType As Type,
                       createOptions As Func(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions),
                       outputKinds As AnalysisOutputKinds,
                       availability As AnalysisAvailability,
                       estimatedCost As AnalysisExecutionCost,
                       requiredCapabilities As IEnumerable(Of String),
                       legacyKind As Nullable(Of SpreadsheetAnalysisKind))
            If Not IsStableId(id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Analysis IDs must be lowercase ASCII segments separated by '.' or '-'.", NameOf(id))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Display name is required.", NameOf(displayName))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Category is required.", NameOf(category))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Description is required.", NameOf(description))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(helpUrl) OrElse Not Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(helpUrl, UriKind.Absolute) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("An absolute help URL is required.", NameOf(helpUrl))
            End If
            If contractVersion <= 0 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(contractVersion))
            If Not IsStableId(inputSchemaId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Input schema ID is invalid.", NameOf(inputSchemaId))
            If Not IsStableId(optionsSchemaId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Options schema ID is invalid.", NameOf(optionsSchemaId))
            If optionsType Is Nothing OrElse Not GetType(SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions).IsAssignableFrom(optionsType) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("OptionsType must derive from SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions.", NameOf(optionsType))
            End If
            If createOptions Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(createOptions))
            If inputTypes Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(inputTypes))
            If requiredCapabilities Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(requiredCapabilities))

            Dim typeList As New List(Of Type)()
            For Each inputType As Type In inputTypes
                If inputType Is Nothing OrElse Not GetType(SpreadsheetAnalysisInput).IsAssignableFrom(inputType) OrElse typeList.Contains(inputType) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Input types must be unique SpreadsheetAnalysisInput types.", NameOf(inputTypes))
                End If
                typeList.Add(inputType)
            Next
            If typeList.Count = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("At least one input type is required.", NameOf(inputTypes))
            _inputTypes = typeList.AsReadOnly()

            Dim caps As New List(Of String)()
            For Each capability As String In requiredCapabilities
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(capability) OrElse caps.Contains(capability) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Capability IDs must be nonblank and unique.", NameOf(requiredCapabilities))
                End If
                caps.Add(capability)
            Next
            _requiredCapabilities = caps.AsReadOnly()

            Me.Id = id
            Me.DisplayName = displayName
            Me.Category = category
            Me.Description = description
            Me.HelpUrl = helpUrl
            Me.ContractVersion = contractVersion
            Me.InputSchemaId = inputSchemaId
            Me.OptionsSchemaId = optionsSchemaId
            Me.OptionsType = optionsType
            Me.OutputKinds = outputKinds
            Me.Availability = availability
            Me.EstimatedCost = estimatedCost
            Me.LegacyKind = legacyKind
            _createOptions = createOptions
        End Sub

        Public Function CreateDefaultOptions() As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions Implements IAnalysisDescriptor.CreateDefaultOptions
            Dim options As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions = _createOptions()
            If options Is Nothing OrElse Not OptionsType.IsInstanceOfType(options) Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("The options factory returned an incompatible type for " & Id & ".")
            End If
            Return options
        End Function

        Private Shared Function IsStableId(value As String) As Boolean
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return False
            Dim precedingSeparator As Boolean = True
            For Each ch As Char In value
                If (ch >= "a"c AndAlso ch <= "z"c) OrElse (ch >= "0"c AndAlso ch <= "9"c) Then
                    precedingSeparator = False
                ElseIf (ch = "."c OrElse ch = "-"c) AndAlso Not precedingSeparator Then
                    precedingSeparator = True
                Else
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            Return Not precedingSeparator
        End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Immutable compile-time registry: the descriptor catalog describes available analyses,
    ''' while this registry alone supplies executable typed handlers.
    ''' Documented but unregistered methods are never dispatched.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AnalysisHandlerRegistry

        Private Shared ReadOnly _all As IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler) = BuildHandlers()
        Private Shared ReadOnly _byId As Dictionary(Of String, IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler)) = BuildIndex(_all)

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared ReadOnly Property All As IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler)
            Get
                Return _all
            End Get
        End Property

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Run using a stable analysis ID. Input and option types are checked before execution.
        ''' Nothing options preserve the historical defaults in each application service.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Run(analysisId As String,
                                   input As SpreadsheetAnalysisInput,
                                   options As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions) As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(analysisId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Analysis ID is required.", NameOf(analysisId))
            If input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(input))

            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
            Dim handlers As IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler) = Nothing
            If Not AnalysisCatalog.TryGetById(analysisId, descriptor) OrElse
               descriptor.Availability <> AnalysisAvailability.ImplementedInCommon OrElse
               Not _byId.TryGetValue(analysisId, handlers) Then
                Throw New NotSupportedException("The shared Excel application layer does not support analysis ID '" & analysisId & "'.")
            End If

            If options IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not descriptor.OptionsType.IsInstanceOfType(options) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException(descriptor.DisplayName & " requires " & descriptor.OptionsType.Name & ".", NameOf(options))
            End If

            For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In handlers
                If handler.InputType.IsInstanceOfType(input) Then
                    Dim result As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult = handler.Execute(input, options)
                    If descriptor.LegacyKind.HasValue AndAlso result.AnalysisKind <> descriptor.LegacyKind.Value Then
                        Throw New InvalidOperationException("Handler returned an incompatible analysis kind for " & analysisId & ".")
                    End If
                    If options IsNot Nothing Then
                        Dim reported As IEnumerable(Of AnalysisWarning) = options.GetWarnings()
                        If reported IsNot Nothing Then
                            Dim warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)(reported)
                            If warnings.Count > 0 Then result = result.WithWarnings(warnings)
                        End If
                    End If
                    Return result
                End If
            Next

            Throw New ArgumentException(descriptor.DisplayName & " does not accept input type " & input.GetType().Name & ".", NameOf(input))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Verify that every implemented descriptor has exactly one handler for every declared input type.</summary>
        ''' <remarks>Also usable with independent test registrations; does not mutate the production catalog.</remarks>
        Public Shared Sub ValidateRegistrations(descriptors As IEnumerable(Of IAnalysisDescriptor),
                                                handlers As IEnumerable(Of IAnalysisHandler))
            If descriptors Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(descriptors))
            If handlers Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(handlers))
            AnalysisCatalog.ValidateDescriptors(descriptors)

            Dim byId As New Dictionary(Of String, IAnalysisDescriptor)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim seen As New Dictionary(Of String, HashSet(Of Type))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor In descriptors
                byId.Add(descriptor.Id, descriptor)
                seen.Add(descriptor.Id, New HashSet(Of Type)())
            Next

            For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In handlers
                If handler Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(handler.AnalysisId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("A handler is missing its analysis ID.", NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
                If Not byId.TryGetValue(handler.AnalysisId, descriptor) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler has no matching descriptor: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If descriptor.Availability <> AnalysisAvailability.ImplementedInCommon Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Unimplemented analysis cannot register a handler: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If handler.OptionsType IsNot descriptor.OptionsType Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler options differ from catalog: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If handler.InputType Is Nothing OrElse Not ContainsInputType(descriptor.InputTypes, handler.InputType) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler input differs from catalog: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If Not seen(handler.AnalysisId).Add(handler.InputType) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate handler for " & handler.AnalysisId & "/" & handler.InputType.Name, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
            Next

            For Each descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor In byId.Values
                If descriptor.Availability = AnalysisAvailability.ImplementedInCommon Then
                    For Each inputType As Type In descriptor.InputTypes
                        If Not seen(descriptor.Id).Contains(inputType) Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Missing handler for " & descriptor.Id & "/" & inputType.Name, NameOf(handlers))
                        End If
                    Next
                End If
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function ContainsInputType(types As IReadOnlyList(Of Type), candidate As Type) As Boolean
            For Each item As Type In types
                If item Is candidate Then Return True
            Next
            Return False
        End Function

        Private Shared Function BuildHandlers() As IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler)
            Dim handlers As IAnalysisHandler() = {
                New TypedAnalysisHandler(Of SpreadsheetRangeData, OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions, OneWayAnovaApplicationResult)(
                    AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova,
                    Function(input, options) OneWayAnovaApplicationService.Run(input, options),
                    AddressOf WrapAnova),
                New TypedAnalysisHandler(Of GroupedNumericData, OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions, OneWayAnovaApplicationResult)(
                    AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova,
                    Function(input, options) OneWayAnovaApplicationService.Run(input, options),
                    AddressOf WrapAnova),
                New TypedAnalysisHandler(Of SpreadsheetRangeData, KruskalWallisAnalysisOptions, KruskalWallisApplicationResult)(
                    AnalysisIds.KruskalWallis,
                    Function(input, options) KruskalWallisApplicationService.Run(input, options),
                    AddressOf WrapKruskalWallis),
                New TypedAnalysisHandler(Of GroupedNumericData, KruskalWallisAnalysisOptions, KruskalWallisApplicationResult)(
                    AnalysisIds.KruskalWallis,
                    Function(input, options) KruskalWallisApplicationService.Run(input, options),
                    AddressOf WrapKruskalWallis)
            }
            ValidateRegistrations(AnalysisCatalog.All, handlers)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly(handlers)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function BuildIndex(handlers As IEnumerable(Of IAnalysisHandler)) As Dictionary(Of String, IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler))
            Dim mutable As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of IAnalysisHandler))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In handlers
                Dim list As List(Of IAnalysisHandler) = Nothing
                If Not mutable.TryGetValue(handler.AnalysisId, list) Then
                    list = New List(Of IAnalysisHandler)()
                    mutable.Add(handler.AnalysisId, list)
                End If
                list.Add(handler)
            Next
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of String, List(Of IAnalysisHandler)) In mutable
                result.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value.AsReadOnly())
            Next
            Return result
        End Function

        Private Shared Function WrapAnova(detail As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult) As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult
            Dim metrics As New Dictionary(Of String, Double)(StringComparer.Ordinal) From {
                {AnalysisMetricNames.FStatistic, detail.FStatistic},
                {AnalysisMetricNames.PValue, detail.PValue}
            }
            If detail.HasWelch Then
                metrics(AnalysisMetricNames.WelchFStatistic) = detail.WelchFStatistic
                metrics(AnalysisMetricNames.WelchPValue) = detail.WelchPValue

        Public Shared Function Run(analysisId As String,

            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(analysisId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Analysis ID is required.", NameOf(analysisId))
            If input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(input))

            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing

            If Not AnalysisCatalog.TryGetById(analysisId, descriptor) OrElse

                Throw New NotSupportedException("The shared Excel application layer does not support analysis ID '" & analysisId & "'.")
            End If

            If options IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not descriptor.OptionsType.IsInstanceOfType(options) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException(descriptor.DisplayName & " requires " & descriptor.OptionsType.Name & ".", NameOf(options))

                                                handlers As IEnumerable(Of IAnalysisHandler))
            If descriptors Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(descriptors))
            If handlers Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(handlers))
            AnalysisCatalog.ValidateDescriptors(descriptors)

            Dim byId As New Dictionary(Of String, IAnalysisDescriptor)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim seen As New Dictionary(Of String, HashSet(Of Type))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor In descriptors
                byId.Add(descriptor.Id, descriptor)
                seen.Add(descriptor.Id, New HashSet(Of Type)())
            Next

            For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In handlers
                If handler Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(handler.AnalysisId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("A handler is missing its analysis ID.", NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
                If Not byId.TryGetValue(handler.AnalysisId, descriptor) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler has no matching descriptor: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If descriptor.Availability <> AnalysisAvailability.ImplementedInCommon Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Unimplemented analysis cannot register a handler: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If handler.OptionsType IsNot descriptor.OptionsType Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler options differ from catalog: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If
                If handler.InputType Is Nothing OrElse Not ContainsInputType(descriptor.InputTypes, handler.InputType) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Handler input differs from catalog: " & handler.AnalysisId, NameOf(handlers))
                End If

                    Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate handler for " & handler.AnalysisId & "/" & handler.InputType.Name, NameOf(handlers))

                End If

        Private Shared Function BuildIndex(handlers As IEnumerable(Of IAnalysisHandler)) As Dictionary(Of String, IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler))
            Dim mutable As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of IAnalysisHandler))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In handlers
                Dim list As List(Of IAnalysisHandler) = Nothing
                If Not mutable.TryGetValue(handler.AnalysisId, list) Then
                    list = New List(Of IAnalysisHandler)()
                    mutable.Add(handler.AnalysisId, list)
                End If
                list.Add(handler)
            Next
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, IReadOnlyList(Of IAnalysisHandler))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of String, List(Of IAnalysisHandler)) In mutable

            Next

    ''' <summary>Immutable capture of existing Core table output, including p-value columns,
    ''' cells, headers and CI footnotes. No reformatting/reparsing of numerical CI strings.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AnovaReportTable
        Private ReadOnly _artifact As AnalysisTableArtifact
        Friend Sub New(index As Integer, table As ResultTable)
            If table.bLeftHeaderAdjustUp Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unexpected ANOVA table header alignment.")
            _artifact = New AnalysisTableArtifact(index, table.ToOutputModel())
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Artifact As AnalysisTableArtifact
            Get
                Return _artifact
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function ToLegacyTable() As ResultTable
            Dim model = _artifact.Model, values = model.Values
            Dim result As New ResultTable
            Dim bodyRows = model.RowCount - model.TitleRows - model.HeaderTopRows - model.FooterRows
            Dim bodyColumns = model.ColumnCount - model.HeaderLeftColumns
            Dim body(bodyRows - 1, bodyColumns - 1) As Object
            For r = 0 To bodyRows - 1
                For c = 0 To bodyColumns - 1
                    body(r, c) = values(model.TitleRows + model.HeaderTopRows + r, model.HeaderLeftColumns + c)
                Next
            Next
            result.SetBody(body)
            For r = 0 To model.TitleRows - 1
                result.AddTitle(TryCast(values(r, 0), String))
            Next
            For r = 0 To model.HeaderTopRows - 1
                Dim header(model.ColumnCount - 1) As String
                For c = 0 To model.ColumnCount - 1
                    header(c) = TryCast(values(model.TitleRows + r, c), String)
                Next
                result.AddHeaderTopRow(header)
            Next
            For c = 0 To model.HeaderLeftColumns - 1
                Dim left(bodyRows - 1) As String
                For r = 0 To bodyRows - 1
                    left(r) = TryCast(values(model.TitleRows + model.HeaderTopRows + r, c), String)
                Next
                result.AddHeaderLeftRow(left)
            Next
            For r = model.RowCount - model.FooterRows To model.RowCount - 1
                result.AddFootnote(TryCast(values(r, 0), String))
            Next
            For Each col In model.PvalueColumns
                result.AddPvalueToFormat(col)
            Next
            For Each cell In model.PvalueCells
                result.AddPvalueCellToFormat(cell.BodyRow, cell.BodyColumn)
            Next
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Workflow/composition only. Existing shared handlers and Core engines remain
    ''' the single numerical implementations. No host state, acquisition, charts or writes.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AnovaWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Private Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), code As String, message As String, field As String,
                                 Optional severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, field))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function RunGrouped(input As AssumptionReportInput, options As AnovaGroupedWorkflowOptions,
                                          Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaGroupedWorkflowResult
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), plots As New List(Of parametric.MultipleComparisonPlotData)
            Dim result As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult = Nothing, failure As Exception = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If input Is Nothing OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Named groups and explicit workflow options are required.")
                Dim groups = input.Groups, names = input.Names
                If groups Is Nothing OrElse names Is Nothing OrElse groups.Length < 2 OrElse groups.Length <> names.Length OrElse
                   groups.Any(Function(g) g Is Nothing OrElse g.Length = 0 OrElse g.Any(Function(v) Double.IsNaN(v) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(v))) Then Throw New ArgumentException("At least two nonempty finite groups and matching names are required.")
                If (CInt(options.Homogeneity) And Not CInt(HomogeneityMethods.All)) <> 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported homogeneity options.")
                If input.Sources.Count = 0 Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "No physical observation mapping was supplied; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Dim seenSources As New HashSet(Of Tuple(Of Integer, Integer))
                For Each source In input.Sources
                    If source Is Nothing OrElse source.GroupIndex < 0 OrElse source.GroupIndex >= groups.Length OrElse
                       source.ObservationIndex < 0 OrElse source.ObservationIndex >= groups(source.GroupIndex).Length OrElse
                       source.SelectedRow < 0 OrElse source.SelectedColumn < 0 OrElse source.WorksheetRow < 0 OrElse source.WorksheetColumn < 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Original observation source mapping is invalid.")
                    If Not seenSources.Add(Tuple.Create(source.GroupIndex, source.ObservationIndex)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("An original observation has ambiguous source mappings.")
                Next
                'Preserve existing invalid-alpha normalization AND warning policy in the unchanged dispatcher.
                result = SharedAnalysisApplicationService.Run(New SpreadsheetAnalysisRequest(options.Kind, New GroupedNumericData(names, groups), options.ToAnalysisOptions()))
                Dim detail = TryCast(result.Detail, OneWayAnovaApplicationResult)
                If detail IsNot Nothing Then
                    If options.Lsd AndAlso detail.FisherLsdPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.FisherLsdPlotData)
                    If options.Bonferroni AndAlso detail.BonferroniPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.BonferroniPlotData)
                    If options.Tukey AndAlso detail.TukeyKramerPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.TukeyKramerPlotData)
                    If options.GamesHowell AndAlso detail.GamesHowellPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.GamesHowellPlotData)
                End If
                For Each warning In result.Document.Warnings
                    Issue(issues, warning.Code, warning.Message, warning.FieldPath, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                Next
                ObserveUndefined(result.Tables, issues)
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : result = Nothing : plots.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_GROUPED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "workflow")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaGroupedWorkflowResult(input, options, result, issues, plots, failure)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildSupplements(input As AssumptionReportInput, options As AnovaGroupedWorkflowOptions,
                                                Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AssumptionReportResult
            Dim tables As New List(Of AssumptionTableSpecification), issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Dim working = If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Groups), failure As Exception = Nothing
            Dim stages As New List(Of AssumptionOutputStage)
            Try
                If input Is Nothing OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Input and workflow options are required.")
                For Each stage In New AnovaWorkflowPlan(options).Stages
                    cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                    If stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.PrimaryTables Then Continue For
                    If stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.WindowsBoxSummary Then
                        stages.Add(AssumptionOutputStage.WindowsBoxSummaryAndChart)
                        Continue For
                    End If
                    Dim kind = If(stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.Descriptive, AssumptionReportKind.Descriptive, AssumptionReportKind.Homogeneity)
                    'These are computational scratch vectors, possibly sorted by an earlier
                    'supplement. Original provenance remains on input, never on this scratch.
                    Dim report = AssumptionReportPolicy.Build(New AssumptionReportInput(working, input.Names),
                        New AssumptionReportOptions(kind, homogeneity:=options.Homogeneity), cancellation)
                    working = report.LegacyWorkingGroups
                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues)
                    report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables)
                    stages.Add(If(stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.Descriptive, AssumptionOutputStage.DescriptiveTable, AssumptionOutputStage.PrimaryTable))
                Next
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear() : stages.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_SUPPLEMENT_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "supplements")
            End Try
            Return New AssumptionReportResult(tables, issues, stages, working, failure)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function RunRepeated(matrix As Double(,), names As String(), options As RepeatedAnovaWorkflowOptions,
                                           Optional sources As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks = Nothing,
                                           Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Dim working = If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(matrix.Clone(), Double(,)))
            Dim labels = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), calls As New List(Of String), tables As New List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim failure As Exception = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If working Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse working.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse working.GetLength(1) < 2 OrElse labels.Length <> working.GetLength(1) OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Complete subject rows and at least two named treatments are required.")
                If Double.IsNaN(options.Alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(options.Alpha) OrElse options.Alpha <= 0 OrElse options.Alpha >= 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Alpha must be finite and between zero and one.")
                For Each value In working
                    If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Repeated ANOVA requires finite complete blocks.")
                Next
                ValidateSources(working, sources, issues)
                If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                Dim model As New parametric.OneWayRmANOVA(working, labels)
                calls.Add("compute") : model.compute()
                If options.GreenhouseGeisser Then
                    calls.Add("GreenhouseGeisser") : model.GreenhouseGeisser()
                End If
                If options.HuynhFeldt Then
                    calls.Add("HuyhnFeldt") : model.HuyhnFeldt()
                End If
                If options.Tukey Then
                    calls.Add("TukeyKramerRM2") : model.TukeyKramerRM2(options.Alpha)
                    calls.Add("Tukey") : model.Tukey(options.Alpha)
                End If
                calls.Add("wrapResults") : tables.AddRange(model.wrapResults())
                If options.Mauchly Then
                    calls.Add("MauchlyTest")
                    Dim test = assumptions.MauchlyTest(working), table As New ResultTable
                    table.SetBody(New Object(,) {{"Chi2", test.TestStatistics1}, {"P-value", test.Pvalue}})
                    table.AddHeaderTopRow({"Mauchly 's Test of Sphericity", ""})
                    table.AddPvalueCellToFormat(2, 2) : tables.Add(table)
                End If
                If options.Descriptive Then
                    calls.Add("Descriptive")
                    Dim groups = Enumerable.Range(0, labels.Length).Select(Function(c) DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(working, c)).ToArray()
                    Dim report = AssumptionReportPolicy.Build(New AssumptionReportInput(groups, labels), New AssumptionReportOptions(AssumptionReportKind.Descriptive), cancellation)
                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues) : report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToLegacyTable()))
                End If
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                ObserveUndefined(tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), issues)
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_REPEATED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "repeated")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaModelReportResult(tables, issues, calls, working, Nothing, sources, Nothing, Nothing, failure, options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.BoxSummary)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function RunRepeated(input As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks, options As RepeatedAnovaWorkflowOptions,
                                           Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Return RunRepeated(If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Matrix), If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Names.ToArray()), options, input, cancellation)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ValidateSources(matrix As Double(,), sources As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue))
            If sources Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "No physical row provenance was supplied; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Return
            End If
            If sources.Blocks.Count <> matrix.GetLength(0) OrElse sources.Names.Count <> matrix.GetLength(1) Then
                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_MAP", "Source dimensions do not match the original matrix.", "sources")
                Return
            End If
            Dim seen As New HashSet(Of Integer)
            For r = 0 To sources.Blocks.Count - 1
                Dim row = sources.Blocks(r)(0).WorksheetRow
                If row > 0 AndAlso Not seen.Add(row) Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_DUPLICATE_BLOCK", "Duplicate physical subject row.", "sources")
                For c = 0 To matrix.GetLength(1) - 1
                    Dim source = sources.Blocks(r)(c)
                    If source.Value <> matrix(r, c) OrElse source.WorksheetRow <> row Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_MAP", "Original source values/rows disagree with the block matrix.", "sources")
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function RunNested(matrix As Object(,), names As String(), Optional sources As SpreadsheetNestedInput = Nothing,
                                         Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing,
                                         Optional originalSource As SpreadsheetNestedInput = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Dim working = If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(matrix.Clone(), Object(,)))
            Dim labels = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), calls As New List(Of String), tables As New List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim failure As Exception = Nothing, balanced As Boolean? = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If working Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse working.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse working.GetLength(1) < 3 OrElse labels.Length <> working.GetLength(1) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Named group, nested factor and response columns are required.")
                Dim parents As New Dictionary(Of String, HashSet(Of String))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                For r = 0 To working.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For c = 0 To working.GetLength(1) - 1
                        Dim value = working(r, c)
                        If value Is Nothing OrElse (Not TypeOf value Is String AndAlso Not IsNumericType(value)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Only detached text/numeric cells are supported.")
                        If c < 2 AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Convert.ToString(value, Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested labels must be nonempty.")
                        If c >= 2 Then
                            Dim numeric = Convert.ToDouble(value, Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                            If Double.IsNaN(numeric) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(numeric) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Responses must be finite.")
                        End If
                    Next
                    Dim parent = Convert.ToString(working(r, 0), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                    Dim child = Convert.ToString(working(r, 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                    If Not parents.ContainsKey(child) Then parents.Add(child, New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal))
                    parents(child).Add(parent)
                Next
                If parents.Values.Any(Function(p) p.Count > 1) Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_NESTED_GLOBAL_LABEL", "Existing Core requires globally unique subgroup labels and rejects a repeated label under different parents. No automatic recoding was applied.", "nested.labels", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                If working.GetLength(1) > 3 Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_NESTED_EXTRA_RESPONSES", "Existing Core uses the first response column only; extra original columns are retained.", "nested.responses", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                If sources Is Nothing Then
                    Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "Physical source provenance is unavailable; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Else
                    Dim response(working.GetLength(0) - 1, working.GetLength(1) - 3) As Double
                    If sources.GroupLabels.Count <> working.GetLength(0) OrElse sources.NestedLabels.Count <> working.GetLength(0) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested source labels have invalid dimensions.")
                    For r = 0 To working.GetLength(0) - 1
                        If sources.GroupLabels(r) <> Convert.ToString(working(r, 0), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) OrElse
                           sources.NestedLabels(r) <> Convert.ToString(working(r, 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested source labels disagree with the original matrix.")
                        For c = 2 To working.GetLength(1) - 1
                            response(r, c - 2) = Convert.ToDouble(working(r, c), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                        Next
                    Next
                    ValidateSources(response, sources.Responses, issues)
                    If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                End If
                calls.Add("TwoWayNestedANOVA")
                Dim model As New parametric.TwoWayNestedANOVA(working, labels)
                calls.Add("compute") : model.compute()
                calls.Add("wrapResults") : tables.AddRange(model.wrapResults())
                balanced = model.balancedDesign
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                ObserveUndefined(tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), issues)
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear() : balanced = Nothing
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_NESTED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "nested")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaModelReportResult(tables, issues, calls, Nothing, working, Nothing, sources, balanced, failure, False, originalSource)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function RunNested(input As SpreadsheetNestedInput, Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            If input Is Nothing Then Return RunNested(Nothing, Nothing, Nothing, cancellation)
            If input.Responses Is Nothing OrElse input.GroupLabels.Count <> input.Responses.Blocks.Count OrElse input.NestedLabels.Count <> input.Responses.Blocks.Count Then Return RunNested(Nothing, Nothing, input, cancellation)
            Dim matrix(input.Responses.Blocks.Count - 1, input.Responses.Names.Count + 1) As Object
            For r = 0 To input.Responses.Blocks.Count - 1
                matrix(r, 0) = input.GroupLabels(r) : matrix(r, 1) = input.NestedLabels(r)
                For c = 0 To input.Responses.Names.Count - 1
                    matrix(r, c + 2) = input.Responses.Blocks(r)(c).Value
                Next
            Next
            Return RunNested(matrix, New String() {"Group", "Nested"}.Concat(input.Responses.Names).ToArray(), input, cancellation)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function IsNumericType(value As Object) As Boolean
            Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType())
                Case TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16, TypeCode.Int32, TypeCode.UInt32,
                     TypeCode.Int64, TypeCode.UInt64, TypeCode.Single, TypeCode.Double, TypeCode.Decimal
                    Return True
            End Select
            Return False
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub ObserveUndefined(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTableOutputModel), issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue))
            Dim index = 0
            For Each table In tables
                For r = 0 To table.RowCount - 1
                    For c = 0 To table.ColumnCount - 1
                        If TypeOf table.Values(r, c) Is Double Then
                            Dim value = CDbl(table.Values(r, c))
                            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then
                                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_UNDEFINED_RESULT", "Existing Core returned an undefined/nonfinite cell; no finite value or NA label was substituted.",
                                    String.Format(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "tables[{0}].cells[{1},{2}]", index, r, c), SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                            End If
                        End If
                    Next
                Next
                index += 1
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class AnovaWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Private Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), code As String, message As String, field As String,
                                 Optional severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, field))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function RunGrouped(input As AssumptionReportInput, options As AnovaGroupedWorkflowOptions,
                                          Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaGroupedWorkflowResult
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), plots As New List(Of parametric.MultipleComparisonPlotData)
            Dim result As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult = Nothing, failure As Exception = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If input Is Nothing OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Named groups and explicit workflow options are required.")
                Dim groups = input.Groups, names = input.Names
                If groups Is Nothing OrElse names Is Nothing OrElse groups.Length < 2 OrElse groups.Length <> names.Length OrElse
                   groups.Any(Function(g) g Is Nothing OrElse g.Length = 0 OrElse g.Any(Function(v) Double.IsNaN(v) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(v))) Then Throw New ArgumentException("At least two nonempty finite groups and matching names are required.")
                If (CInt(options.Homogeneity) And Not CInt(HomogeneityMethods.All)) <> 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported homogeneity options.")
                If input.Sources.Count = 0 Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "No physical observation mapping was supplied; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Dim seenSources As New HashSet(Of Tuple(Of Integer, Integer))
                For Each source In input.Sources
                    If source Is Nothing OrElse source.GroupIndex < 0 OrElse source.GroupIndex >= groups.Length OrElse
                       source.ObservationIndex < 0 OrElse source.ObservationIndex >= groups(source.GroupIndex).Length OrElse
                       source.SelectedRow < 0 OrElse source.SelectedColumn < 0 OrElse source.WorksheetRow < 0 OrElse source.WorksheetColumn < 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Original observation source mapping is invalid.")
                    If Not seenSources.Add(Tuple.Create(source.GroupIndex, source.ObservationIndex)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("An original observation has ambiguous source mappings.")
                Next
                'Preserve existing invalid-alpha normalization AND warning policy in the unchanged dispatcher.
                result = SharedAnalysisApplicationService.Run(New SpreadsheetAnalysisRequest(options.Kind, New GroupedNumericData(names, groups), options.ToAnalysisOptions()))
                Dim detail = TryCast(result.Detail, OneWayAnovaApplicationResult)
                If detail IsNot Nothing Then
                    If options.Lsd AndAlso detail.FisherLsdPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.FisherLsdPlotData)
                    If options.Bonferroni AndAlso detail.BonferroniPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.BonferroniPlotData)
                    If options.Tukey AndAlso detail.TukeyKramerPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.TukeyKramerPlotData)
                    If options.GamesHowell AndAlso detail.GamesHowellPlotData IsNot Nothing Then plots.Add(detail.GamesHowellPlotData)
                End If
                For Each warning In result.Document.Warnings
                    Issue(issues, warning.Code, warning.Message, warning.FieldPath, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                Next
                ObserveUndefined(result.Tables, issues)
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : result = Nothing : plots.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_GROUPED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "workflow")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaGroupedWorkflowResult(input, options, result, issues, plots, failure)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildSupplements(input As AssumptionReportInput, options As AnovaGroupedWorkflowOptions,
                                                Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AssumptionReportResult
            Dim tables As New List(Of AssumptionTableSpecification), issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Dim working = If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Groups), failure As Exception = Nothing
            Dim stages As New List(Of AssumptionOutputStage)
            Try
                If input Is Nothing OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Input and workflow options are required.")
                For Each stage In New AnovaWorkflowPlan(options).Stages
                    cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                    If stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.PrimaryTables Then Continue For
                    If stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.WindowsBoxSummary Then
                        stages.Add(AssumptionOutputStage.WindowsBoxSummaryAndChart)
                        Continue For
                    End If
                    Dim kind = If(stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.Descriptive, AssumptionReportKind.Descriptive, AssumptionReportKind.Homogeneity)
                    'These are computational scratch vectors, possibly sorted by an earlier
                    'supplement. Original provenance remains on input, never on this scratch.
                    Dim report = AssumptionReportPolicy.Build(New AssumptionReportInput(working, input.Names),
                        New AssumptionReportOptions(kind, homogeneity:=options.Homogeneity), cancellation)
                    working = report.LegacyWorkingGroups
                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues)
                    report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables)
                    stages.Add(If(stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.Descriptive, AssumptionOutputStage.DescriptiveTable, AssumptionOutputStage.PrimaryTable))
                Next
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear() : stages.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_SUPPLEMENT_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "supplements")
            End Try
            Return New AssumptionReportResult(tables, issues, stages, working, failure)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function RunRepeated(matrix As Double(,), names As String(), options As RepeatedAnovaWorkflowOptions,
                                           Optional sources As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks = Nothing,
                                           Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Dim working = If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(matrix.Clone(), Double(,)))
            Dim labels = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), calls As New List(Of String), tables As New List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim failure As Exception = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If working Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse working.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse working.GetLength(1) < 2 OrElse labels.Length <> working.GetLength(1) OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Complete subject rows and at least two named treatments are required.")
                If Double.IsNaN(options.Alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(options.Alpha) OrElse options.Alpha <= 0 OrElse options.Alpha >= 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Alpha must be finite and between zero and one.")
                For Each value In working
                    If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Repeated ANOVA requires finite complete blocks.")
                Next
                ValidateSources(working, sources, issues)
                If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                Dim model As New parametric.OneWayRmANOVA(working, labels)
                calls.Add("compute") : model.compute()
                If options.GreenhouseGeisser Then
                    calls.Add("GreenhouseGeisser") : model.GreenhouseGeisser()
                End If
                If options.HuynhFeldt Then
                    calls.Add("HuyhnFeldt") : model.HuyhnFeldt()
                End If
                If options.Tukey Then
                    calls.Add("TukeyKramerRM2") : model.TukeyKramerRM2(options.Alpha)
                    calls.Add("Tukey") : model.Tukey(options.Alpha)
                End If
                calls.Add("wrapResults") : tables.AddRange(model.wrapResults())
                If options.Mauchly Then
                    calls.Add("MauchlyTest")
                    Dim test = assumptions.MauchlyTest(working), table As New ResultTable
                    table.SetBody(New Object(,) {{"Chi2", test.TestStatistics1}, {"P-value", test.Pvalue}})
                    table.AddHeaderTopRow({"Mauchly 's Test of Sphericity", ""})
                    table.AddPvalueCellToFormat(2, 2) : tables.Add(table)
                End If
                If options.Descriptive Then
                    calls.Add("Descriptive")
                    Dim groups = Enumerable.Range(0, labels.Length).Select(Function(c) DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(working, c)).ToArray()
                    Dim report = AssumptionReportPolicy.Build(New AssumptionReportInput(groups, labels), New AssumptionReportOptions(AssumptionReportKind.Descriptive), cancellation)
                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues) : report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToLegacyTable()))
                End If
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                ObserveUndefined(tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), issues)
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_REPEATED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "repeated")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaModelReportResult(tables, issues, calls, working, Nothing, sources, Nothing, Nothing, failure, options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.BoxSummary)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function RunRepeated(input As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks, options As RepeatedAnovaWorkflowOptions,
                                           Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Return RunRepeated(If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Matrix), If(input Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Names.ToArray()), options, input, cancellation)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ValidateSources(matrix As Double(,), sources As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue))
            If sources Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "No physical row provenance was supplied; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Return
            End If
            If sources.Blocks.Count <> matrix.GetLength(0) OrElse sources.Names.Count <> matrix.GetLength(1) Then
                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_MAP", "Source dimensions do not match the original matrix.", "sources")
                Return
            End If
            Dim seen As New HashSet(Of Integer)
            For r = 0 To sources.Blocks.Count - 1
                Dim row = sources.Blocks(r)(0).WorksheetRow
                If row > 0 AndAlso Not seen.Add(row) Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_DUPLICATE_BLOCK", "Duplicate physical subject row.", "sources")
                For c = 0 To matrix.GetLength(1) - 1
                    Dim source = sources.Blocks(r)(c)
                    If source.Value <> matrix(r, c) OrElse source.WorksheetRow <> row Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_MAP", "Original source values/rows disagree with the block matrix.", "sources")
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function RunNested(matrix As Object(,), names As String(), Optional sources As SpreadsheetNestedInput = Nothing,
                                         Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing,
                                         Optional originalSource As SpreadsheetNestedInput = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Dim working = If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(matrix.Clone(), Object(,)))
            Dim labels = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), calls As New List(Of String), tables As New List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim failure As Exception = Nothing, balanced As Boolean? = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If working Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse working.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse working.GetLength(1) < 3 OrElse labels.Length <> working.GetLength(1) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Named group, nested factor and response columns are required.")
                Dim parents As New Dictionary(Of String, HashSet(Of String))(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                For r = 0 To working.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For c = 0 To working.GetLength(1) - 1
                        Dim value = working(r, c)
                        If value Is Nothing OrElse (Not TypeOf value Is String AndAlso Not IsNumericType(value)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Only detached text/numeric cells are supported.")
                        If c < 2 AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Convert.ToString(value, Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested labels must be nonempty.")
                        If c >= 2 Then
                            Dim numeric = Convert.ToDouble(value, Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                            If Double.IsNaN(numeric) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(numeric) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Responses must be finite.")
                        End If
                    Next
                    Dim parent = Convert.ToString(working(r, 0), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                    Dim child = Convert.ToString(working(r, 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                    If Not parents.ContainsKey(child) Then parents.Add(child, New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal))
                    parents(child).Add(parent)
                Next
                If parents.Values.Any(Function(p) p.Count > 1) Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_NESTED_GLOBAL_LABEL", "Existing Core requires globally unique subgroup labels and rejects a repeated label under different parents. No automatic recoding was applied.", "nested.labels", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                If working.GetLength(1) > 3 Then Issue(issues, "ANOVA_NESTED_EXTRA_RESPONSES", "Existing Core uses the first response column only; extra original columns are retained.", "nested.responses", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                If sources Is Nothing Then
                    Issue(issues, "ANOVA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", "Physical source provenance is unavailable; none is invented.", "sources", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information)
                Else
                    Dim response(working.GetLength(0) - 1, working.GetLength(1) - 3) As Double
                    If sources.GroupLabels.Count <> working.GetLength(0) OrElse sources.NestedLabels.Count <> working.GetLength(0) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested source labels have invalid dimensions.")
                    For r = 0 To working.GetLength(0) - 1
                        If sources.GroupLabels(r) <> Convert.ToString(working(r, 0), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) OrElse
                           sources.NestedLabels(r) <> Convert.ToString(working(r, 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nested source labels disagree with the original matrix.")
                        For c = 2 To working.GetLength(1) - 1
                            response(r, c - 2) = Convert.ToDouble(working(r, c), Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                        Next
                    Next
                    ValidateSources(response, sources.Responses, issues)
                    If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                End If
                calls.Add("TwoWayNestedANOVA")
                Dim model As New parametric.TwoWayNestedANOVA(working, labels)
                calls.Add("compute") : model.compute()
                calls.Add("wrapResults") : tables.AddRange(model.wrapResults())
                balanced = model.balancedDesign
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                ObserveUndefined(tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), issues)
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear() : balanced = Nothing
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_NESTED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "nested")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaModelReportResult(tables, issues, calls, Nothing, working, Nothing, sources, balanced, failure, False, originalSource)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function RunNested(input As SpreadsheetNestedInput, Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            If input Is Nothing Then Return RunNested(Nothing, Nothing, Nothing, cancellation)
            If input.Responses Is Nothing OrElse input.GroupLabels.Count <> input.Responses.Blocks.Count OrElse input.NestedLabels.Count <> input.Responses.Blocks.Count Then Return RunNested(Nothing, Nothing, input, cancellation)
            Dim matrix(input.Responses.Blocks.Count - 1, input.Responses.Names.Count + 1) As Object
            For r = 0 To input.Responses.Blocks.Count - 1
                matrix(r, 0) = input.GroupLabels(r) : matrix(r, 1) = input.NestedLabels(r)
                For c = 0 To input.Responses.Names.Count - 1
                    matrix(r, c + 2) = input.Responses.Blocks(r)(c).Value
                Next
            Next
            Return RunNested(matrix, New String() {"Group", "Nested"}.Concat(input.Responses.Names).ToArray(), input, cancellation)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function IsNumericType(value As Object) As Boolean
            Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType())
                Case TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16, TypeCode.Int32, TypeCode.UInt32,
                     TypeCode.Int64, TypeCode.UInt64, TypeCode.Single, TypeCode.Double, TypeCode.Decimal
                    Return True
            End Select
            Return False
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub ObserveUndefined(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTableOutputModel), issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue))
            Dim index = 0
            For Each table In tables
                For r = 0 To table.RowCount - 1
                    For c = 0 To table.ColumnCount - 1
                        If TypeOf table.Values(r, c) Is Double Then
                            Dim value = CDbl(table.Values(r, c))
                            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then
                                Issue(issues, "ANOVA_UNDEFINED_RESULT", "Existing Core returned an undefined/nonfinite cell; no finite value or NA label was substituted.",
                                    String.Format(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "tables[{0}].cells[{1},{2}]", index, r, c), SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                            End If
                        End If
                    Next
                Next
                index += 1
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

            Dim tables As New List(Of AssumptionTableSpecification), issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)

                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues)
                    report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables)
                    stages.Add(If(stage = AnovaWorkflowStage.Descriptive, AssumptionOutputStage.DescriptiveTable, AssumptionOutputStage.PrimaryTable))
                Next

                failure = ex : tables.Clear() : stages.Clear()

Public Shared Function RunRepeated(matrix As Double(,), names As String(), options As RepeatedAnovaWorkflowOptions,
                                           Optional sources As SpreadsheetNumericBlocks = Nothing,
                                           Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing) As AnovaModelReportResult
            Dim working = If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(matrix.Clone(), Double(,)))
            Dim labels = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), calls As New List(Of String), tables As New List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim failure As Exception = Nothing
            Try
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                If working Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse working.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse working.GetLength(1) < 2 OrElse labels.Length <> working.GetLength(1) OrElse options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Complete subject rows and at least two named treatments are required.")
                If Double.IsNaN(options.Alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(options.Alpha) OrElse options.Alpha <= 0 OrElse options.Alpha >= 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Alpha must be finite and between zero and one.")
                For Each value In working
                    If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Repeated ANOVA requires finite complete blocks.")
                Next
                ValidateSources(working, sources, issues)
                If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                Dim model As New parametric.OneWayRmANOVA(working, labels)
                calls.Add("compute") : model.compute()
                If options.GreenhouseGeisser Then
                    calls.Add("GreenhouseGeisser") : model.GreenhouseGeisser()
                End If
                If options.HuynhFeldt Then
                    calls.Add("HuyhnFeldt") : model.HuyhnFeldt()
                End If
                If options.Tukey Then
                    calls.Add("TukeyKramerRM2") : model.TukeyKramerRM2(options.Alpha)
                    calls.Add("Tukey") : model.Tukey(options.Alpha)
                End If
                calls.Add("wrapResults") : tables.AddRange(model.wrapResults())
                If options.Mauchly Then
                    calls.Add("MauchlyTest")
                    Dim test = assumptions.MauchlyTest(working), table As New ResultTable
                    table.SetBody(New Object(,) {{"Chi2", test.TestStatistics1}, {"P-value", test.Pvalue}})
                    table.AddHeaderTopRow({"Mauchly 's Test of Sphericity", ""})
                    table.AddPvalueCellToFormat(2, 2) : tables.Add(table)
                End If
                If options.Descriptive Then
                    calls.Add("Descriptive")
                    Dim groups = Enumerable.Range(0, labels.Length).Select(Function(c) DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(working, c)).ToArray()
                    Dim report = AssumptionReportPolicy.Build(New AssumptionReportInput(groups, labels), New AssumptionReportOptions(AssumptionReportKind.Descriptive), cancellation)
                    issues.AddRange(report.Validation.Issues) : report.ThrowIfFailed()
                    tables.AddRange(report.Tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToLegacyTable()))
                End If
                cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                ObserveUndefined(tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), issues)
            Catch ex As Exception
                failure = ex : tables.Clear()
                Issue(issues, If(TypeOf ex Is OperationCanceledException, "ANOVA_CANCELLED", "ANOVA_REPEATED_FAILURE"), ex.Message, "repeated")
            End Try
            Return New AnovaModelReportResult(tables, issues, calls, working, Nothing, sources, Nothing, Nothing, failure, options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.BoxSummary)
        End Function

            Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType())
