    Public Function BuildAutomaticNumberFormat(stepValue As Double,
                                                       scaleMaximum As Double,
                                                       additionalValue As Nullable(Of Double)) As String
        Dim values As New List(Of Double) From {Math.Abs(stepValue), Math.Abs(scaleMaximum)}
        If additionalValue.HasValue Then values.Add(Math.Abs(additionalValue.Value))

        For Each value As Double In values
            If Not IsFinite(value) Then Return "0.###"
            If value > 0.0R AndAlso (value >= 1.0E8R OrElse value < 1.0E-6R) Then
                Return "0.###E+0"
            End If
        Next

        Dim requiredDecimals As Integer = 0
        For Each value As Double In values
            requiredDecimals = Math.Max(requiredDecimals, RequiredDecimalPlaces(value))
        Next

        If requiredDecimals <= 0 Then Return "0"
        If requiredDecimals <= 8 Then Return "0." & New String("0"c, requiredDecimals)
        Return "0.########"
    End Function
    Public Function RequiredDecimalPlaces(value As Double) As Integer
        If value = 0.0R Then Return 0

        For decimals As Integer = 0 To 8
            Dim scale As Double = Math.Pow(10.0R, decimals)
            Dim scaled As Double = value * scale
            If Math.Abs(scaled - Math.Round(scaled)) <= 1.0E-9R * Math.Max(1.0R, Math.Abs(scaled)) Then
                Return decimals
            End If
        Next
        Return 8
    End Function

        Dim cleanValue As Double = value
        If Math.Abs(cleanValue) < 1.0E-14R Then cleanValue = 0.0R
        Return cleanValue.ToString(format, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
    End Function

    Public Function ResolveAxisContext(results() As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                               appearance As CdfChartSettings34) As AxisContext
        Dim xMinimum As Double = Double.PositiveInfinity
        Dim xMaximum As Double = Double.NegativeInfinity
        Dim explicitMinimum As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
        Dim explicitMaximum As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
        Dim yScale As CumulativeDistributionYScale = results(0).Options.YScale

        For Each result As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult In results
            xMinimum = Math.Min(xMinimum, result.XMinimum)
            xMaximum = Math.Max(xMaximum, result.XMaximum)

            Dim options As CumulativeDistributionPlotOptions = result.Options
            If options.XMinimum.HasValue Then explicitMinimum = options.XMinimum.Value
            If options.XMaximum.HasValue Then explicitMaximum = options.XMaximum.Value
        Next

        If Not IsFinite(xMinimum) OrElse Not IsFinite(xMaximum) OrElse xMaximum <= xMinimum Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("The cumulative-distribution result does not contain a finite X range.", NameOf(results))
        End If

        Dim scale As ChartAxisScaleResult = ChartAxisScalingCore.Compute(xMinimum, xMaximum)
        Dim resolvedMinimum As Double = If(explicitMinimum.HasValue, explicitMinimum.Value, scale.Min)
        Dim resolvedMaximum As Double = If(explicitMaximum.HasValue, explicitMaximum.Value, scale.Max)

        If resolvedMaximum <= resolvedMinimum Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("The resolved CDF X-axis maximum must be larger than its minimum.", NameOf(results))
        End If

        Dim majorUnit As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.HasValue Then
            majorUnit = appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.Value
        Else
            Dim resolvedScale As ChartAxisScaleResult = ChartAxisScalingCore.Compute(resolvedMinimum, resolvedMaximum)
            majorUnit = resolvedScale.Scale
        End If

        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then
            majorUnit = Math.Max((resolvedMaximum - resolvedMinimum) / 5.0R, 1.0R)
        End If

        Dim xNumberFormat As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.XAxisNumberFormat),
                                         AutomaticNumberFormat(majorUnit),
                                         appearance.XAxisNumberFormat.Trim())

        Dim context As New AxisContext With {
            .XMinimum = resolvedMinimum,
            .XMaximum = resolvedMaximum,
            .XMajorUnit = majorUnit,
            .XNumberFormat = xNumberFormat
        }

        If yScale = CumulativeDistributionYScale.Percent Then
            context.YMinimum = 0.0R
            context.YMaximum = 100.0R
            context.YMajorUnit = 20.0R
            context.YNumberFormat = "0"
            context.YAxisTitle = "Percent"
        Else
            context.YMinimum = 0.0R
            context.YMaximum = 1.0R
            context.YMajorUnit = 0.2R
            context.YNumberFormat = "0.0"
            context.YAxisTitle = "Cumulative probability"
        End If

        Return context
    End Function
    Public Function FormatPercentileLabel(percentile As CumulativeDistributionPercentile,
                                                  seriesName As String,
                                                  appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                                  isMultiSeries As Boolean) As String
        Dim percentText As String
        If Math.Abs(percentile.Percent - Math.Round(percentile.Percent)) < 1.0E-10R Then
            percentText = Math.Round(percentile.Percent).ToString("0", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & "%"
        Else
            percentText = percentile.Percent.ToString("0.###", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & "%"
        End If

        Dim valueFormat As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.PercentileValueFormat),
                                       "0.###",
                                       appearance.PercentileValueFormat.Trim())
        Dim valueText As String = percentile.XValue.ToString(valueFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
        Dim body As String = percentText & " = " & valueText

        If isMultiSeries AndAlso appearance.IncludeSeriesNameInPercentileLabels AndAlso
           Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(seriesName) Then
            Return seriesName.Trim() & ": " & body
        End If

        Return body
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveChartTitle(results() As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                              appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                              isOverlay As Boolean) As String
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.ChartTitle) Then Return appearance.ChartTitle.Trim()

        Dim options As CumulativeDistributionPlotOptions = results(0).Options
        Dim baseTitle As String

        Select Case options.Mode
            Case CumulativeDistributionPlotMode.EmpiricalOnly
                baseTitle = "Empirical cumulative distribution"
            Case CumulativeDistributionPlotMode.FittedDistributionOnly
                baseTitle = DistributionShortName(options.Distribution) & " cumulative distribution"
            Case Else
                baseTitle = "Empirical CDF with " & DistributionShortName(options.Distribution) & " fit"
        End Select

        If Not isOverlay AndAlso results.Length = 1 AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(results(0).SeriesName) Then
            baseTitle &= " of " & results(0).SeriesName.Trim()
        End If

        Return baseTitle
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveEmpiricalSeriesName(result As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                                       appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                                       resultCount As Integer) As String
        Dim groupName As String = ResolveGroupLegendName(result)
        If appearance.LegendMode = CumulativeDistributionLegendMode.GroupsOnly Then Return groupName
        Return groupName & " - ECDF"
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveFittedSeriesName(result As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                                    appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                                    resultCount As Integer) As String
        Dim groupName As String = ResolveGroupLegendName(result)
        If appearance.LegendMode = CumulativeDistributionLegendMode.GroupsOnly Then Return groupName

        Dim fitName As String
        If result.Fit IsNot Nothing Then
            fitName = DistributionShortName(result.Fit.Distribution)
        Else
            fitName = DistributionShortName(result.Options.Distribution)
        End If
        Return groupName & " - " & fitName & " fit"
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveGroupLegendName(result As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult) As String
        If result Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.SeriesName) Then Return "Data"
        Return result.SeriesName.Trim()
    End Function
    Public Function DistributionShortName(kind As CumulativeDistributionKind) As String
        Select Case kind
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Normal
                Return "Normal"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Lognormal
                Return "Lognormal"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterLognormal
                Return "3-parameter lognormal"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Gamma
                Return "Gamma"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterGamma
                Return "3-parameter gamma"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Exponential
                Return "Exponential"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.TwoParameterExponential
                Return "2-parameter exponential"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.SmallestExtremeValue
                Return "Smallest extreme value"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Weibull
                Return "Weibull"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterWeibull
                Return "3-parameter Weibull"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.LargestExtremeValue
                Return "Largest extreme value"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Logistic
                Return "Logistic"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Loglogistic
                Return "Loglogistic"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterLoglogistic
                Return "3-parameter loglogistic"
            Case Else
                Return kind.ToString()
        End Select
    End Function
    Public Function AutomaticNumberFormat(majorUnit As Double) As String
        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then Return "0.###"

        Dim absoluteUnit As Double = Math.Abs(majorUnit)
        If absoluteUnit >= 1.0R Then Return "0.###"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.1R Then Return "0.0##"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.01R Then Return "0.00##"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.001R Then Return "0.000##"
        Return "0.#####"
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinite(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinitePositive(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return IsFinite(value) AndAlso value > 0.0R
    End Function
End Module

    Public Function ResolveAxisContext(results() As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                               appearance As CdfChartSettings34) As AxisContext
        Dim xMinimum As Double = Double.PositiveInfinity
        Dim xMaximum As Double = Double.NegativeInfinity
        Dim explicitMinimum As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
        Dim explicitMaximum As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
        Dim yScale As CumulativeDistributionYScale = results(0).Options.YScale

        For Each result As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult In results
            xMinimum = Math.Min(xMinimum, result.XMinimum)
            xMaximum = Math.Max(xMaximum, result.XMaximum)

            Dim options As CumulativeDistributionPlotOptions = result.Options
            If options.XMinimum.HasValue Then explicitMinimum = options.XMinimum.Value
            If options.XMaximum.HasValue Then explicitMaximum = options.XMaximum.Value
        Next

        If Not IsFinite(xMinimum) OrElse Not IsFinite(xMaximum) OrElse xMaximum <= xMinimum Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("The cumulative-distribution result does not contain a finite X range.", NameOf(results))
        End If

        Dim scale As ChartAxisScaleResult = ChartAxisScalingCore.Compute(xMinimum, xMaximum)
        Dim resolvedMinimum As Double = If(explicitMinimum.HasValue, explicitMinimum.Value, scale.Min)
        Dim resolvedMaximum As Double = If(explicitMaximum.HasValue, explicitMaximum.Value, scale.Max)

        If resolvedMaximum <= resolvedMinimum Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("The resolved CDF X-axis maximum must be larger than its minimum.", NameOf(results))
        End If

        Dim majorUnit As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.HasValue Then
            majorUnit = appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.Value
        Else
            Dim resolvedScale As ChartAxisScaleResult = ChartAxisScalingCore.Compute(resolvedMinimum, resolvedMaximum)
            majorUnit = resolvedScale.Scale
        End If

        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then
            majorUnit = Math.Max((resolvedMaximum - resolvedMinimum) / 5.0R, 1.0R)
        End If

        Dim xNumberFormat As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.XAxisNumberFormat),
                                         AutomaticNumberFormat(majorUnit),
                                         appearance.XAxisNumberFormat.Trim())

        Dim context As New AxisContext With {
            .XMinimum = resolvedMinimum,
            .XMaximum = resolvedMaximum,
            .XMajorUnit = majorUnit,
            .XNumberFormat = xNumberFormat
        }

        If yScale = CumulativeDistributionYScale.Percent Then
            context.YMinimum = 0.0R
            context.YMaximum = 100.0R
            context.YMajorUnit = 20.0R
            context.YNumberFormat = "0"
            context.YAxisTitle = "Percent"
        Else
            context.YMinimum = 0.0R
            context.YMaximum = 1.0R
            context.YMajorUnit = 0.2R
            context.YNumberFormat = "0.0"
            context.YAxisTitle = "Cumulative probability"
        End If

        Return context
    End Function
    Public Function FormatPercentileLabel(percentile As CumulativeDistributionPercentile,
                                                  seriesName As String,
                                                  appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                                  isMultiSeries As Boolean) As String
        Dim percentText As String
        If Math.Abs(percentile.Percent - Math.Round(percentile.Percent)) < 1.0E-10R Then
            percentText = Math.Round(percentile.Percent).ToString("0", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & "%"
        Else
            percentText = percentile.Percent.ToString("0.###", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & "%"
        End If

        Dim valueFormat As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.PercentileValueFormat),
                                       "0.###",
                                       appearance.PercentileValueFormat.Trim())
        Dim valueText As String = percentile.XValue.ToString(valueFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
        Dim body As String = percentText & " = " & valueText

        If isMultiSeries AndAlso appearance.IncludeSeriesNameInPercentileLabels AndAlso
           Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(seriesName) Then
            Return seriesName.Trim() & ": " & body
        End If

        Return body
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveChartTitle(results() As CumulativeDistributionPlotResult,
                                              appearance As CdfChartSettings34,
                                              isOverlay As Boolean) As String
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.ChartTitle) Then Return appearance.ChartTitle.Trim()

        Dim options As CumulativeDistributionPlotOptions = results(0).Options
        Dim baseTitle As String

        Select Case options.Mode
            Case CumulativeDistributionPlotMode.EmpiricalOnly
                baseTitle = "Empirical cumulative distribution"
            Case CumulativeDistributionPlotMode.FittedDistributionOnly
                baseTitle = DistributionShortName(options.Distribution) & " cumulative distribution"
            Case Else
                baseTitle = "Empirical CDF with " & DistributionShortName(options.Distribution) & " fit"
        End Select

        If Not isOverlay AndAlso results.Length = 1 AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(results(0).SeriesName) Then
            baseTitle &= " of " & results(0).SeriesName.Trim()
        End If

        Return baseTitle
    End Function

        Select Case kind

                Return "Normal"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Lognormal
                Return "Lognormal"

                Return "3-parameter lognormal"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Gamma

                Return "3-parameter gamma"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Exponential

            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.TwoParameterExponential
                Return "2-parameter exponential"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.SmallestExtremeValue
                Return "Smallest extreme value"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Weibull
                Return "Weibull"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterWeibull
                Return "3-parameter Weibull"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.LargestExtremeValue
                Return "Largest extreme value"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Logistic
                Return "Logistic"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.Loglogistic
                Return "Loglogistic"
            Case CumulativeDistributionKind.ThreeParameterLoglogistic

            Case Else
                Return kind.ToString()
        End Select
    End Function
    Public Function AutomaticNumberFormat(majorUnit As Double) As String
        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then Return "0.###"

        Dim absoluteUnit As Double = Math.Abs(majorUnit)
        If absoluteUnit >= 1.0R Then Return "0.###"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.1R Then Return "0.0##"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.01R Then Return "0.00##"
        If absoluteUnit >= 0.001R Then Return "0.000##"
        Return "0.#####"
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinite(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinitePositive(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return IsFinite(value) AndAlso value > 0.0R
    End Function

        Private ReadOnly _options As CoxOptions

        End Function
        ''' <summary>Existing Windows validation/conversion remains authoritative for shipping
        ''' refusal timing. No new IsValid gate, exception handling or Fit call is inserted.</summary>
        Public Function CreateAcquiredModel(records As List(Of SurvivalRecord)) As CoxPH
            Dim fit As New CoxPH(SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.CopyRecords(records), Expanded.Names, _options.MaximumIterations, _options.Epsilon)
            fit.startParams = Expanded.InitialValues
            fit.bRobustVariance = _options.RobustVariance : fit.bReturnCov = _options.ReturnCovariance
            fit.bComputeAllResiduals = _options.AllResiduals : fit.bComputePHScoreTest = _options.PHScoreTest

    Public NotInheritable Class CoxWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared ReadOnly Property OmitCategoricalReference As Boolean
            Get
                Return True
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Shared Function InitialValuesCountMatches(values() As Double, expandedParameterCount As Integer) As Boolean
            Return values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length = expandedParameterCount
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Validate(input As SurvivalInput, expanded As RegressionComponent, options As CoxOptions) As RegressionValidation
            options = If(options, New CoxOptions())
            Dim issues = SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Validate(SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox, input, New SurvivalOptions With {.Alpha = options.Alpha}).Diagnostics.ToList()
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(TieMethod), options.Ties) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.ties", "Unknown Cox tie method.")
            If options.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.iterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(options.Epsilon) OrElse options.Epsilon <= 0 Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.epsilon", "Epsilon must be positive and finite.")
            If expanded Is Nothing OrElse expanded.Data Is Nothing OrElse expanded.Names Is Nothing OrElse expanded.RowIds Is Nothing Then
                SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.predictors", "Expanded predictors, names and source rows are required.")
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            Dim x = expanded.Data, names = expanded.Names, rows = expanded.RowIds, p = x.GetLength(1)
            If p = 0 OrElse names.Length <> p OrElse names.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse names.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> names.Length Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.names", "Expanded coefficient names must be present, distinct and aligned with columns.")
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Time Is Nothing OrElse input.Time.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not rows.SequenceEqual(input.Time.RowIds) OrElse rows.Length <> x.GetLength(0) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.rows", "Expanded design and survival roles must retain exactly the same row identities/order.")
            For Each value In x
                If Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(value) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.predictors.finite", "Expanded predictors must be finite.") : Exit For
            Next
            Dim initial = expanded.InitialValues
            If Not InitialValuesCountMatches(initial, p) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.starts.count", "Supplied starts must match the expanded coefficient count.")
            If initial IsNot Nothing AndAlso initial.Any(Function(v) Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(v)) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.starts.finite", "Supplied starts must be finite.")
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues, p, 0, {})
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Same positional expansion bridge as the original form. Core design authoring
        ''' has already expanded the selected TermSpecs; this function does not parse effects.</summary>
        Public Shared Function BuildExpandedRecords(input As SurvivalInput, x(,) As Double) As List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            Dim times = input.Time.Values, status = input.Status.Values, ids = input.Time.RowIds
            Dim strata = If(input.Strata Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Strata.Values), records As New List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            For i = 0 To times.Length - 1
                Dim row = i
                Dim values = If(x Is Nothing, Array.Empty(Of Double)(), Enumerable.Range(0, x.GetLength(1)).Select(Function(j) x(row, j)).ToArray())
                records.Add(New SurvivalRecord With {.Time = times(i), .Censorship = CInt(status(i)), .Index = ids(i),
                    .Stratum = If(strata Is Nothing, "0", strata(i)), .Covariates = values})
            Next
            Return records
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Shared Function Validate(input As SurvivalInput, expanded As RegressionComponent, options As CoxOptions) As RegressionValidation
            options = If(options, New CoxOptions())
            Dim issues = SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Validate(SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox, input, New SurvivalOptions With {.Alpha = options.Alpha}).Diagnostics.ToList()
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(TieMethod), options.Ties) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.ties", "Unknown Cox tie method.")
            If options.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.iterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(options.Epsilon) OrElse options.Epsilon <= 0 Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.epsilon", "Epsilon must be positive and finite.")
            If expanded Is Nothing OrElse expanded.Data Is Nothing OrElse expanded.Names Is Nothing OrElse expanded.RowIds Is Nothing Then
                SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.predictors", "Expanded predictors, names and source rows are required.")
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            Dim x = expanded.Data, names = expanded.Names, rows = expanded.RowIds, p = x.GetLength(1)
            If p = 0 OrElse names.Length <> p OrElse names.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse names.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> names.Length Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.names", "Expanded coefficient names must be present, distinct and aligned with columns.")
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Time Is Nothing OrElse input.Time.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not rows.SequenceEqual(input.Time.RowIds) OrElse rows.Length <> x.GetLength(0) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.rows", "Expanded design and survival roles must retain exactly the same row identities/order.")
            For Each value In x
                If Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(value) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.predictors.finite", "Expanded predictors must be finite.") : Exit For
            Next
            Dim initial = expanded.InitialValues
            If Not InitialValuesCountMatches(initial, p) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.starts.count", "Supplied starts must match the expanded coefficient count.")
            If initial IsNot Nothing AndAlso initial.Any(Function(v) Not SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Finite(v)) Then SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "cox.starts.finite", "Supplied starts must be finite.")
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues, p, 0, {})
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Same positional expansion bridge as the original form. Core design authoring
        ''' has already expanded the selected TermSpecs; this function does not parse effects.</summary>
        Public Shared Function BuildExpandedRecords(input As SurvivalInput, x(,) As Double) As List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            Dim times = input.Time.Values, status = input.Status.Values, ids = input.Time.RowIds
            Dim strata = If(input.Strata Is Nothing, Nothing, input.Strata.Values), records As New List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            For i = 0 To times.Length - 1
                Dim row = i
                Dim values = If(x Is Nothing, Array.Empty(Of Double)(), Enumerable.Range(0, x.GetLength(1)).Select(Function(j) x(row, j)).ToArray())
                records.Add(New SurvivalRecord With {.Time = times(i), .Censorship = CInt(status(i)), .Index = ids(i),
                    .Stratum = If(strata Is Nothing, "0", strata(i)), .Covariates = values})
            Next
            Return records
        End Function

    Public Function ResolveAxisContext(result As DumbbellPlotResult,
                                               appearance As DumbbellChartSettings34) As AxisContext
        Dim dataMinimum As Double = result.MinimumValue
        Dim dataMaximum As Double = result.MaximumValue
        If Not IsFinite(dataMinimum) OrElse Not IsFinite(dataMaximum) Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("The dumbbell result does not contain a finite X range.", NameOf(result))
        End If

        Dim span As Double = dataMaximum - dataMinimum
        Dim fallbackSpan As Double
        If span > 0.0R Then
            fallbackSpan = span
        ElseIf result.AxisValueKind = DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue Then
            fallbackSpan = 2.0R
        Else
            fallbackSpan = Math.Max(1.0R, Math.Abs(dataMinimum) * 0.1R)
        End If

        Dim padding As Double = fallbackSpan * appearance.XAxisPaddingFraction
        If result.AxisValueKind = DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue Then
            padding = Math.Max(padding, 0.5R)
        End If

        Dim paddedMinimum As Double = dataMinimum - padding
        Dim paddedMaximum As Double = dataMaximum + padding
        If paddedMinimum >= paddedMaximum Then
            paddedMinimum = dataMinimum - 0.5R * fallbackSpan
            paddedMaximum = dataMaximum + 0.5R * fallbackSpan
        End If

        'Use a 1-2-5 "nice" step, mirroring the histogram bin-step logic, so the
        'automatic gridlines land on human-friendly values instead of starting at
        'an arbitrary padded minimum such as 13.012. Aim for about five intervals.
        Dim majorUnit As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.HasValue Then
            majorUnit = appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.Value
        Else
            majorUnit = NiceStep125((paddedMaximum - paddedMinimum) / 5.0R)
            If result.AxisValueKind = DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue Then
                'The default date tick format displays days, so sub-day automatic
                'ticks would only create repeated date labels.
                majorUnit = Math.Max(1.0R, majorUnit)
            End If
        End If

        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then majorUnit = 1.0R

        Dim xMinimum As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMinimum.HasValue Then
            xMinimum = appearance.XAxisMinimum.Value
        Else
            xMinimum = FloorToStep(paddedMinimum, majorUnit)
        End If

        Dim xMaximum As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMaximum.HasValue Then
            xMaximum = appearance.XAxisMaximum.Value
        Else
            xMaximum = CeilingToStep(paddedMaximum, majorUnit)
        End If

        If xMinimum >= xMaximum Then
            If Not appearance.XAxisMinimum.HasValue AndAlso Not appearance.XAxisMaximum.HasValue Then
                xMinimum = FloorToStep(dataMinimum - 0.5R * fallbackSpan, majorUnit)
                xMaximum = CeilingToStep(dataMaximum + 0.5R * fallbackSpan, majorUnit)
                If xMinimum >= xMaximum Then xMaximum = xMinimum + majorUnit
            Else
                Throw New ArgumentException("The resolved X-axis minimum must be smaller than the X-axis maximum.", NameOf(appearance))
            End If
        End If

        Return New AxisContext With {
            .XMinimum = xMinimum,
            .XMaximum = xMaximum,
            .XMajorUnit = majorUnit,
            .YMinimum = 0.0R,
            .YMaximum = result.CategoryCount + 1.0R,
            .XNumberFormat = ResolveXAxisNumberFormat(result.AxisValueKind, appearance.XAxisNumberFormat)
        }
    End Function
    Public Function NiceStep125(rawStep As Double) As Double
        If Not IsFinitePositive(rawStep) Then Return 1.0R

        Dim exponent As Double = Math.Floor(Math.Log10(rawStep))
        Dim scale As Double = Math.Pow(10.0R, exponent)
        Dim fraction As Double = rawStep / scale
        Dim niceFraction As Double

        If fraction <= 1.0R Then
            niceFraction = 1.0R
        ElseIf fraction <= 2.0R Then
            niceFraction = 2.0R
        ElseIf fraction <= 5.0R Then
            niceFraction = 5.0R
        Else
            niceFraction = 10.0R
        End If

        Return niceFraction * scale
    End Function
    Public Function FloorToStep(value As Double, stepSize As Double) As Double
        Return Math.Floor(value / stepSize) * stepSize
    End Function
    Public Function CeilingToStep(value As Double, stepSize As Double) As Double
        Return Math.Ceiling(value / stepSize) * stepSize
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveXAxisNumberFormat(axisValueKind As DumbbellAxisValueKind,
                                                     requestedFormat As String) As String
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedFormat) Then Return requestedFormat.Trim()

        Select Case axisValueKind
            Case DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue
                Return "dd-mmm"
            Case DumbbellAxisValueKind.Numeric
                Return "0.###"
            Case Else
                Return "General"
        End Select
    End Function
    Public Function ResolveSeriesName(value As String, fallback As String) As String
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return fallback
        Return value.Trim()
    End Function
    Public Function SuggestedHeight(result As DumbbellPlotResult) As Double
        If result Is Nothing OrElse result.CategoryCount < 1 Then Return 360.0R
        Return Math.Max(340.0R, Math.Min(1400.0R, 145.0R + 22.0R * result.CategoryCount))
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinite(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
    End Function
    Private Function IsFinitePositive(value As Double) As Boolean
        Return IsFinite(value) AndAlso value > 0.0R
    End Function

        Dim padding As Double = fallbackSpan * appearance.XAxisPaddingFraction
        If result.AxisValueKind = DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue Then
            padding = Math.Max(padding, 0.5R)
        End If

        Dim paddedMinimum As Double = dataMinimum - padding
        Dim paddedMaximum As Double = dataMaximum + padding
        If paddedMinimum >= paddedMaximum Then
            paddedMinimum = dataMinimum - 0.5R * fallbackSpan
            paddedMaximum = dataMaximum + 0.5R * fallbackSpan
        End If

        'Use a 1-2-5 "nice" step, mirroring the histogram bin-step logic, so the
        'automatic gridlines land on human-friendly values instead of starting at
        'an arbitrary padded minimum such as 13.012. Aim for about five intervals.
        Dim majorUnit As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.HasValue Then
            majorUnit = appearance.XAxisMajorUnit.Value
        Else
            majorUnit = NiceStep125((paddedMaximum - paddedMinimum) / 5.0R)
            If result.AxisValueKind = DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue Then
                'The default date tick format displays days, so sub-day automatic
                'ticks would only create repeated date labels.
                majorUnit = Math.Max(1.0R, majorUnit)
            End If
        End If

        If Not IsFinitePositive(majorUnit) Then majorUnit = 1.0R

        Dim xMinimum As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMinimum.HasValue Then
            xMinimum = appearance.XAxisMinimum.Value
        Else
            xMinimum = FloorToStep(paddedMinimum, majorUnit)
        End If

        Dim xMaximum As Double
        If appearance.XAxisMaximum.HasValue Then
            xMaximum = appearance.XAxisMaximum.Value
        Else
            xMaximum = CeilingToStep(paddedMaximum, majorUnit)
        End If

        If xMinimum >= xMaximum Then
            If Not appearance.XAxisMinimum.HasValue AndAlso Not appearance.XAxisMaximum.HasValue Then
                xMinimum = FloorToStep(dataMinimum - 0.5R * fallbackSpan, majorUnit)
                xMaximum = CeilingToStep(dataMaximum + 0.5R * fallbackSpan, majorUnit)

            .YMinimum = 0.0R,
            .YMaximum = result.CategoryCount + 1.0R,
            .XNumberFormat = ResolveXAxisNumberFormat(result.AxisValueKind, appearance.XAxisNumberFormat)

    Public Function NiceStep125(rawStep As Double) As Double
        If Not IsFinitePositive(rawStep) Then Return 1.0R

        Dim exponent As Double = Math.Floor(Math.Log10(rawStep))
        Dim scale As Double = Math.Pow(10.0R, exponent)
        Dim fraction As Double = rawStep / scale
        Dim niceFraction As Double

        If fraction <= 1.0R Then
            niceFraction = 1.0R
        ElseIf fraction <= 2.0R Then
            niceFraction = 2.0R
        ElseIf fraction <= 5.0R Then
            niceFraction = 5.0R
        Else
            niceFraction = 10.0R
        End If

        Return niceFraction * scale
    End Function
    Public Function FloorToStep(value As Double, stepSize As Double) As Double
        Return Math.Floor(value / stepSize) * stepSize
    End Function
    Public Function CeilingToStep(value As Double, stepSize As Double) As Double
        Return Math.Ceiling(value / stepSize) * stepSize

    Public Function ResolveXAxisNumberFormat(axisValueKind As DumbbellAxisValueKind,
                                                     requestedFormat As String) As String
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedFormat) Then Return requestedFormat.Trim()

        Select Case axisValueKind
            Case DumbbellAxisValueKind.DateValue
                Return "dd-mmm"
            Case DumbbellAxisValueKind.Numeric

        If result Is Nothing OrElse result.CategoryCount < 1 Then Return 360.0R
        Return Math.Max(340.0R, Math.Min(1400.0R, 145.0R + 22.0R * result.CategoryCount))
    End Function

        Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)

Public Function Connectors(categories As DumbbellPlotCategory()) As SeriesPayload34
        Dim n As Integer = categories.Length
        Dim xStarts(n - 1) As Double
        Dim yValues(n - 1) As Double
        Dim connectorLengths(n - 1) As Double
        Dim hasVisibleConnector As Boolean = False

        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            xStarts(i) = categories(i).ConnectorStart
            yValues(i) = categories(i).YPosition
            connectorLengths(i) = categories(i).ConnectorLength
            If connectorLengths(i) > 0.0R Then hasVisibleConnector = True
        Next

        Dim n As Integer = categories.Length
        Dim xValues(n - 1) As Double
        Dim yValues(n - 1) As Double

        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            xValues(i) = If(useFirstEndpoint, categories(i).FirstValue, categories(i).SecondValue)
            yValues(i) = categories(i).YPosition
        Next

Return New SeriesPayload34(xValues, yValues, source:=categories.Select(Function(c) c.SourceIndex).ToArray())
End Function

        If observations Is Nothing OrElse observations.Length = 0 Then Return Nothing

            xValues(i) = observations(i).Value

    Public Enum RegressionDispersionMode
        NotApplicable
        EstimatedNegativeBinomial2
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>Four-family application intent over the accepted immutable request. ZIP owns
    ''' two independent components. Core expansion, fitting and category coding stay authoritative.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ExtendedRegressionIntent
        Friend Sub New(request As RegressionRequest)
            Me.Request = request : Me.Validation = RegressionRequestPolicy.Validate(request)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Request As RegressionRequest
        Public ReadOnly Property Validation As RegressionValidation
        Public ReadOnly Property Primary As RegressionComponent
            Get
                Return Request.Primary
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Logistic As RegressionComponent
            Get
                Return Request.Logistic
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Options As RegressionOptions
            Get
                Return Request.Options
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property PrimaryParameterCount As Integer
            Get
                Return Validation.PrimaryParameterCount
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property LogisticParameterCount As Integer
            Get
                Return Validation.LogisticParameterCount
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property PrimaryIntercept As Integer
            Get
                Return If(Primary.Effects.IncludeIntercept, 1, 0)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property LogisticIntercept As Integer
            Get
                Return If(Logistic IsNot Nothing AndAlso Logistic.Effects.IncludeIntercept, 1, 0)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property DispersionMode As RegressionDispersionMode
            Get
                Return If(Request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2, RegressionDispersionMode.EstimatedNegativeBinomial2, RegressionDispersionMode.NotApplicable)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Reference As ReferenceCategory
            Get
                Return Options.Reference
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function CreateLink() As Link
            If Request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Only the NB2 route selects a GLM link.")
            Dim o = Options
            Return If(o.Link = RegressionLink.Power, LinkUtils.createLink(o.Link.Value.ToString(), o.Power.GetValueOrDefault()), LinkUtils.createLink(o.Link.Value.ToString()))
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class ExtendedRegressionFamilyPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Project(request As RegressionRequest) As ExtendedRegressionIntent
            If request Is Nothing OrElse (request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 AndAlso request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal AndAlso request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.extended.family: Expected NB2, ZIP, ordinal or multinomial request.")
            ' Observation only in Windows: do not turn these diagnostics into a new refusal.
            Return New ExtendedRegressionIntent(request)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Compose(intent As ExtendedRegressionIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), rows As RegressionRowOutput,
                                       Optional converged As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing,
                                       Optional estimatedDispersion As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing) As ExtendedRegressionReport
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If rows Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(rows))
            Dim categorical = intent.Request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse intent.Request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial
            Dim fitted = rows.Fitted, categories = rows.Categories, residual = rows.Residuals
            If categorical Then
                If fitted IsNot Nothing AndAlso (categories Is Nothing OrElse fitted.GetLength(1) <> categories.Length) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.categories: Actual Core probability axes are required.")
                If categories IsNot Nothing AndAlso intent.Validation.IsValid AndAlso Not categories.OrderBy(Function(c) c).SequenceEqual(intent.Validation.ObservedClasses.OrderBy(Function(c) c)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.categories: Core class identities differ from the observed response.")
            ElseIf fitted IsNot Nothing AndAlso fitted.GetLength(1) <> 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.fitted.axis: Count response requires one fitted column.")
            End If
            If residual IsNot Nothing Then
                If residual.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse residual.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse rows.ResidualHeaderRows <> 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Core residual arrays require zero bounds and one header row.")
                Dim width As Integer = If(categorical, If(categories Is Nothing, 0, 5 * categories.Length + 3), If(intent.Request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson, 2, 7))
                If residual.GetLength(1) <> width Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Residual columns differ from the actual family/class axis.")
                For c = 0 To width - 1
                    If Not TypeOf residual(0, c) Is String Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.headers: Explicit Core headers are required.")
                Next
            End If
            Dim report = RegressionReportPolicy.Compose(intent.Request, tables, rows, converged)
            Return New ExtendedRegressionReport(intent, report, estimatedDispersion)
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

        Private ReadOnly _labels, _names As String()

        Private ReadOnly _counts As Integer()
        Friend Sub New(labels() As String, names() As String, contrast(,) As Double, counts() As Integer,
                       diagnostics As IEnumerable(Of RegressionDiagnostic))

            _contrast = DirectCast(contrast.Clone(), Double(,)) : _counts = DirectCast(counts.Clone(), Integer())
            Me.Diagnostics = New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)(diagnostics).AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

            Get
                Return DirectCast(_labels.Clone(), String())
            End Get

        Public ReadOnly Property ParameterNames As String()
            Get
                Return DirectCast(_names.Clone(), String())
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Contrast As Double(,)
            Get
                Return DirectCast(_contrast.Clone(), Double(,))
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property MatchedCounts As Integer()
            Get
                Return DirectCast(_counts.Clone(), Integer())
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Portable orchestration of existing UDF observed-profile selection and L rows.
    ''' No Wald inference, inverse link, estimator or public UDF export is implemented here.
    ''' AT/name/range parsing and actual statistical inference remain in the existing UDF.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class GeeContrastPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Project(design(,) As Double, names() As String,
                                       components As IEnumerable(Of GeeContrastComponent),
                                       Optional times() As Double = Nothing) As GeeContrastPlan
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), labels As New List(Of String), counts As New List(Of Integer)
            Dim contrasts As New Dictionary(Of String, Double())(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim add = Sub(code As String, message As String)
                          issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("gee.contrast." & code, "contrast", message))
                      End Sub
            Dim p = If(design Is Nothing, 0, design.GetLength(1)), parameterNames = If(names, Array.Empty(Of String)())
            If design Is Nothing OrElse design.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse design.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse parameterNames.Length <> p Then
                add("design", "Usable fitted design and exact parameter-name axis are required.")
            ElseIf components Is Nothing Then
                add("components.missing", "Contrast components were not supplied.")
            Else
                Dim supplied = components.ToList()
                If supplied.Count = 0 Then add("components.empty", "Supplied contrast selection is empty.")
                For Each component In supplied
                    If component Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(component.Label) Then
                        add("label", "Each component requires a label.") : Continue For
                    End If
                    If Not RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(component.Weight) Then add("weight", "Contrast weights must be finite.") : Continue For
                    If Math.Abs(component.Weight) <= 0.0 Then Continue For
                    Dim sums(p - 1) As Double, matched As Integer = 0
                    For i = 0 To design.GetLength(0) - 1
                        If component.Time.HasValue AndAlso (times Is Nothing OrElse times.Length <> design.GetLength(0) OrElse Not NearlyEqual(times(i), component.Time.Value)) Then Continue For
                        Dim match As Boolean = True
                        For Each value In component.Profile
                            If value.Key < 0 OrElse value.Key >= p OrElse Not NearlyEqual(design(i, value.Key), value.Value) Then match = False : Exit For
                        Next
                        If Not match Then Continue For
                        matched += 1
                        For j = 0 To p - 1 : sums(j) += design(i, j) : Next
                    Next
                    counts.Add(matched)
                    If matched <= 0 Then add("unmatched", "No observed design rows matched a supplied profile/time.") : Continue For
                    If Not contrasts.ContainsKey(component.Label) Then
                        contrasts.Add(component.Label, New Double(p - 1) {}) : labels.Add(component.Label)
                    End If
                    For j = 0 To p - 1
                        sums(j) /= CDbl(matched)
                        contrasts(component.Label)(j) += component.Weight * sums(j)
                    Next
                Next
            End If
            If labels.Count = 0 Then add("no-rows", "No non-zero matched contrast rows were produced; no estimate is invented.")
            Dim matrix(labels.Count - 1, p - 1) As Double
            For i = 0 To labels.Count - 1
                For j = 0 To p - 1 : matrix(i, j) = contrasts(labels(i))(j) : Next
            Next
            Return New GeeContrastPlan(labels.ToArray(), parameterNames, matrix, counts.ToArray(), issues)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function NearlyEqual(a As Double, b As Double) As Boolean
            Return Math.Abs(a - b) <= 0.00000001 * Math.Max(1.0, Math.Max(Math.Abs(a), Math.Abs(b)))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Response(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable)) As AnalysisResultDocument
            If tables Is Nothing Then Return AnalysisResultDocument.Failure("regression.gee.contrast", New AnalysisFault("gee.contrast.unavailable", "No existing inference result was supplied."))
            Return New AnalysisResultDocument("regression.gee.contrast", tables.Select(Function(t) t.ToOutputModel()), Array.Empty(Of KeyValuePair(Of String, Double))(), Nothing)
        End Function
    End Class

                     If(MeanRequest.Offset Is Nothing, Nothing, MeanRequest.Offset.Values),

                     If(Time Is Nothing, Nothing, Time.Values))

                            If(MeanRequest.Offset Is Nothing, Nothing, MeanRequest.Offset.Key),

        Public Shared Function Project(mean As RegressionRequest, cluster As GeeClusterVector,
                                       Optional time As RegressionVector = Nothing,
                                       Optional options As GeeWorkflowOptions = Nothing) As GeeWorkflowIntent
            If mean Is Nothing OrElse mean.Primary Is Nothing OrElse mean.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.mean.required: A typed marginal GLM mean specification is required.")
            Dim o = If(options, New GeeWorkflowOptions()).Copy()
            ' Preserve authored terms; describe the intercept that Core actually fits.
            Dim p = mean.Primary
            Dim effective As New RegressionComponent(p.Data, p.Names, p.RowIds,
                If(p.Effects Is Nothing, Nothing, New RegressionEffectModel(p.Effects.Effects, True)), p.SourceKeys, p.InitialValues, p.ResponseSources)
            Dim request As New RegressionRequest(mean.Kind, mean.ResponseKey, effective, If(mean.OptionsDefaulted, Nothing, mean.Options), mean.Offset, mean.Weights)
            Dim generic = RegressionRequestPolicy.Validate(request), issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            For Each diagnostic In generic.Diagnostics
                If diagnostic.Code = "regression.options.dispersion" AndAlso request.Options.Family <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial AndAlso
                    request.Options.Dispersion.HasValue AndAlso RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(request.Options.Dispersion.Value) AndAlso request.Options.Dispersion.Value > 0 Then
                    issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("gee.dispersion.unused-family", "options.dispersion", "The legacy positive dispersion property is retained; this family does not use the NB dispersion parameter.", blocking:=False))
                Else
                    issues.Add(diagnostic)
                End If
            Next
            Dim add = Sub(code As String, field As String, message As String, blocking As Boolean)
                          issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("gee." & code, field, message, blocking:=blocking))
                      End Sub
            If options Is Nothing Then add("options.defaulted", "options", "GEE defaults were used.", False)
            If Not o.RequestedIntercept Then add("intercept.implicit", "options.intercept", "Core GEE always includes an intercept; the UI selection is retained as request metadata.", False)
            If request.Weights IsNot Nothing Then add("weights.estimating-equations", "weights", "Weights are retained/echoed and exposed for classification; they do not weight the GEE estimating equations.", False)
            If o.TraceRequested Then add("trace.ui-only", "options.trace", "The legacy trace checkbox has no per-model RunGEE assignment; Core logging remains authoritative.", False)
            If request.Options.MaximumIterations = Integer.MaxValue Then add("options.iterations.overflow", "options.maximumIterations", "Core iteration count plus one overflows Int32.", True)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(GeeStandardError), o.StandardError) Then add("options.standard-error", "options.standardError", "Unsupported GEE standard-error selection.", True)
            Try
                GEEcovStructUtils.createGEEcovMat(o.Correlation)
            Catch ex As Exception
                add("options.correlation", "options.correlation", "Unsupported Core working-correlation selection.", True)
            End Try
            Dim rows = If(p.RowIds, Array.Empty(Of Integer)()), ids = If(cluster Is Nothing, Nothing, cluster.Values)
            Dim validCluster = cluster IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cluster.Key) AndAlso ids IsNot Nothing AndAlso
                cluster.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso cluster.RowIds.SequenceEqual(rows) AndAlso ids.Length = rows.Length AndAlso ids.All(Function(v) v IsNot Nothing)
            If Not validCluster Then add("cluster.alignment", "cluster", "Cluster key, immutable identities and source RowIds must be present and aligned.", True)
            Dim times = If(time Is Nothing, Nothing, time.Values)
            If time IsNot Nothing Then
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(time.Key) OrElse times Is Nothing OrElse time.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not time.RowIds.SequenceEqual(rows) OrElse times.Length <> rows.Length Then
                    add("time.alignment", "time", "Time key, values and RowIds must match retained input order.", True)
                ElseIf times.Any(Function(v) Not RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(v)) Then
                    add("time.nonfinite", "time", "Time values contain non-finite entries; nothing is dropped or coerced.", True)
                End If
            End If
            If p.Data IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Data.GetLength(0) <= ExpandedParameterCount(p.Data) Then add("data.insufficient", "primary.data", "Core GEE requires more observations than mean coefficients.", True)
            Dim flattened As New List(Of Integer), positions(rows.Length - 1) As Integer, visits As New List(Of Double), groupCount As Integer = 0
            If validCluster Then
                Dim groups = ids.Select(Function(value, index) New With {.Value = value, .Index = index}).GroupBy(Function(v) v.Value).ToList()
                groupCount = groups.Count
                If groups.Select(Function(g) g.Key.ToString()).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> groupCount Then add("cluster.text-collision", "cluster", "Distinct cluster values share the same Core text label; Core grouping is ambiguous.", True)
                For Each group In groups
                    Dim at = 0, previous As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
                    For Each entry In group
                        flattened.Add(entry.Index) : positions(entry.Index) = at
                        Dim visit = If(time Is Nothing, CDbl(at), If(times IsNot Nothing AndAlso times.Length = rows.Length, times(entry.Index), Double.NaN))
                        If time Is Nothing OrElse (times IsNot Nothing AndAlso times.Length = rows.Length) Then visits.Add(visit)
                        If previous.HasValue AndAlso visit = previous.Value AndAlso time IsNot Nothing Then add("time.duplicate", "time", "Repeated visit labels retain the imported tie order; no stable tie sort is invented.", False)
                        previous = visit : at += 1
                    Next
                Next
                If groupCount = 1 Then add("cluster.single", "cluster", "One cluster cannot establish reliable sandwich inference; actual Core outputs are retained.", False)
                If groups.Any(Function(g) g.Count() = 1) Then add("cluster.singleton", "cluster", "Singleton clusters are retained; some association structures are undefined.", False)
            End If
            Dim order As New GeeClusterPlan(rows, flattened.ToArray(), positions, visits.Distinct().OrderBy(Function(v) v).ToArray(), groupCount)
            If validCluster AndAlso Not order.PredictionOrderMatchesInput Then add("order.cluster-concatenated", "output.prediction", "Core predictions use cluster-concatenated order; the explicit row map is required to align them with original input.", False)
            Return New GeeWorkflowIntent(request, cluster, time, o, order,
                New RegressionValidation(issues, ExpandedParameterCount(p.Data), 0, Array.Empty(Of Integer)()))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Characterization/planning of the exact existing importer sort. The shipping
        ''' adapter receives an already-sorted geeData and does not call this to sort again.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ImportSortPermutation(cluster() As Object, rows() As Integer, Optional time() As Double = Nothing) As Integer()
            If cluster Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing OrElse cluster.Length <> rows.Length OrElse (time IsNot Nothing AndAlso time.Length <> rows.Length) Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.import.alignment")
            Dim values(rows.Length - 1, 2) As Object
            For i = 0 To rows.Length - 1
                values(i, 0) = cluster(i) : values(i, 1) = If(time Is Nothing, CDbl(rows(i)), time(i)) : values(i, 2) = i
            Next
            If rows.Length > 0 Then RowArrayUtilities.SortRows(values, "0,A,1,A", 0, rows.Length - 1)
            Return Enumerable.Range(0, rows.Length).Select(Function(i) DirectCast(values(i, 2), Integer)).ToArray()
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class GeeWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared ReadOnly Property OmitCategoricalReference As Boolean
            Get
                Return True
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Shared Function StandardErrorNames() As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly({"Robust", "Naive", "Bias Reduced"})
        End Function
        Public Shared Function FamilyNames() As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly(DirectCast(Family.FamiliesList.Clone(), String()))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CorrelationNames() As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly(DirectCast(GEEcovStruct.CovStructsList.Clone(), String()))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function FamilyCode(display As String) As String
            Dim index = Array.IndexOf(Family.FamiliesList, display)
            Return If(index < 0, String.Empty, Family.FamiliesCodes(index))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function SupportedLinks(familyCode As String) As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Dim selected = FamilyUtils.createFamily(familyCode)
            Return Link.LinkList.Values.Where(Function(value) selected.testLink(value)).ToList().AsReadOnly()
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ExpandedParameterCount(data(,) As Double) As Integer
            Return If(data Is Nothing, 0, data.GetLength(1))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Project(mean As RegressionRequest, cluster As GeeClusterVector,
                                       Optional time As RegressionVector = Nothing,
                                       Optional options As GeeWorkflowOptions = Nothing) As GeeWorkflowIntent
            If mean Is Nothing OrElse mean.Primary Is Nothing OrElse mean.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.mean.required: A typed marginal GLM mean specification is required.")
            Dim o = If(options, New GeeWorkflowOptions()).Copy()
            ' Preserve authored terms; describe the intercept that Core actually fits.
            Dim p = mean.Primary
            Dim effective As New RegressionComponent(p.Data, p.Names, p.RowIds,
                If(p.Effects Is Nothing, Nothing, New RegressionEffectModel(p.Effects.Effects, True)), p.SourceKeys, p.InitialValues, p.ResponseSources)
            Dim request As New RegressionRequest(mean.Kind, mean.ResponseKey, effective, If(mean.OptionsDefaulted, Nothing, mean.Options), mean.Offset, mean.Weights)
            Dim generic = RegressionRequestPolicy.Validate(request), issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            For Each diagnostic In generic.Diagnostics
                If diagnostic.Code = "regression.options.dispersion" AndAlso request.Options.Family <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial AndAlso
                    request.Options.Dispersion.HasValue AndAlso RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(request.Options.Dispersion.Value) AndAlso request.Options.Dispersion.Value > 0 Then
                    issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("gee.dispersion.unused-family", "options.dispersion", "The legacy positive dispersion property is retained; this family does not use the NB dispersion parameter.", blocking:=False))
                Else
                    issues.Add(diagnostic)
                End If
            Next
            Dim add = Sub(code As String, field As String, message As String, blocking As Boolean)
                          issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("gee." & code, field, message, blocking:=blocking))
                      End Sub
            If options Is Nothing Then add("options.defaulted", "options", "GEE defaults were used.", False)
            If Not o.RequestedIntercept Then add("intercept.implicit", "options.intercept", "Core GEE always includes an intercept; the UI selection is retained as request metadata.", False)
            If request.Weights IsNot Nothing Then add("weights.estimating-equations", "weights", "Weights are retained/echoed and exposed for classification; they do not weight the GEE estimating equations.", False)
            If o.TraceRequested Then add("trace.ui-only", "options.trace", "The legacy trace checkbox has no per-model RunGEE assignment; Core logging remains authoritative.", False)
            If request.Options.MaximumIterations = Integer.MaxValue Then add("options.iterations.overflow", "options.maximumIterations", "Core iteration count plus one overflows Int32.", True)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(GeeStandardError), o.StandardError) Then add("options.standard-error", "options.standardError", "Unsupported GEE standard-error selection.", True)
            Try
                GEEcovStructUtils.createGEEcovMat(o.Correlation)
            Catch ex As Exception
                add("options.correlation", "options.correlation", "Unsupported Core working-correlation selection.", True)
            End Try
            Dim rows = If(p.RowIds, Array.Empty(Of Integer)()), ids = If(cluster Is Nothing, Nothing, cluster.Values)
            Dim validCluster = cluster IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cluster.Key) AndAlso ids IsNot Nothing AndAlso
                cluster.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso cluster.RowIds.SequenceEqual(rows) AndAlso ids.Length = rows.Length AndAlso ids.All(Function(v) v IsNot Nothing)
            If Not validCluster Then add("cluster.alignment", "cluster", "Cluster key, immutable identities and source RowIds must be present and aligned.", True)
            Dim times = If(time Is Nothing, Nothing, time.Values)
            If time IsNot Nothing Then
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(time.Key) OrElse times Is Nothing OrElse time.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not time.RowIds.SequenceEqual(rows) OrElse times.Length <> rows.Length Then
                    add("time.alignment", "time", "Time key, values and RowIds must match retained input order.", True)
                ElseIf times.Any(Function(v) Not RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(v)) Then
                    add("time.nonfinite", "time", "Time values contain non-finite entries; nothing is dropped or coerced.", True)
                End If
            End If
            If p.Data IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Data.GetLength(0) <= ExpandedParameterCount(p.Data) Then add("data.insufficient", "primary.data", "Core GEE requires more observations than mean coefficients.", True)
            Dim flattened As New List(Of Integer), positions(rows.Length - 1) As Integer, visits As New List(Of Double), groupCount As Integer = 0
            If validCluster Then
                Dim groups = ids.Select(Function(value, index) New With {.Value = value, .Index = index}).GroupBy(Function(v) v.Value).ToList()
                groupCount = groups.Count
                If groups.Select(Function(g) g.Key.ToString()).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> groupCount Then add("cluster.text-collision", "cluster", "Distinct cluster values share the same Core text label; Core grouping is ambiguous.", True)
                For Each group In groups
                    Dim at = 0, previous As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
                    For Each entry In group
                        flattened.Add(entry.Index) : positions(entry.Index) = at
                        Dim visit = If(time Is Nothing, CDbl(at), If(times IsNot Nothing AndAlso times.Length = rows.Length, times(entry.Index), Double.NaN))
                        If time Is Nothing OrElse (times IsNot Nothing AndAlso times.Length = rows.Length) Then visits.Add(visit)
                        If previous.HasValue AndAlso visit = previous.Value AndAlso time IsNot Nothing Then add("time.duplicate", "time", "Repeated visit labels retain the imported tie order; no stable tie sort is invented.", False)
                        previous = visit : at += 1
                    Next
                Next
                If groupCount = 1 Then add("cluster.single", "cluster", "One cluster cannot establish reliable sandwich inference; actual Core outputs are retained.", False)
                If groups.Any(Function(g) g.Count() = 1) Then add("cluster.singleton", "cluster", "Singleton clusters are retained; some association structures are undefined.", False)
            End If
            Dim order As New GeeClusterPlan(rows, flattened.ToArray(), positions, visits.Distinct().OrderBy(Function(v) v).ToArray(), groupCount)
            If validCluster AndAlso Not order.PredictionOrderMatchesInput Then add("order.cluster-concatenated", "output.prediction", "Core predictions use cluster-concatenated order; the explicit row map is required to align them with original input.", False)
            Return New GeeWorkflowIntent(request, cluster, time, o, order,
                New RegressionValidation(issues, ExpandedParameterCount(p.Data), 0, Array.Empty(Of Integer)()))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Characterization/planning of the exact existing importer sort. The shipping
        ''' adapter receives an already-sorted geeData and does not call this to sort again.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ImportSortPermutation(cluster() As Object, rows() As Integer, Optional time() As Double = Nothing) As Integer()
            If cluster Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing OrElse cluster.Length <> rows.Length OrElse (time IsNot Nothing AndAlso time.Length <> rows.Length) Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.import.alignment")
            Dim values(rows.Length - 1, 2) As Object
            For i = 0 To rows.Length - 1
                values(i, 0) = cluster(i) : values(i, 1) = If(time Is Nothing, CDbl(rows(i)), time(i)) : values(i, 2) = i
            Next
            If rows.Length > 0 Then RowArrayUtilities.SortRows(values, "0,A,1,A", 0, rows.Length - 1)
            Return Enumerable.Range(0, rows.Length).Select(Function(i) DirectCast(values(i, 2), Integer)).ToArray()
        End Function
    End Class
