        Public Shared Overloads Function Project(request As RegressionRequest,
                                       Optional sums As TermSumOfSquaresType = TermSumOfSquaresType.TypeIII,
                                       Optional groups As Dictionary(Of String, Integer()) = Nothing,
                                       Optional codingFootnotes As IEnumerable(Of String) = Nothing,
                                       Optional alphaMode As LinearFitAlphaMode = LinearFitAlphaMode.Requested) As LinearBinomialFitIntent
            If Not Supports(request) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.linear-binomial.family: Only LM, Gaussian GLM and binomial GLM are projected.")
            Return New LinearBinomialFitIntent(request, sums, groups, codingFootnotes, alphaMode)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Snapshot real Core responses once, before any native write. No solver, inverse
        ''' link, sorting or replacement of nonfinite/missing cells occurs here.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Compose(intent As LinearBinomialFitIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable),
                                       fitted() As Double, residuals(,) As Object,
                                       Optional converged As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing,
                                       Optional actualFitAlpha As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing) As LinearBinomialReport
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim matrix(,) As Double = Nothing
            If fitted IsNot Nothing Then
                ReDim matrix(fitted.Length - 1, 0)
                For i = 0 To fitted.Length - 1 : matrix(i, 0) = fitted(i) : Next
            End If
            If residuals IsNot Nothing Then
                If residuals.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse residuals.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse residuals.GetLength(1) = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Zero-based residual columns are required.")
                ' Core residual matrices do not embed RowIds; their axis follows the exact fit
                ' input order. Identity is carried separately by RegressionRowOutput.
                If residuals.GetLength(1) <> If(intent.IsLinearModel, 6, 7) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Unexpected Core LM/GLM residual axis.")
                For c = 0 To residuals.GetLength(1) - 1
                    If residuals.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse Not TypeOf residuals(0, c) Is String Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.headers: Core residual headers are required.")
                Next
            End If
            Dim plan = RegressionReportPolicy.Compose(intent.Request, tables,
                New RegressionRowOutput(intent.Request.Primary.RowIds, matrix, residuals), converged)
            Return New LinearBinomialReport(intent, plan, actualFitAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(intent.EffectiveFitAlpha))
        End Function
    End Class

Public Shared Function Compose(intent As LinearBinomialFitIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable),
                                       fitted() As Double, residuals(,) As Object,
                                       Optional converged As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing,
                                       Optional actualFitAlpha As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing) As LinearBinomialReport
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim matrix(,) As Double = Nothing
            If fitted IsNot Nothing Then
                ReDim matrix(fitted.Length - 1, 0)
                For i = 0 To fitted.Length - 1 : matrix(i, 0) = fitted(i) : Next
            End If
            If residuals IsNot Nothing Then
                If residuals.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse residuals.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse residuals.GetLength(1) = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Zero-based residual columns are required.")
                ' Core residual matrices do not embed RowIds; their axis follows the exact fit
                ' input order. Identity is carried separately by RegressionRowOutput.
                If residuals.GetLength(1) <> If(intent.IsLinearModel, 6, 7) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.axes: Unexpected Core LM/GLM residual axis.")
                For c = 0 To residuals.GetLength(1) - 1
                    If residuals.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse Not TypeOf residuals(0, c) Is String Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.residuals.headers: Core residual headers are required.")
                Next
            End If
            Dim plan = RegressionReportPolicy.Compose(intent.Request, tables,
                New RegressionRowOutput(intent.Request.Primary.RowIds, matrix, residuals), converged)
            Return New LinearBinomialReport(intent, plan, actualFitAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(intent.EffectiveFitAlpha))
        End Function

    ''' <summary>Lossless covariance selection. Metadata uses the existing validation-only
    ''' Core projections; construction deliberately calls the original factory exactly once,
    ''' preserving its logging, exceptions and aliases. No covariance matrix is retained.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelCovarianceSelection
        Private ReadOnly _residual As MixedModelRStruct
        Private ReadOnly _random As MixedModelGStruct
        Friend Sub New(token As String, randomSide As Boolean)
            RequestedToken = token
            IsRandomSide = randomSide
            If randomSide Then
                _random = MixedModelOptionPolicy.RandomForValidation(token)
                IsSupported = _random IsNot Nothing
                If IsSupported Then
                    EffectiveCoreType = _random.GetType().Name
                    EffectiveName = _random.ToString()
                    IsZeroRandom = _random.IsDegenerateZeroG()
                End If
            Else
                _residual = MixedModelOptionPolicy.ResidualForValidation(token)
                IsSupported = _residual IsNot Nothing
                If IsSupported Then
                    EffectiveCoreType = _residual.GetType().Name
                    EffectiveName = _residual.ToString()
                    UsesVisitIndex = _residual.UsesVisitIndex()
                End If
            End If
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property RequestedToken As String
        Public ReadOnly Property IsRandomSide As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property IsSupported As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property EffectiveCoreType As String
        Public ReadOnly Property EffectiveName As String
        Public ReadOnly Property UsesVisitIndex As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property IsZeroRandom As Boolean

        Public Function CreateResidualStructure() As MixedModelRStruct
            If IsRandomSide Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("R-side selection required.")
            Return MixedModelFittingOptions.CreateResidualStructure(RequestedToken)
        End Function
        Public Function CreateRandomStructure() As MixedModelGStruct
            If Not IsRandomSide Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("G-side selection required.")
            Return MixedModelFittingOptions.CreateRandomStructure(RequestedToken)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Delegate shape/parameter metadata to Core, including its Q restrictions.
        ''' Nothing means unsupported selection/dimension, not a zero-parameter covariance.
        ''' Does not allocate a covariance matrix or parameter vector.</summary>
        Public Function ParameterCount(data As MixedModelBlockData) As Nullable(Of Integer)
            If Not IsSupported OrElse data Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            If IsRandomSide Then Return RandomParameterCount(data.Q)
            Try
                Return _residual.ParamCount(data)
            Catch ex As OverflowException
                Return Nothing
            Catch ex As ApplicationException
                Return Nothing
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Return Nothing
            End Try
        End Function
        Public Function RandomParameterCount(q As Integer) As Nullable(Of Integer)
            If Not IsRandomSide OrElse Not IsSupported OrElse q < 0 Then Return Nothing
            Try
                Return _random.ParamCount(q)
            Catch ex As OverflowException
                Return Nothing
            Catch ex As ApplicationException
                Return Nothing
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Return Nothing
            End Try
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Portable covariance and fitting specialization for the GUI workflow.
    ''' Keeps requested strings and effective Core controls distinct. Core remains responsible
    ''' for runtime AI/gradient fallback, numerical fitting and convergence. This selection
    ''' never fits, invokes callbacks, promotes random designs or rejects an acquired request.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelFittingOptions
        Private ReadOnly _requested As MixedModelWorkflowOptions
        Private ReadOnly _optimizerFallback, _gradientFallback As Boolean
        Public Sub New(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, options As MixedModelWorkflowOptions)
            Me.Kind = kind
            _requested = If(options, MixedModelWorkflowOptions.Defaults(kind)).Copy()
            Residual = SelectResidual(_requested.ResidualStructure)
            ' MMRM has no G design. The unused requested token remains in RequestedOptions.
            Random = SelectRandom(If(kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, "None", _requested.RandomStructure))
            Decision = MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.DecideFit(kind, _requested.FitMethod, _requested.Inference)
            Dim control As New MixedModelControl
            ProjectOptimizer(kind, control, _requested.Optimizer, _requested.Gradient)
            OptimizerMode = control.CovarianceOptimizerMode
            GradientMode = control.CovarianceGradientMode
            Dim text = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_requested.Optimizer), "AI/Fisher scoring (default)", _requested.Optimizer)
            _optimizerFallback = MixedModelOptionPolicy.ParseCovarianceOptimizerMode(text, CType(-1, MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode)) = CType(-1, MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode) AndAlso
                Not String.Equals(text, "Projected BFGS (finite-difference gradient)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim gradientToken = MixedModelOptionPolicy.NormalizeToken(_requested.Gradient)
            _gradientFallback = gradientToken <> String.Empty AndAlso gradientToken <> "AUTO" AndAlso gradientToken <> "AUTOANALYTICWHEREAVAILABLE" AndAlso
                MixedModelOptionPolicy.ParseCovarianceGradientMode(_requested.Gradient, CType(-1, MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode)) = CType(-1, MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind
        Public ReadOnly Property Residual As MixedModelCovarianceSelection
        Public ReadOnly Property Random As MixedModelCovarianceSelection
        Public ReadOnly Property Decision As MixedModelFitDecision
        Public ReadOnly Property OptimizerMode As MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode
        Public ReadOnly Property GradientMode As MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode
        Public ReadOnly Property RequestedOptions As MixedModelWorkflowOptions
            Get
                Return _requested.Copy()
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Shared Function SelectResidual(token As String) As MixedModelCovarianceSelection
            Return New MixedModelCovarianceSelection(token, False)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function SelectRandom(token As String) As MixedModelCovarianceSelection
            Return New MixedModelCovarianceSelection(token, True)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CreateResidualStructure(token As String) As MixedModelRStruct
            Return MixedModelRStructUtils.createMixedModelRStruct(token)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CreateRandomStructure(token As String) As MixedModelGStruct
            Return MixedModelGStructUtils.createMixedModelGStruct(token)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ResidualChoices() As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly(DirectCast(MixedModelRStruct.RStructsList.Clone(), String()))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function RandomChoices() As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Return Array.AsReadOnly(DirectCast(MixedModelGStruct.GStructsList.Clone(), String()))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Modify only the original GUI-owned control fields. Other Core defaults,
        ''' restart/scaling settings and callbacks stay with their existing owners.</summary>
        Public Sub ApplyControl(ByRef control As MixedModelControl)
            control.MaxIter = _requested.MaximumIterations
            control.Epsilon = _requested.Epsilon
            control.StepTolerance = _requested.Epsilon
            control.FunctionTolerance = _requested.Epsilon
            control.CovarianceOptimizerMode = OptimizerMode
            control.CovarianceGradientMode = GradientMode
            control.Trace = _requested.Trace OrElse _requested.IterationDetails
        End Sub

        ' The 04A.14 public ApplyOptimizer seam delegates here. Preserve its exact
        ' model-specific unknown fallback and exact-label gradient overrides.
        Friend Shared Sub ProjectOptimizer(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, ByRef control As MixedModelControl, optimizer As String, gradient As String)
            Dim text = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(optimizer), "AI/Fisher scoring (default)", optimizer)
            control.CovarianceOptimizerMode = MixedModelOptionPolicy.ParseCovarianceOptimizerMode(text,
                If(kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgs, MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.AverageInformationReml))
            control.CovarianceGradientMode = MixedModelOptionPolicy.ParseCovarianceGradientMode(gradient, MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.Auto)
            If String.Equals(text, "Projected BFGS (analytic gradient)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                control.CovarianceOptimizerMode = MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgsAnalyticGradient
                control.CovarianceGradientMode = MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.AnalyticScore
            ElseIf String.Equals(text, "Projected BFGS (finite-difference gradient)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                control.CovarianceOptimizerMode = MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgs
                control.CovarianceGradientMode = MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.NumericalFiniteDifference
            End If
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>Additional portable diagnostics only. Existing workflow validation owns
        ''' roles, authoring, finite inputs and missing visit-role diagnostics. Acquired Windows
        ''' construction intentionally does not enforce either diagnostic set.</summary>
        Public Function DesignDiagnostics(data As MixedModelBlockData) As IReadOnlyList(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If _optimizerFallback Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "optimizer.fallback", "Unknown optimizer retains the model-specific GUI fallback.", False)
            If _gradientFallback Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "gradient.fallback", "Unknown gradient retains Auto selection.", False)
            If Not String.Equals(_requested.FitMethod, "ML", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso Not String.Equals(_requested.FitMethod, "REML", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "fit.fallback", "Unknown GUI fit method retains REML.", False)
            End If
            If data IsNot Nothing Then
                If Residual.IsSupported AndAlso Not Residual.ParameterCount(data).HasValue Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "residual.dimension", "Core cannot describe R parameters for this design.")
                If Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM AndAlso Random.IsSupported AndAlso Not Random.IsZeroRandom AndAlso Not Random.ParameterCount(data).HasValue Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.dimension", "Core G structure does not support the expanded Z column count.")
                End If
            End If
            Return issues.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

        Friend Shared Sub ProjectOptimizer(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, ByRef control As MixedModelControl, optimizer As String, gradient As String)
            Dim text = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(optimizer), "AI/Fisher scoring (default)", optimizer)
            control.CovarianceOptimizerMode = MixedModelOptionPolicy.ParseCovarianceOptimizerMode(text,

            If Not String.Equals(_requested.FitMethod, "ML", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso Not String.Equals(_requested.FitMethod, "REML", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "fit.fallback", "Unknown GUI fit method retains REML.", False)
            End If
            If data IsNot Nothing Then
                If Residual.IsSupported AndAlso Not Residual.ParameterCount(data).HasValue Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "residual.dimension", "Core cannot describe R parameters for this design.")

                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.dimension", "Core G structure does not support the expanded Z column count.")

    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelOptionPolicy
        Public Shared Function ParseFitMethod(arg As Object,
                                       Optional defaultValue As MixedModelFitMethod = MixedModelFitMethod.REML) As MixedModelFitMethod
            Dim token As String = NormalizeToken(AsString(arg))
            If token = "ML" OrElse token = "MAXIMUMLIKELIHOOD" Then Return MixedModelFitMethod.ML
            If token = "REML" OrElse token = "RESTRICTEDML" OrElse token = "RESTRICTEDMAXIMUMLIKELIHOOD" Then Return MixedModelFitMethod.REML
            Return defaultValue
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseInferenceMethod(arg As Object,
                                             Optional defaultValue As MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger) As MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod
            Dim token As String = NormalizeToken(AsString(arg))
            If token = "KR" OrElse token = "KENWARDROGER" Then Return MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger
            If token = "SATTERTHWAITE" OrElse token = "SATTERTHWAITEDF" Then Return MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.Satterthwaite
            If token = "BETWEENWITHIN" OrElse token = "BW" Then Return MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.BetweenWithin
            If token = "RESIDUALDF" OrElse token = "RESIDUAL" Then Return MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.ResidualDF
            If token = "WALD" OrElse token = "WALDNORMAL" OrElse token = "LARGESAMPLENORMAL" OrElse token = "NORMAL" Then Return MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.WaldNormal
            Return defaultValue
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseCovarianceOptimizerMode(arg As Object,
                                                      Optional defaultValue As MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode = MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.AverageInformationReml) As MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode
            Dim token As String = NormalizeToken(AsString(arg))
            If token = String.Empty Then Return defaultValue

            If token = "AI" OrElse token = "AVERAGEINFORMATION" OrElse token = "FISHERSCORING" OrElse token = "SAS" OrElse
               token = "AIFISHERSCORINGDEFAULT" OrElse token = "AVERAGEINFORMATIONREML" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.AverageInformationReml
            End If

            If token = "BFGSANALYTIC" OrElse token = "PROJECTEDBFGSANALYTIC" OrElse
               token = "PROJECTEDBFGSANALYTICGRADIENT" OrElse token = "ANALYTICBFGS" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgsAnalyticGradient
            End If

            If token = "BFGS" OrElse token = "PROJECTEDBFGS" OrElse token = "BFGSAUTOGRADIENT" OrElse
               token = "PROJECTEDBFGSAUTOGRADIENT" OrElse token = "BFGSNUMERICAL" OrElse
               token = "PROJECTEDBFGSNUMERICAL" OrElse token = "BFGSFINITE" OrElse
               token = "BFGSFINITEDIFFERENCE" OrElse token = "NUMERICALBFGS" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.ProjectedBfgs
            End If

            Return defaultValue
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseCovarianceGradientMode(arg As Object,
                                                     Optional defaultValue As MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode = MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.Auto) As MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode
            Dim token As String = NormalizeToken(AsString(arg))
            If token = String.Empty OrElse token = "AUTO" OrElse token = "AUTOANALYTICWHEREAVAILABLE" Then Return defaultValue

            If token = "ANALYTIC" OrElse token = "ANALYTICSCORE" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.AnalyticScore
            End If

            If token = "ANALYTICVALIDATION" OrElse token = "VALIDATE" OrElse
               token = "ANALYTICSCOREFINITEDIFFERENCEVALIDATION" OrElse
               token = "ANALYTICSCOREWITHFINITEDIFFERENCEVALIDATION" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.AnalyticScoreWithFiniteDifferenceValidation
            End If

            If token = "NUMERICAL" OrElse token = "FINITE" OrElse token = "FINITEDIFFERENCE" OrElse
               token = "NUMERICALFINITEDIFFERENCE" Then
                Return MixedModelCovarianceGradientMode.NumericalFiniteDifference
            End If

            Return defaultValue
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NormalizeToken(s As String) As String
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return String.Empty
            Dim chars As IEnumerable(Of Char) = s.Where(Function(ch) Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch))
            Return New String(chars.ToArray()).ToUpperInvariant()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function AsString(arg As Object) As String
            If arg Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty
            Return Convert.ToString(arg, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        End Function

            Dim f As MixedModelRStruct

                OrElse normalized = "cs" OrElse normalized = "exchangeable" Then
                f = New CompoundSymmetryR()
            ElseIf normalized = "heterogeneous cs" OrElse normalized = "heterogeneous compound symmetry" _
                OrElse normalized = "csh" Then
                f = New HeterogeneousCSR()
            ElseIf normalized = "ar(1)" OrElse normalized = "ar1" OrElse normalized = "autoregressive" Then
                f = New AR1R()
            ElseIf normalized = "heterogeneous ar(1)" OrElse normalized = "heterogeneous ar1" _
                OrElse normalized = "heterogeneous autoregressive" OrElse normalized = "arh(1)" _
                OrElse normalized = "arh1" OrElse normalized = "arh" OrElse normalized = "har1" _
                OrElse normalized = "har(1)" OrElse normalized = "har" Then
                f = New HeterogeneousAR1R()
            ElseIf normalized = "toeplitz" OrElse normalized = "toep" OrElse normalized = "toeplitz (toep)" Then
                f = New ToeplitzR()
            ElseIf normalized = "heterogeneous toeplitz" OrElse normalized = "toeplitz heterogeneous" _
                OrElse normalized = "toeph" OrElse normalized = "toep h" OrElse normalized = "toeplitz h" _
                OrElse normalized = "toeplitz (heterogeneous)" _
                OrElse normalized = "heterogeneous toeplitz (toeph)" Then

            ElseIf normalized = "unstructured" OrElse normalized = "un" Then

Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public Enum MixedModelWorkflowKind
        MMRM
        LMM
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>Caller-owned option builder. Requests retain and return independent copies.
    ''' Raw GUI display choices are retained alongside exact legacy effective choices.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelWorkflowOptions
        Public Property ResidualStructure As String = "Unstructured"
        Public Property RandomStructure As String = "Random Intercept"
        Public Property FitMethod As String = "REML"
        Public Property Inference As String = "Kenward-Roger"
        Public Property Optimizer As String = "AI/Fisher scoring (default)"
        Public Property Gradient As String = "Auto (analytic where available)"
        Public Property MaximumIterations As Integer = 500
        Public Property Epsilon As Double = 0.000001
        Public Property Trace As Boolean
        Public Property IterationDetails As Boolean
        Public Property FixedIntercept As Boolean = True
        Public Property RandomIntercept As Boolean = True
        Public Shared Function Defaults(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind) As MixedModelWorkflowOptions
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowOptions With {.ResidualStructure = If(kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM, "Identity", "Unstructured"),
                .RandomIntercept = kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM}
        End Function
        Public Function Copy() As MixedModelWorkflowOptions
            Return DirectCast(MemberwiseClone(), MixedModelWorkflowOptions)
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelFitDecision
        Friend Sub New(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, fit As String, inference As String)
            RequestedMethod = If(String.Equals(fit, "ML", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), MixedModelFitMethod.ML, MixedModelFitMethod.REML)
            ' Deliberately different comparisons in the original GUI: the KR timing guard
            ' ignores case; the inference Select Case is exact and may take its fallback.
            CoerceToReml = RequestedMethod = MixedModelFitMethod.ML AndAlso String.Equals(inference, "Kenward-Roger", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            EffectiveMethod = If(CoerceToReml, MixedModelFitMethod.REML, RequestedMethod)
            Select Case inference
                Case "Large-sample normal" : EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.WaldNormal
                Case "Residual DF" : EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.ResidualDF
                Case "Satterthwaite" : EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.Satterthwaite
                Case "Kenward-Roger" : EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger
                Case Else
                    EffectiveInference = If(kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.BetweenWithin, MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.WaldNormal)
                    InferenceFallback = inference <> "Between-within DF" OrElse kind <> MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM
            End Select
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property RequestedMethod As MixedModelFitMethod
        Public ReadOnly Property EffectiveMethod As MixedModelFitMethod
        Public ReadOnly Property EffectiveInference As MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod
        Public ReadOnly Property CoerceToReml As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property InferenceFallback As Boolean
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Reuse Core's immutable subject-block snapshot: one existing block copy of
    ''' Y/X/Z, O(n) row/subject sidecars, no second long-lived n-by-p or n-by-q matrix.
    ''' Core sorts subject keys ordinally and each block by visit then source row, or row
    ''' only when no visit is supplied. Those positions are never worksheet coordinates.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelWorkflowData
        Private ReadOnly _rows As Integer()
        Private ReadOnly _subjects As Object()
        Private Sub New(data As MixedModelBlockData, rows() As Integer, subjects() As Object,
                        issues As IEnumerable(Of RegressionDiagnostic), provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame)
            CoreData = data : _rows = If(rows Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(rows.Clone(), Integer()))
            _subjects = If(subjects Is Nothing, Nothing, subjects.Select(Function(v) If(v Is Nothing OrElse Type.GetTypeCode(v.GetType()) <> TypeCode.Object, v, Nothing)).ToArray())
            Diagnostics = New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)(issues).AsReadOnly() : Me.Provenance = provenance
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property CoreData As MixedModelBlockData
        Public ReadOnly Property Diagnostics As IReadOnlyList(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
        Public ReadOnly Property Provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame
        Public ReadOnly Property InputRowIds As Integer()
            Get
                Return If(_rows Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(_rows.Clone(), Integer()))
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property SubjectIds As Object()
            Get
                Return If(_subjects Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(_subjects.Clone(), Object()))
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property BlockRowIds As Integer()
            Get
                Return If(CoreData Is Nothing, Array.Empty(Of Integer)(), CoreData.Blocks.SelectMany(Function(b) b.RowIndices).ToArray())
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property BlockToInputIndices As Integer()
            Get
                If _rows Is Nothing Then Return Array.Empty(Of Integer)()
                Dim positions As New Dictionary(Of Integer, Integer)
                For i = 0 To _rows.Length - 1
                    If Not positions.ContainsKey(_rows(i)) Then positions.Add(_rows(i), i)
                Next
                Return BlockRowIds.Select(Function(id) If(positions.ContainsKey(id), positions(id), -1)).ToArray()
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Shared Function FromArrays(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, y() As Double, x(,) As Double, subjects() As Object,
                                          visit() As Double, rows() As Integer, Optional z(,) As Double = Nothing,
                                          Optional provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame = Nothing) As MixedModelWorkflowData
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If y Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing OrElse subjects Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.required", "Response, expanded design, subjects and source RowIds are required.")
            Else
                If y.Length = 0 OrElse x.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.empty", "At least one observation and fixed-effect column are required.")
                If x.GetLength(0) <> y.Length OrElse subjects.Length <> y.Length OrElse rows.Length <> y.Length OrElse
                    (visit IsNot Nothing AndAlso visit.Length <> y.Length) OrElse (z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(0) <> y.Length) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.shape", "Response, subject, visit, RowId, X and Z row axes must agree.")
                If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source RowIds must be distinct.")
                For Each array As Array In New Array() {y, x, z, visit}
                    If array Is Nothing Then Continue For
                    For Each value As Double In array
                        If Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.finite", "Numeric model arrays must be finite.") : Exit For
                    Next
                Next
                ValidateSubjects(subjects, issues)
                If z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "An expanded random design cannot have zero columns.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM AndAlso (z Is Nothing OrElse z.GetLength(1) = 0) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "LMM requires an expanded random design.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM AndAlso visit Is Nothing Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "visit.required", "MMRM requires a visit role.")
            End If
            Dim data As MixedModelBlockData = Nothing
            If Not issues.Any(Function(i) i.Blocking) Then data = MixedModelBlockData.FromArrays(y, x, subjects, z, visit, kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM OrElse visit IsNot Nothing, rows)
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowData(data, rows, subjects, issues, provenance)
        End Function
        ''' <summary>The real form has already called the original Core builder, so original
        ''' acquisition/build errors and timing are untouched. Further diagnostics stay observational.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromAcquiredBlocks(data As MixedModelBlockData, rows() As Integer, subjects() As Object,
                                                 Optional provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame = Nothing) As MixedModelWorkflowData
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            ValidateSubjects(subjects, issues)
            If data Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Length <> data.Nobs Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.shape", "Core blocks and retained RowIds must agree.")
            Else
                If subjects Is Nothing OrElse subjects.Length <> data.Nobs Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.shape", "Subject sidecar and Core blocks must align.")
                If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source RowIds must be distinct.")
                If Not data.Blocks.SelectMany(Function(b) b.RowIndices).OrderBy(Function(id) id).SequenceEqual(rows.OrderBy(Function(id) id)) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.mapping", "Core block rows must equal retained source rows.")
            End If
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowData(data, rows, subjects, issues, provenance)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub ValidateSubjects(subjects() As Object, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If subjects Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.required", "Subject identities are required.") : Return
            End If
            Dim identities As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each value In subjects
                If value Is Nothing OrElse Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()) = TypeCode.Object OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Subjects must be nonmissing immutable scalar labels.")
                ElseIf (TypeOf value Is Double AndAlso Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(DirectCast(value, Double))) OrElse
                       (TypeOf value Is Single AndAlso (Single.IsNaN(DirectCast(value, Single)) OrElse Single.IsInfinity(DirectCast(value, Single)))) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Numeric subject identities must be finite.")
                Else
                    Dim key = Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    If identities.ContainsKey(key) AndAlso Not Object.Equals(identities(key), value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.ambiguous", "Distinct typed subjects collapse to the same Core text identity.")
                    If Not identities.ContainsKey(key) Then identities.Add(key, value)
                End If
                If issues.Count >= MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

        Public Sub New(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, data As MixedModelWorkflowData, responseKey As String, subjectKey As String, visitKey As String,
                       fixedNames() As String, randomNames() As String, fixedEffects As RegressionEffectModel, randomEffects As RegressionEffectModel,
                       fixedText As String, randomText As String, options As MixedModelWorkflowOptions,
                       Optional sourceResponseKey As String = Nothing, Optional sourceSubjectKey As String = Nothing, Optional sourceVisitKey As String = Nothing)
            Me.Kind = kind : Me.Data = data : Me.ResponseKey = responseKey : Me.SubjectKey = subjectKey : Me.VisitKey = visitKey
            Me.SourceResponseKey = If(sourceResponseKey, responseKey) : Me.SourceSubjectKey = If(sourceSubjectKey, subjectKey)
            Me.SourceVisitKey = If(sourceVisitKey, visitKey)
            _fixedNames = If(fixedNames Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(fixedNames.Clone(), String()))

            Me.FixedEffects = fixedEffects : Me.RandomEffects = randomEffects : Me.FixedText = fixedText : Me.RandomText = randomText
            _options = If(options, MixedModelWorkflowOptions.Defaults(kind)).Copy()

        Public Function CreateCoreRequest() As MixedModelFitRequest
            If Not Validation.IsValid Then Throw New ArgumentException("mixed.request.invalid: Resolve portable request diagnostics.")
            Return CreateAcquiredCoreRequest()
        End Function
        Public Function CreateAcquiredCoreRequest(Optional residual As MixedModelRStruct = Nothing, Optional random As MixedModelGStruct = Nothing) As MixedModelFitRequest
            residual = If(residual, Fitting.Residual.CreateResidualStructure())
            Dim req = If(Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM,
                MixedModelFitRequest.CreateMMRM(Data.CoreData, residual, Decision.EffectiveMethod),
                MixedModelFitRequest.CreateLMM(Data.CoreData, residual, If(random, Fitting.Random.CreateRandomStructure()), Decision.EffectiveMethod))
            req.ResponseVarName = ResponseKey : req.SubjectVarName = SubjectKey : req.VisitVarName = If(VisitKey, String.Empty)
            req.FixedEffectNames = FixedNames : req.RandomEffectNames = RandomNames
            req.FixedFormulaText = FixedText : req.RandomFormulaText = If(Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, String.Empty, RandomText)
            req.RequestLabel = Kind.ToString() : req.FixedInferenceMethod = Decision.EffectiveInference
            If Decision.EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.Satterthwaite Then req.UseSatterthwaite = True
            If Decision.EffectiveInference = MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger Then
                If Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM Then req.EnableFullKenwardRogerForMmrm() Else req.EnableFullKenwardRogerForLmm()
            End If
            Dim ctl = req.Control
            Fitting.ApplyControl(ctl)
            req.Control = ctl ' MixedModelControl is a value type: assigning back is essential.
            Return req
        End Function

    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Const MaximumDiagnostics As Integer = 128
        Public Shared Function LegacyRejectEpsilon(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return value <= 0 ' Preserve existing GUI NaN comparison; finite checks remain candidate diagnostics.
        End Function
        Public Shared Function LegacyRejectIterations(value As Integer) As Boolean
            Return value <= 0
        End Function
        Public Shared Function EmptyEffectSelection(count As Integer, intercept As Boolean) As Boolean
            Return count = 0 AndAlso Not intercept
        End Function
        Friend Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Friend Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), field As String, message As String, Optional blocking As Boolean = True)
            If issues.Count < MaximumDiagnostics Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("mixed." & field, field, message, blocking:=blocking))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function DecideFit(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, fit As String, inference As String) As MixedModelFitDecision
            Return New MixedModelFitDecision(kind, fit, inference)
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub ApplyOptimizer(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, ByRef control As MixedModelControl, optimizer As String, gradient As String)
            MixedModelFittingOptions.ProjectOptimizer(kind, control, optimizer, gradient)
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function PromotedRandomStructure(current As String, effects As RegressionEffectModel, generalOperation As Boolean, Optional authoredCount As Nullable(Of Integer) = Nothing) As String
            Dim count = If(authoredCount.HasValue, authoredCount.Value, If(effects Is Nothing, 0, effects.Effects.Count)), intercept = effects IsNot Nothing AndAlso effects.IncludeIntercept
            Dim general = generalOperation OrElse (Not intercept AndAlso count > 0) OrElse count + If(intercept, 1, 0) > 2
            If effects IsNot Nothing Then general = general OrElse effects.Effects.Any(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso
                (e.Spec.Scale = PredictorScale.Categorical OrElse Not String.Equals(e.Spec.Kind, "MainEffect", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse e.Spec.Degree > 1))
            Dim simple = String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept + Slope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            If general AndAlso simple Then Return "Variance Components (VC/Diag)"
            If count = 1 AndAlso intercept AndAlso String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return "Random Intercept + Slope"
            Return current
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Validate(request As MixedModelWorkflowRequest) As RegressionValidation
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If request Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "request.required", "A mixed-model request is required.") : Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            Dim o = request.Options, d = If(request.Data Is Nothing, Nothing, request.Data.CoreData)
            If request.Data IsNot Nothing Then issues.AddRange(request.Data.Diagnostics)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(MixedModelWorkflowKind), request.Kind) Then Issue(issues, "kind", "Unknown mixed-model kind.")
            If d Is Nothing Then Issue(issues, "data.required", "Usable subject-block data are required.")
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ResponseKey) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.SubjectKey) Then Issue(issues, "roles", "Response and subject keys are required.")
            If request.Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.VisitKey) Then Issue(issues, "visit.required", "MMRM requires a named visit role.")
            If o.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then Issue(issues, "iterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If Not Finite(o.Epsilon) OrElse o.Epsilon <= 0 Then Issue(issues, "epsilon", "All three convergence tolerances require a finite positive epsilon.")
            If request.Decision.InferenceFallback Then Issue(issues, "inference.fallback", "Unrecognized GUI inference retains the model-specific legacy fallback.", False)
            If request.Decision.CoerceToReml Then Issue(issues, "fit.reml", "The existing KR guard changes ML to REML; Windows owns the information message.", False)
            If Not o.FixedIntercept AndAlso (request.FixedEffects Is Nothing OrElse request.FixedEffects.Effects.Count = 0) Then Issue(issues, "fixed.empty", "No fixed effects and fixed intercept is disabled.")
            Dim residual = request.Fitting.Residual
            If Not residual.IsSupported Then
                Issue(issues, "residual.structure", "Unsupported R-side covariance selection.")
            ElseIf residual.UsesVisitIndex AndAlso (d Is Nothing OrElse Not d.HasVisit OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.VisitKey)) Then
                Issue(issues, "visit.required", "The selected R structure requires visit indices.")
            End If
            If d IsNot Nothing Then
                If request.FixedNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso (request.FixedNames.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse request.FixedNames.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> request.FixedNames.Length) Then Issue(issues, "fixed.names", "Expanded fixed names must be nonblank and unambiguous.")
                If request.FixedNames Is Nothing OrElse request.FixedNames.Length <> d.P Then Issue(issues, "fixed.names", "Expanded fixed names must match X columns.")
                If request.Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM Then
                    If request.RandomNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso (request.RandomNames.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse request.RandomNames.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> request.RandomNames.Length) Then Issue(issues, "random.names", "Expanded random names must be nonblank and unambiguous.")
                    If d.Q <= 0 OrElse request.RandomNames Is Nothing OrElse request.RandomNames.Length <> d.Q Then Issue(issues, "random.names", "Expanded random names must match Z columns.")
                    Dim authored = If(request.RandomEffects Is Nothing, 0, request.RandomEffects.Effects.Count)
                    If Not o.RandomIntercept AndAlso authored = 0 Then Issue(issues, "random.empty", "No random effects and random intercept is disabled.")
                    If String.Equals(o.RandomStructure, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso (d.Q <> 1 OrElse Not o.RandomIntercept OrElse authored <> 0) Then Issue(issues, "random.intercept", "Random Intercept requires intercept-only authoring and one expanded column.")
                    If String.Equals(o.RandomStructure, "Random Intercept + Slope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso (d.Q <> 2 OrElse Not o.RandomIntercept OrElse authored <> 1) Then Issue(issues, "random.slope", "Random Intercept + Slope requires intercept and exactly one authored effect/two expanded columns.")
                    Dim random = request.Fitting.Random
                    If Not random.IsSupported Then
                        Issue(issues, "random.structure", "Unsupported G-side covariance selection.")
                    ElseIf random.IsZeroRandom Then
                        Issue(issues, "random.structure", "LMM requires a G-side random structure.")
                    End If
                ElseIf d.Q <> 0 Then
                    Issue(issues, "random.mmrm", "MMRM has no random design.")
                End If
            End If
            issues.AddRange(request.Fitting.DesignDiagnostics(d))
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues.Take(MaximumDiagnostics), If(d Is Nothing, 0, d.P), If(d Is Nothing, 0, d.Q), {})
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

            Select Case inference

        Public Shared Function FromArrays(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, y() As Double, x(,) As Double, subjects() As Object,
                                          visit() As Double, rows() As Integer, Optional z(,) As Double = Nothing,
                                          Optional provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame = Nothing) As MixedModelWorkflowData
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If y Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing OrElse subjects Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.required", "Response, expanded design, subjects and source RowIds are required.")
            Else
                If y.Length = 0 OrElse x.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.empty", "At least one observation and fixed-effect column are required.")
                If x.GetLength(0) <> y.Length OrElse subjects.Length <> y.Length OrElse rows.Length <> y.Length OrElse
                    (visit IsNot Nothing AndAlso visit.Length <> y.Length) OrElse (z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(0) <> y.Length) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.shape", "Response, subject, visit, RowId, X and Z row axes must agree.")
                If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source RowIds must be distinct.")
                For Each array As Array In New Array() {y, x, z, visit}
                    If array Is Nothing Then Continue For
                    For Each value As Double In array
                        If Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.finite", "Numeric model arrays must be finite.") : Exit For
                    Next
                Next
                ValidateSubjects(subjects, issues)
                If z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "An expanded random design cannot have zero columns.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM AndAlso (z Is Nothing OrElse z.GetLength(1) = 0) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "LMM requires an expanded random design.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM AndAlso visit Is Nothing Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "visit.required", "MMRM requires a visit role.")
            End If
            Dim data As MixedModelBlockData = Nothing
            If Not issues.Any(Function(i) i.Blocking) Then data = MixedModelBlockData.FromArrays(y, x, subjects, z, visit, kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM OrElse visit IsNot Nothing, rows)
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowData(data, rows, subjects, issues, provenance)
        End Function
        ''' <summary>The real form has already called the original Core builder, so original
        ''' acquisition/build errors and timing are untouched. Further diagnostics stay observational.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromAcquiredBlocks(data As MixedModelBlockData, rows() As Integer, subjects() As Object,
                                                 Optional provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame = Nothing) As MixedModelWorkflowData
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            ValidateSubjects(subjects, issues)
            If data Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Length <> data.Nobs Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.shape", "Core blocks and retained RowIds must agree.")
            Else
                If subjects Is Nothing OrElse subjects.Length <> data.Nobs Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.shape", "Subject sidecar and Core blocks must align.")
                If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source RowIds must be distinct.")
                If Not data.Blocks.SelectMany(Function(b) b.RowIndices).OrderBy(Function(id) id).SequenceEqual(rows.OrderBy(Function(id) id)) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.mapping", "Core block rows must equal retained source rows.")
            End If
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowData(data, rows, subjects, issues, provenance)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub ValidateSubjects(subjects() As Object, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If subjects Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.required", "Subject identities are required.") : Return
            End If
            Dim identities As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each value In subjects
                If value Is Nothing OrElse Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()) = TypeCode.Object OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Subjects must be nonmissing immutable scalar labels.")
                ElseIf (TypeOf value Is Double AndAlso Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(DirectCast(value, Double))) OrElse
                       (TypeOf value Is Single AndAlso (Single.IsNaN(DirectCast(value, Single)) OrElse Single.IsInfinity(DirectCast(value, Single)))) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Numeric subject identities must be finite.")
                Else
                    Dim key = Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    If identities.ContainsKey(key) AndAlso Not Object.Equals(identities(key), value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.ambiguous", "Distinct typed subjects collapse to the same Core text identity.")
                    If Not identities.ContainsKey(key) Then identities.Add(key, value)
                End If
                If issues.Count >= MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

Public Shared Function FromArrays(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, y() As Double, x(,) As Double, subjects() As Object,
                                          visit() As Double, rows() As Integer, Optional z(,) As Double = Nothing,
                                          Optional provenance As SpreadsheetTransportFrame = Nothing) As MixedModelWorkflowData
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If y Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing OrElse subjects Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.required", "Response, expanded design, subjects and source RowIds are required.")
            Else
                If y.Length = 0 OrElse x.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.empty", "At least one observation and fixed-effect column are required.")
                If x.GetLength(0) <> y.Length OrElse subjects.Length <> y.Length OrElse rows.Length <> y.Length OrElse
                    (visit IsNot Nothing AndAlso visit.Length <> y.Length) OrElse (z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(0) <> y.Length) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.shape", "Response, subject, visit, RowId, X and Z row axes must agree.")
                If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source RowIds must be distinct.")
                For Each array As Array In New Array() {y, x, z, visit}
                    If array Is Nothing Then Continue For
                    For Each value As Double In array
                        If Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "data.finite", "Numeric model arrays must be finite.") : Exit For
                    Next
                Next
                ValidateSubjects(subjects, issues)
                If z IsNot Nothing AndAlso z.GetLength(1) = 0 Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "An expanded random design cannot have zero columns.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM AndAlso (z Is Nothing OrElse z.GetLength(1) = 0) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "random.empty", "LMM requires an expanded random design.")
                If kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM AndAlso visit Is Nothing Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "visit.required", "MMRM requires a visit role.")
            End If
            Dim data As MixedModelBlockData = Nothing
            If Not issues.Any(Function(i) i.Blocking) Then data = MixedModelBlockData.FromArrays(y, x, subjects, z, visit, kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM OrElse visit IsNot Nothing, rows)
            Return New MixedModelWorkflowData(data, rows, subjects, issues, provenance)
        End Function

Private Shared Sub ValidateSubjects(subjects() As Object, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If subjects Is Nothing Then
                MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.required", "Subject identities are required.") : Return
            End If
            Dim identities As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each value In subjects
                If value Is Nothing OrElse Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()) = TypeCode.Object OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Subjects must be nonmissing immutable scalar labels.")
                ElseIf (TypeOf value Is Double AndAlso Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(DirectCast(value, Double))) OrElse
                       (TypeOf value Is Single AndAlso (Single.IsNaN(DirectCast(value, Single)) OrElse Single.IsInfinity(DirectCast(value, Single)))) Then
                    MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.missing", "Numeric subject identities must be finite.")
                Else
                    Dim key = Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    If identities.ContainsKey(key) AndAlso Not Object.Equals(identities(key), value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "subject.ambiguous", "Distinct typed subjects collapse to the same Core text identity.")
                    If Not identities.ContainsKey(key) Then identities.Add(key, value)
                End If
                If issues.Count >= MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Sub New(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, data As MixedModelWorkflowData, responseKey As String, subjectKey As String, visitKey As String,
                       fixedNames() As String, randomNames() As String, fixedEffects As RegressionEffectModel, randomEffects As RegressionEffectModel,
                       fixedText As String, randomText As String, options As MixedModelWorkflowOptions,
                       Optional sourceResponseKey As String = Nothing, Optional sourceSubjectKey As String = Nothing, Optional sourceVisitKey As String = Nothing)
            Me.Kind = kind : Me.Data = data : Me.ResponseKey = responseKey : Me.SubjectKey = subjectKey : Me.VisitKey = visitKey
            Me.SourceResponseKey = If(sourceResponseKey, responseKey) : Me.SourceSubjectKey = If(sourceSubjectKey, subjectKey)
            Me.SourceVisitKey = If(sourceVisitKey, visitKey)
            _fixedNames = If(fixedNames Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(fixedNames.Clone(), String()))
            _randomNames = If(randomNames Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(randomNames.Clone(), String()))
            Me.FixedEffects = fixedEffects : Me.RandomEffects = randomEffects : Me.FixedText = fixedText : Me.RandomText = randomText
            _options = If(options, MixedModelWorkflowOptions.Defaults(kind)).Copy()
            Fitting = New MixedModelFittingOptions(kind, _options)
            Decision = Fitting.Decision
            Validation = MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Validate(Me)

Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelWorkflowPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Const MaximumDiagnostics As Integer = 128
        Public Shared Function LegacyRejectEpsilon(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return value <= 0 ' Preserve existing GUI NaN comparison; finite checks remain candidate diagnostics.
        End Function
        Public Shared Function LegacyRejectIterations(value As Integer) As Boolean
            Return value <= 0
        End Function
        Public Shared Function EmptyEffectSelection(count As Integer, intercept As Boolean) As Boolean
            Return count = 0 AndAlso Not intercept
        End Function
        Friend Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Friend Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), field As String, message As String, Optional blocking As Boolean = True)
            If issues.Count < MaximumDiagnostics Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("mixed." & field, field, message, blocking:=blocking))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function DecideFit(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, fit As String, inference As String) As MixedModelFitDecision
            Return New MixedModelFitDecision(kind, fit, inference)
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub ApplyOptimizer(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, ByRef control As MixedModelControl, optimizer As String, gradient As String)
            MixedModelFittingOptions.ProjectOptimizer(kind, control, optimizer, gradient)
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function PromotedRandomStructure(current As String, effects As RegressionEffectModel, generalOperation As Boolean, Optional authoredCount As Nullable(Of Integer) = Nothing) As String
            Dim count = If(authoredCount.HasValue, authoredCount.Value, If(effects Is Nothing, 0, effects.Effects.Count)), intercept = effects IsNot Nothing AndAlso effects.IncludeIntercept
            Dim general = generalOperation OrElse (Not intercept AndAlso count > 0) OrElse count + If(intercept, 1, 0) > 2
            If effects IsNot Nothing Then general = general OrElse effects.Effects.Any(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso
                (e.Spec.Scale = PredictorScale.Categorical OrElse Not String.Equals(e.Spec.Kind, "MainEffect", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse e.Spec.Degree > 1))
            Dim simple = String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept + Slope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            If general AndAlso simple Then Return "Variance Components (VC/Diag)"
            If count = 1 AndAlso intercept AndAlso String.Equals(current, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return "Random Intercept + Slope"
            Return current
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Validate(request As MixedModelWorkflowRequest) As RegressionValidation
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If request Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "request.required", "A mixed-model request is required.") : Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            Dim o = request.Options, d = If(request.Data Is Nothing, Nothing, request.Data.CoreData)
            If request.Data IsNot Nothing Then issues.AddRange(request.Data.Diagnostics)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(MixedModelWorkflowKind), request.Kind) Then Issue(issues, "kind", "Unknown mixed-model kind.")
            If d Is Nothing Then Issue(issues, "data.required", "Usable subject-block data are required.")
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ResponseKey) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.SubjectKey) Then Issue(issues, "roles", "Response and subject keys are required.")
            If request.Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.VisitKey) Then Issue(issues, "visit.required", "MMRM requires a named visit role.")
            If o.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then Issue(issues, "iterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If Not Finite(o.Epsilon) OrElse o.Epsilon <= 0 Then Issue(issues, "epsilon", "All three convergence tolerances require a finite positive epsilon.")
            If request.Decision.InferenceFallback Then Issue(issues, "inference.fallback", "Unrecognized GUI inference retains the model-specific legacy fallback.", False)
            If request.Decision.CoerceToReml Then Issue(issues, "fit.reml", "The existing KR guard changes ML to REML; Windows owns the information message.", False)
            If Not o.FixedIntercept AndAlso (request.FixedEffects Is Nothing OrElse request.FixedEffects.Effects.Count = 0) Then Issue(issues, "fixed.empty", "No fixed effects and fixed intercept is disabled.")
            Dim residual = request.Fitting.Residual
            If Not residual.IsSupported Then
                Issue(issues, "residual.structure", "Unsupported R-side covariance selection.")
            ElseIf residual.UsesVisitIndex AndAlso (d Is Nothing OrElse Not d.HasVisit OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.VisitKey)) Then
                Issue(issues, "visit.required", "The selected R structure requires visit indices.")
            End If
            If d IsNot Nothing Then
                If request.FixedNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso (request.FixedNames.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse request.FixedNames.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> request.FixedNames.Length) Then Issue(issues, "fixed.names", "Expanded fixed names must be nonblank and unambiguous.")
                If request.FixedNames Is Nothing OrElse request.FixedNames.Length <> d.P Then Issue(issues, "fixed.names", "Expanded fixed names must match X columns.")
                If request.Kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM Then
                    If request.RandomNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso (request.RandomNames.Any(Function(n) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n)) OrElse request.RandomNames.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> request.RandomNames.Length) Then Issue(issues, "random.names", "Expanded random names must be nonblank and unambiguous.")
                    If d.Q <= 0 OrElse request.RandomNames Is Nothing OrElse request.RandomNames.Length <> d.Q Then Issue(issues, "random.names", "Expanded random names must match Z columns.")
                    Dim authored = If(request.RandomEffects Is Nothing, 0, request.RandomEffects.Effects.Count)
                    If Not o.RandomIntercept AndAlso authored = 0 Then Issue(issues, "random.empty", "No random effects and random intercept is disabled.")
                    If String.Equals(o.RandomStructure, "Random Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso (d.Q <> 1 OrElse Not o.RandomIntercept OrElse authored <> 0) Then Issue(issues, "random.intercept", "Random Intercept requires intercept-only authoring and one expanded column.")
                    If String.Equals(o.RandomStructure, "Random Intercept + Slope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso (d.Q <> 2 OrElse Not o.RandomIntercept OrElse authored <> 1) Then Issue(issues, "random.slope", "Random Intercept + Slope requires intercept and exactly one authored effect/two expanded columns.")
                    Dim random = request.Fitting.Random
                    If Not random.IsSupported Then
                        Issue(issues, "random.structure", "Unsupported G-side covariance selection.")
                    ElseIf random.IsZeroRandom Then
                        Issue(issues, "random.structure", "LMM requires a G-side random structure.")
                    End If
                ElseIf d.Q <> 0 Then
                    Issue(issues, "random.mmrm", "MMRM has no random design.")
                End If
            End If
            issues.AddRange(request.Fitting.DesignDiagnostics(d))
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues.Take(MaximumDiagnostics), If(d Is Nothing, 0, d.P), If(d Is Nothing, 0, d.Q), {})
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' around C17-CA-NOLABEL-INDEX-01.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MultivariateContingencyInput
        Private ReadOnly _names, _labels As String()
        Private ReadOnly _rows As Integer()
        Friend Sub New(rowCount As Integer, sourceColumns As Integer, labelled As Boolean,
                       names() As String, sourceRows() As Integer, labels() As String)
            Me.RowCount = rowCount : Me.SourceColumnCount = sourceColumns : Me.HasLabelColumn = labelled
            _names = If(names Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(names.Clone(), String()))
            _rows = If(sourceRows Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(sourceRows.Clone(), Integer()))
            _labels = If(labels Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(labels.Clone(), String()))
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If rowCount < 1 OrElse CountColumnCount < 1 Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("multivariate.ca.empty", "counts", "Count axes are empty or invalid.", blocking:=False))
            If _rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso _rows.Length <> rowCount Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("multivariate.ca.rows.shape", "rows", "Supplied source RowIds do not match the count-row axis.", blocking:=False))
            If _names IsNot Nothing AndAlso _names.Length <> sourceColumns Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("multivariate.ca.names.shape", "columns", "Source names do not match the acquired column axis.", blocking:=False))
            If labelled AndAlso _labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso _labels.Length <> rowCount Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("multivariate.ca.labels.shape", "labels", "Supplied row labels do not match count rows.", blocking:=False))
            If Not labelled Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("C17-CA-NOLABEL-INDEX-01", "activation", "Correct unlabelled column identity mapping is dormant; the existing Windows failure remains active.", blocking:=False))
            Validation = New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
        End Sub

        Friend Sub New(input As MultivariateInputIntent, factor As Boolean)
            Dim labels = input.RowLabels

            Shape = New MultivariateArrayShape(input.RowCount + 1, input.ColumnCount + If(factor OrElse IncludesRowLabel, 1, 0))
            Dim names As New List(Of String)
            If factor Then names.Add("OriginalRow")

            If input.VariableNames IsNot Nothing Then names.AddRange(input.VariableNames)
            Headers = names.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

    Public Shared Sub ParsePriors(txt As String, ByRef categoryLabels() As Object, ByRef priorProbabilities() As Double)
        If txt.Trim() = String.Empty Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("User-specified priors were selected, but no prior definitions were supplied. Use the format GroupA=0.4; GroupB=0.6 or place each definition on a new line.")
        End If

        Dim normalized As String = txt.Replace(New String({Convert.ToChar(13), Convert.ToChar(10)}), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString()).Replace(Convert.ToChar(13).ToString(), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString())
        Dim chunks() As String = normalized.Split(New String() {Convert.ToChar(10).ToString(), ";"}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)

        Dim labelList As New List(Of Object)
        Dim valueList As New List(Of Double)

        For Each rawChunk As String In chunks
            Dim chunk As String = rawChunk.Trim()
            If chunk = String.Empty Then Continue For

            Dim splitPos As Integer = chunk.IndexOf("="c)
            If splitPos < 0 Then splitPos = chunk.IndexOf(":"c)
            If splitPos <= 0 OrElse splitPos >= chunk.Length - 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must be written as label=probability (for example: GroupA=0.4). Separate multiple definitions with semicolons or new lines.")
            End If

            Dim label As String = chunk.Substring(0, splitPos).Trim()
            Dim valueText As String = chunk.Substring(splitPos + 1).Trim()

            If label = String.Empty Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must include a non-empty group label.")
            End If

            Dim p As Double
            If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                               System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                               System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                               p) Then
                If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                                   System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                                   System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                   p) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Could not parse the user-specified prior probability '" & valueText & "'.")
                End If
            End If

            labelList.Add(label)
            valueList.Add(p)
        Next

        If labelList.Count = 0 Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("No valid user-specified priors were found.")
        End If

        categoryLabels = labelList.ToArray()

    Public Shared Sub ParsePriors(txt As String, ByRef categoryLabels() As Object, ByRef priorProbabilities() As Double)
        If txt.Trim() = String.Empty Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("User-specified priors were selected, but no prior definitions were supplied. Use the format GroupA=0.4; GroupB=0.6 or place each definition on a new line.")
        End If

        Dim normalized As String = txt.Replace(New String({Convert.ToChar(13), Convert.ToChar(10)}), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString()).Replace(Convert.ToChar(13).ToString(), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString())
        Dim chunks() As String = normalized.Split(New String() {Convert.ToChar(10).ToString(), ";"}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)

        Dim labelList As New List(Of Object)
        Dim valueList As New List(Of Double)

        For Each rawChunk As String In chunks
            Dim chunk As String = rawChunk.Trim()
            If chunk = String.Empty Then Continue For

            Dim splitPos As Integer = chunk.IndexOf("="c)
            If splitPos < 0 Then splitPos = chunk.IndexOf(":"c)
            If splitPos <= 0 OrElse splitPos >= chunk.Length - 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must be written as label=probability (for example: GroupA=0.4). Separate multiple definitions with semicolons or new lines.")
            End If

            Dim label As String = chunk.Substring(0, splitPos).Trim()
            Dim valueText As String = chunk.Substring(splitPos + 1).Trim()

            If label = String.Empty Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must include a non-empty group label.")
            End If

            Dim p As Double
            If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                               System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                               System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                               p) Then
                If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                                   System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                                   System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                   p) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Could not parse the user-specified prior probability '" & valueText & "'.")
                End If
            End If

            labelList.Add(label)
            valueList.Add(p)
        Next

        If labelList.Count = 0 Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("No valid user-specified priors were found.")
        End If

        categoryLabels = labelList.ToArray()
        priorProbabilities = valueList.ToArray()
    End Sub
    End Class

Public Shared Sub ParsePriors(txt As String, ByRef categoryLabels() As Object, ByRef priorProbabilities() As Double)
        If txt.Trim() = String.Empty Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("User-specified priors were selected, but no prior definitions were supplied. Use the format GroupA=0.4; GroupB=0.6 or place each definition on a new line.")
        End If

        Dim normalized As String = txt.Replace(New String({Convert.ToChar(13), Convert.ToChar(10)}), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString()).Replace(Convert.ToChar(13).ToString(), Convert.ToChar(10).ToString())
        Dim chunks() As String = normalized.Split(New String() {Convert.ToChar(10).ToString(), ";"}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)

        Dim labelList As New List(Of Object)
        Dim valueList As New List(Of Double)

        For Each rawChunk As String In chunks
            Dim chunk As String = rawChunk.Trim()
            If chunk = String.Empty Then Continue For

            Dim splitPos As Integer = chunk.IndexOf("="c)
            If splitPos < 0 Then splitPos = chunk.IndexOf(":"c)
            If splitPos <= 0 OrElse splitPos >= chunk.Length - 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must be written as label=probability (for example: GroupA=0.4). Separate multiple definitions with semicolons or new lines.")
            End If

            Dim label As String = chunk.Substring(0, splitPos).Trim()
            Dim valueText As String = chunk.Substring(splitPos + 1).Trim()

            If label = String.Empty Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Each user prior must include a non-empty group label.")
            End If

            Dim p As Double
            If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                               System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                               System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                               p) Then
                If Not Double.TryParse(valueText,
                                   System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands,
                                   System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                   p) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Could not parse the user-specified prior probability '" & valueText & "'.")
                End If
            End If

            labelList.Add(label)
            valueList.Add(p)
        Next

        If labelList.Count = 0 Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("No valid user-specified priors were found.")
        End If

        categoryLabels = labelList.ToArray()
        priorProbabilities = valueList.ToArray()
    End Sub
