    ''' <summary>Detached acquired identity/shape, not a second matrix store. Source rows,
    ''' Core retained positions, user labels and class labels are deliberately separate.
    ''' Numerical/categorical matrices are borrowed only for immediate Core calls.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MultivariateInputIntent
        Private ReadOnly _names As String(), _labels As String(), _groups As String(), _rows As Integer(), _keys As String()
        Public Sub New(kind As MultivariateAnalysisKind, rowCount As Integer, columnCount As Integer,
                       names() As String, Optional sourceRowIds() As Integer = Nothing,
                       Optional rowLabels() As String = Nothing, Optional groupLabels() As String = Nothing,
                       Optional sourceColumnKeys() As String = Nothing)
            Me.Kind = kind : Me.RowCount = rowCount : Me.ColumnCount = columnCount
            _names = Copy(names) : _rows = Copy(sourceRowIds) : _labels = Copy(rowLabels) : _groups = Copy(groupLabels) : _keys = Copy(sourceColumnKeys)
            Me.CellSemantics = If(kind = MultivariateAnalysisKind.MCA, MultivariateCellSemantics.CategoricalAnalysis,
                If(kind = MultivariateAnalysisKind.CA, MultivariateCellSemantics.ContingencyCounts,
                If(kind = MultivariateAnalysisKind.Discriminant, MultivariateCellSemantics.GroupThenNumericPredictors, MultivariateCellSemantics.NumericAnalysis)))
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If rowCount < 1 OrElse columnCount < 1 Then issues.Add(Candidate("dimensions", "Input has no analysis rows or columns."))
            If _names Is Nothing OrElse _names.Length <> columnCount Then issues.Add(Candidate("names.shape", "Column names do not match the acquired column axis."))
            If _names IsNot Nothing AndAlso _names.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> _names.Length Then issues.Add(Candidate("names.duplicate", "Duplicate column display names are retained."))
            If _rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso _rows.Length <> rowCount Then issues.Add(Candidate("rows.shape", "Source RowIds do not match the acquired row axis."))
            If _labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso _labels.Length <> rowCount Then issues.Add(Candidate("labels.shape", "User labels do not match the acquired row axis."))
            If _groups IsNot Nothing AndAlso _groups.Length <> rowCount Then issues.Add(Candidate("groups.shape", "Display groups do not match the acquired row axis."))
            If _keys IsNot Nothing AndAlso _keys.Length <> columnCount Then issues.Add(Candidate("keys.shape", "Selected source keys do not match the acquired column axis."))
            Validation = New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Candidate(code As String, message As String) As RegressionDiagnostic
            Return New RegressionDiagnostic("multivariate." & code, "input", message, blocking:=False)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Copy(Of T)(values() As T) As T()
            Return If(values Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(values.Clone(), T()))
        End Function

        Public ReadOnly Property CellSemantics As MultivariateCellSemantics
        Public ReadOnly Property RowCount As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property ColumnCount As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Validation As RegressionValidation
        Public ReadOnly Property Columns As IReadOnlyList(Of MultivariateColumnIntent)
            Get
                Dim output As New List(Of MultivariateColumnIntent)
                For j = 0 To Math.Min(Math.Max(0, ColumnCount), If(_names Is Nothing, 0, _names.Length)) - 1
                    output.Add(New MultivariateColumnIntent(j, If(_names IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < _names.Length, _names(j), Nothing),
                        If(_keys IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < _keys.Length, _keys(j), Nothing),
                        If(Kind = MultivariateAnalysisKind.Discriminant AndAlso j = 0, MultivariateColumnRole.GroupingVariable, MultivariateColumnRole.AnalysisVariable)))
                Next
                Return output.AsReadOnly()
            End Get
        End Property

            Get

            Get

            If groupingKey <> String.Empty AndAlso keys.Contains(groupingKey, StringComparer.Ordinal) Then Throw New ArgumentException("The grouping variable must not also be selected as an analysis variable.")

        Public Shared Function ClusterInputTable(data(,) As Object, names() As String, rows() As Integer, labels() As String) As Object(,)
            Dim n = data.GetLength(0), p = data.GetLength(1), include = labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso labels.Length = n
            Dim extra = If(include, 2, 1), output(n, p + extra - 1) As Object
            output(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If include Then output(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
            For j = 0 To p - 1
                output(0, j + extra) = names(j)
            Next
            For i = 0 To n - 1
                output(i + 1, 0) = rows(i)

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Shared one-way ANOVA application service. It owns the complete host-neutral ANOVA
    ''' orchestration (classical ANOVA, optional Welch test, and optional post-hoc procedures).
    ''' Windows Excel-DNA and Office.js/WASM hosts therefore do not need to recreate the Core model.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OneWayAnovaApplicationService

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Run(input As SpreadsheetRangeData) As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult
            Return Run(GroupedNumericRangeParser.Parse(input), Nothing)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Run(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                                   options As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions) As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult
            Return Run(GroupedNumericRangeParser.Parse(input), options)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Run(grouped As GroupedNumericData) As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult
            Return Run(grouped, Nothing)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Runs the shared ANOVA workflow from grouped numeric data that has already been
        ''' imported/validated by a host adapter.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Run(grouped As GroupedNumericData,
                                   options As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions) As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult
            If grouped Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(grouped))

            Dim safeOptions As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions = NormalizeOptions(options)
            Dim model As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(grouped.Groups, grouped.GroupNames)
            Dim raw As Object(,) = model.compute()

            Dim welch As Global.BESHStatNG.TestResult = Nothing
            If safeOptions.IncludeWelch Then
                welch = model.WelshANOVA()
            End If

            If safeOptions.IncludeFisherLsd Then model.FisherLSD(False, safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeBonferroni Then model.FisherLSD(True, safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeTukeyKramer Then model.TukeyKramer(safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeGamesHowell Then model.GamesHowell(safeOptions.Alpha)

            Dim resultTables As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable) = model.wrapResults()
            If resultTables Is Nothing OrElse resultTables.Count = 0 Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("One-way ANOVA did not produce a ResultTable.")
            End If

            Dim outputTables As New List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel)(resultTables.Count)
            For Each table As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable In resultTables
                outputTables.Add(table.ToOutputModel())
            Next

            Dim fStatistic As Double = Convert.ToDouble(raw(0, 3), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Dim pValue As Double = Convert.ToDouble(raw(0, 4), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

            Return New OneWayAnovaApplicationResult(
                outputTables,
                fStatistic,
                pValue,
                DirectCast(grouped.GroupNames.Clone(), String()),
                grouped.GroupCounts,
                welch,
                model.FisherLSDPlotData,
                model.BonferroniPlotData,
                model.TukeyKramerPlotData,
                model.GamesHowellPlotData)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function NormalizeOptions(options As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions) As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions
            Dim source As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions = If(options, New OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions())
            Dim safeAlpha As Double = source.Alpha

            If Double.IsNaN(safeAlpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(safeAlpha) OrElse
               safeAlpha <= 0.0 OrElse safeAlpha >= 1.0 Then
                safeAlpha = 0.05
            End If

            Return New OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions With {
                .IncludeWelch = source.IncludeWelch,
                .IncludeFisherLsd = source.IncludeFisherLsd,
                .IncludeBonferroni = source.IncludeBonferroni,
                .IncludeTukeyKramer = source.IncludeTukeyKramer,
                .IncludeGamesHowell = source.IncludeGamesHowell,
                .Alpha = safeAlpha
            }
        End Function
    End Class

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Runs the shared ANOVA workflow from grouped numeric data that has already been
        ''' imported/validated by a host adapter.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Run(grouped As GroupedNumericData,
                                   options As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions) As OneWayAnovaApplicationResult
            If grouped Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(grouped))

            Dim safeOptions As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions = NormalizeOptions(options)
            Dim model As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(grouped.Groups, grouped.GroupNames)
            Dim raw As Object(,) = model.compute()

            Dim welch As Global.BESHStatNG.TestResult = Nothing
            If safeOptions.IncludeWelch Then
                welch = model.WelshANOVA()
            End If

            If safeOptions.IncludeFisherLsd Then model.FisherLSD(False, safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeBonferroni Then model.FisherLSD(True, safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeTukeyKramer Then model.TukeyKramer(safeOptions.Alpha)
            If safeOptions.IncludeGamesHowell Then model.GamesHowell(safeOptions.Alpha)

            Dim resultTables As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable) = model.wrapResults()
            If resultTables Is Nothing OrElse resultTables.Count = 0 Then
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("One-way ANOVA did not produce a ResultTable.")
            End If

            Dim outputTables As New List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel)(resultTables.Count)
            For Each table As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable In resultTables
                outputTables.Add(table.ToOutputModel())
            Next

            Dim fStatistic As Double = Convert.ToDouble(raw(0, 3), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Dim pValue As Double = Convert.ToDouble(raw(0, 4), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

            Return New OneWayAnovaApplicationResult(
                outputTables,
                fStatistic,
                pValue,
                DirectCast(grouped.GroupNames.Clone(), String()),
                grouped.GroupCounts,
                welch,
                model.FisherLSDPlotData,
                model.BonferroniPlotData,
                model.TukeyKramerPlotData,
                model.GamesHowellPlotData)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function NormalizeOptions(options As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions) As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions
            Dim source As OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions = If(options, New OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions())
            Dim safeAlpha As Double = source.Alpha

            If Double.IsNaN(safeAlpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(safeAlpha) OrElse
               safeAlpha <= 0.0 OrElse safeAlpha >= 1.0 Then
                safeAlpha = 0.05
            End If

            Return New OneWayAnovaAnalysisOptions With {
                .IncludeWelch = source.IncludeWelch,
                .IncludeFisherLsd = source.IncludeFisherLsd,
                .IncludeBonferroni = source.IncludeBonferroni,
                .IncludeTukeyKramer = source.IncludeTukeyKramer,
                .IncludeGamesHowell = source.IncludeGamesHowell,
                .Alpha = safeAlpha
            }
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Ordered presentation snapshot over existing grouped-input contracts.
    ''' Does not acquire, regroup, trim, sort, deduplicate, filter or format labels/data.
    ''' Numeric and text raw labels remain distinct. The host supplies display labels.
    ''' Only immutable scalar raw labels are accepted; no workbook objects are retained.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OrderedPlotGroups

        Private ReadOnly names() As String, raw() As Object, groups()() As Double

        Private ReadOnly sources As Dictionary(Of Tuple(Of Integer, Integer), UnivariateObservationSource)

        Public Sub New(data As GroupedNumericData, Optional rawLabels As Object() = Nothing, Optional observationSources As IEnumerable(Of UnivariateObservationSource) = Nothing)
            If data Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(data))
            If data.GroupNames.Length <> data.Groups.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("Group and label counts must agree.", NameOf(data))
            If rawLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rawLabels.Length <> data.Groups.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("Raw label count must agree.", NameOf(rawLabels))
            names = DirectCast(data.GroupNames.Clone(), String())
            raw = If(rawLabels Is Nothing, names.Cast(Of Object)().ToArray(), DirectCast(rawLabels.Clone(), Object()))
            For Each label As Object In raw
                If label IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not(TypeOf label Is String OrElse TypeOf label Is Boolean OrElse TypeOf label Is Char OrElse TypeOf label Is Byte OrElse TypeOf label Is SByte OrElse TypeOf label Is Short OrElse TypeOf label Is UShort OrElse TypeOf label Is Integer OrElse TypeOf label Is UInteger OrElse TypeOf label Is Long OrElse TypeOf label Is ULong OrElse TypeOf label Is Single OrElse TypeOf label Is Double OrElse TypeOf label Is Decimal) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Raw labels must be immutable text/numeric/Boolean scalars.", NameOf(rawLabels))
                End If
            Next

            ReDim groups(data.Groups.Length - 1)
            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                groups(i) = If(data.Groups(i) Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(data.Groups(i).Clone(), Double()))
            Next

            sources = New Dictionary(Of Tuple(Of Integer, Integer), UnivariateObservationSource)()
            If observationSources IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each source In observationSources
                    If source Is Nothing OrElse source.GroupIndex < 0 OrElse source.GroupIndex >= groups.Length OrElse groups(source.GroupIndex) Is Nothing OrElse source.ObservationIndex < 0 OrElse source.ObservationIndex >= groups(source.GroupIndex).Length Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Source coordinates must identify an existing observation.", NameOf(observationSources))
                    End If

                    Dim key = Tuple.Create(source.GroupIndex, source.ObservationIndex)
                    If sources.ContainsKey(key) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate observation source.", NameOf(observationSources))
                    sources.Add(key, source)
                Next
            End If
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property DisplayLabels As String()
            Get
                Return DirectCast(names.Clone(), String())
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property RawLabels As Object()
            Get
                Return DirectCast(raw.Clone(), Object())
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property Data As GroupedNumericData
            Get
                Dim copy(groups.Length - 1)() As Double
                For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                    copy(i) = If(groups(i) Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(groups(i).Clone(), Double()))
                Next

                Return New GroupedNumericData(DisplayLabels, copy)
            End Get
        End Property

        ''' <summary>Explicit permutation from chart slot to original observation, with no
        ''' inferred physical row. A missing group vector has zero plotted observations.</summary>
        Public Function PointOrder(groupOrdinal As Integer, Optional observationOrder As Integer() = Nothing) As IReadOnlyList(Of OrderedPlotPoint)
            If groupOrdinal < 0 OrElse groupOrdinal >= groups.Length Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(groupOrdinal))
            Dim count = If(groups(groupOrdinal) Is Nothing, 0, groups(groupOrdinal).Length)
            Dim order = If(observationOrder Is Nothing, Enumerable.Range(0, count).ToArray(), DirectCast(observationOrder.Clone(), Integer()))
            If order.Length <> count OrElse order.Distinct().Count() <> count OrElse order.Any(Function(i) i < 0 OrElse i >= count) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Order must be a permutation of the group observations.", NameOf(observationOrder))
            End If

            Dim points As New List(Of OrderedPlotPoint)()
            For chartIndex As Integer = 0 To order.Length - 1
                Dim source As UnivariateObservationSource = Nothing
                sources.TryGetValue(Tuple.Create(groupOrdinal, order(chartIndex)), source)
                points.Add(New OrderedPlotPoint(groupOrdinal, order(chartIndex), chartIndex, source))
            Next

            Return New ReadOnlyCollection(Of OrderedPlotPoint)(points)
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Detached post-alignment row. Source row, input ordinal, display ID and match set
    ''' identity are distinct. Nothing source row records unavailable provenance, never a fabricated row.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PsmAlignedRow
        Friend Sub New(ordinal As Integer, sourceRow As Integer?, id As String, effectiveId As String, treatment As Double, outcome As Double?, score As Double?, exactLabel As String)
            Me.Ordinal = ordinal : Me.SourceRow = sourceRow : Me.Id = id : Me.EffectiveId = effectiveId
            Me.Treatment = treatment : Me.Outcome = outcome : Me.SuppliedScore = score : Me.ExactLabel = exactLabel
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property ExactLabel As String
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Observation-only identity snapshot after native alignment/design expansion.
    ''' Does not retain or copy covariate matrices; diagnostics never reject a Windows request.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PsmAlignedInputAxis
        Private ReadOnly sourceRows As Integer()
        Public Sub New(input As PsmInputData, sourceRowIds As Integer(), rawNames As IEnumerable(Of String), effectNames As IEnumerable(Of String), droppedRows As Integer)
            sourceRows = If(sourceRowIds Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(sourceRowIds.Clone(), Integer()))
            Me.DroppedRows = droppedRows
            RawCovariates = Array.AsReadOnly(If(rawNames, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()).ToArray())
            Effects = Array.AsReadOnly(If(effectNames, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()).ToArray())
            ExpandedCovariates = Array.AsReadOnly(If(input Is Nothing OrElse input.CovariateNames Is Nothing, New String() {}, CType(input.CovariateNames.Clone(), String())))
            HasExactGroups = input IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.ExactGroupLabels IsNot Nothing
            HasSuppliedScores = input IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.SuppliedPropensityScores IsNot Nothing
            Dim mapped As New List(Of PsmAlignedRow), notes As New List(Of String)
            If input IsNot Nothing Then
                If sourceRows Is Nothing OrElse sourceRows.Length <> input.RowCount Then notes.Add("C25-SOURCE-AXIS-SHAPE: source-row count differs from input; candidate only.")
                If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso sourceRows.Distinct().Count() <> sourceRows.Length Then notes.Add("C25-SOURCE-AXIS-DUPLICATE: repeated physical row identity; candidate only.")
                For i = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                    Dim source As Integer? = Nothing
                    If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < sourceRows.Length Then source = sourceRows(i)
                    Dim id As String = Nothing, exact As String = Nothing, score As Double? = Nothing, outcome As Double? = Nothing
                    If input.Ids IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < input.Ids.Length Then id = input.Ids(i)
                    If input.ExactGroupLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < input.ExactGroupLabels.Length Then exact = input.ExactGroupLabels(i)
                    If input.SuppliedPropensityScores IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < input.SuppliedPropensityScores.Length Then score = input.SuppliedPropensityScores(i)
                    If input.Outcome IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < input.Outcome.Length Then outcome = input.Outcome(i)
                    mapped.Add(New PsmAlignedRow(i, source, id, input.GetId(i), input.Treatment(i), outcome, score, exact))
                Next
            End If
            Rows = mapped.AsReadOnly() : CandidateDiagnostics = notes.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Rows As IReadOnlyList(Of PsmAlignedRow)
        Public ReadOnly Property RawCovariates As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public ReadOnly Property Effects As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public ReadOnly Property ExpandedCovariates As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public ReadOnly Property HasExactGroups As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property HasSuppliedScores As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property DroppedRows As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property CandidateDiagnostics As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public Function SourceRowIds() As Integer()
            Return If(sourceRows Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(sourceRows.Clone(), Integer()))
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Detached, already parsed Windows selections. No parsing or validation is added.
    ''' Selected options and effective options are separate fresh Core objects. Matrices are not copied.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PsmRequestSelection
        Private ReadOnly selected As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions
        Public Sub New(options As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions)
            selected = Copy(options)
        End Sub
        Public Function SelectedOptions() As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions
            Return Copy(selected)
        End Function
        Public Function CreateEffectiveOptions() As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions
            Dim fit = Copy(selected)
            Normalize(fit)
            Return fit
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CreateCemSpec(bins As Integer, standard As PsmOptions) As PsmCoarseningSpec
            Return New PsmCoarseningSpec With {.DefaultCovariateBins = bins, .PropensityScoreBins = bins,
                .Estimand = standard.Estimand, .NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize = standard.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize}
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Preserves Ui20 normalization, including inactive values; Core validates later.</summary>
        Public Shared Sub Normalize(fit As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions)
            If fit.StandardOptions Is Nothing Then Return
            Dim options = fit.StandardOptions
            If fit.RunMethod = PsmBackendRunMethod.OptimalPairMatching Then
                options.MatchingRatio = 1
                options.WithReplacement = False
                options.MatchingOrder = PsmMatchingOrder.AsInput
            End If
            If Not PsmMethodCapabilities.UsesMatchingControls(fit.RunMethod) Then
                options.DistanceMetric = PsmDistanceMetric.PropensityScore
                options.CaliperScale = PsmCaliperScale.None
                options.Caliper = Double.NaN
                options.MatchingRatio = 1
                options.WithReplacement = False
                options.MatchingOrder = PsmMatchingOrder.AsInput
            End If
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Copy(source As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions) As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions
            If source Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(source))
            Dim output As New PsmComprehensiveFitOptions With {
                .StandardOptions = If(source.StandardOptions Is Nothing, Nothing, PsmComprehensiveBackend.CloneOptions(source.StandardOptions)),
                .RunMethod = source.RunMethod, .IncludeDoublyRobustEstimate = source.IncludeDoublyRobustEstimate,
                .IncludeOverlapDiagnostics = source.IncludeOverlapDiagnostics, .IncludeWeightDiagnostics = source.IncludeWeightDiagnostics,
                .IncludeLovePlotRows = source.IncludeLovePlotRows, .OverlapBinCount = source.OverlapBinCount,
                .LovePlotThreshold = source.LovePlotThreshold, .ExtremeWeightCutoff = source.ExtremeWeightCutoff}
            Dim spec = source.CoarseningSpec
            If spec IsNot Nothing Then
                output.CoarseningSpec = New PsmCoarseningSpec With {
                    .BinCounts = If(spec.BinCounts Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(spec.BinCounts.Clone(), Integer())),
                    .CutPoints = If(spec.CutPoints Is Nothing, Nothing, spec.CutPoints.Select(Function(a) If(a Is Nothing, Nothing, CType(a.Clone(), Double()))).ToArray()),
                    .IncludePropensityScore = spec.IncludePropensityScore, .PropensityScoreBins = spec.PropensityScoreBins,
                    .DefaultCovariateBins = spec.DefaultCovariateBins, .Estimand = spec.Estimand,
                    .NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize = spec.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize, .DropUnmatchedStrata = spec.DropUnmatchedStrata}
            End If
            Return output
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Post-fit metadata only, from one existing Core result. Does not compute an estimator.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PsmResultPresentation
        Public Sub New(inputRowCount As Integer, result As PsmComprehensiveResult)
            Dim links As New List(Of PsmMatchIdentity), statuses As New List(Of PsmRowStatus), notes As New List(Of String)
            If result IsNot Nothing Then
                RunMethod = result.RunMethod : HasCem = result.CoarsenedExactResult IsNot Nothing
                HasLoveRows = result.LovePlotRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.LovePlotRows.Count > 0
                HasOverlapDiagnostics = result.OverlapDiagnostics IsNot Nothing
                HasDoublyRobust = result.DoublyRobustResult IsNot Nothing
                HasWeightDiagnostics = result.WeightDiagnostics IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.WeightDiagnostics.Count > 0
                If HasCem Then CemStrata = Array.AsReadOnly(If(result.CoarsenedExactResult.Strata, New List(Of PsmCemStratumRow)).Where(Function(s) s IsNot Nothing).Select(Function(s) New PsmStratumIdentity(s)).ToArray())
                Warnings = Array.AsReadOnly(If(result.Warnings, New List(Of String)).ToArray())
                Dim core = result.Result
                If core IsNot Nothing Then
                    If core.Options IsNot Nothing Then Estimand = core.Options.Estimand
                    If core.ScoreModel IsNot Nothing Then
                        ScoreConverged = core.ScoreModel.Converged : ScoreMethod = core.ScoreModel.Method
                    End If
                    BalanceRowCount = If(core.Balance Is Nothing, 0, core.Balance.Count)
                    For Each link In If(core.Matches, New List(Of PsmMatchLink))
                        If link Is Nothing Then
                            notes.Add("C25-MATCH-AXIS: missing link; candidate only.") : Continue For
                        End If
                        links.Add(New PsmMatchIdentity(link))
                        If {link.FocalRowIndex, link.MatchedRowIndex, link.TreatedRowIndex, link.ControlRowIndex}.Any(Function(i) i < 0 OrElse i >= inputRowCount) Then notes.Add("C25-MATCH-AXIS: out-of-range Core ordinal; candidate only.")
                    Next
                    'Index explicit Core ordinals once; duplicate observations retain first occurrence.
                    Dim byRow = If(core.Observations, New List(Of PsmObservation)).Where(Function(o) o IsNot Nothing).GroupBy(Function(o) o.RowIndex).ToDictionary(Function(g) g.Key, Function(g) g.First())
                    For i = 0 To inputRowCount - 1
                        Dim observation As PsmObservation = Nothing
                        byRow.TryGetValue(i, observation)
                        statuses.Add(New PsmRowStatus(i, core, result.CoarsenedExactResult, observation))
                    Next
                    SubclassIds = Array.AsReadOnly(If(core.Subclasses, New List(Of PsmSubclassRow)).Select(Function(s) s.Stratum).ToArray())
                End If
            End If
            If Warnings Is Nothing Then Warnings = Array.AsReadOnly(New String() {})
            If SubclassIds Is Nothing Then SubclassIds = Array.AsReadOnly(New Integer() {})
            If CemStrata Is Nothing Then CemStrata = Array.AsReadOnly(New PsmStratumIdentity() {})
            Matches = links.AsReadOnly() : Rows = statuses.AsReadOnly() : CandidateDiagnostics = notes.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

    ''' <summary>Optional-section orchestration; computations remain BinaryClassificationCore.
    ''' Windows supplies the legacy weighted event rate; ROC and chart work never enter Common.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class RegressionClassificationPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Compose(y() As Double, p() As Double, weights() As Double, options As RegressionOptions,
                                       Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN,
                                       Optional label As String = "GLM Binary Classification") As RegressionClassificationReport
            If options Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(options))
            If Not options.Classification Then Return New RegressionClassificationReport(New List(Of ResultTable), Nothing)
            If Not options.Family.HasValue OrElse options.Family.Value <> RegressionFamily.Binomial Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.options.classification: Classification requires a binomial GLM.")
            If Not RegressionRequestPolicy.Finite(options.Threshold) OrElse options.Threshold < 0 OrElse options.Threshold > 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.options.threshold: Classification threshold must be between 0 and 1.")
            If options.Calibration AndAlso options.CalibrationBins < 2 Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.options.calibrationBins: Calibration bin count must be at least 2.")
            BinaryClassificationCore.ValidateBinaryInputs(y, p, weights)
            Dim summary = BinaryClassificationCore.ComputeBinarySummary(y, p, options.Threshold, weights)
            Dim thresholds As List(Of BinaryThresholdRow) = Nothing, calibration As List(Of CalibrationBinSummary) = Nothing
            If options.ThresholdTable Then thresholds = BinaryClassificationCore.BuildThresholdTable(y, p, Nothing, weights)
            If options.Calibration Then calibration = BinaryClassificationCore.BuildCalibrationBins(y, p, options.CalibrationBins, weights, "quantile")
            Dim brier = Double.NaN
            If options.Brier Then brier = BinaryClassificationCore.ComputeBrierScore(y, p, weights)
            Return New RegressionClassificationReport(BinaryClassificationCore.WrapResults(summary, thresholds, calibration, brier, If(options.Brier, eventRate, Double.NaN), label), calibration)
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class RegressionRequestPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Validate(request As RegressionRequest) As RegressionValidation
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), classes As New List(Of Integer)
            If request Is Nothing Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.request.required", "request", "Regression request is required."))
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, classes)
            End If
            Dim o = request.Options
            Dim defaults As New List(Of String) From {"alpha"}
            If request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel Then defaults.AddRange({"epsilon", "maximumIterations"})
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson Then defaults.Add("emIterations")
            If o.Classification Then defaults.Add("threshold")
            For Each field In defaults
                If Not o.WasSupplied(field) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.options." & field & ".defaulted", "options." & field, "Default " & field & " was used.", blocking:=False))
            Next
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionAnalysisKind), request.Kind) Then Add(issues, "kind", "Unknown regression family.")
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ResponseKey) Then Add(issues, "response", "Dependent variable is missing.")
            If request.OptionsDefaulted Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.options.defaulted", "options", "Default regression options were used.", blocking:=False))
            If Not Finite(o.Alpha) OrElse o.Alpha <= 0 OrElse o.Alpha >= 1 Then Add(issues, "options.alpha", "Alpha must be finite and between 0 and 1.")
            If Not Finite(o.Epsilon) OrElse o.Epsilon <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.epsilon", "Convergence epsilon must be positive and finite.")
            If o.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.maximumIterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso o.EmIterations <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.emIterations", "EM iterations must be positive.")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(ReferenceCategory), o.Reference) Then Add(issues, "options.reference", "Invalid reference category.")
            If o.PValuePresentation Is Nothing Then Add(issues, "options.pValuePresentation", "P-value presentation metadata is required.")
            Dim family As Family = Nothing
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 Then
                If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel AndAlso (Not o.Family.HasValue OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionFamily), o.Family.Value)) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.family", "A GLM family is required.")
                Else
                    family = FamilyUtils.createFamily(If(request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2, "NegativeBinomial", o.Family.Value.ToString()))
                End If
                If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 AndAlso o.Family.HasValue AndAlso o.Family.Value <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial Then Add(issues, "options.family", "NB2 uses the Core negative-binomial family.")
                If Not o.Link.HasValue OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionLink), o.Link.Value) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.link", "A supported link is required.")
                ElseIf family IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not family.testLink(o.Link.Value.ToString()) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.link", "Link is not supported for the selected family.")
                End If
                If o.Link = RegressionLink.Power AndAlso (Not o.Power.HasValue OrElse Not Finite(o.Power.Value)) Then Add(issues, "options.power", "Power link parameter must be finite.")
            ElseIf o.Family.HasValue OrElse o.Link.HasValue Then
                Add(issues, "options.family", "Family/link options apply only to GLM and NB2.")
            End If
            If o.Dispersion.HasValue AndAlso (Not Finite(o.Dispersion.Value) OrElse o.Dispersion.Value <= 0 OrElse request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse o.Family <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial) Then Add(issues, "options.dispersion", "Dispersion applies to a negative-binomial GLM and must be positive and finite; NB2 estimates dispersion in Core.")
            If o.Power.HasValue AndAlso o.Link <> RegressionLink.Power Then Add(issues, "options.power", "Power parameter requires the power link.")
            If o.Classification AndAlso (request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse o.Family <> RegressionFamily.Binomial) Then Add(issues, "options.classification", "Classification requires a binomial GLM.")
            If o.Classification Then
                If Not Finite(o.Threshold) OrElse o.Threshold < 0 OrElse o.Threshold > 1 Then Add(issues, "options.threshold", "Classification threshold must be between 0 and 1.")
                If o.Calibration AndAlso o.CalibrationBins < 2 Then Add(issues, "options.calibrationBins", "Calibration bin count must be at least 2 under the Core contract.")
            End If
            Dim p = ValidateComponent(request.Primary, "primary", request.ResponseKey, issues, classes, family, request.Kind)
            Dim q = 0
            If request.Primary IsNot Nothing Then
                ValidateVector(request.Offset, request.Primary.RowIds, "offset", False, request.Kind, issues)
                ValidateVector(request.Weights, request.Primary.RowIds, "weights", True, request.Kind, issues)
            End If
            If request.Offset IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Weights IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Offset.Key = request.Weights.Key Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.roles.shared-key", "roles", "Offset and weights use the same source key; legacy role selection is retained.", blocking:=False))
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso request.Offset IsNot Nothing Then Add(issues, "offset", "LM does not consume an offset.")
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson Then
                Dim unused As New List(Of Integer)
                q = ValidateComponent(request.Logistic, "logistic", request.ResponseKey, issues, unused, Nothing, request.Kind)
                If request.Weights IsNot Nothing Then Add(issues, "weights", "The shipping ZIP model does not consume observation weights.")
                If request.Primary IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Logistic IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim a = request.Primary.RowIds, b = request.Logistic.RowIds
                    If a Is Nothing OrElse b Is Nothing OrElse Not a.SequenceEqual(b) Then Add(issues, "logistic.rowIds", "ZIP component row identities and ordering must match.")
                    Dim x = request.Primary.Data, z = request.Logistic.Data
                    If x IsNot Nothing AndAlso z IsNot Nothing AndAlso x.GetLength(1) > 0 AndAlso z.GetLength(1) > 0 AndAlso x.GetLength(0) = z.GetLength(0) Then
                        For i = 0 To x.GetLength(0) - 1
                            If x(i, 0) <> z(i, 0) Then Add(issues, "logistic.response", "ZIP components must share the same response.") : Exit For
                        Next
                    End If
                End If
            ElseIf request.Logistic IsNot Nothing Then
                Add(issues, "logistic", "Separate logistic effects apply only to ZIP.")
            End If
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal Then p += Math.Max(0, classes.Count - 1)
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial Then p *= Math.Max(0, classes.Count - 1)
            If (request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial) AndAlso classes.Count < 2 Then Add(issues, "primary.response.categories", "At least two observed response categories are required.")
            ValidateInitial(request.Primary, p, "primary.initialValues", issues)
            ValidateInitial(request.Logistic, q, "logistic.initialValues", issues)
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues, p, q, classes)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ValidateComponent(c As RegressionComponent, path As String, response As String,
                issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), classes As List(Of Integer), family As Family, kind As RegressionAnalysisKind) As Integer
            If c Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path, "Expanded model component is required.") : Return 0
            End If
            Dim data = c.Data, names = c.Names, rows = c.RowIds, keys = c.SourceKeys
            If data Is Nothing OrElse data.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse data.GetLength(1) = 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data", "Expanded data must contain a response and rows.") : Return 0
            End If
            If data.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse data.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data.bounds", "Expanded arrays must be zero based.") : Return 0
            End If
            If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso data.GetLength(0) < 2 Then Add(issues, path & ".data", "LM requires at least two rows under the existing Core contract.")
            If names Is Nothing OrElse names.Length <> data.GetLength(1) OrElse names.Length = 0 OrElse (names(0) <> response AndAlso names(0) <> RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(response)) Then Add(issues, path & ".names", "Expanded names must match the matrix with response first.")
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Length <> data.GetLength(0) OrElse rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".rowIds", "Source RowIds must be present, unique and aligned with the expanded matrix.")
            If c.ResponseSources IsNot Nothing AndAlso (rows Is Nothing OrElse c.ResponseSources.Count <> rows.Length OrElse c.ResponseSources.Where(Function(s, i) s Is Nothing OrElse s.WorksheetRow <> rows(i)).Any()) Then Add(issues, path & ".provenance", "Response transport provenance does not match selected source rows.")
            If keys Is Nothing OrElse keys.Any(Function(k) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(k)) OrElse keys.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> keys.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".sourceKeys", "Source keys must be present and unambiguous.")
            If c.Effects Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Typed effects snapshot is required.")
            Else
                If c.Effects.Effects.Count = 0 AndAlso Not c.Effects.IncludeIntercept Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "No intercept and effects were specified.")
                Dim seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                For Each e In c.Effects.Effects
                    If Not seen.Add(e.Key) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Duplicate effect key.")
                    Dim spec = e.Spec
                    Dim bases = If(spec Is Nothing, New List(Of String) From {e.Key}, spec.BaseVarKeys)
                    If bases Is Nothing OrElse bases.Count = 0 OrElse bases.Any(Function(k) keys Is Nothing OrElse Not keys.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal)) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects.sourceKeys", "Effect source key is missing or renamed.")
                Next
                For Each diagnostic In RegressionEffectAuthoringPolicy.Inspect(c.Effects, keys)
                    If diagnostic.Code = "term-metadata" Then
                        ' Core supports a plain raw key without optional TermSpec metadata.
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.effects.legacy-metadata", path & ".effects", "Plain source-key effect uses the existing Core metadata fallback.", columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey, blocking:=False))
                    Else
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, diagnostic.Message, columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey))
                    End If
                Next
            End If
            For i = 0 To data.GetLength(0) - 1
                For j = 0 To data.GetLength(1) - 1
                    If Not Finite(data(i, j)) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.numeric.nonfinite", path & ".data", "Expanded data must be finite; rows are never silently dropped.", If(rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Integer?), Nothing), If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < names.Length, names(j), Nothing)))
                Next
                Dim y = data(i, 0)
                If family IsNot Nothing AndAlso Finite(y) AndAlso Not family.validata(y) Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "Response is outside the existing Core family domain.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso y < 0 Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "ZIP response must be nonnegative.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial Then
                    If Finite(y) AndAlso Math.Round(y) >= Integer.MinValue AndAlso Math.Round(y) <= Integer.MaxValue Then
                        Dim category = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round(y)) ' Existing Core coding; do not introduce new coercion.
                        If Not classes.Contains(category) Then classes.Add(category)
                    Else
                        Add(issues, path & ".response.categories", "Category cannot be represented by the existing Core integer coding.")
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            Return data.GetLength(1) - 1 + If(c.Effects IsNot Nothing AndAlso c.Effects.IncludeIntercept AndAlso kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal, 1, 0)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ValidateInitial(c As RegressionComponent, expected As Integer, path As String, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If c Is Nothing Then Return
            Dim v = c.InitialValues
            If v Is Nothing Then Return
            If v.Length <> expected Then Add(issues, path & ".count", $"Expected {expected} initial values, received {v.Length}.")
            If v.Any(Function(x) Not Finite(x)) Then Add(issues, path, "Initial values must be finite.")
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub ValidateVector(v As RegressionVector, rows() As Integer, path As String, weights As Boolean, kind As RegressionAnalysisKind, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If v Is Nothing Then Return
            Dim values = v.Values, ids = v.RowIds
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v.Key) Then Add(issues, path & ".key", "Imported vector name is required.")
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse values Is Nothing OrElse ids Is Nothing OrElse values.Length <> rows.Length OrElse Not ids.SequenceEqual(rows) Then
                Add(issues, path & ".alignment", "Vector lengths, RowIds and ordering must match the source rows.") : Return
            End If
            For i = 0 To values.Length - 1
                If Not Finite(values(i)) OrElse (weights AndAlso (values(i) < 0 OrElse (kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso values(i) = 0))) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path & ".value", path, If(weights, "Invalid weight under the existing Core contract.", "Offset must be finite."), rows(i), v.Key))
            Next
        End Sub
        Friend Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), path As String, message As String)
            issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path, path, message))
        End Sub
    End Class
End Namespace

Public NotInheritable Class RegressionRequestPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Validate(request As RegressionRequest) As RegressionValidation
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), classes As New List(Of Integer)
            If request Is Nothing Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.request.required", "request", "Regression request is required."))
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, classes)
            End If
            Dim o = request.Options
            Dim defaults As New List(Of String) From {"alpha"}
            If request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel Then defaults.AddRange({"epsilon", "maximumIterations"})
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson Then defaults.Add("emIterations")
            If o.Classification Then defaults.Add("threshold")
            For Each field In defaults
                If Not o.WasSupplied(field) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.options." & field & ".defaulted", "options." & field, "Default " & field & " was used.", blocking:=False))
            Next
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionAnalysisKind), request.Kind) Then Add(issues, "kind", "Unknown regression family.")
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ResponseKey) Then Add(issues, "response", "Dependent variable is missing.")
            If request.OptionsDefaulted Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.options.defaulted", "options", "Default regression options were used.", blocking:=False))
            If Not Finite(o.Alpha) OrElse o.Alpha <= 0 OrElse o.Alpha >= 1 Then Add(issues, "options.alpha", "Alpha must be finite and between 0 and 1.")
            If Not Finite(o.Epsilon) OrElse o.Epsilon <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.epsilon", "Convergence epsilon must be positive and finite.")
            If o.MaximumIterations <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.maximumIterations", "Maximum iterations must be positive.")
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso o.EmIterations <= 0 Then Add(issues, "options.emIterations", "EM iterations must be positive.")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(ReferenceCategory), o.Reference) Then Add(issues, "options.reference", "Invalid reference category.")
            If o.PValuePresentation Is Nothing Then Add(issues, "options.pValuePresentation", "P-value presentation metadata is required.")
            Dim family As Family = Nothing
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 Then
                If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel AndAlso (Not o.Family.HasValue OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionFamily), o.Family.Value)) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.family", "A GLM family is required.")
                Else
                    family = FamilyUtils.createFamily(If(request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2, "NegativeBinomial", o.Family.Value.ToString()))
                End If
                If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.NegativeBinomial2 AndAlso o.Family.HasValue AndAlso o.Family.Value <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial Then Add(issues, "options.family", "NB2 uses the Core negative-binomial family.")
                If Not o.Link.HasValue OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionLink), o.Link.Value) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.link", "A supported link is required.")
                ElseIf family IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not family.testLink(o.Link.Value.ToString()) Then
                    Add(issues, "options.link", "Link is not supported for the selected family.")
                End If
                If o.Link = RegressionLink.Power AndAlso (Not o.Power.HasValue OrElse Not Finite(o.Power.Value)) Then Add(issues, "options.power", "Power link parameter must be finite.")
            ElseIf o.Family.HasValue OrElse o.Link.HasValue Then
                Add(issues, "options.family", "Family/link options apply only to GLM and NB2.")
            End If
            If o.Dispersion.HasValue AndAlso (Not Finite(o.Dispersion.Value) OrElse o.Dispersion.Value <= 0 OrElse request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse o.Family <> RegressionFamily.NegativeBinomial) Then Add(issues, "options.dispersion", "Dispersion applies to a negative-binomial GLM and must be positive and finite; NB2 estimates dispersion in Core.")
            If o.Power.HasValue AndAlso o.Link <> RegressionLink.Power Then Add(issues, "options.power", "Power parameter requires the power link.")
            If o.Classification AndAlso (request.Kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.GeneralizedLinearModel OrElse o.Family <> RegressionFamily.Binomial) Then Add(issues, "options.classification", "Classification requires a binomial GLM.")
            If o.Classification Then
                If Not Finite(o.Threshold) OrElse o.Threshold < 0 OrElse o.Threshold > 1 Then Add(issues, "options.threshold", "Classification threshold must be between 0 and 1.")
                If o.Calibration AndAlso o.CalibrationBins < 2 Then Add(issues, "options.calibrationBins", "Calibration bin count must be at least 2 under the Core contract.")
            End If
            Dim p = ValidateComponent(request.Primary, "primary", request.ResponseKey, issues, classes, family, request.Kind)
            Dim q = 0
            If request.Primary IsNot Nothing Then
                ValidateVector(request.Offset, request.Primary.RowIds, "offset", False, request.Kind, issues)
                ValidateVector(request.Weights, request.Primary.RowIds, "weights", True, request.Kind, issues)
            End If
            If request.Offset IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Weights IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Offset.Key = request.Weights.Key Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.roles.shared-key", "roles", "Offset and weights use the same source key; legacy role selection is retained.", blocking:=False))
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso request.Offset IsNot Nothing Then Add(issues, "offset", "LM does not consume an offset.")
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson Then
                Dim unused As New List(Of Integer)
                q = ValidateComponent(request.Logistic, "logistic", request.ResponseKey, issues, unused, Nothing, request.Kind)
                If request.Weights IsNot Nothing Then Add(issues, "weights", "The shipping ZIP model does not consume observation weights.")
                If request.Primary IsNot Nothing AndAlso request.Logistic IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim a = request.Primary.RowIds, b = request.Logistic.RowIds
                    If a Is Nothing OrElse b Is Nothing OrElse Not a.SequenceEqual(b) Then Add(issues, "logistic.rowIds", "ZIP component row identities and ordering must match.")
                    Dim x = request.Primary.Data, z = request.Logistic.Data
                    If x IsNot Nothing AndAlso z IsNot Nothing AndAlso x.GetLength(1) > 0 AndAlso z.GetLength(1) > 0 AndAlso x.GetLength(0) = z.GetLength(0) Then
                        For i = 0 To x.GetLength(0) - 1
                            If x(i, 0) <> z(i, 0) Then Add(issues, "logistic.response", "ZIP components must share the same response.") : Exit For
                        Next
                    End If
                End If
            ElseIf request.Logistic IsNot Nothing Then
                Add(issues, "logistic", "Separate logistic effects apply only to ZIP.")
            End If
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal Then p += Math.Max(0, classes.Count - 1)
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial Then p *= Math.Max(0, classes.Count - 1)
            If (request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial) AndAlso classes.Count < 2 Then Add(issues, "primary.response.categories", "At least two observed response categories are required.")
            ValidateInitial(request.Primary, p, "primary.initialValues", issues)
            ValidateInitial(request.Logistic, q, "logistic.initialValues", issues)
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues, p, q, classes)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ValidateComponent(c As RegressionComponent, path As String, response As String,
                issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), classes As List(Of Integer), family As Family, kind As RegressionAnalysisKind) As Integer
            If c Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path, "Expanded model component is required.") : Return 0
            End If
            Dim data = c.Data, names = c.Names, rows = c.RowIds, keys = c.SourceKeys
            If data Is Nothing OrElse data.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse data.GetLength(1) = 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data", "Expanded data must contain a response and rows.") : Return 0
            End If
            If data.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse data.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data.bounds", "Expanded arrays must be zero based.") : Return 0
            End If
            If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso data.GetLength(0) < 2 Then Add(issues, path & ".data", "LM requires at least two rows under the existing Core contract.")
            If names Is Nothing OrElse names.Length <> data.GetLength(1) OrElse names.Length = 0 OrElse (names(0) <> response AndAlso names(0) <> RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(response)) Then Add(issues, path & ".names", "Expanded names must match the matrix with response first.")
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Length <> data.GetLength(0) OrElse rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".rowIds", "Source RowIds must be present, unique and aligned with the expanded matrix.")
            If c.ResponseSources IsNot Nothing AndAlso (rows Is Nothing OrElse c.ResponseSources.Count <> rows.Length OrElse c.ResponseSources.Where(Function(s, i) s Is Nothing OrElse s.WorksheetRow <> rows(i)).Any()) Then Add(issues, path & ".provenance", "Response transport provenance does not match selected source rows.")
            If keys Is Nothing OrElse keys.Any(Function(k) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(k)) OrElse keys.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> keys.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".sourceKeys", "Source keys must be present and unambiguous.")
            If c.Effects Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Typed effects snapshot is required.")
            Else
                If c.Effects.Effects.Count = 0 AndAlso Not c.Effects.IncludeIntercept Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "No intercept and effects were specified.")
                Dim seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                For Each e In c.Effects.Effects
                    If Not seen.Add(e.Key) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Duplicate effect key.")
                    Dim spec = e.Spec
                    Dim bases = If(spec Is Nothing, New List(Of String) From {e.Key}, spec.BaseVarKeys)
                    If bases Is Nothing OrElse bases.Count = 0 OrElse bases.Any(Function(k) keys Is Nothing OrElse Not keys.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal)) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects.sourceKeys", "Effect source key is missing or renamed.")
                Next
                For Each diagnostic In RegressionEffectAuthoringPolicy.Inspect(c.Effects, keys)
                    If diagnostic.Code = "term-metadata" Then
                        ' Core supports a plain raw key without optional TermSpec metadata.
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.effects.legacy-metadata", path & ".effects", "Plain source-key effect uses the existing Core metadata fallback.", columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey, blocking:=False))
                    Else
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, diagnostic.Message, columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey))
                    End If
                Next
            End If
            For i = 0 To data.GetLength(0) - 1
                For j = 0 To data.GetLength(1) - 1
                    If Not Finite(data(i, j)) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.numeric.nonfinite", path & ".data", "Expanded data must be finite; rows are never silently dropped.", If(rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Integer?), Nothing), If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < names.Length, names(j), Nothing)))
                Next
                Dim y = data(i, 0)
                If family IsNot Nothing AndAlso Finite(y) AndAlso Not family.validata(y) Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "Response is outside the existing Core family domain.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso y < 0 Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "ZIP response must be nonnegative.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial Then
                    If Finite(y) AndAlso Math.Round(y) >= Integer.MinValue AndAlso Math.Round(y) <= Integer.MaxValue Then
                        Dim category = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round(y)) ' Existing Core coding; do not introduce new coercion.
                        If Not classes.Contains(category) Then classes.Add(category)
                    Else
                        Add(issues, path & ".response.categories", "Category cannot be represented by the existing Core integer coding.")
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            Return data.GetLength(1) - 1 + If(c.Effects IsNot Nothing AndAlso c.Effects.IncludeIntercept AndAlso kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal, 1, 0)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ValidateInitial(c As RegressionComponent, expected As Integer, path As String, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If c Is Nothing Then Return
            Dim v = c.InitialValues
            If v Is Nothing Then Return
            If v.Length <> expected Then Add(issues, path & ".count", $"Expected {expected} initial values, received {v.Length}.")
            If v.Any(Function(x) Not Finite(x)) Then Add(issues, path, "Initial values must be finite.")
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub ValidateVector(v As RegressionVector, rows() As Integer, path As String, weights As Boolean, kind As RegressionAnalysisKind, issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic))
            If v Is Nothing Then Return
            Dim values = v.Values, ids = v.RowIds
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v.Key) Then Add(issues, path & ".key", "Imported vector name is required.")
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse values Is Nothing OrElse ids Is Nothing OrElse values.Length <> rows.Length OrElse Not ids.SequenceEqual(rows) Then
                Add(issues, path & ".alignment", "Vector lengths, RowIds and ordering must match the source rows.") : Return
            End If
            For i = 0 To values.Length - 1
                If Not Finite(values(i)) OrElse (weights AndAlso (values(i) < 0 OrElse (kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso values(i) = 0))) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path & ".value", path, If(weights, "Invalid weight under the existing Core contract.", "Offset must be finite."), rows(i), v.Key))
            Next
        End Sub
        Friend Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), path As String, message As String)
            issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path, path, message))
        End Sub
    End Class

Private Shared Function ValidateComponent(c As RegressionComponent, path As String, response As String,
                issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), classes As List(Of Integer), family As Family, kind As RegressionAnalysisKind) As Integer
            If c Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path, "Expanded model component is required.") : Return 0
            End If
            Dim data = c.Data, names = c.Names, rows = c.RowIds, keys = c.SourceKeys
            If data Is Nothing OrElse data.GetLength(0) = 0 OrElse data.GetLength(1) = 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data", "Expanded data must contain a response and rows.") : Return 0
            End If
            If data.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse data.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 Then
                Add(issues, path & ".data.bounds", "Expanded arrays must be zero based.") : Return 0
            End If
            If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel AndAlso data.GetLength(0) < 2 Then Add(issues, path & ".data", "LM requires at least two rows under the existing Core contract.")
            If names Is Nothing OrElse names.Length <> data.GetLength(1) OrElse names.Length = 0 OrElse (names(0) <> response AndAlso names(0) <> RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(response)) Then Add(issues, path & ".names", "Expanded names must match the matrix with response first.")
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Length <> data.GetLength(0) OrElse rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".rowIds", "Source RowIds must be present, unique and aligned with the expanded matrix.")
            If c.ResponseSources IsNot Nothing AndAlso (rows Is Nothing OrElse c.ResponseSources.Count <> rows.Length OrElse c.ResponseSources.Where(Function(s, i) s Is Nothing OrElse s.WorksheetRow <> rows(i)).Any()) Then Add(issues, path & ".provenance", "Response transport provenance does not match selected source rows.")
            If keys Is Nothing OrElse keys.Any(Function(k) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(k)) OrElse keys.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> keys.Length Then Add(issues, path & ".sourceKeys", "Source keys must be present and unambiguous.")
            If c.Effects Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Typed effects snapshot is required.")
            Else
                If c.Effects.Effects.Count = 0 AndAlso Not c.Effects.IncludeIntercept Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "No intercept and effects were specified.")
                Dim seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                For Each e In c.Effects.Effects
                    If Not seen.Add(e.Key) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects", "Duplicate effect key.")
                    Dim spec = e.Spec
                    Dim bases = If(spec Is Nothing, New List(Of String) From {e.Key}, spec.BaseVarKeys)
                    If bases Is Nothing OrElse bases.Count = 0 OrElse bases.Any(Function(k) keys Is Nothing OrElse Not keys.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal)) Then Add(issues, path & ".effects.sourceKeys", "Effect source key is missing or renamed.")
                Next
                For Each diagnostic In RegressionEffectAuthoringPolicy.Inspect(c.Effects, keys)
                    If diagnostic.Code = "term-metadata" Then
                        ' Core supports a plain raw key without optional TermSpec metadata.
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.effects.legacy-metadata", path & ".effects", "Plain source-key effect uses the existing Core metadata fallback.", columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey, blocking:=False))
                    Else
                        issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression." & path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, path & ".effects." & diagnostic.Code, diagnostic.Message, columnKey:=diagnostic.RawKey))
                    End If
                Next
            End If
            For i = 0 To data.GetLength(0) - 1
                For j = 0 To data.GetLength(1) - 1
                    If Not Finite(data(i, j)) Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.numeric.nonfinite", path & ".data", "Expanded data must be finite; rows are never silently dropped.", If(rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Integer?), Nothing), If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < names.Length, names(j), Nothing)))
                Next
                Dim y = data(i, 0)
                If family IsNot Nothing AndAlso Finite(y) AndAlso Not family.validata(y) Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "Response is outside the existing Core family domain.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.ZeroInflatedPoisson AndAlso y < 0 Then Add(issues, path & ".response", "ZIP response must be nonnegative.")
                If kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal OrElse kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.Multinomial Then
                    If Finite(y) AndAlso Math.Round(y) >= Integer.MinValue AndAlso Math.Round(y) <= Integer.MaxValue Then
                        Dim category = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round(y)) ' Existing Core coding; do not introduce new coercion.
                        If Not classes.Contains(category) Then classes.Add(category)
                    Else
                        Add(issues, path & ".response.categories", "Category cannot be represented by the existing Core integer coding.")
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            Return data.GetLength(1) - 1 + If(c.Effects IsNot Nothing AndAlso c.Effects.IncludeIntercept AndAlso kind <> RegressionAnalysisKind.Ordinal, 1, 0)
        End Function

                                            result As SankeyPlotResult,
                                            appearance As SankeyChartSettings34) As String
        Dim valueText As String = node.Value.ToString(appearance.ValueNumberFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
        Dim denominator As Double

                denominator = result.ReferenceTotal

        Dim percentageText As String = percentage.ToString(appearance.PercentageNumberFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)

        Select Case appearance.NodeLabelMode
            Case SankeyNodeLabelMode.NameOnly
                Return node.Label
            Case SankeyNodeLabelMode.NameAndValue
                Return node.Label & " (" & valueText & ")"
            Case SankeyNodeLabelMode.NameAndPercentage
                Return node.Label & " " & percentageText
            Case SankeyNodeLabelMode.NamePercentageAndValue
                Return node.Label & " " & percentageText & " (" & valueText & ")"
            Case Else
                Return node.Label
        End Select
    End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Stable host-neutral application facade. The legacy enum-based request remains
    ''' binary/source compatible, but execution is now delegated to typed registrations.
    ''' New callers may dispatch directly by the stable analysis ID.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SharedAnalysisApplicationService

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>Compatibility entry point used by the Windows Excel-DNA host.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Run(request As SpreadsheetAnalysisRequest) As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult
            If request Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(request))
            If request.Input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("The analysis request has no input.", NameOf(request))

            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
            If Not AnalysisCatalog.TryGetByLegacyKind(request.AnalysisKind, descriptor) Then
                Throw New NotSupportedException(
                    "The shared Excel application layer does not support analysis kind " &
                    CInt(request.AnalysisKind).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & ".")
            End If
            Return AnalysisHandlerRegistry.Run(descriptor.Id, request.Input, request.Options)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Stable-ID entry point for new Excel/Office consumers.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Run(analysisId As String,
                                   input As SpreadsheetAnalysisInput,
                                   Optional options As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetAnalysisResult
            Return AnalysisHandlerRegistry.Run(analysisId, input, options)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Opt-in host-facing document API: known validation/unsupported/computation failures
        ''' become stable fault codes. Legacy Run overloads still throw as before.
        ''' Does not catch unexpected programming errors such as NullReferenceException.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function RunDocument(analysisId As String,
                                           input As SpreadsheetAnalysisInput,
                                           Optional options As SpreadsheetAnalysisOptions = Nothing) As AnalysisResultDocument
            Dim safeId As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(analysisId), "analysis.unknown", analysisId)
            Try
                Return Run(analysisId, input, options).Document
            Catch ex As NotSupportedException
                Return AnalysisResultDocument.Failure(safeId,
                    New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis, "The requested analysis is not supported.", "analysisId"))
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Return AnalysisResultDocument.Failure(safeId,
                    New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "The analysis request contains invalid inputs or options.", "request"))
            Catch ex As InvalidOperationException
                Return AnalysisResultDocument.Failure(safeId,
                    New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.ExecutionFailed, "The analysis could not complete.", "execution"))
            End Try
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class SpcSourcePointMap
        Friend Sub New(layout As SpcDataLayout, sources() As Integer, ids() As String, rejectBlank As Boolean)
            Me.Layout = layout
            Dim groups As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim rows As New List(Of List(Of Integer)), sourceGroups As New List(Of List(Of Integer)), keys As New List(Of String)
            Dim indices(sources.Length - 1) As Integer
            For row = 0 To sources.Length - 1
                Dim point As Integer
                Dim id As String = Nothing
                If layout = SpcDataLayout.StackedObservations Then
                    id = If(ids(row), String.Empty).Trim()
                    If rejectBlank AndAlso id.Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("A subgroup ID is blank at worksheet row " & sources(row).ToString() & ".")
                    If Not groups.TryGetValue(id, point) Then
                        point = groups.Count : groups.Add(id, point)
                    End If
                Else
                    point = row
                End If
                If point = rows.Count Then
                    rows.Add(New List(Of Integer)) : sourceGroups.Add(New List(Of Integer)) : keys.Add(id)
                End If
                rows(point).Add(row) : sourceGroups(point).Add(sources(row)) : indices(row) = point
            Next
            SourceRowIndices = Array.AsReadOnly(CType(sources.Clone(), Integer()))
            PointIndexByRow = Array.AsReadOnly(indices)
            Points = rows.Select(Function(v, i) New SpcSourcePoint(i, keys(i), v, sourceGroups(i))).ToList().AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

            If lastRow < firstRow Then Throw New ArgumentException("The selected columns contain no data rows.")

        End Function
        Public Shared Function FromRows(layout As SpcDataLayout, sources() As Integer, Optional subgroupIds() As String = Nothing, Optional rejectBlank As Boolean = True) As SpcSourcePointMap
            If sources Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(sources))
            If layout = SpcDataLayout.StackedObservations AndAlso (subgroupIds Is Nothing OrElse subgroupIds.Length <> sources.Length) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Subgroup identities must align with source rows.", NameOf(subgroupIds))
            Return New SpcSourcePointMap(layout, sources, subgroupIds, rejectBlank)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function LogicalPointCount(input As SpcInputData) As Integer
            If input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(input))
            If input.Layout <> SpcDataLayout.StackedObservations Then Return input.RowCount
            Dim distinct As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each id In input.SubgroupIds

    ''' <summary>Short-lived grid assembly; validation calls interleave with native cell parsing.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpcMultivariateStageBuilder
        Private ReadOnly _stages As String()
        Private ReadOnly _phases As SpcPhase()
        Private ReadOnly _assigned As Boolean()
        Private ReadOnly _used As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Private _count As Integer
        Public Sub New(pointCount As Integer)
            _stages = New String(pointCount - 1) {}
            _phases = New SpcPhase(pointCount - 1) {}
            _assigned = New Boolean(pointCount - 1) {}
        End Sub
        Public Sub BeginStage(id As String)
            _count += 1
            If id.Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Every stage requires a nonblank stage ID.")
            If Not _used.Add(id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage ID '" & id & "' is duplicated.")
        End Sub
        Public Sub ValidateRange(id As String, firstPoint As Integer, lastPoint As Integer)
            If firstPoint < 1 OrElse lastPoint < firstPoint OrElse lastPoint > _stages.Length Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & id & "' must use a valid one-based point range within 1 to " & _stages.Length.ToString() & ".")
            End If
        End Sub
        Public Sub Assign(id As String, firstPoint As Integer, lastPoint As Integer, phase As SpcPhase)
            For point As Integer = firstPoint - 1 To lastPoint - 1
                If _assigned(point) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " belongs to more than one stage.")
                _assigned(point) = True
                _stages(point) = id
                _phases(point) = phase
            Next
        End Sub
        Public Function Finish() As SpcMultivariatePointAssignments
            If _count = 0 Then
                For point As Integer = 0 To _stages.Length - 1
                    _stages(point) = "Stage1"
                    _phases(point) = SpcPhase.PhaseI
                Next
            Else
                For point As Integer = 0 To _stages.Length - 1
                    If Not _assigned(point) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " is not covered by the stage grid.")
                Next
            End If
            Return New SpcMultivariatePointAssignments(_stages, _phases)
        End Function
    End Class
