    Public NotInheritable Class SpcMultivariateExclusionImport
        Private ReadOnly _map As SpcMultivariatePointMap
        Private ReadOnly _excluded As Boolean()
        Private ReadOnly _reasons As HashSet(Of String)()
        Public Sub New(map As SpcMultivariatePointMap)
            _map = map
            _excluded = New Boolean(map.PointCount - 1) {}
            _reasons = New HashSet(Of String)(map.PointCount - 1) {}
            For i As Integer = 0 To _reasons.Length - 1
                _reasons(i) = New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Next
        End Sub
        Public Sub IncludeRow(row As Integer, excluded As Boolean, reasons As String())
            Dim point = _map.PointIndexByRow(row)
            If excluded Then
                _excluded(point) = True
                If reasons IsNot Nothing AndAlso reasons(row).Length > 0 Then _reasons(point).Add(reasons(row))
            End If
        End Sub
        Public Function Rows() As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcMultivariateImportedExclusion)
            Dim values As New List(Of SpcMultivariateImportedExclusion)
            For point As Integer = 0 To _excluded.Length - 1
                If Not _excluded(point) Then Continue For
                values.Add(New SpcMultivariateImportedExclusion(point + 1, String.Join("; ", _reasons(point).ToArray())))
            Next
            Return values.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
    End Class

    Public Enum SpcMultivariateQuickPhase
        AllPhaseI
        PhaseIThenPhaseII
        AllPhaseII
    End Enum

    Public NotInheritable Class SpcMultivariatePhasePolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ParsePhase(text As String) As SpcPhase
            Dim normalized = text.Trim().Replace(" ", String.Empty).ToUpperInvariant()
            If normalized = "PHASEI" OrElse normalized = "I" OrElse normalized = "1" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseI
            If normalized = "PHASEII" OrElse normalized = "II" OrElse normalized = "2" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseII
            Throw New ArgumentException("Phase must be 'Phase I' or 'Phase II'.")
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Quick(pointCount As Integer, mode As SpcMultivariateQuickPhase, Optional lastPhaseI As Integer = 1, Optional modelSource As SpcMultivariateModelSource = SpcMultivariateModelSource.EstimateFromPhaseI) As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            Dim rows As New List(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            If mode = SpcMultivariateQuickPhase.AllPhaseI Then
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseI", 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseI))
            ElseIf mode = SpcMultivariateQuickPhase.AllPhaseII Then
                If modelSource <> SpcMultivariateModelSource.UseHistoricalParameters Then Throw New ArgumentException("All-Phase-II monitoring requires historical parameters.")
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseII", 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseII))
            Else
                If lastPhaseI < 1 OrElse lastPhaseI >= pointCount Then Throw New ArgumentException("The last Phase I point must be between 1 and " & (pointCount - 1).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & ".")
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseI", 1, lastPhaseI, SpcPhase.PhaseI))
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseII", lastPhaseI + 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseII))
            End If
            Return rows.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CollapseImported(map As SpcMultivariatePointMap, rowStages As String(), rowPhases As String()) As SpcMultivariatePointAssignments
            Dim stages(map.PointCount - 1) As String
            Dim phases(map.PointCount - 1) As SpcPhase
            For point As Integer = 0 To map.PointCount - 1
                If rowPhases Is Nothing Then
                    phases(point) = SpcPhase.PhaseI
                Else
                    Dim found As SpcPhase? = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = ParsePhase(rowPhases(row))
                        If found.HasValue AndAlso found.Value <> current Then Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent phase values.")
                        found = current
                    Next
                    If Not found.HasValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("No phase value is available for chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                    phases(point) = found.Value
                End If
                If rowStages IsNot Nothing Then
                    stages(point) = map.CollapsedText(rowStages, point, "stage identifier")
                    If stages(point).Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("The stage identifier is blank at chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                End If
            Next
            If rowStages Is Nothing Then GenerateStageIdsFromPhaseRuns(stages, phases)
            Return New SpcMultivariatePointAssignments(stages, phases)
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub GenerateStageIdsFromPhaseRuns(stageIds As String(), phases As SpcPhase())
            Dim phaseCounts As New Dictionary(Of SpcPhase, Integer)
            Dim start As Integer = 0
            While start < phases.Length
                Dim phase = phases(start), finish = start
                While finish + 1 < phases.Length AndAlso phases(finish + 1) = phase
                    finish += 1
                End While
                Dim number = If(phaseCounts.ContainsKey(phase), phaseCounts(phase) + 1, 1)
                phaseCounts(phase) = number
                Dim baseId = If(phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "PhaseI", "PhaseII")
                Dim id = If(number = 1, baseId, baseId & "-" & number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                For i As Integer = start To finish
                    stageIds(i) = id
                Next
                start = finish + 1
            End While
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>Lazy to preserve clearing/add-row chronology and partial grid state on failure.</summary>
        Public Shared Iterator Function ImportedRows(assignments As SpcMultivariatePointAssignments) As IEnumerable(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            Dim used As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim runStart = 0, count = assignments.Phases.Count
            For point As Integer = 1 To count
                Dim atEnd = point = count
                Dim changed = Not atEnd AndAlso (Not String.Equals(assignments.StageIds(point), assignments.StageIds(runStart), StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse assignments.Phases(point) <> assignments.Phases(runStart))
                If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For
                Dim id = assignments.StageIds(runStart).Trim()
                If Not used.Add(id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & id & "' occurs in more than one non-contiguous block.")
                Yield New SpcMultivariateStageRow(id, runStart + 1, point, assignments.Phases(runStart))
                runStart = point
            Next
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class SpcMultivariatePhasePolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ParsePhase(text As String) As SpcPhase
            Dim normalized = text.Trim().Replace(" ", String.Empty).ToUpperInvariant()
            If normalized = "PHASEI" OrElse normalized = "I" OrElse normalized = "1" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseI
            If normalized = "PHASEII" OrElse normalized = "II" OrElse normalized = "2" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseII
            Throw New ArgumentException("Phase must be 'Phase I' or 'Phase II'.")
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Quick(pointCount As Integer, mode As SpcMultivariateQuickPhase, Optional lastPhaseI As Integer = 1, Optional modelSource As SpcMultivariateModelSource = SpcMultivariateModelSource.EstimateFromPhaseI) As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            Dim rows As New List(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            If mode = SpcMultivariateQuickPhase.AllPhaseI Then
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseI", 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseI))
            ElseIf mode = SpcMultivariateQuickPhase.AllPhaseII Then
                If modelSource <> SpcMultivariateModelSource.UseHistoricalParameters Then Throw New ArgumentException("All-Phase-II monitoring requires historical parameters.")
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseII", 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseII))
            Else
                If lastPhaseI < 1 OrElse lastPhaseI >= pointCount Then Throw New ArgumentException("The last Phase I point must be between 1 and " & (pointCount - 1).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & ".")
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseI", 1, lastPhaseI, SpcPhase.PhaseI))
                rows.Add(New SpcMultivariateStageRow("PhaseII", lastPhaseI + 1, pointCount, SpcPhase.PhaseII))
            End If
            Return rows.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CollapseImported(map As SpcMultivariatePointMap, rowStages As String(), rowPhases As String()) As SpcMultivariatePointAssignments
            Dim stages(map.PointCount - 1) As String
            Dim phases(map.PointCount - 1) As SpcPhase
            For point As Integer = 0 To map.PointCount - 1
                If rowPhases Is Nothing Then
                    phases(point) = SpcPhase.PhaseI
                Else
                    Dim found As SpcPhase? = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = ParsePhase(rowPhases(row))
                        If found.HasValue AndAlso found.Value <> current Then Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent phase values.")
                        found = current
                    Next
                    If Not found.HasValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("No phase value is available for chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                    phases(point) = found.Value
                End If
                If rowStages IsNot Nothing Then
                    stages(point) = map.CollapsedText(rowStages, point, "stage identifier")
                    If stages(point).Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("The stage identifier is blank at chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                End If
            Next
            If rowStages Is Nothing Then GenerateStageIdsFromPhaseRuns(stages, phases)
            Return New SpcMultivariatePointAssignments(stages, phases)
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub GenerateStageIdsFromPhaseRuns(stageIds As String(), phases As SpcPhase())
            Dim phaseCounts As New Dictionary(Of SpcPhase, Integer)
            Dim start As Integer = 0
            While start < phases.Length
                Dim phase = phases(start), finish = start
                While finish + 1 < phases.Length AndAlso phases(finish + 1) = phase
                    finish += 1
                End While
                Dim number = If(phaseCounts.ContainsKey(phase), phaseCounts(phase) + 1, 1)
                phaseCounts(phase) = number
                Dim baseId = If(phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "PhaseI", "PhaseII")
                Dim id = If(number = 1, baseId, baseId & "-" & number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                For i As Integer = start To finish
                    stageIds(i) = id
                Next
                start = finish + 1
            End While
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>Lazy to preserve clearing/add-row chronology and partial grid state on failure.</summary>
        Public Shared Iterator Function ImportedRows(assignments As SpcMultivariatePointAssignments) As IEnumerable(Of SpcMultivariateStageRow)
            Dim used As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim runStart = 0, count = assignments.Phases.Count
            For point As Integer = 1 To count
                Dim atEnd = point = count
                Dim changed = Not atEnd AndAlso (Not String.Equals(assignments.StageIds(point), assignments.StageIds(runStart), StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse assignments.Phases(point) <> assignments.Phases(runStart))
                If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For
                Dim id = assignments.StageIds(runStart).Trim()
                If Not used.Add(id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & id & "' occurs in more than one non-contiguous block.")
                Yield New SpcMultivariateStageRow(id, runStart + 1, point, assignments.Phases(runStart))
                runStart = point
            Next
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Function BuildDiagnosticTables(signalOnly As Boolean) As List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim result = _result
            Dim context = Me.Context
            Dim selected = context.SelectDiagnostics(signalOnly).Select(Function(item) New SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot(item)).ToList()

            Dim names As String() = result.Request.VariableNames
            Dim hasState As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.StateVector IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasScores As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.ComponentScores IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasResiduals As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.ResidualVector IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasContributions As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.Contributions IsNot Nothing)
            Dim scoreCount As Integer = 0
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                If item.ComponentScores IsNot Nothing Then scoreCount = Math.Max(scoreCount, item.ComponentScores.Length)
            Next

            Dim headers As New List(Of String) From {
                "Point", "Source Rows", "Label", "Stage", "Phase", "Statistic", "Effective Sample Size"
            }
            For Each name As String In names
                headers.Add("Observed: " & name)
            Next
            If hasState Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("State: " & name)
                Next
            End If
            If hasScores Then
                For i As Integer = 1 To scoreCount
                    headers.Add("PC Score " & i.ToString())
                Next
            End If
            If hasResiduals Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("Residual: " & name)
                Next
            End If
            If hasContributions Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("Contribution: " & name)
                Next
                headers.Add("Contribution Total")
                headers.Add("Contribution Basis")
            End If

            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                Dim values As New List(Of Object) From {
                    item.PointIndex + 1,
                    JoinIntegers(item.SourceRowIndices, addOne:=False),
                    item.Label,
                    item.StageId,
                    PhaseText(item.Phase),
                    item.Statistic,
                    item.EffectiveSampleSize
                }
                AddVectorValues(values, item.ObservationVector, names.Length)
                If hasState Then AddVectorValues(values, item.StateVector, names.Length)
                If hasScores Then AddVectorValues(values, item.ComponentScores, scoreCount)
                If hasResiduals Then AddVectorValues(values, item.ResidualVector, names.Length)
                If hasContributions Then
                    AddVectorValues(values, item.Contributions, names.Length)
                    values.Add(If(Double.IsNaN(item.ContributionTotal), CType(String.Empty, Object), item.ContributionTotal))
                    values.Add(item.ContributionBasis)
                End If
                rows.Add(values.ToArray())
            Next

            Dim tables As New List(Of ResultTable) From {
                CreateTable("Multivariate point diagnostics and contributions", headers.ToArray(), rows,
                            emptyMessage:=If(signalOnly, "No signalled points have diagnostics.", "No point diagnostics were returned."))
            }
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                If item.SubgroupCovariance Is Nothing Then Continue For
                tables.Add(CreateMatrixTable("Subgroup covariance - point " & (item.PointIndex + 1).ToString(),
                                              names, names, item.SubgroupCovariance))
            Next
            Return tables
        End Function

        Public Function BuildAuditTables(view As SpcMultivariateAuditView) As List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim result = _result
            Dim request As SpcMultivariateRequest = result.Request
            Dim settings As New List(Of Object()) From {
                Row("Request label", request.RequestLabel),
                Row("Chart type", ChartTypeText(request.ChartType)),
                Row("Observation structure", If(request.HasSubgroups, "Rational subgroups", "Individual observations")),
                Row("Missing-value policy", MissingPolicyText(request.MissingValuePolicy)),
                Row("Model source", ModelSourceText(request.ModelSource)),
                Row("Control-limit alpha", request.ControlLimitAlpha),
                Row("Use lower Hotelling limit", YesNo(request.UseLowerHotellingLimit)),
                Row("Diagonal ridge factor", request.CovarianceRegularization),
                Row("Allow pseudoinverse", YesNo(request.AllowPseudoInverse)),
                Row("PCA matrix", If(request.PcaUseCorrelationMatrix, "Correlation", "Covariance")),
                Row("PCA component count", NullableValue(request.PcaComponentCount)),
                Row("PCA cumulative variance", request.PcaCumulativeVariance),
                Row("MEWMA lambda", request.MewmaLambda),
                Row("MEWMA supplied UCL", NullableValue(request.MewmaControlLimit)),
                Row("MCUSUM k", request.McusumReferenceValue),
                Row("MCUSUM h", request.McusumDecisionInterval),
                Row("Generalized-variance sigma multiplier", NullableValue(request.GeneralizedVarianceSigmaMultiplier)),
                Row("Reset at stage boundary", YesNo(request.ResetAtStageBoundary)),
                Row("Reset at phase boundary", YesNo(request.ResetAtPhaseBoundary)),
                Row("Reset after signal", YesNo(request.ResetAfterSignal)),
                Row("Sequence-gap behaviour", SequenceGapBehaviorText(request.SequenceGapBehavior)),
                Row("Chart title", view.ChartTitle),
                Row("Value-axis title", view.ValueAxisTitle),
                Row("Horizontal-axis title", view.HorizontalAxisTitle),
                Row("Use sequence on horizontal axis", YesNo(view.UseSequence)),
                Row("Chart width", view.Width),
                Row("Chart height", view.Height),
                Row("Execution time (ms)", result.ExecutionTimeMilliseconds)
            }

            Dim stageRows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim panelPoints As SpcPointResult() = result.Panels(0).Points
            If panelPoints.Length > 0 Then
                Dim start As Integer = 0
                For i As Integer = 1 To panelPoints.Length
                    Dim atEnd As Boolean = i = panelPoints.Length
                    Dim changed As Boolean = Not atEnd AndAlso
                        (Not String.Equals(panelPoints(i).StageId, panelPoints(start).StageId, StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                         panelPoints(i).Phase <> panelPoints(start).Phase)
                    If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For
                    stageRows.Add(Row(panelPoints(start).StageId,
                                      panelPoints(start).PointIndex + 1,
                                      panelPoints(i - 1).PointIndex + 1,
                                      PhaseText(panelPoints(start).Phase)))
                    start = i
                Next
            End If

            Dim exclusionRows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim scopes As SpcExclusionScope() = request.ExclusionScopes
            Dim reasons As String() = request.ExclusionReasons
            Dim sourceRows As Integer() = request.SourceRowIndices
            For i As Integer = 0 To scopes.Length - 1
                If scopes(i) = SpcExclusionScope.None Then Continue For
                exclusionRows.Add(Row(sourceRows(i), ExclusionScopeText(scopes(i)), reasons(i)))
            Next

            Return New List(Of ResultTable) From {
                CreateTable("Multivariate SPC settings and audit", {"Setting", "Value"}, settings),
                CreateTable("Effective stages", {"Stage", "First Point", "Last Point", "Phase"}, stageRows,
                            emptyMessage:="No chart points were returned."),
                CreateTable("Source-row exclusions", {"Source Row", "Scope", "Reason"}, exclusionRows,
                            emptyMessage:="No explicit exclusions were supplied."),
                BuildWarningsTable()
            }
        End Function

        Public Function BuildWarningsTable() As ResultTable
            Dim result = _result
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim warnings As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Me.Warnings.Values
            For i As Integer = 0 To warnings.Count - 1
                rows.Add(Row(i + 1, warnings(i)))
            Next
            Return CreateTable("Multivariate SPC warnings", {"Number", "Warning"}, rows,
                               emptyMessage:="No calculation warnings were reported.")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateTable(title As String, headers As String(), rows As IList(Of Object()),
                                            Optional emptyMessage As String = Nothing,
                                            Optional footnote As String = Nothing) As ResultTable
            Dim table As New ResultTable()
            If title.Length > 0 Then table.AddTitle(title)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(CType(headers.Clone(), String()))
            If rows.Count > 0 Then
                Dim body(rows.Count - 1, headers.Length - 1) As Object
                For r As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                    If rows(r).Length <> headers.Length Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("A result row does not match its table header.")
                    For c As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1
                        body(r, c) = rows(r)(c)
                    Next
                Next
                table.SetBody(body)
            ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(emptyMessage) Then
                table.AddFootnote(emptyMessage)
            End If
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(footnote) Then table.AddFootnote(footnote)
            Return table
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateVectorTable(title As String, names As String(), values As Double(), valueHeader As String) As ResultTable
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            If values IsNot Nothing Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                    rows.Add(Row(names(i), values(i)))
                Next
            End If
            Return CreateTable(title, {"Variable", valueHeader}, rows, emptyMessage:="Not applicable to this chart.")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateIndexedVectorTable(title As String, values As Double(), indexHeader As String, valueHeader As String) As ResultTable
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                rows.Add(Row(i + 1, values(i)))
            Next
            Return CreateTable(title, {indexHeader, valueHeader}, rows)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateMatrixTable(title As String, rowNames As String(), columnNames As String(), values As Double(,)) As ResultTable
            Dim headers As New List(Of String) From {"Variable"}
            headers.AddRange(columnNames)
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For r As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim row(values.GetLength(1)) As Object
                row(0) = rowNames(r)
                For c As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(1) - 1
                    row(c + 1) = values(r, c)
                Next
                rows.Add(row)
            Next
            Return CreateTable(title, headers.ToArray(), rows)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComponentNames(count As Integer) As String()
            Dim names(count - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To count - 1
                names(i) = "PC" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Next
            Return names
        End Function

        Public Shared Sub AddVectorValues(target As List(Of Object), values As Double(), count As Integer)
            For i As Integer = 0 To count - 1
                If values IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < values.Length Then
                    target.Add(values(i))
                Else
                    target.Add(String.Empty)
                End If
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Row(ParamArray values As Object()) As Object()
            Return values
        End Function

        Public Shared Function PhaseText(value As SpcPhase) As String
            Return If(value = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "Phase I", "Phase II")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function MissingPolicyText(value As SpcMissingValuePolicy) As String
            Return If(value = SpcMissingValuePolicy.Reject, "Reject", "Omit incomplete observation")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ModelSourceText(value As SpcMultivariateModelSource) As String
            Return If(value = SpcMultivariateModelSource.EstimateFromPhaseI, "Estimate from Phase I", "Use historical parameters")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function SequenceGapBehaviorText(value As SpcSequenceGapBehavior) As String
            Select Case value
                Case SpcSequenceGapBehavior.BreakSequence : Return "Break sequence"
                Case SpcSequenceGapBehavior.SkipPointAndContinue : Return "Skip point and continue"
                Case Else : Return value.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ChartTypeText(value As SpcChartType) As String
            Select Case value
                Case SpcChartType.HotellingT2 : Return "Hotelling T-squared"
                Case SpcChartType.GeneralizedVariance : Return "Generalized variance"
                Case SpcChartType.PcaT2 : Return "PCA T-squared"
                Case SpcChartType.PcaQ : Return "PCA Q"
                Case SpcChartType.Mewma : Return "MEWMA"
                Case SpcChartType.Mcusum : Return "MCUSUM (Crosier)"
                Case Else : Return value.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function YesNo(value As Boolean) As String
            Return If(value, "Yes", "No")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NullableValue(value As Nullable(Of Double)) As Object
            Return If(value.HasValue, CType(value.Value, Object), String.Empty)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NullableValue(value As Nullable(Of Integer)) As Object
            Return If(value.HasValue, CType(value.Value, Object), String.Empty)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function JoinIntegers(values As Integer(), addOne As Boolean) As String
            If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length = 0 Then Return String.Empty
            Dim text(values.Length - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                Dim value As Integer = values(i)
                If addOne Then value += 1
                text(i) = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Next
            Return String.Join(", ", text)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ExclusionScopeText(scope As SpcExclusionScope) As String
            Select Case scope
                Case SpcExclusionScope.None : Return "None"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.ParameterEstimation : Return "Parameter estimation"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.RuleEvaluation : Return "Signal evaluation"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.EstimationAndRules : Return "Parameter estimation and signal evaluation"
                Case Else : Return scope.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

            Dim scoreCount As Integer = 0
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                If item.ComponentScores IsNot Nothing Then scoreCount = Math.Max(scoreCount, item.ComponentScores.Length)
            Next

            Dim headers As New List(Of String) From {
                "Point", "Source Rows", "Label", "Stage", "Phase", "Statistic", "Effective Sample Size"
            }
            For Each name As String In names
                headers.Add("Observed: " & name)
            Next
            If hasState Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("State: " & name)
                Next
            End If
            If hasScores Then
                For i As Integer = 1 To scoreCount
                    headers.Add("PC Score " & i.ToString())
                Next
            End If
            If hasResiduals Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("Residual: " & name)
                Next
            End If
            If hasContributions Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("Contribution: " & name)
                Next
                headers.Add("Contribution Total")
                headers.Add("Contribution Basis")
            End If

            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                Dim values As New List(Of Object) From {
                    item.PointIndex + 1,
                    JoinIntegers(item.SourceRowIndices, addOne:=False),
                    item.Label,
                    item.StageId,
                    PhaseText(item.Phase),
                    item.Statistic,
                    item.EffectiveSampleSize
                }
                AddVectorValues(values, item.ObservationVector, names.Length)
                If hasState Then AddVectorValues(values, item.StateVector, names.Length)
                If hasScores Then AddVectorValues(values, item.ComponentScores, scoreCount)
                If hasResiduals Then AddVectorValues(values, item.ResidualVector, names.Length)
                If hasContributions Then
                    AddVectorValues(values, item.Contributions, names.Length)
                    values.Add(If(Double.IsNaN(item.ContributionTotal), CType(String.Empty, Object), item.ContributionTotal))
                    values.Add(item.ContributionBasis)
                End If
                rows.Add(values.ToArray())
            Next

            Dim tables As New List(Of ResultTable) From {
                CreateTable("Multivariate point diagnostics and contributions", headers.ToArray(), rows,
                            emptyMessage:=If(signalOnly, "No signalled points have diagnostics.", "No point diagnostics were returned."))
            }
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                If item.SubgroupCovariance Is Nothing Then Continue For
                tables.Add(CreateMatrixTable("Subgroup covariance - point " & (item.PointIndex + 1).ToString(),
                                              names, names, item.SubgroupCovariance))
            Next
            Return tables
        End Function

        Public Function BuildAuditTables(view As SpcMultivariateAuditView) As List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim result = _result
            Dim request As SpcMultivariateRequest = result.Request
            Dim settings As New List(Of Object()) From {
                Row("Request label", request.RequestLabel),
                Row("Chart type", ChartTypeText(request.ChartType)),
                Row("Observation structure", If(request.HasSubgroups, "Rational subgroups", "Individual observations")),
                Row("Missing-value policy", MissingPolicyText(request.MissingValuePolicy)),
                Row("Model source", ModelSourceText(request.ModelSource)),
                Row("Control-limit alpha", request.ControlLimitAlpha),
                Row("Use lower Hotelling limit", YesNo(request.UseLowerHotellingLimit)),
                Row("Diagonal ridge factor", request.CovarianceRegularization),
                Row("Allow pseudoinverse", YesNo(request.AllowPseudoInverse)),
                Row("PCA matrix", If(request.PcaUseCorrelationMatrix, "Correlation", "Covariance")),
                Row("PCA component count", NullableValue(request.PcaComponentCount)),
                Row("PCA cumulative variance", request.PcaCumulativeVariance),
                Row("MEWMA lambda", request.MewmaLambda),
                Row("MEWMA supplied UCL", NullableValue(request.MewmaControlLimit)),
                Row("MCUSUM k", request.McusumReferenceValue),
                Row("MCUSUM h", request.McusumDecisionInterval),
                Row("Generalized-variance sigma multiplier", NullableValue(request.GeneralizedVarianceSigmaMultiplier)),
                Row("Reset at stage boundary", YesNo(request.ResetAtStageBoundary)),
                Row("Reset at phase boundary", YesNo(request.ResetAtPhaseBoundary)),
                Row("Reset after signal", YesNo(request.ResetAfterSignal)),
                Row("Sequence-gap behaviour", SequenceGapBehaviorText(request.SequenceGapBehavior)),
                Row("Chart title", view.ChartTitle),
                Row("Value-axis title", view.ValueAxisTitle),
                Row("Horizontal-axis title", view.HorizontalAxisTitle),
                Row("Use sequence on horizontal axis", YesNo(view.UseSequence)),
                Row("Chart width", view.Width),
                Row("Chart height", view.Height),
                Row("Execution time (ms)", result.ExecutionTimeMilliseconds)
            }

            Dim stageRows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim panelPoints As SpcPointResult() = result.Panels(0).Points
            If panelPoints.Length > 0 Then
                Dim start As Integer = 0
                For i As Integer = 1 To panelPoints.Length
                    Dim atEnd As Boolean = i = panelPoints.Length
                    Dim changed As Boolean = Not atEnd AndAlso
                        (Not String.Equals(panelPoints(i).StageId, panelPoints(start).StageId, StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                         panelPoints(i).Phase <> panelPoints(start).Phase)
                    If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For
                    stageRows.Add(Row(panelPoints(start).StageId,
                                      panelPoints(start).PointIndex + 1,
                                      panelPoints(i - 1).PointIndex + 1,
                                      PhaseText(panelPoints(start).Phase)))
                    start = i
                Next
            End If

            Dim exclusionRows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim scopes As SpcExclusionScope() = request.ExclusionScopes
            Dim reasons As String() = request.ExclusionReasons
            Dim sourceRows As Integer() = request.SourceRowIndices
            For i As Integer = 0 To scopes.Length - 1
                If scopes(i) = SpcExclusionScope.None Then Continue For
                exclusionRows.Add(Row(sourceRows(i), ExclusionScopeText(scopes(i)), reasons(i)))
            Next

            Return New List(Of ResultTable) From {
                CreateTable("Multivariate SPC settings and audit", {"Setting", "Value"}, settings),
                CreateTable("Effective stages", {"Stage", "First Point", "Last Point", "Phase"}, stageRows,
                            emptyMessage:="No chart points were returned."),
                CreateTable("Source-row exclusions", {"Source Row", "Scope", "Reason"}, exclusionRows,
                            emptyMessage:="No explicit exclusions were supplied."),
                BuildWarningsTable()
            }
        End Function

        Public Function BuildWarningsTable() As ResultTable
            Dim result = _result
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            Dim warnings As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Me.Warnings.Values
            For i As Integer = 0 To warnings.Count - 1
                rows.Add(Row(i + 1, warnings(i)))
            Next
            Return CreateTable("Multivariate SPC warnings", {"Number", "Warning"}, rows,
                               emptyMessage:="No calculation warnings were reported.")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateTable(title As String, headers As String(), rows As IList(Of Object()),
                                            Optional emptyMessage As String = Nothing,
                                            Optional footnote As String = Nothing) As ResultTable
            Dim table As New ResultTable()
            If title.Length > 0 Then table.AddTitle(title)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(CType(headers.Clone(), String()))
            If rows.Count > 0 Then
                Dim body(rows.Count - 1, headers.Length - 1) As Object
                For r As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                    If rows(r).Length <> headers.Length Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("A result row does not match its table header.")
                    For c As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1
                        body(r, c) = rows(r)(c)
                    Next
                Next
                table.SetBody(body)
            ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(emptyMessage) Then
                table.AddFootnote(emptyMessage)
            End If
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(footnote) Then table.AddFootnote(footnote)
            Return table
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateVectorTable(title As String, names As String(), values As Double(), valueHeader As String) As ResultTable
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            If values IsNot Nothing Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                    rows.Add(Row(names(i), values(i)))
                Next
            End If
            Return CreateTable(title, {"Variable", valueHeader}, rows, emptyMessage:="Not applicable to this chart.")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateIndexedVectorTable(title As String, values As Double(), indexHeader As String, valueHeader As String) As ResultTable
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                rows.Add(Row(i + 1, values(i)))
            Next
            Return CreateTable(title, {indexHeader, valueHeader}, rows)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateMatrixTable(title As String, rowNames As String(), columnNames As String(), values As Double(,)) As ResultTable
            Dim headers As New List(Of String) From {"Variable"}
            headers.AddRange(columnNames)
            Dim rows As New List(Of Object())()
            For r As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim row(values.GetLength(1)) As Object
                row(0) = rowNames(r)
                For c As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(1) - 1
                    row(c + 1) = values(r, c)
                Next
                rows.Add(row)
            Next
            Return CreateTable(title, headers.ToArray(), rows)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComponentNames(count As Integer) As String()
            Dim names(count - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To count - 1
                names(i) = "PC" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Next
            Return names
        End Function

        Public Shared Sub AddVectorValues(target As List(Of Object), values As Double(), count As Integer)
            For i As Integer = 0 To count - 1
                If values IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < values.Length Then
                    target.Add(values(i))
                Else
                    target.Add(String.Empty)
                End If
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Row(ParamArray values As Object()) As Object()
            Return values
        End Function

        Public Shared Function PhaseText(value As SpcPhase) As String
            Return If(value = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "Phase I", "Phase II")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function MissingPolicyText(value As SpcMissingValuePolicy) As String
            Return If(value = SpcMissingValuePolicy.Reject, "Reject", "Omit incomplete observation")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ModelSourceText(value As SpcMultivariateModelSource) As String
            Return If(value = SpcMultivariateModelSource.EstimateFromPhaseI, "Estimate from Phase I", "Use historical parameters")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function SequenceGapBehaviorText(value As SpcSequenceGapBehavior) As String
            Select Case value
                Case SpcSequenceGapBehavior.BreakSequence : Return "Break sequence"
                Case SpcSequenceGapBehavior.SkipPointAndContinue : Return "Skip point and continue"
                Case Else : Return value.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ChartTypeText(value As SpcChartType) As String
            Select Case value
                Case SpcChartType.HotellingT2 : Return "Hotelling T-squared"
                Case SpcChartType.GeneralizedVariance : Return "Generalized variance"
                Case SpcChartType.PcaT2 : Return "PCA T-squared"
                Case SpcChartType.PcaQ : Return "PCA Q"
                Case SpcChartType.Mewma : Return "MEWMA"
                Case SpcChartType.Mcusum : Return "MCUSUM (Crosier)"
                Case Else : Return value.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function YesNo(value As Boolean) As String
            Return If(value, "Yes", "No")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NullableValue(value As Nullable(Of Double)) As Object
            Return If(value.HasValue, CType(value.Value, Object), String.Empty)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NullableValue(value As Nullable(Of Integer)) As Object
            Return If(value.HasValue, CType(value.Value, Object), String.Empty)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function JoinIntegers(values As Integer(), addOne As Boolean) As String
            If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length = 0 Then Return String.Empty
            Dim text(values.Length - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                Dim value As Integer = values(i)
                If addOne Then value += 1
                text(i) = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Next
            Return String.Join(", ", text)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ExclusionScopeText(scope As SpcExclusionScope) As String
            Select Case scope
                Case SpcExclusionScope.None : Return "None"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.ParameterEstimation : Return "Parameter estimation"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.RuleEvaluation : Return "Signal evaluation"
                Case SpcExclusionScope.EstimationAndRules : Return "Parameter estimation and signal evaluation"
                Case Else : Return scope.ToString()
            End Select
        End Function
    End Class

Public Function BuildDiagnosticTables(signalOnly As Boolean) As List(Of ResultTable)
            Dim result = _result
            Dim context = Me.Context
            Dim selected = context.SelectDiagnostics(signalOnly).Select(Function(item) New SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot(item)).ToList()

            Dim names As String() = result.Request.VariableNames
            Dim hasState As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.StateVector IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasScores As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.ComponentScores IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasResiduals As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.ResidualVector IsNot Nothing)
            Dim hasContributions As Boolean = selected.Any(Function(item) item.Contributions IsNot Nothing)
            Dim scoreCount As Integer = 0
            For Each item As SpcMultivariateDiagnosticSnapshot In selected
                If item.ComponentScores IsNot Nothing Then scoreCount = Math.Max(scoreCount, item.ComponentScores.Length)
            Next

            Dim headers As New List(Of String) From {
                "Point", "Source Rows", "Label", "Stage", "Phase", "Statistic", "Effective Sample Size"
            }
            For Each name As String In names
                headers.Add("Observed: " & name)
            Next
            If hasState Then
                For Each name As String In names
                    headers.Add("State: " & name)

            Dim settings As New List(Of Object()) From {

                Row("Missing-value policy", MissingPolicyText(request.MissingValuePolicy)),

                Row("PCA component count", NullableValue(request.PcaComponentCount)),
                Row("PCA cumulative variance", request.PcaCumulativeVariance),
                Row("MEWMA lambda", request.MewmaLambda),

                Row("MCUSUM k", request.McusumReferenceValue),

                CreateTable("Multivariate SPC settings and audit", {"Setting", "Value"}, settings),

                CreateTable("Source-row exclusions", {"Source Row", "Scope", "Reason"}, exclusionRows,
                            emptyMessage:="No explicit exclusions were supplied."),

            }

Public Shared Function CreateTable(title As String, headers As String(), rows As IList(Of Object()),
                                            Optional emptyMessage As String = Nothing,
                                            Optional footnote As String = Nothing) As ResultTable
            Dim table As New ResultTable()
            If title.Length > 0 Then table.AddTitle(title)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(CType(headers.Clone(), String()))
            If rows.Count > 0 Then
                Dim body(rows.Count - 1, headers.Length - 1) As Object
                For r As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                    If rows(r).Length <> headers.Length Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("A result row does not match its table header.")
                    For c As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1
                        body(r, c) = rows(r)(c)
                    Next
                Next
                table.SetBody(body)
            ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(emptyMessage) Then
                table.AddFootnote(emptyMessage)
            End If
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(footnote) Then table.AddFootnote(footnote)
            Return table
        End Function

        Dim minimum=Double.PositiveInfinity, maximum=Double.NegativeInfinity
        For channel=0 To 7
            For Each sample As Double? In panel.Channels(channel)
                Dim nextBounds=SpcAxisBoundsCore.SpcOptionalExtent(sample,minimum,maximum)
                minimum=nextBounds.Min : maximum=nextBounds.Max
            Next
        Next
        If Chart34.SpcChartPreparation34.PanelSupportsSpecificationLimits(panel.Panel.PanelType) Then
            If showSpecs Then
                Dim lower=SpcAxisBoundsCore.SpcOptionalExtent(specifications.LowerSpecificationLimit,minimum,maximum)
                minimum=lower.Min : maximum=lower.Max
                Dim upper=SpcAxisBoundsCore.SpcOptionalExtent(specifications.UpperSpecificationLimit,minimum,maximum)
                minimum=upper.Min : maximum=upper.Max
            End If
            If showTarget Then
                Dim target=SpcAxisBoundsCore.SpcOptionalExtent(specifications.Target,minimum,maximum)
                minimum=target.Min : maximum=target.Max
            End If
        End If
        Return SpcAxisBoundsCore.FromExtents(minimum,maximum,panel.Panel.PanelType)
    End Function
    Public Sub New(panel As SpcPanelSeriesProjection, specifications As SpcSpecificationLimits, zoneMode As Integer, showSpecs As Boolean, showTarget As Boolean, showExcluded As Boolean, showLabels As Boolean, showZoneLegend As Boolean)
        Dim result As New List(Of SpcSeriesIntent36)
        IncludesBands=zoneMode=2 OrElse zoneMode=3
        Dim add As Action(Of SpcSeriesRole36,String,IEnumerable(Of Double?),Boolean,Boolean)=Sub(role,name,values,label,hide)
            Dim intent As New SpcSeriesIntent36(role,name,values,label,hide)
            If role=SpcSeriesRole36.Statistic OrElse intent.LastValueOrdinal>=0 Then result.Add(intent)

        Dim c=panel.Channels
        add(SpcSeriesRole36.Statistic,panel.Panel.DisplayName,c(CInt(SpcChartChannel.Statistic)),False,False)
        add(SpcSeriesRole36.Center,"CL",c(CInt(SpcChartChannel.CenterLine)),showLabels,False)
        add(SpcSeriesRole36.Control,"UCL",c(CInt(SpcChartChannel.UpperControlLimit)),showLabels,False)
        add(SpcSeriesRole36.Control,"LCL",c(CInt(SpcChartChannel.LowerControlLimit)),showLabels,False)
        If zoneMode=1 OrElse zoneMode=3 Then
            add(SpcSeriesRole36.Zone,"-2 sigma",c(CInt(SpcChartChannel.LowerTwoSigma)),False,Not showZoneLegend)

        Public Shared Iterator Function Quick(pointCount As Integer, singlePhaseI As Boolean, lastPhaseI As Integer, source As SpcParameterSource) As IEnumerable(Of SpcStageRowIntent)

                    If(source = SpcParameterSource.UseHistoricalParameters, SpcStageLimitMode.UseHistoricalParameters, SpcStageLimitMode.UseReferenceStage), If(source = SpcParameterSource.UseHistoricalParameters, String.Empty, "PhaseI"))

    Public Shared Function ParsePhaseText(text As String) As SpcPhase
        Dim normalized As String = text.Trim().Replace(" ", String.Empty).ToUpperInvariant()
        If normalized = "PHASEI" OrElse normalized = "I" OrElse normalized = "1" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseI
        If normalized = "PHASEII" OrElse normalized = "II" OrElse normalized = "2" Then Return SpcPhase.PhaseII
        Throw New ArgumentException("Phase must be 'Phase I' or 'Phase II'.")
    End Function
        Public Shared Function Collapse(map As SpcSourcePointMap, rowStages() As String, rowPhases() As String) As SpcImportedStageIntent
            If map Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(map))
            If rowStages Is Nothing AndAlso rowPhases Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Select a stage identifier column, a Phase I/Phase II column, or both.")
            If rowStages IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowStages.Length <> map.PointIndexByRow.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage values must align with source rows.", NameOf(rowStages))
            If rowPhases IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowPhases.Length <> map.PointIndexByRow.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Phase values must align with source rows.", NameOf(rowPhases))
            Dim stages(map.PointCount - 1) As String, phases(map.PointCount - 1) As SpcPhase
            For point = 0 To map.PointCount - 1
                If rowStages IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim found As String = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = rowStages(row).Trim()
                        If found Is Nothing Then
                            found = current
                        ElseIf Not String.Equals(found, current, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent stage identifier values.")
                        End If
                    Next
                    stages(point) = If(found, String.Empty)
                    If stages(point).Trim().Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("The stage identifier is blank at chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                End If
                If rowPhases Is Nothing Then
                    phases(point) = SpcPhase.PhaseI
                Else
                    Dim found As SpcPhase? = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = ParsePhaseText(rowPhases(row))
                        If found.HasValue AndAlso found.Value <> current Then Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent phase values.")
                        found = current
                    Next
                    If Not found.HasValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("No phase value is available for chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                    phases(point) = found.Value
                End If
            Next
            If rowStages Is Nothing Then
                Dim phaseRunCounts As New Dictionary(Of SpcPhase, Integer)()
                Dim runStartPoint As Integer = 0
                While runStartPoint < map.PointCount
                    Dim phase As SpcPhase = phases(runStartPoint)
                    Dim runEndPoint As Integer = runStartPoint
                    While runEndPoint + 1 < map.PointCount AndAlso phases(runEndPoint + 1) = phase
                        runEndPoint += 1
                    End While
                    Dim runNumber As Integer = 1
                    If phaseRunCounts.ContainsKey(phase) Then runNumber = phaseRunCounts(phase) + 1
                    phaseRunCounts(phase) = runNumber
                    Dim baseId As String = If(phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "PhaseI", "PhaseII")
                    Dim generatedId As String = If(runNumber = 1, baseId, baseId & "-" & runNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    For point As Integer = runStartPoint To runEndPoint
                        stages(point) = generatedId
                    Next
                    runStartPoint = runEndPoint + 1
                End While
            End If

            Return New SpcImportedStageIntent(stages, phases)
        End Function
        Public Shared Iterator Function ImportedRows(intent As SpcImportedStageIntent, source As SpcParameterSource) As IEnumerable(Of SpcStageRowIntent)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim pointStages = intent.StageIds, pointPhases = intent.Phases
            Dim usedIds As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim runStart As Integer = 0
            Dim lastPhaseIId As String = String.Empty
            For point As Integer = 1 To intent.StageIds.Count
                Dim atEnd As Boolean = point = intent.StageIds.Count
                Dim changed As Boolean = Not atEnd AndAlso
                    (Not String.Equals(pointStages(point), pointStages(runStart), StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                     pointPhases(point) <> pointPhases(runStart))
                If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For

                Dim stageId As String = pointStages(runStart).Trim()
                If Not usedIds.Add(stageId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & stageId & "' occurs in more than one non-contiguous block.")
                End If

                Dim phase As SpcPhase = pointPhases(runStart)
                Dim limitMode As SpcStageLimitMode
                Dim referenceId As String = String.Empty
                If source = SpcParameterSource.UseHistoricalParameters Then
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.UseHistoricalParameters
                    If phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI Then lastPhaseIId = stageId
                ElseIf phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI Then
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.EstimateFromStageData
                    lastPhaseIId = stageId
                Else
                    If lastPhaseIId.Length = 0 Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("A Phase II stage requires an earlier Phase I reference stage or historical parameters.")
                    End If
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.UseReferenceStage
                    referenceId = lastPhaseIId
                End If

                Yield New SpcStageRowIntent(stageId, stageId, runStart + 1, point, phase, limitMode, referenceId)
                runStart = point
            Next
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Manual(row As SpcStageRowIntent, logicalPointCount As Integer) As SpcStageDefinition
            If row Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(row))
            If row.LastPoint > logicalPointCount Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & row.StageId & "' ends after the last chart point (" & logicalPointCount.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) & ").")
            Return New SpcStageDefinition(row.StageId, row.FirstPoint - 1, row.LastPoint - 1, row.Phase, row.LimitMode, If(row.ReferenceStageId.Length = 0, Nothing, row.ReferenceStageId), row.DisplayName)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function FinishManual(stages As IEnumerable(Of SpcStageDefinition), source As SpcParameterSource) As SpcStageDefinition()
            Dim result = stages.ToArray()
            If result.Length = 0 AndAlso source = SpcParameterSource.DefinedByStage Then Throw New ArgumentException("Define at least one stage when 'Defined by stage' is selected.")
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class

Public Shared Function Collapse(map As SpcSourcePointMap, rowStages() As String, rowPhases() As String) As SpcImportedStageIntent
            If map Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(map))
            If rowStages Is Nothing AndAlso rowPhases Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Select a stage identifier column, a Phase I/Phase II column, or both.")
            If rowStages IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowStages.Length <> map.PointIndexByRow.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stage values must align with source rows.", NameOf(rowStages))
            If rowPhases IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowPhases.Length <> map.PointIndexByRow.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Phase values must align with source rows.", NameOf(rowPhases))
            Dim stages(map.PointCount - 1) As String, phases(map.PointCount - 1) As SpcPhase
            For point = 0 To map.PointCount - 1
                If rowStages IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim found As String = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = rowStages(row).Trim()
                        If found Is Nothing Then
                            found = current
                        ElseIf Not String.Equals(found, current, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent stage identifier values.")
                        End If
                    Next
                    stages(point) = If(found, String.Empty)
                    If stages(point).Trim().Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("The stage identifier is blank at chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                End If
                If rowPhases Is Nothing Then
                    phases(point) = SpcPhase.PhaseI
                Else
                    Dim found As SpcPhase? = Nothing
                    For Each row In map.Points(point).InputRowIndices
                        Dim current = ParsePhaseText(rowPhases(row))
                        If found.HasValue AndAlso found.Value <> current Then Throw New ArgumentException("Rows belonging to chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & " contain inconsistent phase values.")
                        found = current
                    Next
                    If Not found.HasValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("No phase value is available for chart point " & (point + 1).ToString() & ".")
                    phases(point) = found.Value
                End If
            Next
            If rowStages Is Nothing Then
                Dim phaseRunCounts As New Dictionary(Of SpcPhase, Integer)()
                Dim runStartPoint As Integer = 0
                While runStartPoint < map.PointCount
                    Dim phase As SpcPhase = phases(runStartPoint)
                    Dim runEndPoint As Integer = runStartPoint
                    While runEndPoint + 1 < map.PointCount AndAlso phases(runEndPoint + 1) = phase
                        runEndPoint += 1
                    End While
                    Dim runNumber As Integer = 1
                    If phaseRunCounts.ContainsKey(phase) Then runNumber = phaseRunCounts(phase) + 1
                    phaseRunCounts(phase) = runNumber
                    Dim baseId As String = If(phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI, "PhaseI", "PhaseII")
                    Dim generatedId As String = If(runNumber = 1, baseId, baseId & "-" & runNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    For point As Integer = runStartPoint To runEndPoint
                        stages(point) = generatedId
                    Next
                    runStartPoint = runEndPoint + 1
                End While
            End If

            Return New SpcImportedStageIntent(stages, phases)
        End Function

Public Shared Iterator Function ImportedRows(intent As SpcImportedStageIntent, source As SpcParameterSource) As IEnumerable(Of SpcStageRowIntent)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim pointStages = intent.StageIds, pointPhases = intent.Phases
            Dim usedIds As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim runStart As Integer = 0
            Dim lastPhaseIId As String = String.Empty
            For point As Integer = 1 To intent.StageIds.Count
                Dim atEnd As Boolean = point = intent.StageIds.Count
                Dim changed As Boolean = Not atEnd AndAlso
                    (Not String.Equals(pointStages(point), pointStages(runStart), StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                     pointPhases(point) <> pointPhases(runStart))
                If Not atEnd AndAlso Not changed Then Continue For

                Dim stageId As String = pointStages(runStart).Trim()
                If Not usedIds.Add(stageId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Stage '" & stageId & "' occurs in more than one non-contiguous block.")
                End If

                Dim phase As SpcPhase = pointPhases(runStart)
                Dim limitMode As SpcStageLimitMode
                Dim referenceId As String = String.Empty
                If source = SpcParameterSource.UseHistoricalParameters Then
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.UseHistoricalParameters
                    If phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI Then lastPhaseIId = stageId
                ElseIf phase = SpcPhase.PhaseI Then
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.EstimateFromStageData
                    lastPhaseIId = stageId
                Else
                    If lastPhaseIId.Length = 0 Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("A Phase II stage requires an earlier Phase I reference stage or historical parameters.")
                    End If
                    limitMode = SpcStageLimitMode.UseReferenceStage
                    referenceId = lastPhaseIId
                End If

                Yield New SpcStageRowIntent(stageId, stageId, runStart + 1, point, phase, limitMode, referenceId)
                runStart = point
            Next
        End Function

    ''' <summary>Detached finite samples. Nothing means a blank; Points retain absence/NaN distinctions.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpcPanelSeriesProjection
        Friend Sub New(panel As SpcPanelResult, axis As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcChartAxisPoint))
            Me.Panel = panel
            Dim byIndex As New Dictionary(Of Integer, SpcPointResult)
            For Each point In panel.Points
                byIndex.Add(point.PointIndex, point)
            Next
            Dim aligned(axis.Count - 1) As SpcPointResult
            Dim channels As New List(Of IReadOnlyList(Of Double?))
            Dim samples(9)() As Double?
            For c As Integer = 0 To 9
                samples(c) = New Double?(axis.Count - 1) {}
                channels.Add(Array.AsReadOnly(samples(c)))
            Next
            Dim pointLabels As New List(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)
            Dim signalLabels As New List(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)
            Dim exclusionLabels As New List(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)
            For i As Integer = 0 To axis.Count - 1
                Dim point As SpcPointResult = Nothing
                If Not byIndex.TryGetValue(axis(i).Point.PointIndex, point) Then Continue For
                aligned(i) = point
                Dim values As Double() = {point.Value, point.CenterLine, point.LowerControlLimit,
                    point.UpperControlLimit, point.LowerOneSigmaLimit, point.UpperOneSigmaLimit,
                    point.LowerTwoSigmaLimit, point.UpperTwoSigmaLimit}
                For c As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                    If IsFinite(values(c)) Then samples(c)(i) = values(c)
                Next
                If point.IsSignalled Then samples(CInt(SpcChartChannel.Signal))(i) = samples(0)(i)
                If point.IsExplicitlyExcluded Then samples(CInt(SpcChartChannel.Excluded))(i) = samples(0)(i)
                If point.HasFiniteValue Then
                    AddLabel(pointLabels, i, point.Label)
                    If point.IsSignalled Then AddLabel(signalLabels, i, RuleText(point.SignalRuleNumbers))
                    If point.IsExplicitlyExcluded Then AddLabel(exclusionLabels, i, If(point.ExclusionReason.Length = 0, "Excluded", point.ExclusionReason))
                End If
            Next
            Me.Points = Array.AsReadOnly(aligned)
            Me.Channels = channels.AsReadOnly()
            Me.PointLabels = pointLabels.AsReadOnly()
            Me.SignalLabels = signalLabels.AsReadOnly()
            Me.ExclusionLabels = exclusionLabels.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>Core's immutable panel retains ordered occurrence/window/contributor/marked metadata.</summary>
        Public ReadOnly Property Panel As SpcPanelResult
        Public ReadOnly Property Points As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcPointResult)
        Public ReadOnly Property Channels As IReadOnlyList(Of IReadOnlyList(Of Double?))
        Public ReadOnly Property PointLabels As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)
        Public ReadOnly Property SignalLabels As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)
        Public ReadOnly Property ExclusionLabels As IReadOnlyList(Of SpcChartLabelIntent)

        Private Shared Sub AddLabel(labels As List(Of SpcChartLabelIntent), index As Integer, text As String)
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) Then labels.Add(New SpcChartLabelIntent(index, text))
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function RuleText(numbers As Integer()) As String
            If numbers Is Nothing OrElse numbers.Length = 0 Then Return String.Empty
            Dim parts(numbers.Length - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To numbers.Length - 1

        Private ReadOnly _options As SurvivalOptions
        Public Sub New(mode As SurvivalAnalysisMode, input As SurvivalInput, Optional options As SurvivalOptions = Nothing)
            Me.Mode = mode : Me.Input = input : _options = If(options, New SurvivalOptions()).Copy()
            Validation = SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.Validate(mode, input, _options)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Mode As SurvivalAnalysisMode
        Public ReadOnly Property Input As SurvivalInput
        Public ReadOnly Property Validation As RegressionValidation
        Public ReadOnly Property Options As SurvivalOptions
            Get
                Return _options.Copy()
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property GroupCount As Integer
            Get
                Return If(Input Is Nothing, 0, Input.GroupLabels.Length)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property RunWeightedTest As Boolean
            Get
                Return GroupCount > 1
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property RunMedianTest As Boolean
            Get
                Return _options.EqualityOfMedians AndAlso GroupCount > 1
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property RunFixedTimeTest As Boolean
            Get
                Return _options.FixedTimeComparison AndAlso GroupCount = 2
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function Execute() As Survival_KM_LR
            If Not Validation.IsValid Then Throw New ArgumentException("survival.request.invalid: Resolve portable diagnostics before execution.")
            Return ExecuteAcquiredRecords(SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.CreateRecords(Input, Mode))
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Shipping compatibility seam: existing host conversions/Core error paths
        ''' have already run. Diagnostics are observational here, never a new Windows refusal.</summary>
        Public Function ExecuteAcquiredRecords(records As List(Of SurvivalRecord)) As Survival_KM_LR
            If Mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("survival.mode.cox: Use CoxWorkflowIntent for Cox fitting.")
            Dim fit As New Survival_KM_LR(SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.CopyRecords(records))
            Dim method As String = Nothing
            SurvivalWorkflowPolicy.TryWeightName(_options.Weight, method)
            If RunWeightedTest Then fit.WeightedLogRankTest(If(method, String.Empty), _options.Alpha)
            If _options.MedianConfidenceInterval Then fit.BrookmeyerCrowleyMedianSurvivalCI(_options.Alpha)
            If _options.DetailedTable Then fit.SurvivalCurveTabularOutput(_options.Alpha)
            If RunMedianTest Then fit.EqualityOfMedianTest()
            If RunFixedTimeTest Then fit.CompareCurveFixTimePoint()
            Return fit
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Const MaximumDiagnostics As Integer = 128
        Public Shared Function TryWeightName(weight As SurvivalWeight, ByRef name As String) As Boolean
            name = Nothing
            Select Case weight
                Case SurvivalWeight.Logrank : name = "Logrank"
                Case SurvivalWeight.TaroneWare : name = "Tarone-Ware"
                Case SurvivalWeight.GehanBreslow : name = "Gehan-Breslow"
                Case SurvivalWeight.Peto : name = "Peto"
                Case SurvivalWeight.ModifiedPeto : name = "modified Peto"
            End Select
            Return name IsNot Nothing
        End Function
        Friend Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Friend Shared Sub Issue(list As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), field As String, message As String,
                                Optional row As Nullable(Of Integer) = Nothing, Optional blocking As Boolean = True)
            If list.Count < MaximumDiagnostics Then list.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("survival." & field, field, message, row, blocking:=blocking))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Validate(mode As SurvivalAnalysisMode, input As SurvivalInput, options As SurvivalOptions) As RegressionValidation
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SurvivalAnalysisMode), mode) Then Issue(issues, "mode", "Unknown survival mode.")
            If options Is Nothing Then options = New SurvivalOptions()
            If Not Finite(options.Alpha) OrElse options.Alpha <= 0 OrElse options.Alpha >= 1 Then Issue(issues, "alpha", "Alpha must be finite and between 0 and 1.")
            Dim name As String = Nothing
            If Not TryWeightName(options.Weight, name) Then Issue(issues, "weight", "Unsupported weighted log-rank option.")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SurvivalOutputTarget), options.OutputTarget) Then Issue(issues, "outputTarget", "Unknown output target metadata.")
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Time Is Nothing OrElse input.Status Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "input.required", "Time and binary status roles are required.")
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            Dim times = input.Time.Values, status = input.Status.Values, rows = input.Time.RowIds
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.Time.Key) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.Status.Key) Then Issue(issues, "roles", "Time and status role names are required.")
            If times Is Nothing OrElse status Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing Then
                Issue(issues, "shape", "Time, status and source row axes are required.")
                Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
            End If
            If times.Length = 0 Then Issue(issues, "empty", "No observations supplied.")
            If times.Length <> status.Length OrElse times.Length <> rows.Length OrElse input.Status.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not rows.SequenceEqual(input.Status.RowIds) Then Issue(issues, "shape", "Time, status and source row axes must agree exactly.")
            If rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Issue(issues, "rows.duplicate", "Source row identities must be distinct.")
            For Each labels In {input.Groups, input.Strata}
                If labels Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim values = labels.Values, ids = labels.RowIds
                If values Is Nothing OrElse ids Is Nothing OrElse values.Length <> times.Length OrElse Not rows.SequenceEqual(ids) Then
                    Issue(issues, "labels.shape", "Selected labels must align with the original source rows.")
                ElseIf values.Any(Function(v) String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v)) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(labels.Key) Then
                    Issue(issues, "labels.missing", "Selected labels and role names cannot be missing; labels are never trimmed or recoded.")
                End If
            Next
            If mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.LogRank AndAlso input.Groups Is Nothing Then Issue(issues, "group.required", "Log-rank mode requires a group role.")
            If mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.KaplanMeier AndAlso input.Strata IsNot Nothing Then Issue(issues, "strata.mode", "The KM dialog has no stratum role; use stratified log-rank mode.")
            If mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox AndAlso input.Groups IsNot Nothing Then Issue(issues, "group.mode", "Cox has strata and predictors, not KM comparison groups.")
            For i = 0 To times.Length - 1
                If Not Finite(times(i)) OrElse times(i) < 0 Then Issue(issues, "time", "Time must be finite and nonnegative.", If(i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing))
                If issues.Count >= MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
            Next
            For i = 0 To status.Length - 1
                If Not Finite(status(i)) OrElse (status(i) <> 0 AndAlso status(i) <> 1) Then Issue(issues, "status", "Status must be exactly 0 (censored) or 1 (event).", If(i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing))
                If issues.Count >= MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
            Next
            If status.Length > 0 AndAlso Not status.Any(Function(s) s = 1) Then Issue(issues, "events.none", "No events: inference/median/baseline outputs may be undefined in Core.", blocking:=False)
            If input.Provenance IsNot Nothing AndAlso rows.Any(Function(id) Not input.Provenance.RowIds.Contains(id)) Then Issue(issues, "provenance", "A retained source row is absent from the transport frame.")
            Return New RegressionValidation(issues, 0, 0, {})
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CreateRecords(input As SurvivalInput, mode As SurvivalAnalysisMode) As List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            Dim validation = Validate(mode, input, New SurvivalOptions())
            If Not validation.IsValid Then Throw New ArgumentException("survival.input.invalid")
            Dim t = input.Time.Values, ids = input.Time.RowIds, err = String.Empty
            Dim groups = If(input.Groups Is Nothing, Enumerable.Repeat("0", t.Length).ToArray(), input.Groups.Values)
            Dim strata = If(input.Strata Is Nothing, Enumerable.Repeat("0", t.Length).ToArray(), input.Strata.Values)
            Dim records = Survival.CreatSurvivalData(t, input.Status.Values.Select(Function(s) CInt(s)).ToArray(), groups, strata, err)
            If records Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException(err)
            For i = 0 To records.Count - 1
                Dim r = records(i) : r.Index = ids(i)
                If mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox Then r.Stratum = strata(i)
                records(i) = r
            Next
            Return records
        End Function
        Public Shared Function CopyRecords(records As IEnumerable(Of SurvivalRecord)) As List(Of SurvivalRecord)
            If records Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(records))
            Return records.Select(Function(r)
                                      r.Covariates = If(r.Covariates Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(r.Covariates.Clone(), Double()))
                                      Return r
                                  End Function).ToList()
        End Function

        Public Function ExecuteAcquiredRecords(records As List(Of SurvivalRecord)) As Survival_KM_LR
            If Mode = SurvivalAnalysisMode.Cox Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("survival.mode.cox: Use CoxWorkflowIntent for Cox fitting.")
