Public Shared Function AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile As UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            atProfile As TProfile, parameterNames As String(), requestedName As String, value As Double,
            sourceDescription As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "internal error: AT profile was not initialized."
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("time"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("visit"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                If atProfile.TimeSpecified Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies time more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
                atProfile.TimeSpecified = True
                atProfile.TimeValue = value
                Return True
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = sourceDescription & " names """ & requestedName & """, which was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & "."
                Return False
            End If

            For Each existing As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                If existing.ColumnIndex = idx Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies design column """ & parameterNames(idx) & """ more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            atProfile.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                .Name = parameterNames(idx),
                .ColumnIndex = idx,
                .Value = value
            })
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryGetMmrmAtSpec(Of TProfile As {UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), modelAvailable As Boolean, names As Func(Of String()),
            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef atProfile As TProfile, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 1 OrElse cols < 1 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain at least one nonblank name/value setting, or be omitted."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim headerlessAt As New TProfile()
            Dim attemptedHeaderlessAt As Boolean = False
            If TryGetMmrmHeaderlessNameValueAtSpec(Of TProfile, TValue)(arr, modelAvailable, names, headerlessAt, isBlank, cellText, tryFinite, errorMessage, attemptedHeaderlessAt) Then
                atProfile = headerlessAt
                Return True
            End If
            If attemptedHeaderlessAt Then Return False

            If rows < 2 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain a header row and at least one data row, or use two-column headerless name/value form."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim nameCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "name", "variable", "effect", "column", "profile", "at")
            Dim valueCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "value", "val", "setting", "atvalue")

            Dim parsed As New TProfile()

            If nameCol >= 0 AndAlso valueCol >= 0 AndAlso nameCol <> valueCol Then
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, nameCol))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    Dim value As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, valueCol), value) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, requestedName, value,
                                                     "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                     errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            Else
                Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
                Dim visitCol As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindHeaderIndex(header, "visit", "time")

                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If c = visitCol Then Continue For
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                    Dim idx As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindDesignColumnIndex(names(), header(c))
                    If idx < 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "at column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                       String.Join(", ", names()) & ". Use header 'visit' for the visit/time column."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
                Next

                If visitCol < 0 AndAlso profileColumns.Count = 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at must contain either name/value headers or at least one visit/design-column header."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim dataRow As Integer = -1
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    If dataRow >= 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "wide-form at ranges must contain exactly one nonblank data row. Use name/value form for multiple AT settings by row."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    dataRow = r
                Next

                If dataRow < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at does not contain any nonblank data row."
                    Return False
                End If

                If visitCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(dataRow, visitCol)) Then
                    Dim visitValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, visitCol), visitValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at visit value must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, "visit", visitValue, "at visit column", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(dataRow, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at value for column """ & header(pair.Key) & """ must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, names, names()(pair.Value), profileValue,
                                                     "at column """ & header(pair.Key) & """",
                                                     errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            End If

            If Not parsed.VisitSpecified AndAlso parsed.ProfileValues.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "at does not specify any nonblank visit or fitted design-column values."
                Return False
            End If

            atProfile = parsed
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile As UdfMmrmAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            atProfile As TProfile, names As Func(Of String()), requestedName As String, value As Double,
            sourceDescription As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "internal error: AT profile was not initialized."
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName("visit"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmNormalizeDesignColumnName("time"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then

                If atProfile.VisitSpecified Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies visit/time more than once."
                    Return False
                End If

                atProfile.VisitSpecified = True
                atProfile.VisitValue = value
                Return True
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = UdfDataImportMetadata38.MmrmFindDesignColumnIndex(names(), requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = sourceDescription & " names """ & requestedName & """, which was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", names()) & "."
                Return False
            End If

            For Each existing As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                If existing.ColumnIndex = idx Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies design column """ & names()(idx) & """ more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            atProfile.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                .Name = names()(idx),
                .ColumnIndex = idx,
                .Value = value
            })
            Return True
        End Function

            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,

            attempted = False
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If arr Is Nothing OrElse Not modelAvailable OrElse atProfile Is Nothing Then Return False
            If arr.GetLength(1) <> 2 Then Return False

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim firstNonblankRow As Integer = -1
            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not isBlank(arr(r, 0)) OrElse
                   Not isBlank(arr(r, 1)) Then
                    firstNonblankRow = r
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next

            If firstNonblankRow < 0 Then Return False

            Dim firstName As String = cellText(arr(firstNonblankRow, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstName) Then Return False

            Dim firstValue As Double
            If Not tryFinite(arr(firstNonblankRow, 1), firstValue) Then

            Dim probe As New TProfile()

            If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(probe, names, firstName, firstValue,
                                             "at row " & (firstNonblankRow + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                             probeError) Then
                Return False
            End If

            attempted = True

            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                Dim nameBlank As Boolean = isBlank(arr(r, 0))
                Dim valueBlank As Boolean = isBlank(arr(r, 1))
                If nameBlank AndAlso valueBlank Then Continue For

                Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                    errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim value As Double
                If Not tryFinite(arr(r, 1), value) Then
                    errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                   " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                    Return False
                End If

                If Not AddMmrmAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(atProfile, names, requestedName, value,
                                                 "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                 errorMessage) Then
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            Return atProfile.VisitSpecified OrElse atProfile.ProfileValues.Count > 0
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryGetGeeSpec(Of TComponent As {UdfGeeComponent38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), parameterNames As String(), isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef components As List(Of TComponent), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 2 OrElse cols < 2 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must contain a header row and at least one data row."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim labelCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "label", "contrast", "estimate", "name")
            Dim weightCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "weight", "coef", "coefficient", "contrastweight")
            Dim timeCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "time", "visit")

            If weightCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec header must include a weight column."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If c = labelCol OrElse c = weightCol OrElse c = timeCol Then Continue For
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, header(c))
                If idx < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "profile column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                   String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & ". Use header 'time' for the fitted time/order column."
                    Return False
                End If

                If String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
                   String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "(Intercept)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    errorMessage = "the intercept column should not be used as a profile column; it is supplied automatically by the fitted design."
                    Return False
                End If

                profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
            Next

            If profileColumns.Count = 0 AndAlso timeCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must include at least one profile column: time and/or a fitted design column name."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim defaultIndex As Integer = 1
            For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                        rowHasAny = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next
                If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                Dim w As Double
                If Not tryFinite(arr(r, weightCol), w) Then
                    errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing or nonnumeric weight."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim label As String = Nothing
                If labelCol >= 0 Then label = cellText(arr(r, labelCol))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then label = "Estimate " & defaultIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

                Dim comp As New TComponent With {
                    .Label = label,
                    .Weight = w,
                    .TimeSpecified = False,
                    .TimeValue = Double.NaN
                }

                If timeCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(r, timeCol)) Then
                    Dim tv As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, timeCol), tv) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a nonnumeric time value."
                        Return False
                    End If
                    comp.TimeSpecified = True
                    comp.TimeValue = tv
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(r, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a nonnumeric value for profile column """ & header(pair.Key) & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    comp.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                        .Name = parameterNames(pair.Value),
                        .ColumnIndex = pair.Value,
                        .Value = profileValue
                    })
                Next

                components.Add(comp)
                defaultIndex += 1
            Next

            If components.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec does not contain any nonblank data rows."
                Return False
            End If

            Return True
        End Function

            header As Func(Of Object(,), Integer(), Boolean), labelText As Func(Of Object, String), numeric As Func(Of Object, Double?),
            ByRef groupMatrices As List(Of Double(,)), ByRef groupNames As List(Of String)) As Boolean

        Public Shared Function TryGetGroupedCompleteMatrixPrepared(dataArr As Object(,), groupArr As Object(,),
            header As Func(Of Object(,), Integer(), Boolean), labelText As Func(Of Object, String), numeric As Func(Of Object, Double?),
            ByRef groupMatrices As List(Of Double(,)), ByRef groupNames As List(Of String)) As Boolean
            If dataArr Is Nothing OrElse groupArr Is Nothing Then Return False
            If groupArr.GetLength(1) <> 1 Then Return False

            Dim dataRows As Integer = dataArr.GetLength(0)
            Dim dataCols As Integer = dataArr.GetLength(1)
            If dataRows < 1 OrElse dataCols < 1 Then Return False

            Dim dataColIndexes(dataCols - 1) As Integer
            For c As Integer = 0 To dataCols - 1
                dataColIndexes(c) = c
            Next

            Dim dataHasHeader As Boolean = header(dataArr, dataColIndexes)
            Dim startData As Integer = If(dataHasHeader, 1, 0)

            Dim usableRows As Integer = dataRows - startData
            Dim groupRows As Integer = groupArr.GetLength(0)

            Dim startGroup As Integer
            If groupRows = usableRows Then
                startGroup = 0
            ElseIf groupRows = usableRows + 1 Then
                startGroup = 1
            Else
                Return False
            End If

            Dim buckets As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Double()))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim order As New List(Of String)()

            For i As Integer = 0 To usableRows - 1
                Dim label As String = labelText(groupArr(startGroup + i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Continue For

                Dim row(dataCols - 1) As Double
                Dim ok As Boolean = True
                For c As Integer = 0 To dataCols - 1
                    Dim d As Double? = numeric(dataArr(startData + i, c))
                    If Not d.HasValue OrElse Double.IsNaN(d.Value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(d.Value) Then
                        ok = False
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    row(c) = d.Value
                Next
                If Not ok Then Continue For

                If Not buckets.ContainsKey(label) Then
                    buckets(label) = New List(Of Double())()
                    order.Add(label)
                End If
                buckets(label).Add(row)
            Next

            groupMatrices = New List(Of Double(,))()
            groupNames = New List(Of String)(order)
            For Each label As String In order
                groupMatrices.Add(Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.RowsToMatrix(buckets(label), dataCols))
            Next

            Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryGetNestedThreeColumnDataPrepared(arr As Object(,), labelText As Func(Of Object, String),
            numeric As Func(Of Object, Double?), ByRef data As Object(,), ByRef names As String()) As Boolean
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return False

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If cols <> 3 OrElse rows < 1 Then Return False

            Dim hasHeader As Boolean = False
            If rows >= 2 Then
                Dim firstRespNumeric As Boolean = numeric(arr(0, 2)).HasValue
                Dim belowRespNumeric As Boolean = False
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    If numeric(arr(r, 2)).HasValue Then
                        belowRespNumeric = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next
                hasHeader = (Not firstRespNumeric) AndAlso belowRespNumeric
            End If
            Dim startRow As Integer = If(hasHeader, 1, 0)

            names = New String() {
                If(hasHeader, labelText(arr(0, 0)), "Group"),
                If(hasHeader, labelText(arr(0, 1)), "Subgroup"),
                If(hasHeader, labelText(arr(0, 2)), "Response")
            }

            Dim rowsOut As New List(Of Object())()
            For r As Integer = startRow To rows - 1
                Dim g As String = labelText(arr(r, 0))
                Dim sg As String = labelText(arr(r, 1))
                Dim y As Double? = numeric(arr(r, 2))
                If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(g, "") AndAlso Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(sg, "") AndAlso y.HasValue Then
                    rowsOut.Add(New Object() {g, sg, y.Value})
                End If
            Next

            If rowsOut.Count < 1 Then Return False
            data = New Object(rowsOut.Count - 1, 2) {}
            For r As Integer = 0 To rowsOut.Count - 1
                data(r, 0) = rowsOut(r)(0)
                data(r, 1) = rowsOut(r)(1)
                data(r, 2) = rowsOut(r)(2)
            Next
            Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryStrictVector(count As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Boolean),
                                                numeric As Func(Of Integer, Double?), ByRef values As Double()) As Boolean
            values = Nothing
            If count < 1 Then Return False
            Dim last As Integer = count - 1
            While last >= 0 AndAlso blank(last)
                last -= 1
            End While
            If last < 0 Then Return False
            Dim start As Integer = 0
            If Not numeric(0).HasValue Then
                If last = 0 Then Return False
                start = 1
            End If
            If start > last Then Return False
            Dim result As New List(Of Double)()
            For index As Integer = start To last
                If blank(index) Then Return False
                Dim value As Double? = numeric(index)
                If Not value.HasValue Then Return False
                result.Add(value.Value)
            Next
            If result.Count = 0 Then Return False
            values = result.ToArray()
            Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryExtractNumericGroupsFromMatrix(rows As Integer, cols As Integer, startRow As Integer, hasHeader As Boolean, defaultPrefix As String, numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Double?), text As Func(Of Integer, Integer, String), ByRef groups()() As Double, ByRef names() As String) As Boolean
        groups = Nothing
        names = Nothing

        If rows < 1 OrElse cols < 1 Then Return False

        Dim groupList As New List(Of Double())()
        Dim nameList As New List(Of String)()

        For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            Dim values As New List(Of Double)(Math.Max(0, rows - startRow))
            For r As Integer = startRow To rows - 1
                Dim d As Double? = numeric(r, c)
                If d.HasValue Then values.Add(d.Value)
            Next

            If values.Count > 0 Then
                groupList.Add(values.ToArray())
                If hasHeader Then
                    nameList.Add(text(0, c))
                Else
                    nameList.Add(defaultPrefix & (groupList.Count).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                End If
            End If
        Next

        groups = groupList.ToArray()
        names = nameList.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryReadCompleteNumericMatrixWithHeadersPrepared(rows As Integer, cols As Integer, numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Double?), text As Func(Of Integer, Integer, String), ByRef mat As Double(,), ByRef names() As String) As Boolean


        Dim numericCols As Integer() = Enumerable.Range(0, cols).ToArray()
        Dim hasHeader As Boolean = UdfRangePreparation38.LooksLikeHeaderRow(rows, numericCols, Function(row, column) numeric(row, column).HasValue)
        Dim startRow As Integer = If(hasHeader, 1, 0)

        names = New String(cols - 1) {}
        For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            names(c) = If(hasHeader, text(0, c), "Condition " & (c + 1).ToString())
        Next

        Dim keepRows As New List(Of Double())()
        For r As Integer = startRow To rows - 1
            Dim row(cols - 1) As Double
            Dim ok As Boolean = True

            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                Dim d As Double? = numeric(r, c)
                If Not d.HasValue Then
                    ok = False
                    Exit For
                End If
                row(c) = d.Value
            Next

            If ok Then keepRows.Add(row)
        Next

        If keepRows.Count < 1 Then Return False

        mat = New Double(keepRows.Count - 1, cols - 1) {}
        For r As Integer = 0 To keepRows.Count - 1
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                mat(r, c) = keepRows(r)(c)
            Next
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ExtractCompleteNumericMatrixCompleteCasesPrepared(r As Integer, c As Integer, numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Double?), ByRef mat As Double(,), ByRef noRows As Integer, ByRef noCols As Integer) As Boolean


        Dim rows As New List(Of Double())()

        For i As Integer = 0 To r - 1
            Dim rowVals(c - 1) As Double
            Dim ok As Boolean = True

            For j As Integer = 0 To c - 1
                Dim d As Double? = numeric(i, j)
                If Not d.HasValue Then
                    ok = False
                    Exit For
                End If
                rowVals(j) = d.Value
            Next

            If ok Then rows.Add(rowVals)
        Next

        noRows = rows.Count
        noCols = c
        If noRows < 2 Then Return True

        mat = New Double(noRows - 1, c - 1) {}
        For i As Integer = 0 To noRows - 1
            For j As Integer = 0 To c - 1
                mat(i, j) = rows(i)(j)
            Next
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ReadFiniteColumn(rows As Integer, startRow As Integer, numeric As Func(Of Integer, Double?),
            Optional initialCapacity As Integer? = Nothing) As Double()
        Dim list As List(Of Double) = If(initialCapacity.HasValue, New List(Of Double)(initialCapacity.Value), New List(Of Double)())
        For r As Integer = startRow To rows - 1
            Dim d As Double? = numeric(r)
            If d.HasValue AndAlso Not Double.IsNaN(d.Value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(d.Value) Then list.Add(d.Value)
        Next

        Return list.ToArray()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryReadProbabilityThresholdsPrepared(rows As Integer, cols As Integer,
            appendCell As Func(Of Integer, Integer, List(Of Double), Boolean), ByRef thresholds() As Double) As Boolean
        If rows <> 1 AndAlso cols <> 1 Then Return False

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        If rows = 1 Then
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If Not appendCell(0, j, values) Then Return False
            Next
        Else
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not appendCell(i, 0, values) Then Return False
            Next
        End If

        If values.Count = 0 Then Return True

        values.Sort()
        Dim uniqueValues As New List(Of Double)(values.Count)
        For i As Integer = 0 To values.Count - 1
            If i = 0 OrElse Math.Abs(values(i) - values(i - 1)) > 0.000000000001R Then
                uniqueValues.Add(values(i))
            End If
        Next

        thresholds = uniqueValues.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

        If rows = 1 Then

            Next
        Else
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1

            Next

        Next

        Public Shared Function TryParseLeveneCenterFromReader(readText As Func(Of String), ByRef useMedian As Boolean, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            useMedian = False
            title = "Levene Test"

            Dim text As String = readText()
            Dim parsedMedian As Boolean = False
            Dim parsedTitle As String = Nothing
            If Not TryParseLeveneCenter(text, parsedMedian, parsedTitle) Then Return False
            useMedian = parsedMedian
            title = parsedTitle
            Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryParseLeveneCenter(arg As String, ByRef useMedian As Boolean, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            useMedian = False
            title = "Levene Test"

            Dim s As String = NormalizeText(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MEAN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "LEVENE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "CLASSICAL") Then
                useMedian = False
                title = "Levene Test"
                Return True
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s, New String() {"MEDIAN", "BROWN-FORSYTHE", "BROWNFORSYTHE", "BF"})
                Case "MEDIAN", "BROWN-FORSYTHE", "BROWNFORSYTHE", "BF"
                    useMedian = True
                    title = "Brown-Forsythe Test"
                    Return True
                Case Else
                    Return False
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryParseSymmetryMethod(arg As String, ByRef methodInternal As String, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            Dim s As String = NormalizeText(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MGG") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MIAO-GEL-GASTWIRTH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MIAO") Then
                methodInternal = "Miao-Gel-Gastwirth"
                title = "Miao-Gel-Gastwirth Symmetry Test"
                Return True
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s, New String() {"CM", "CABILIO-MASARO", "CABILIO", "MASARO"})
                Case "CM", "CABILIO-MASARO", "CABILIO", "MASARO"
                    methodInternal = "Cabilio-Masaro"
                    title = "Cabilio-Masaro Symmetry Test"
                    Return True
                Case Else
                    Return False
            End Select
        End Function

            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "KR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "KENWARDROGER") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "KENWARDROGERDF") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "KENWARDROGERF") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.KenwardRoger
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "SAT") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "SATTERTHWAITE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "SATTERTHWAITEDF") Then Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.Satterthwaite
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BW") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BETWEENWITHIN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BETWEENWITHINDF") Then Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.BetweenWithin
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "RESID") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "RESIDUAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "RESIDUALDF") Then Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.ResidualDF
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "WALD") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "NORMAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "WALDNORMAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "Z") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "LARGESAMPLENORMAL") Then Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelFixedInferenceMethod.WaldNormal

        End Function

               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AIFISHERSCORINGDEFAULT") Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.MixedModelCovarianceOptimizerMode.AverageInformationReml
            End If

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSAUTO") OrElse

               LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSANALYTICGRADIENT") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ANALYTICBFGS") Then

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "BFGSNUMERICAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "PROJECTEDBFGSNUMERICAL") OrElse

        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryClassifyMixedModelResidualCovarianceName(arg As String, defaultValue As String, ByRef canonical As String) As Boolean
            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) Then
                canonical = defaultValue
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ID") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "IDENTITY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "INDEPENDENCE") Then
                canonical = "Identity"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAG") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONALHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSDIAGONAL") Then
                canonical = "Diagonal"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "COMPOUNDSYMMETRY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "EXCHANGEABLE") Then
                canonical = "CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CSH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCOMPOUNDSYMMETRY") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZ") Then
                canonical = "Toeplitz (TOEP)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEPLITZ") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZHETEROGENEOUS") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous Toeplitz (TOEPH)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UNSTRUCTURED") Then
                canonical = "UN"

        Public Shared Function TryClassifyMixedModelResidualCovarianceName(arg As String, defaultValue As String, ByRef canonical As String) As Boolean
            Dim token As String = NormalizeMixedModelOptionToken(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, String.Empty) Then
                canonical = defaultValue
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ID") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "IDENTITY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "INDEPENDENCE") Then
                canonical = "Identity"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAG") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONAL") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "DIAGONALHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSDIAGONAL") Then
                canonical = "Diagonal"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "COMPOUNDSYMMETRY") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "EXCHANGEABLE") Then
                canonical = "CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "CSH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSCOMPOUNDSYMMETRY") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous CS"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "AUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "ARH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR1") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAR") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSAUTOREGRESSIVE") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous AR(1)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZ") Then
                canonical = "Toeplitz (TOEP)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPHETEROGENEOUS") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEP") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "HETEROGENEOUSTOEPLITZ") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "TOEPLITZHETEROGENEOUS") Then
                canonical = "Heterogeneous Toeplitz (TOEPH)"
                Return True
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(token, "UNSTRUCTURED") Then
                canonical = "UN"
                Return True
            End If

            canonical = Nothing
            Return False
        End Function

            Dim pos As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim neg As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim normalizedPositive As String = normalize(positiveLabel)

            For i As Integer = 0 To markerCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim x As Double
                If Not finiteDouble(markerCol(i, 0), x) Then Continue For

                Dim label As String = toText(statusCol(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Continue For

                Dim isPositive As Boolean = False
                Dim iv As Integer
                If normalizedPositive = "1" AndAlso status01(statusCol(i, 0), iv) Then
                    isPositive = (iv = 1)
                Else
                    isPositive = String.Equals(normalize(label), normalizedPositive, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                End If

                If isLowerDirection Then x = -x
                If isPositive Then
                    pos.Add(x)
                Else
                    neg.Add(x)
                End If
            Next

            If pos.Count < 1 OrElse neg.Count < 1 Then Return False
            rocInput = New Double()() {pos.ToArray(), neg.ToArray()}
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function CompleteSurvivalRecordsPrepared(timeCol As Object(,), statusCol As Object(,), groupCol As Object(,), hasGroup As Boolean, finiteDouble As UdfPlotFiniteDoubleReader38, status01 As UdfPlotStatusReader38, toText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord)) As Boolean
Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

For i As Integer = 0 To timeCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim t As Double
                Dim s As Integer
                If Not finiteDouble(timeCol(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
                If t < 0.0R Then Return False
                If Not status01(statusCol(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

                Dim g As String = "ALL"
                If hasGroup Then
                    g = toText(groupCol(i, 0))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                End If

                tList.Add(t)
                sList.Add(s)
                gList.Add(g)
                stratList.Add("ALL")
            Next
For i As Integer = 0 To timeCol.GetLength(0) - 1
If Not finiteDouble(timeCol(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
If Not status01(statusCol(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

If hasGroup Then
                    g = toText(groupCol(i, 0))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                End If
Return records IsNot Nothing AndAlso records.Count > 0

        Private Sub New()

        Public Shared Sub NormalizeFitOptions(fitOptions As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions)
            Dim o As PsmOptions = fitOptions.StandardOptions
            If fitOptions.RunMethod = PsmBackendRunMethod.OptimalPairMatching Then
                o.MatchingRatio = 1
                o.WithReplacement = False
            End If
            If Not PsmMethodCapabilities.UsesMatchingControls(fitOptions.RunMethod) Then
                o.MatchingRatio = 1
                o.WithReplacement = False
                o.DistanceMetric = PsmDistanceMetric.PropensityScore
                o.CaliperScale = PsmCaliperScale.None
                o.Caliper = Double.NaN
            End If
            If fitOptions.RunMethod = PsmBackendRunMethod.CoarsenedExactMatching AndAlso fitOptions.CoarseningSpec Is Nothing Then
                fitOptions.CoarseningSpec = New PsmCoarseningSpec With {
                    .Estimand = o.Estimand,
                    .NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize = o.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize
                }
            End If
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub ApplyOptionText(fitOptions As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions, optionText As String)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(optionText) Then Return
            Dim parts As String() = optionText.Split({";"c, Convert.ToChar(10), Convert.ToChar(13)}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            For Each raw As String In parts
                Dim p As String = raw.Trim()
                If p.Length = 0 Then Continue For
                Dim eq As Integer = p.IndexOf("="c)
                Dim key As String = NormalizeOptionKey(If(eq >= 0, p.Substring(0, eq), p))
                Dim value As String = If(eq >= 0, p.Substring(eq + 1).Trim(), "true")
                ApplyOption(fitOptions, key, value)
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub ApplyOption(fitOptions As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions, key As String, value As String)
            Dim o As PsmOptions = fitOptions.StandardOptions
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(key, New String() {"method", "runmethod", "estimand", "scoremethod", "score", "distance", "distancemetric", "ratio", "matchingratio", "k", "replacement", "withreplacement", "caliperscale", "calipertype", "caliper", "order", "matchingorder", "support", "commonsupport", "seed", "randomseed", "intercept", "includeintercept", "standardize", "standardizecovariates", "maxiter", "logisticmaxiterations", "tol", "tolerance", "logistictolerance", "ridge", "ridgepenalty", "logisticridgepenalty", "smd", "smdthreshold", "balancesmdthreshold", "vrlower", "varianceratiolower", "vrupper", "varianceratioupper", "strata", "subclasses", "subclassificationstrata", "normalize", "normalizeweights", "normalizeweightstosamplesize", "trimlower", "trimpropensitylower", "trimupper", "trimpropensityupper", "dr", "aipw", "doublyrobust", "overlap", "overlapdiagnostics", "weightdiagnostics", "loveplot", "loveplotrows", "overlapbins", "overlapbincount", "extremeweight", "extremeweightcutoff", "cembins", "bins", "defaultcovariatebins", "psbins", "propensityscorebins", "includeps", "includepropensityscore"})
                Case "method", "runmethod"
                    fitOptions.RunMethod = ParseRunMethod(value, fitOptions.RunMethod)
                Case "estimand"
                    o.Estimand = ParseEstimand(value, o.Estimand)
                Case "scoremethod", "score"
                    o.ScoreMethod = ParseScoreMethod(value, o.ScoreMethod)
                Case "distance", "distancemetric"
                    o.DistanceMetric = ParseDistance(value, o.DistanceMetric)
                Case "ratio", "matchingratio", "k"
                    o.MatchingRatio = Math.Max(1, ParseInteger(value, o.MatchingRatio))
                Case "replacement", "withreplacement"
                    o.WithReplacement = ParseBoolean(value, o.WithReplacement)
                Case "caliperscale", "calipertype"
                    o.CaliperScale = ParseCaliperScale(value, o.CaliperScale)
                Case "caliper"
                    o.Caliper = ParseDouble(value, o.Caliper)
                Case "order", "matchingorder"
                    o.MatchingOrder = ParseOrder(value, o.MatchingOrder)
                Case "support", "commonsupport"
                    o.CommonSupport = ParseSupport(value, o.CommonSupport)
                Case "seed", "randomseed"
                    o.RandomSeed = ParseInteger(value, o.RandomSeed)
                Case "intercept", "includeintercept"
                    o.IncludeIntercept = ParseBoolean(value, o.IncludeIntercept)
                Case "standardize", "standardizecovariates"
                    o.StandardizeCovariates = ParseBoolean(value, o.StandardizeCovariates)
                Case "maxiter", "logisticmaxiterations"
                    o.LogisticMaxIterations = Math.Max(1, ParseInteger(value, o.LogisticMaxIterations))
                Case "tol", "tolerance", "logistictolerance"
                    o.LogisticTolerance = ParseDouble(value, o.LogisticTolerance)
                Case "ridge", "ridgepenalty", "logisticridgepenalty"
                    o.LogisticRidgePenalty = ParseDouble(value, o.LogisticRidgePenalty)
                Case "smd", "smdthreshold", "balancesmdthreshold"
                    o.BalanceSmdThreshold = ParseDouble(value, o.BalanceSmdThreshold)
                    fitOptions.LovePlotThreshold = o.BalanceSmdThreshold
                Case "vrlower", "varianceratiolower"
                    o.BalanceVarianceRatioLower = ParseDouble(value, o.BalanceVarianceRatioLower)
                Case "vrupper", "varianceratioupper"
                    o.BalanceVarianceRatioUpper = ParseDouble(value, o.BalanceVarianceRatioUpper)
                Case "strata", "subclasses", "subclassificationstrata"
                    o.SubclassificationStrata = Math.Max(2, ParseInteger(value, o.SubclassificationStrata))
                Case "normalize", "normalizeweights", "normalizeweightstosamplesize"
                    o.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize = ParseBoolean(value, o.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize)
                Case "trimlower", "trimpropensitylower"
                    o.TrimPropensityLower = ParseDouble(value, o.TrimPropensityLower)
                Case "trimupper", "trimpropensityupper"
                    o.TrimPropensityUpper = ParseDouble(value, o.TrimPropensityUpper)
                Case "dr", "aipw", "doublyrobust"
                    fitOptions.IncludeDoublyRobustEstimate = ParseBoolean(value, fitOptions.IncludeDoublyRobustEstimate)
                Case "overlap", "overlapdiagnostics"
                    fitOptions.IncludeOverlapDiagnostics = ParseBoolean(value, fitOptions.IncludeOverlapDiagnostics)
                Case "weightdiagnostics"
                    fitOptions.IncludeWeightDiagnostics = ParseBoolean(value, fitOptions.IncludeWeightDiagnostics)
                Case "loveplot", "loveplotrows"
                    fitOptions.IncludeLovePlotRows = ParseBoolean(value, fitOptions.IncludeLovePlotRows)
                Case "overlapbins", "overlapbincount"
                    fitOptions.OverlapBinCount = Math.Max(2, ParseInteger(value, fitOptions.OverlapBinCount))
                Case "extremeweight", "extremeweightcutoff"
                    fitOptions.ExtremeWeightCutoff = ParseDouble(value, fitOptions.ExtremeWeightCutoff)
                Case "cembins", "bins", "defaultcovariatebins"
                    EnsureCoarseningSpec(fitOptions)
                    fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.DefaultCovariateBins = Math.Max(2, ParseInteger(value, fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.DefaultCovariateBins))
                    fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.PropensityScoreBins = fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.DefaultCovariateBins
                Case "psbins", "propensityscorebins"
                    EnsureCoarseningSpec(fitOptions)
                    fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.PropensityScoreBins = Math.Max(2, ParseInteger(value, fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.PropensityScoreBins))
                Case "includeps", "includepropensityscore"
                    EnsureCoarseningSpec(fitOptions)
                    fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.IncludePropensityScore = ParseBoolean(value, fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.IncludePropensityScore)
            End Select
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub EnsureCoarseningSpec(fitOptions As PsmComprehensiveFitOptions)
            If fitOptions.CoarseningSpec Is Nothing Then fitOptions.CoarseningSpec = New PsmCoarseningSpec()
            fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.Estimand = fitOptions.StandardOptions.Estimand
            fitOptions.CoarseningSpec.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize = fitOptions.StandardOptions.NormalizeWeightsToSampleSize
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ParseEstimand(value As String, defaultValue As PsmEstimand) As PsmEstimand
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return defaultValue
            Try
                Return CType([Enum].Parse(GetType(PsmEstimand), value.Trim(), True), PsmEstimand)
            Catch
                Return defaultValue
            End Try
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FindLastNonBlankRow(rows As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Integer

        For i As Integer = rows - 1 To 0 Step -1
            For j As Integer = 0 To columns - 1
                If Not blank(i, j) Then
                    Return i
                End If
            Next
        Next

        Return -1
        End Function

        Public Shared Function HasNumericColumnHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False
        If blank(0, 0) Then Return False
        Dim firstIsNumeric As Boolean = numeric(0, 0)
        Dim secondIsNumeric As Boolean = numeric(1, 0)
        Return (Not firstIsNumeric) AndAlso secondIsNumeric
        End Function

        Public Shared Function HasBinaryColumnHeader(lastRow As Integer, binary As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim firstIsBinary As Boolean = binary(0, 0)
        Dim secondIsBinary As Boolean = binary(1, 0)
        Return (Not firstIsBinary) AndAlso secondIsBinary
        End Function

        Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim cols As Integer = columns
        Dim anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        Dim anyNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If blank(0, j) Then Continue For

            If numeric(0, j) Then
                anyNumericFirstRow = True
            Else
                anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow = True
            End If
        Next

        ' A real numeric-matrix header should look like labels, not like a data row
        ' with one or more missing numeric values. This prevents explicit data ranges
        ' whose first observation has missing values from being shortened before row-wise
        ' complete-case filtering aligns y, x, subject, and visit.
        If Not anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow Then Return False
        If anyNumericFirstRow Then Return False

        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If Not numeric(1, j) Then
                Return False
            End If
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function LooksLikeHeaderRow(rows As Integer, numericCols As Integer(), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If rows < 2 Then Return False

        Dim anyNonNumeric As Boolean = False
        For Each c In numericCols
            If Not numeric(0, c) Then
                anyNonNumeric = True
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        If Not anyNonNumeric Then Return False

        For Each c In numericCols
            Dim foundNumericBelow As Boolean = False
            For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                If numeric(r, c) Then
                    foundNumericBelow = True
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            If Not foundNumericBelow Then Return False
        Next

        Return True

        Private Shared Function Failed(ByRef errorKind As UdfSampleSizeError38, value As UdfSampleSizeError38) As UdfReportProjection38
            errorKind = value
            Return Nothing

        Public Shared Function PrepareUnpaired(meanDifference As Object, _
            commonSd As Object, _
            controlToExperimentalRatio As Object, _
            alpha As Object, _
            beta As Object, _
            hypothesisType As Object, _
            margin As Object, _
            readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), _
            readHypothesis As Func(Of Object, UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38), _
            isOpenUnitInterval As Func(Of Double, Boolean), _
            ByRef errorKind As UdfSampleSizeError38) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim diff As Double? = readNumber(meanDifference)
            Dim sd As Double? = readNumber(commonSd)
            Dim kappa As Double? = readNumber(controlToExperimentalRatio)
            Dim a As Double? = readNumber(alpha)
            Dim b As Double? = readNumber(beta)

            If Not diff.HasValue OrElse Not sd.HasValue OrElse Not kappa.HasValue OrElse Not a.HasValue OrElse Not b.HasValue Then
                Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
            End If
            If sd.Value <= 0 OrElse kappa.Value <= 0 OrElse Not isOpenUnitInterval(a.Value) OrElse Not isOpenUnitInterval(b.Value) Then
                Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
            End If

            Dim hypothesis As UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38 = readHypothesis(hypothesisType)
            If hypothesis = UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Invalid Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)

            Select Case hypothesis
                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Superiority
                    If diff.Value = 0 Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
                    Dim result As UnpairedTTestSampleSizeResult = SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateUnpairedTTest(diff.Value, sd.Value, kappa.Value, a.Value, b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeTwoGroupTable("Required subjects", result.NumberOfControls, result.NumberOfExperimental)

                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.NonInferiority
                    Dim m As Double? = readNumber(margin)
                    If Not m.HasValue Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
                    If m.Value <= 0 Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)

                    Dim result As UnpairedTTestSampleSizeResult =
                        SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateNonInferiorityUnpairedTTest(diff.Value,
                                                                                 -m.Value,
                                                                                 sd.Value,
                                                                                 kappa.Value,
                                                                                 a.Value,
                                                                                 b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeTwoGroupTable("Required subjects", result.NumberOfControls, result.NumberOfExperimental)

                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Equivalence
                    Dim m As Double? = readNumber(margin)
                    If Not m.HasValue Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
                    If m.Value <= 0 Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)

                    Dim result As EquivalenceUnpairedTTestSampleSizeResult =
                        SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateEquivalenceUnpairedTTest(diff.Value,
                                                                              -m.Value,
                                                                              m.Value,
                                                                              sd.Value,
                                                                              kappa.Value,
                                                                              a.Value,
                                                                              b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeEquivalenceTwoGroupTable(result)

                Case Else
                    Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
            End Select
        End Function

Public Shared Function PrepareIndependentProportions(controlProportion As Object, _
            experimentalProportion As Object, _
            controlToExperimentalRatio As Object, _
            alpha As Object, _
            beta As Object, _
            hypothesisType As Object, _
            margin As Object, _
            readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), _
            readHypothesis As Func(Of Object, UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38), _
            isOpenUnitInterval As Func(Of Double, Boolean), _
            isClosedUnitInterval As Func(Of Double, Boolean), _
            ByRef errorKind As UdfSampleSizeError38) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim cProp As Double? = readNumber(controlProportion)
            Dim eProp As Double? = readNumber(experimentalProportion)
            Dim kappa As Double? = readNumber(controlToExperimentalRatio)
            Dim a As Double? = readNumber(alpha)
            Dim b As Double? = readNumber(beta)

            If Not cProp.HasValue OrElse Not eProp.HasValue OrElse Not kappa.HasValue OrElse Not a.HasValue OrElse Not b.HasValue Then
                Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
            End If
            If Not isClosedUnitInterval(cProp.Value) OrElse Not isClosedUnitInterval(eProp.Value) OrElse kappa.Value <= 0 OrElse Not isOpenUnitInterval(a.Value) OrElse Not isOpenUnitInterval(b.Value) Then
                Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
            End If

            Dim hypothesis As UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38 = readHypothesis(hypothesisType)
            If hypothesis = UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Invalid Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)

            Select Case hypothesis
                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Superiority
                    If cProp.Value = eProp.Value Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
                    Dim result As IndependentProportionsSampleSizeResult = SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateIndependentProportions(cProp.Value, eProp.Value, kappa.Value, a.Value, b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeIndependentProportionsTable(result)

                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.NonInferiority
                    Dim m As Double? = readNumber(margin)
                    If Not m.HasValue Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
                    If m.Value <= 0 Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
                    Dim result As IndependentProportionsSampleSizeResult =
                        SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateNonInferiorityIndependentProportions(cProp.Value,
                                                                                          eProp.Value,
                                                                                          -m.Value,
                                                                                          kappa.Value,
                                                                                          a.Value,
                                                                                          b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeIndependentProportionsTable(result)

                Case UdfSampleSizeHypothesis38.Equivalence
                    Dim m As Double? = readNumber(margin)
                    If Not m.HasValue Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
                    If m.Value <= 0 Then Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Numeric)
                    Dim result As EquivalenceIndependentProportionsSampleSizeResult =
                        SampleSizeCalculator.CalculateEquivalenceIndependentProportions(cProp.Value,
                                                                                       eProp.Value,
                                                                                       -m.Value,
                                                                                       m.Value,
                                                                                       kappa.Value,
                                                                                       a.Value,
                                                                                       b.Value)
                    Return SampleSizeUDFsReports38.MakeEquivalenceIndependentProportionsTable(result)

                Case Else
                    Return Failed(errorKind, UdfSampleSizeError38.Value)
            End Select
        End Function

                    result = integerValue

                End If
                Return False

            If Not value.HasValue Then Return False
            If Double.IsNaN(value.Value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value.Value) Then Return False
            Dim rounded As Double = Math.Round(value.Value)
            If Math.Abs(value.Value - rounded) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
            If rounded < Integer.MinValue OrElse rounded > Integer.MaxValue Then Return False
            result = CInt(rounded)

        Public Shared Function ResolveMmrmFormulaColumns(formulaText As String, formulaAddressingMode As String, pAll As Integer, allDisplayNames() As String, allAbsoluteLetters() As String, hasAbsoluteLetters As Boolean, ByRef columnIndices() As Integer, ByRef selectedNames() As String, ByRef selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim normalizedFormula As String = If(formulaText, String.Empty).Trim()
        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(normalizedFormula, String.Empty) Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim mode As String = If(formulaAddressingMode, String.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
        Dim allowAbsolute As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "absolute", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowRelative As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "relative", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowQuoted As Boolean = True

        If allowAbsolute AndAlso Not hasAbsoluteLetters Then
            errorMessage = "formulaAddressing='absolute' requires x to be passed as a direct worksheet range so absolute worksheet column letters can be determined."
            Return False
        End If

        Dim catalog As RegressionVariableCatalog = RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(varNames:=allDisplayNames,
                                                                                   absoluteColumnLetters:=If(allowAbsolute, allAbsoluteLetters, Nothing),
                                                                                   allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelative,
                                                                                   allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsolute,
                                                                                   allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuoted)

        Dim spec As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
        Dim parseErr As String = Nothing
        If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(formulaText:=normalizedFormula,
                                                                   variableCatalog:=catalog,
                                                                   designSpec:=spec,
                                                                   errorMessage:=parseErr) Then
            errorMessage = "formula could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(parseErr, String.Empty)
            Return False
        End If

        If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "formula did not reference any predictor columns."
            Return False
        End If

        If allowRelative Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim entries As New List(Of RegressionVariableCatalogEntry)()
        For Each requiredKey As String In spec.RequiredRawVarKeys
            Dim entry As RegressionVariableCatalogEntry = catalog.Variables.FirstOrDefault(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, requiredKey, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            If entry Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced an unknown predictor column."
                Return False
            End If
            If Not entries.Any(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, entry.BaseKey, StringComparison.Ordinal)) Then
                entries.Add(entry)
            End If
        Next

        entries = entries.OrderBy(Function(v) v.RelativeColumnIndex).ToList()
        ReDim columnIndices(entries.Count - 1)
        ReDim selectedNames(entries.Count - 1)
        If hasAbsoluteLetters Then ReDim selectedAbsoluteLetters(entries.Count - 1)

        For j As Integer = 0 To entries.Count - 1
            Dim originalIndex As Integer = entries(j).RelativeColumnIndex - 1
            If originalIndex < 0 OrElse originalIndex >= pAll Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced a predictor column outside the supplied x range."
                Return False
            End If
            columnIndices(j) = originalIndex
            selectedNames(j) = entries(j).DisplayName
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters(j) = entries(j).AbsoluteColumnLetter
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function AlignMmrmRows(yCol(,) As Object, xRaw(,) As Object, subjectCol(,) As Object, visitCol(,) As Object, xColumnIndices() As Integer, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef yValues() As Double, ByRef xValues(,) As Double, ByRef subjectValues() As Object, ByRef visitValues() As Double, ByRef droppedRows As Integer, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim p As Integer = xColumnIndices.Length
        Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
        Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
        Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
            Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
            Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)
            Dim row(p - 1) As Double

            If valid Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, xColumnIndices(j)))
                    If Not xij.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    row(j) = xij.Value
                Next
            End If

            Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
            If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                    valid = False
                Else
                    vi = parsedVisit.Value
                End If
            End If

            If valid Then
                yList.Add(yi.Value)
                xRows.Add(row)
                subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
            Else
                droppedRows += 1
            End If
        Next

        If yList.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, subject, or visit values."
            Return False
        End If

        yValues = yList.ToArray()
        subjectValues = subjectList.ToArray()
        ReDim xValues(yList.Count - 1, p - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
            Next
        Next

        If visitSupplied Then visitValues = visitList.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function
