        Public Shared Function ResponseColumnsMatchObjects(countData(,) As Object, zeroData(,) As Object, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            If countData Is Nothing OrElse zeroData Is Nothing Then Return False
        If countData.GetLength(0) <> zeroData.GetLength(0) Then Return False
            
        For i As Integer = 0 To countData.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim yc As Double? = readNumber(countData(i, 0))
            Dim yz As Double? = readNumber(zeroData(i, 0))
            If Not yc.HasValue OrElse Not yz.HasValue Then Return False
            If Math.Abs(yc.Value - yz.Value) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
        Next
            
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryExtractNonnegativeIntegerResponseObjects(data(,) As Object, ByRef response() As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            response = Nothing
        If data Is Nothing Then Return False
        Dim n As Integer = data.GetLength(0)
        If n < 1 Then Return False
            
        ReDim response(n - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(data(i, 0))
            If Not yi.HasValue Then Return False
            Dim yr As Double = Math.Round(yi.Value)
            If yi.Value < 0.0R OrElse Math.Abs(yi.Value - yr) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
            response(i) = CInt(yr)
        Next
            
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function PrepareKaplanMeierRecords(tArr(,) As Object, sArr(,) As Object, gArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord), readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim map As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim nextId As Integer = 0
        Dim out As New List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To tArr.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim tVal As Double
            Dim sVal As Integer

            If Not readFinite(tArr(i, 0), tVal) Then Continue For
            If tVal < 0.0R Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(sArr(i, 0), sVal) Then Continue For

            Dim gKey As String = "All"
            If hasGroup Then
                gKey = readText(gArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gKey) Then Continue For
                gKey = gKey.Trim()
            End If

            Dim gid As Integer
            If Not map.TryGetValue(gKey, gid) Then
                gid = nextId
                map(gKey) = gid
                nextId += 1
            End If

            out.Add(New survival.SurvivalRecord With {
                    .Time = tVal,
                    .Censorship = sVal,
                    .Group = gid,
                    .strGroup = gKey,
                    .Stratum = "",
                    .strStratum = ""
                })
        Next

        records = out
        Return records.Count > 0
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalMedianCi(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, alpha As Double, ByRef outTable(,) As Object, unavailable As Object, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For
            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            Dim g As String = "ALL"
            If hasGroup Then
                g = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                g = g.Trim()
            End If

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g)
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim stratAll() As String = Enumerable.Repeat("ALL", tList.Count).ToArray()
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratAll, err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then Return False

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        Dim mci As Object(,) = lr.BrookmeyerCrowleyMedianSurvivalCI(alpha)
        If mci Is Nothing OrElse mci.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Return False

        Dim groupIds = gList.Distinct().ToList()
        Dim k As Integer = mci.GetLength(0)
        Dim out As Object(,) = New Object(k - 1, 3) {}

        For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
            Dim med As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 0), Double)
            Dim ll As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 1), Double)
            Dim ul As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 2), Double)

            out(j, 0) = groupIds(j)
            out(j, 1) = If(Double.IsNaN(med) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(med), unavailable, CType(med, Object))
            out(j, 2) = If(Double.IsNaN(ll) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ll), unavailable, CType(ll, Object))
            out(j, 3) = If(Double.IsNaN(ul) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ul), unavailable, CType(ul, Object))
        Next

        outTable = out
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalLogRank(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, strataArr(,) As Object, hasStrata As Boolean, weightMethod As String, ByRef result As TestResult, ByRef errText As String, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
        Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer
            Dim st As String = "ALL"

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

            Dim g As String = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For

            If hasStrata Then
                st = readText(strataArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(st) Then st = "ALL"
            End If

            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g.Trim())
            stratList.Add(st.Trim())
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False
        If gList.Distinct().Count() < 2 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then
            errText = err
            Return False
        End If

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        result = lr.WeightedLogRankTest(weightMethod)
        Return result IsNot Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseSurvivalWeightText(s As String) As String
            Dim key As String = s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "logrank") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "lr") Then
                Return "logrank"
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "gehan-breslow") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "gehan") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "breslow") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "wilcoxon") Then
                Return "gehan-breslow"
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "tarone-ware") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "tarone") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "ware") Then
                Return "tarone-ware"
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "peto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "peto-peto") Then
                Return "peto"
            End If
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modified peto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modifiedpeto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "anderson") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modpeto") Then
                Return "modified peto"
            End If
                Return Nothing

        Public Shared Function MapMmrmNamesByLetter(suppliedNames() As String, suppliedLetters() As String, selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, inferred() As String, selectedCount As Integer) As String()
                    Dim byLetter As New Dictionary(Of String, String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    For i As Integer = 0 To Math.Min(suppliedNames.Length, suppliedLetters.Length) - 1
                        Dim letter As String = If(suppliedLetters(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(letter, String.Empty) Then Continue For
                        If Not byLetter.ContainsKey(letter) Then byLetter(letter) = If(suppliedNames(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                    Next

                    Dim mapped(selectedCount - 1) As String
                    Dim anyMapped As Boolean = False
                    For j As Integer = 0 To selectedCount - 1
                        Dim selectedLetter As String = If(selectedAbsoluteLetters(j), String.Empty).Trim()
                        Dim mappedName As String = Nothing
                        If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(selectedLetter, String.Empty) AndAlso byLetter.TryGetValue(selectedLetter, mappedName) Then
                            mapped(j) = mappedName
                            anyMapped = True
                        Else
                            mapped(j) = inferred(j)
                        End If
                    Next

                    If anyMapped Then Return MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.NormalizeMmrmNameList(mapped, selectedCount, "X")
            Return inferred
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ResolveMmrmFormulaColumns(formulaText As String, formulaAddressingMode As String, pAll As Integer, allDisplayNames() As String, allAbsoluteLetters() As String, hasAbsoluteLetters As Boolean, ByRef columnIndices() As Integer, ByRef selectedNames() As String, ByRef selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim normalizedFormula As String = If(formulaText, String.Empty).Trim()
        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(normalizedFormula, String.Empty) Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim mode As String = If(formulaAddressingMode, String.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
        Dim allowAbsolute As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "absolute", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowRelative As Boolean = String.Equals(mode, "relative", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim allowQuoted As Boolean = True

        If allowAbsolute AndAlso Not hasAbsoluteLetters Then
            errorMessage = "formulaAddressing='absolute' requires x to be passed as a direct worksheet range so absolute worksheet column letters can be determined."
            Return False
        End If

        Dim catalog As RegressionVariableCatalog = RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(varNames:=allDisplayNames,
                                                                                   absoluteColumnLetters:=If(allowAbsolute, allAbsoluteLetters, Nothing),
                                                                                   allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelative,
                                                                                   allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsolute,
                                                                                   allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuoted)

        Dim spec As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
        Dim parseErr As String = Nothing
        If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(formulaText:=normalizedFormula,
                                                                   variableCatalog:=catalog,
                                                                   designSpec:=spec,
                                                                   errorMessage:=parseErr) Then
            errorMessage = "formula could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(parseErr, String.Empty)
            Return False
        End If

        If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse spec.RequiredRawVarKeys.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "formula did not reference any predictor columns."
            Return False
        End If

        If allowRelative Then
            ReDim columnIndices(pAll - 1)
            For j As Integer = 0 To pAll - 1
                columnIndices(j) = j
            Next
            selectedNames = CType(allDisplayNames.Clone(), String())
            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters = CType(allAbsoluteLetters.Clone(), String())
            Return True
        End If

        Dim entries As New List(Of RegressionVariableCatalogEntry)()
        For Each requiredKey As String In spec.RequiredRawVarKeys
            Dim entry As RegressionVariableCatalogEntry = catalog.Variables.FirstOrDefault(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, requiredKey, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            If entry Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced an unknown predictor column."
                Return False
            End If
            If Not entries.Any(Function(v) String.Equals(v.BaseKey, entry.BaseKey, StringComparison.Ordinal)) Then
                entries.Add(entry)
            End If
        Next

        entries = entries.OrderBy(Function(v) v.RelativeColumnIndex).ToList()
        ReDim columnIndices(entries.Count - 1)
        ReDim selectedNames(entries.Count - 1)
        If hasAbsoluteLetters Then ReDim selectedAbsoluteLetters(entries.Count - 1)

        For j As Integer = 0 To entries.Count - 1
            Dim originalIndex As Integer = entries(j).RelativeColumnIndex - 1
            If originalIndex < 0 OrElse originalIndex >= pAll Then
                errorMessage = "formula referenced a predictor column outside the supplied x range."
                Return False
            End If
            columnIndices(j) = originalIndex

            If hasAbsoluteLetters Then selectedAbsoluteLetters(j) = entries(j).AbsoluteColumnLetter

        End Function

        Public Shared Function AlignMmrmRows(yCol(,) As Object, xRaw(,) As Object, subjectCol(,) As Object, visitCol(,) As Object, xColumnIndices() As Integer, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef yValues() As Double, ByRef xValues(,) As Double, ByRef subjectValues() As Object, ByRef visitValues() As Double, ByRef droppedRows As Integer, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
        Dim p As Integer = xColumnIndices.Length
        Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
        Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
        Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
            Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
            Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)
            Dim row(p - 1) As Double

            If valid Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, xColumnIndices(j)))
                    If Not xij.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    row(j) = xij.Value
                Next
            End If

            Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
            If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                    valid = False
                Else
                    vi = parsedVisit.Value
                End If
            End If

            If valid Then
                yList.Add(yi.Value)
                xRows.Add(row)
                subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
            Else
                droppedRows += 1
            End If
        Next

        If yList.Count = 0 Then
            errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, subject, or visit values."
            Return False
        End If

        yValues = yList.ToArray()
        subjectValues = subjectList.ToArray()
        ReDim xValues(yList.Count - 1, p - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
            Next
        Next

        If visitSupplied Then visitValues = visitList.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ResponseColumnsMatchObjects(countData(,) As Object, zeroData(,) As Object, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            If countData Is Nothing OrElse zeroData Is Nothing Then Return False
        If countData.GetLength(0) <> zeroData.GetLength(0) Then Return False
            
        For i As Integer = 0 To countData.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim yc As Double? = readNumber(countData(i, 0))
            Dim yz As Double? = readNumber(zeroData(i, 0))
            If Not yc.HasValue OrElse Not yz.HasValue Then Return False
            If Math.Abs(yc.Value - yz.Value) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
        Next

        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryExtractNonnegativeIntegerResponseObjects(data(,) As Object, ByRef response() As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?)) As Boolean
            response = Nothing
        If data Is Nothing Then Return False
        Dim n As Integer = data.GetLength(0)
        If n < 1 Then Return False
            
        ReDim response(n - 1)
        For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
            Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(data(i, 0))
            If Not yi.HasValue Then Return False
            Dim yr As Double = Math.Round(yi.Value)
            If yi.Value < 0.0R OrElse Math.Abs(yi.Value - yr) > 0.0000001R Then Return False
            response(i) = CInt(yr)
        Next
            
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function PrepareKaplanMeierRecords(tArr(,) As Object, sArr(,) As Object, gArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord), readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim map As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        Dim nextId As Integer = 0
        Dim out As New List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To tArr.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim tVal As Double
            Dim sVal As Integer

            If Not readFinite(tArr(i, 0), tVal) Then Continue For
            If tVal < 0.0R Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(sArr(i, 0), sVal) Then Continue For

            Dim gKey As String = "All"
            If hasGroup Then
                gKey = readText(gArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gKey) Then Continue For
                gKey = gKey.Trim()
            End If

            Dim gid As Integer
            If Not map.TryGetValue(gKey, gid) Then
                gid = nextId
                map(gKey) = gid
                nextId += 1
            End If

            out.Add(New survival.SurvivalRecord With {
                    .Time = tVal,
                    .Censorship = sVal,
                    .Group = gid,
                    .strGroup = gKey,
                    .Stratum = "",
                    .strStratum = ""
                })
        Next

        records = out
        Return records.Count > 0
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalMedianCi(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, alpha As Double, ByRef outTable(,) As Object, unavailable As Object, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For
            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            Dim g As String = "ALL"
            If hasGroup Then
                g = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                g = g.Trim()
            End If

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g)
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim stratAll() As String = Enumerable.Repeat("ALL", tList.Count).ToArray()
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratAll, err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then Return False

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        Dim mci As Object(,) = lr.BrookmeyerCrowleyMedianSurvivalCI(alpha)
        If mci Is Nothing OrElse mci.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Return False

        Dim groupIds = gList.Distinct().ToList()
        Dim k As Integer = mci.GetLength(0)
        Dim out As Object(,) = New Object(k - 1, 3) {}

        For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
            Dim med As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 0), Double)
            Dim ll As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 1), Double)
            Dim ul As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 2), Double)

            out(j, 0) = groupIds(j)
            out(j, 1) = If(Double.IsNaN(med) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(med), unavailable, CType(med, Object))
            out(j, 2) = If(Double.IsNaN(ll) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ll), unavailable, CType(ll, Object))
            out(j, 3) = If(Double.IsNaN(ul) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ul), unavailable, CType(ul, Object))
        Next

        outTable = out
        Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalLogRank(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, strataArr(,) As Object, hasStrata As Boolean, weightMethod As String, ByRef result As TestResult, ByRef errText As String, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
        Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer
            Dim st As String = "ALL"

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

            Dim g As String = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For

            If hasStrata Then
                st = readText(strataArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(st) Then st = "ALL"
            End If

            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g.Trim())
            stratList.Add(st.Trim())
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False
        If gList.Distinct().Count() < 2 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then
            errText = err
            Return False
        End If

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        result = lr.WeightedLogRankTest(weightMethod)
        Return result IsNot Nothing
        End Function

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "gehan-breslow") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "gehan") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "breslow") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "wilcoxon") Then

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "peto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "peto-peto") Then

            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modified peto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modifiedpeto") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "anderson") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(key, "modpeto") Then

        Public Shared Function MapMmrmNamesByLetter(suppliedNames() As String, suppliedLetters() As String, selectedAbsoluteLetters() As String, inferred() As String, selectedCount As Integer) As String()

                        If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(letter, String.Empty) Then Continue For
                        If Not byLetter.ContainsKey(letter) Then byLetter(letter) = If(suppliedNames(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                    Next

                    Dim mapped(selectedCount - 1) As String

                    For j As Integer = 0 To selectedCount - 1

                        Dim mappedName As String = Nothing
                        If Not LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(selectedLetter, String.Empty) AndAlso byLetter.TryGetValue(selectedLetter, mappedName) Then

                            anyMapped = True
                        Else

                        End If
                    Next

Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalMedianCi(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, hasGroup As Boolean, alpha As Double, ByRef outTable(,) As Object, unavailable As Object, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For
            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            Dim g As String = "ALL"
            If hasGroup Then
                g = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                g = g.Trim()
            End If

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g)

        Dim stratAll() As String = Enumerable.Repeat("ALL", tList.Count).ToArray()
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratAll, err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then Return False

        If mci Is Nothing OrElse mci.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Return False

        Dim k As Integer = mci.GetLength(0)
        Dim out As Object(,) = New Object(k - 1, 3) {}

        For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1

            Dim ll As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 1), Double)
            Dim ul As Double = DirectCast(mci(j, 2), Double)

            out(j, 0) = groupIds(j)
            out(j, 1) = If(Double.IsNaN(med) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(med), unavailable, CType(med, Object))
            out(j, 2) = If(Double.IsNaN(ll) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ll), unavailable, CType(ll, Object))
            out(j, 3) = If(Double.IsNaN(ul) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(ul), unavailable, CType(ul, Object))
        Next

        outTable = out
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function ComputeSurvivalLogRank(nRows As Integer, timeArr(,) As Object, statusArr(,) As Object, groupArr(,) As Object, strataArr(,) As Object, hasStrata As Boolean, weightMethod As String, ByRef result As TestResult, ByRef errText As String, readFinite As UdfReadFiniteDouble38, readStatus As UdfReadStatusInteger38, readText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Boolean
        Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
        Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
        Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

        For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
            Dim t As Double
            Dim s As Integer
            Dim st As String = "ALL"

            If Not readFinite(timeArr(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
            If Not readStatus(statusArr(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

            Dim g As String = readText(groupArr(i, 0))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For

            If hasStrata Then
                st = readText(strataArr(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(st) Then st = "ALL"
            End If

            If t < 0.0R Then Return False

            tList.Add(t)
            sList.Add(s)
            gList.Add(g.Trim())
            stratList.Add(st.Trim())
        Next

        If tList.Count < 3 Then Return False
        If gList.Distinct().Count() < 2 Then Return False

        Dim err As String = Nothing
        Dim recs = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
        If recs Is Nothing Then
            errText = err
            Return False
        End If

        Dim lr As New survival.Survival_KM_LR(recs)
        result = lr.WeightedLogRankTest(weightMethod)
        Return result IsNot Nothing
        End Function

Namespace ExcelCommon

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Marker base class for host-neutral analysis inputs consumed by the shared Excel
    ''' application layer. Concrete analyses can introduce strongly typed input contracts
    ''' without coupling the application dispatcher to Office.js, Excel-DNA, COM, or UI code.
    ''' </summary>
    Public MustInherit Class SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Portable representation of the small set of primitive spreadsheet values used by
    ''' BESHStatNG analysis-input adapters. Host adapters translate Excel/Office.js/COM cells
    ''' into this type before any analysis-specific validation occurs.
    ''' </summary>
    Public Enum SpreadsheetCellKind
        Blank = 0
        Number = 1
        Text = 2
        Bool = 3
        CellError = 4
    End Enum

    Public Class SpreadsheetCellValue

        Public Sub New()
            Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank
            TextValue = String.Empty
            NumberFormat = String.Empty
        End Sub

        Public Property Kind As SpreadsheetCellKind
        Public Property NumberValue As Double
        Public Property TextValue As String
        Public Property BooleanValue As Boolean
        ' Optional Excel number-format hint; this is never sufficient by itself to treat a numeric cell as a date.
        Public Property NumberFormat As String
        ''' <summary>Optional native host error identity, independent of Excel error text.</summary>
        Public Property NativeErrorCode As String = String.Empty

        Public Shared Function BlankCell() As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NumberCell(value As Double) As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue With {
                .Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Number,
                .NumberValue = value
            }
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TextCell(value As String) As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue With {
                .Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Text,
                .TextValue = If(value, String.Empty)
            }
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BooleanCell(value As Boolean) As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue With {
                .Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool,
                .BooleanValue = value
            }
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ErrorCell(value As String) As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return ErrorCell(value, Nothing)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ErrorCell(value As String, nativeErrorCode As String) As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue With {
                .Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError,
                .TextValue = If(value, String.Empty),
                .NativeErrorCode = If(nativeErrorCode, String.Empty)
            }
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Host-neutral rectangular worksheet selection. Rows are zero-based in memory, while
    ''' RowCount/ColumnCount describe the original host range.
    ''' </summary>
    Public Class SpreadsheetRangeData
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput

        Public Sub New()
            WorksheetName = String.Empty
            Address = String.Empty
            WorkbookId = String.Empty
            WorkbookName = String.Empty
            WorksheetId = String.Empty
            Rows = New List(Of List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue))()
            DateSystem = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Unknown
            AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1
        End Sub

        Public Property WorksheetName As String
        Public Property Address As String
        ' Source identity is optional for older Stage 3.04 payloads.
        Public Property WorkbookId As String
        Public Property WorkbookName As String
        Public Property WorksheetId As String
        ' Unknown means the host has not verified this workbook setting.
        Public Property DateSystem As SpreadsheetDateSystem
        ''' <summary>
        ''' Non-Excel hosts may explicitly specify the midnight origin for serial day values.
        ''' Nothing means unknown. Do not use with a known Excel DateSystem.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Property DateSerialOrigin As Nullable(Of DateTime)
        Public Property AddressDialect As SpreadsheetAddressDialect
        Public Property SelectionId As String
        Public Property SelectionRevision As String
        ' One-based worksheet coordinates; zero means legacy/unknown.
        Public Property StartRow As Integer
        Public Property StartColumn As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property QualifiedAddress As String
            Get
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Address) Then Return String.Empty
                If AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative Then Return If(Address, String.Empty)
                If AddressDialect <> SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1 Then Return String.Empty
                Return SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(Address, WorksheetName).QualifiedAddress
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function ToReference() As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Dim reference As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Select Case AddressDialect
                Case SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1
                    reference = SpreadsheetRangeReference.FromAddress(Address, WorksheetName, WorkbookName)
                Case SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative
                    reference = SpreadsheetRangeReference.FromCoordinates(WorksheetName, StartRow, StartColumn,
                                                                         RowCount, ColumnCount, Address)
                    reference.WorkbookName = If(WorkbookName, String.Empty)
                Case Else
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Unknown source address dialect.", NameOf(AddressDialect))
            End Select
            reference.WorkbookId = If(WorkbookId, String.Empty)
            reference.WorksheetId = If(WorksheetId, String.Empty)
            reference.SelectionId = If(SelectionId, String.Empty)
            reference.SelectionRevision = If(SelectionRevision, String.Empty)
            If StartRow > 0 Then reference.StartRow = StartRow
            If StartColumn > 0 Then reference.StartColumn = StartColumn
            Return reference
        End Function
        Public Property RowCount As Integer
        Public Property ColumnCount As Integer
        Public Property Rows As List(Of List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue))
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Identifies how a host-supplied display address is interpreted. ExcelA1 is the
    ''' legacy/default contract; HostNative addresses are never parsed as Excel A1.
    ''' </summary>
    Public Enum SpreadsheetAddressDialect
        Unknown = 0
        ExcelA1 = 1
        HostNative = 2
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>A bounded, rectangular Excel A1 address. No host objects or I/O.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetRangeAddress
        Public Const ExcelMaxRows As Integer = 1048576
        Public Const ExcelMaxColumns As Integer = 16384
        Private Shared ReadOnly CellPattern As New Regex("^\$?([A-Za-z]{1,3})\$?([1-9][0-9]{0,6})$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Property WorkbookName As String = String.Empty
        Public Property WorksheetName As String = String.Empty
        Public Property Address As String = String.Empty
        Public Property StartRow As Integer
        Public Property StartColumn As Integer
        Public Property EndRow As Integer
        Public Property EndColumn As Integer

        Public ReadOnly Property RowCount As Integer
            Get
                Return EndRow - StartRow + 1
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property ColumnCount As Integer
            Get
                Return EndColumn - StartColumn + 1
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property QualifiedAddress As String
            Get
                If WorksheetName.Length = 0 Then Return Address
                Dim qualifier As String = If(WorkbookName.Length = 0, WorksheetName, "[" & WorkbookName & "]" & WorksheetName)
                Return "'" & qualifier.Replace("'", "''") & "'!" & Address
            End Get
        End Property

        Public Shared Function Parse(text As String, Optional defaultWorksheetName As String = Nothing) As SpreadsheetRangeAddress
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) Then Throw New ArgumentException("An A1 range address is required.", NameOf(text))
            Dim expression As String = text.Trim()
            Dim bang As Integer = -1
            Dim inQuotes As Boolean = False
            Dim i As Integer = 0
            While i < expression.Length
                Dim ch As Char = expression(i)
                If ch = "'"c Then
                    If inQuotes AndAlso i + 1 < expression.Length AndAlso expression(i + 1) = "'"c Then
                        i += 1
                    Else
                        inQuotes = Not inQuotes
                    End If
                ElseIf ch = "!"c AndAlso Not inQuotes Then
                    If bang >= 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Only one worksheet qualifier is supported.", NameOf(text))
                    bang = i
                End If
                i += 1
            End While
            If inQuotes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unclosed quoted worksheet name.", NameOf(text))

            Dim sheet As String = If(defaultWorksheetName, String.Empty).Trim()
            Dim book As String = String.Empty
            If bang >= 0 Then
                Dim qualifier As String = expression.Substring(0, bang)
                If qualifier.StartsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso qualifier.EndsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso qualifier.Length >= 2 Then
                    qualifier = qualifier.Substring(1, qualifier.Length - 2).Replace("''", "'")
                ElseIf qualifier.IndexOf("'"c) >= 0 Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid worksheet quoting.", NameOf(text))
                End If
                If qualifier.StartsWith("[", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                    Dim closing As Integer = qualifier.IndexOf("]"c)
                    If closing < 2 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid workbook qualifier.", NameOf(text))
                    book = qualifier.Substring(1, closing - 1)
                    qualifier = qualifier.Substring(closing + 1)
                End If
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(qualifier) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Worksheet name is missing.", NameOf(text))
                If sheet.Length > 0 AndAlso Not String.Equals(sheet, qualifier, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Worksheet name conflicts with the qualified address.", NameOf(text))
                End If
                sheet = qualifier
                expression = expression.Substring(bang + 1)
            End If
            If expression.IndexOfAny(New Char() {","c, ";"c, "!"c}) >= 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Disjoint or multi-sheet A1 addresses are not supported; use SpreadsheetRangeSelection.", NameOf(text))
            End If
            Dim pieces As String() = expression.Split(":"c)
            If pieces.Length < 1 OrElse pieces.Length > 2 Then Throw New ArgumentException("A single rectangular A1 address is required.", NameOf(text))
            Dim row1 As Integer, col1 As Integer, row2 As Integer, col2 As Integer
            ParseCell(pieces(0), row1, col1)
            If pieces.Length = 2 Then
                ParseCell(pieces(1), row2, col2)
            Else
                row2 = row1 : col2 = col1
            End If
            If row2 < row1 OrElse col2 < col1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("The A1 range end precedes its start.", NameOf(text))
            Return New SpreadsheetRangeAddress With {
                .WorkbookName = book, .WorksheetName = sheet,
                .Address = ToColumn(col1) & row1.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & ":" & ToColumn(col2) & row2.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                .StartRow = row1, .StartColumn = col1, .EndRow = row2, .EndColumn = col2
            }
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ParseCell(text As String, ByRef row As Integer, ByRef column As Integer)
            Dim match As Match = CellPattern.Match(text)
            If Not match.Success Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid A1 cell address: " & text)
            column = 0
            For Each c As Char In match.Groups(1).Value.ToUpperInvariant()
                column = column * 26 + (Convert.ToInt32(c) - 64)
            Next
            If column > ExcelMaxColumns OrElse Not Integer.TryParse(match.Groups(2).Value, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, row) OrElse row > ExcelMaxRows Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(text), "The address exceeds Excel worksheet boundaries.")
            End If
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>Format a known Excel column without querying active host state.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ColumnLetters(index As Integer) As String
            If index < 1 OrElse index > ExcelMaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(index))
            Return ToColumn(index)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ToColumn(index As Integer) As String
            Dim chars As String = String.Empty
            While index > 0
                index -= 1
                chars = Convert.ToChar(65 + (index Mod 26)).ToString() & chars
                index \= 26
            End While
            Return chars
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Selection intent and source identity. IDs are host-supplied; blank means unknown.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetRangeReference
        Public Sub New()
            WorkbookId = String.Empty
            WorkbookName = String.Empty
            WorksheetId = String.Empty
            WorksheetName = String.Empty
            Address = String.Empty
        End Sub

        Public Property WorkbookId As String
        Public Property WorkbookName As String
        Public Property WorksheetId As String
        Public Property WorksheetName As String
        ''' <summary>Unqualified rectangular A1 address. Use QualifiedAddress for display.</summary>
        Public Property Address As String
        ''' <summary>Legacy references use Excel A1; other hosts must explicitly declare HostNative.</summary>
        Public Property AddressDialect As SpreadsheetAddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1
        Public Property StartRow As Integer
        Public Property StartColumn As Integer
        Public Property RowCount As Integer
        Public Property ColumnCount As Integer
        Public Property SelectionId As String
        Public Property SelectionRevision As String

        Public ReadOnly Property QualifiedAddress As String
            Get
                If AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative Then Return If(Address, String.Empty)
                If AddressDialect <> SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1 Then Return String.Empty
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Address) Then Return String.Empty
                Dim parsed As SpreadsheetRangeAddress = SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(Address, WorksheetName)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkbookName) Then Return parsed.QualifiedAddress
                Return "'[" & WorkbookName.Replace("'", "''") & "]" & WorksheetName.Replace("'", "''") & "'!" & parsed.Address
            End Get
        End Property

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Constructs a coordinate-based host-native reference. Coordinates are one-based;
        ''' displayAddress is opaque and must not be evaluated as a formula or parsed as A1.
        ''' The acquiring host must validate its own address dialect and grid bounds.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromCoordinates(worksheetName As String, startRow As Integer, startColumn As Integer,
                                               rowCount As Integer, columnCount As Integer,
                                               Optional displayAddress As String = Nothing) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(worksheetName) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Worksheet name is required.", NameOf(worksheetName))
            If startRow < 1 OrElse startColumn < 1 OrElse rowCount < 1 OrElse columnCount < 1 OrElse
               CLng(startRow) + CLng(rowCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue OrElse
               CLng(startColumn) + CLng(columnCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(startRow), "Source coordinates must describe a positive, representable rectangle.")
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetRangeReference With {
                .WorksheetName = worksheetName, .AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative,
                .Address = If(displayAddress, String.Empty), .StartRow = startRow, .StartColumn = startColumn,
                .RowCount = rowCount, .ColumnCount = columnCount
            }
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Interprets separate task-pane worksheet/address fields. The worksheet field normally
        ''' contains a sheet name; a full qualified A1 reference pasted there is also accepted.
        ''' Conflicting duplicate addresses fail before any host lookup.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromUserInput(worksheetNameOrAddress As String,
                                             address As String) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Dim sheetInput As String = If(worksheetNameOrAddress, String.Empty).Trim()
            Dim rangeInput As String = If(address, String.Empty).Trim()

            Dim bang As Integer = sheetInput.LastIndexOf("!"c)
            Dim hasQualifiedAddress As Boolean = bang >= 0 AndAlso bang < sheetInput.Length - 1 AndAlso
                Regex.IsMatch(sheetInput.Substring(bang + 1), "^\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?[1-9][0-9]{0,6}(?::\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?[1-9][0-9]{0,6})?$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)
            If hasQualifiedAddress Then
                Dim qualified As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(sheetInput)
                If rangeInput.Length > 0 Then
                    Dim repeated As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(rangeInput, qualified.WorksheetName, qualified.WorkbookName)
                    If Not String.Equals(qualified.Address, repeated.Address, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("The range in the worksheet field conflicts with the A1 address field.", NameOf(address))
                    End If
                End If
                Return qualified
            End If

            If rangeInput.Length = 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("An A1 address is required when a worksheet is specified.", NameOf(address))
            End If

            If sheetInput.StartsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse sheetInput.EndsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                If sheetInput.Length < 2 OrElse Not sheetInput.StartsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                   Not sheetInput.EndsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid worksheet-name quoting.", NameOf(worksheetNameOrAddress))
                End If
                sheetInput = sheetInput.Substring(1, sheetInput.Length - 2).Replace("''", "'")
            End If

            Dim result As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(rangeInput, sheetInput)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.WorksheetName) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Specify a worksheet name for the addressed range.", NameOf(worksheetNameOrAddress))
            End If
            Return result
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromAddress(address As String, Optional worksheetName As String = Nothing,
                                           Optional workbookName As String = Nothing) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Dim parsed As SpreadsheetRangeAddress = SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(address, worksheetName)
            If parsed.WorkbookName.Length > 0 AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(workbookName) AndAlso
               Not String.Equals(parsed.WorkbookName, workbookName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Workbook name conflicts with the qualified address.", NameOf(workbookName))
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetRangeReference With {
                .WorkbookName = If(parsed.WorkbookName.Length > 0, parsed.WorkbookName, If(workbookName, String.Empty)),
                .WorksheetName = parsed.WorksheetName, .Address = parsed.Address,
                .StartRow = parsed.StartRow, .StartColumn = parsed.StartColumn,
                .RowCount = parsed.RowCount, .ColumnCount = parsed.ColumnCount
            }
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Ordered selection of ranges; ranges can be on different worksheets.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetRangeSelection
        Public Sub New()
            Ranges = New List(Of SpreadsheetRangeReference)()
        End Sub
        Public Property Ranges As List(Of SpreadsheetRangeReference)
        Public Property SelectionId As String
        Public Sub Validate()
            If Ranges Is Nothing OrElse Ranges.Count = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("At least one range must be selected.")
            For Each reference As SpreadsheetRangeReference In Ranges
                If reference Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reference.WorksheetName) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Every range must identify a worksheet.")
                End If
                Select Case reference.AddressDialect
                    Case SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1
                        Dim parsed As SpreadsheetRangeAddress = SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(reference.Address, reference.WorksheetName)
                        If parsed.RowCount < 1 OrElse parsed.ColumnCount < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Range dimensions must be positive.")
                    Case SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative
                        If reference.StartRow < 1 OrElse reference.StartColumn < 1 OrElse
                           reference.RowCount < 1 OrElse reference.ColumnCount < 1 OrElse
                           CLng(reference.StartRow) + CLng(reference.RowCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue OrElse
                           CLng(reference.StartColumn) + CLng(reference.ColumnCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Host-native ranges require positive, representable coordinates.")
                        End If
                    Case Else
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Unknown range address dialect.")
                End Select
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

            Dim chars As String = String.Empty

        Public Sub New()
            WorkbookId = String.Empty
            WorkbookName = String.Empty
            WorksheetId = String.Empty

        ''' <summary>Unqualified rectangular A1 address. Use QualifiedAddress for display.</summary>
        Public Property Address As String
        ''' <summary>Legacy references use Excel A1; other hosts must explicitly declare HostNative.</summary>
        Public Property AddressDialect As SpreadsheetAddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1
        Public Property StartRow As Integer
        Public Property StartColumn As Integer

        Public Property ColumnCount As Integer

        Public ReadOnly Property QualifiedAddress As String
            Get
                If AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative Then Return If(Address, String.Empty)
                If AddressDialect <> SpreadsheetAddressDialect.ExcelA1 Then Return String.Empty
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Address) Then Return String.Empty
                Dim parsed As SpreadsheetRangeAddress = SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(Address, WorksheetName)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkbookName) Then Return parsed.QualifiedAddress
                Return "'[" & WorkbookName.Replace("'", "''") & "]" & WorksheetName.Replace("'", "''") & "'!" & parsed.Address
            End Get
        End Property

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Constructs a coordinate-based host-native reference. Coordinates are one-based;
        ''' displayAddress is opaque and must not be evaluated as a formula or parsed as A1.
        ''' The acquiring host must validate its own address dialect and grid bounds.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromCoordinates(worksheetName As String, startRow As Integer, startColumn As Integer,
                                               rowCount As Integer, columnCount As Integer,
                                               Optional displayAddress As String = Nothing) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(worksheetName) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Worksheet name is required.", NameOf(worksheetName))
            If startRow < 1 OrElse startColumn < 1 OrElse rowCount < 1 OrElse columnCount < 1 OrElse
               CLng(startRow) + CLng(rowCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue OrElse
               CLng(startColumn) + CLng(columnCount) - 1 > Integer.MaxValue Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(startRow), "Source coordinates must describe a positive, representable rectangle.")
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetRangeReference With {
                .WorksheetName = worksheetName, .AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.HostNative,
                .Address = If(displayAddress, String.Empty), .StartRow = startRow, .StartColumn = startColumn,
                .RowCount = rowCount, .ColumnCount = columnCount
            }
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Interprets separate task-pane worksheet/address fields. The worksheet field normally
        ''' contains a sheet name; a full qualified A1 reference pasted there is also accepted.
        ''' Conflicting duplicate addresses fail before any host lookup.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromUserInput(worksheetNameOrAddress As String,
                                             address As String) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Dim sheetInput As String = If(worksheetNameOrAddress, String.Empty).Trim()
            Dim rangeInput As String = If(address, String.Empty).Trim()

            Dim bang As Integer = sheetInput.LastIndexOf("!"c)
            Dim hasQualifiedAddress As Boolean = bang >= 0 AndAlso bang < sheetInput.Length - 1 AndAlso
                Regex.IsMatch(sheetInput.Substring(bang + 1), "^\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?[1-9][0-9]{0,6}(?::\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?[1-9][0-9]{0,6})?$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)
            If hasQualifiedAddress Then
                Dim qualified As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(sheetInput)
                If rangeInput.Length > 0 Then
                    Dim repeated As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(rangeInput, qualified.WorksheetName, qualified.WorkbookName)
                    If Not String.Equals(qualified.Address, repeated.Address, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("The range in the worksheet field conflicts with the A1 address field.", NameOf(address))
                    End If
                End If
                Return qualified
            End If

            If rangeInput.Length = 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("An A1 address is required when a worksheet is specified.", NameOf(address))
            End If

            If sheetInput.StartsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse sheetInput.EndsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                If sheetInput.Length < 2 OrElse Not sheetInput.StartsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                   Not sheetInput.EndsWith("'", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid worksheet-name quoting.", NameOf(worksheetNameOrAddress))
                End If
                sheetInput = sheetInput.Substring(1, sheetInput.Length - 2).Replace("''", "'")
            End If

            Dim result As SpreadsheetRangeReference = FromAddress(rangeInput, sheetInput)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.WorksheetName) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Specify a worksheet name for the addressed range.", NameOf(worksheetNameOrAddress))
            End If
            Return result
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromAddress(address As String, Optional worksheetName As String = Nothing,
                                           Optional workbookName As String = Nothing) As SpreadsheetRangeReference
            Dim parsed As SpreadsheetRangeAddress = SpreadsheetRangeAddress.Parse(address, worksheetName)
            If parsed.WorkbookName.Length > 0 AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(workbookName) AndAlso
               Not String.Equals(parsed.WorkbookName, workbookName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Workbook name conflicts with the qualified address.", NameOf(workbookName))
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetRangeReference With {
                .WorkbookName = If(parsed.WorkbookName.Length > 0, parsed.WorkbookName, If(workbookName, String.Empty)),
                .WorksheetName = parsed.WorksheetName, .Address = parsed.Address,
                .StartRow = parsed.StartRow, .StartColumn = parsed.StartColumn,
                .RowCount = parsed.RowCount, .ColumnCount = parsed.ColumnCount
            }
        End Function

    Public Enum DocumentInvalidationReason
        None = 0
        Unverifiable
        WorkbookClosed
        DocumentChanged
        ActiveDocumentSwitched
        WorksheetRemoved
        WorksheetRenamed
        WorksheetReplaced
        SelectionChanged

    Public Enum DocumentLifecycleStatus
        VerifiedEqual = 0
        Unavailable
        Stale
        Disposed
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>Bounded metadata only. Empty identity/revision means unverified, never equal.
    ''' ContextIdentity is proof of a host session object, NOT a physical workbook ID.
    ''' A host with no workbook ID may instead prove continuity of that same context.
    ''' Coordinates are an immutable rectangle; names are display/name-addressing metadata.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class DocumentLifecycleSnapshot
        Public Sub New(workbookIdentity As String, worksheetIdentity As String, worksheetName As String,
                       Optional bounds As OutputRectangle = Nothing, Optional selectionRevision As String = Nothing,
                       Optional contextIdentity As String = Nothing, Optional available As Boolean = True)
            Me.WorkbookIdentity = Bounded(workbookIdentity, 1024)
            Me.ContextIdentity = Bounded(contextIdentity, 1024)
            Me.WorksheetIdentity = Bounded(worksheetIdentity, 1024)
            Me.WorksheetName = Bounded(worksheetName, 256)
            Me.SelectionRevision = Bounded(selectionRevision, 256)
            Me.Bounds = bounds
            Me.Available = available
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Bounded(value As String, limit As Integer) As String
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return String.Empty
            If value.Length > limit Then Throw New ArgumentException("Lifecycle metadata exceeds its limit.")
            For Each character In value
                If Char.IsControl(character) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid lifecycle metadata.")
            Next
            Return value
        End Function
        Public ReadOnly Property WorkbookIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property ContextIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetName As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Bounds As OutputRectangle
        Public ReadOnly Property SelectionRevision As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Available As Boolean
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class DocumentLifecycleException
        Inherits InvalidOperationException
        Public Sub New(reason As DocumentInvalidationReason)
            MyBase.New("The bound document or selection is unavailable or changed. Refresh the source and destination, then retry.")
            Me.Reason = reason
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Reason As DocumentInvalidationReason
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Operation-owned lease, not an execution state machine. Hosts supply fresh
    ''' observations at checkpoints. No event registry, worksheet values or host references.
    ''' Pinned references ignore selection changes; volatile inputs stop requiring selection
    ''' continuity only after their immutable input has been copied. Target leases are separate.
    ''' Invalidation is sticky; disposal is idempotent and late invalidations are ignored.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class DocumentLifecycleLease
        Implements IDisposable
        Private ReadOnly _gate As New Object()
        Private ReadOnly _selectionBound As Boolean
        Private ReadOnly _nameAddressed As Boolean
        Private ReadOnly _requiresWorksheet As Boolean
        Private _copied As Boolean
        Private _disposed As Boolean
        Private _reason As DocumentInvalidationReason
        Public Sub New(binding As DocumentLifecycleSnapshot, Optional selectionBound As Boolean = False,
                       Optional nameAddressed As Boolean = True, Optional requiresWorksheet As Boolean = True)
            If binding Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(binding))
            Me.Binding = binding
            _selectionBound = selectionBound : _nameAddressed = nameAddressed : _requiresWorksheet = requiresWorksheet
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Binding As DocumentLifecycleSnapshot
        Public ReadOnly Property Reason As DocumentInvalidationReason
            Get
                SyncLock _gate
                    Return If(_disposed, DocumentInvalidationReason.ContextDisposed, _reason)
                End SyncLock
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function Invalidate(reason As DocumentInvalidationReason) As Boolean
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(DocumentInvalidationReason), reason) OrElse reason = DocumentInvalidationReason.None Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(reason))
            End If
            SyncLock _gate
                If _disposed OrElse _reason <> DocumentInvalidationReason.None Then Return False
                If reason = DocumentInvalidationReason.SelectionChanged AndAlso (Not _selectionBound OrElse _copied) Then Return False
                If reason = DocumentInvalidationReason.ActiveDocumentSwitched AndAlso Not _selectionBound Then Return False
                _reason = reason
                Return True
            End SyncLock
        End Function
        Public Sub MarkInputCopied()
            SyncLock _gate
                If _disposed OrElse _reason <> DocumentInvalidationReason.None Then Throw New DocumentLifecycleException(Reason)
                _copied = True
            End SyncLock
        End Sub
        Public Function Check(current As DocumentLifecycleSnapshot) As DocumentLifecycleStatus
            SyncLock _gate
                If _disposed Then Return DocumentLifecycleStatus.Disposed
                If _reason <> DocumentInvalidationReason.None Then Return DocumentLifecycleStatus.Stale
                If current Is Nothing OrElse Not Binding.Available OrElse Not current.Available OrElse
                    (Binding.WorkbookIdentity.Length = 0 AndAlso Binding.ContextIdentity.Length = 0) OrElse
                    (Binding.WorkbookIdentity.Length > 0 AndAlso current.WorkbookIdentity.Length = 0) OrElse
                    (Binding.WorkbookIdentity.Length = 0 AndAlso current.ContextIdentity.Length = 0) OrElse
                    (_requiresWorksheet AndAlso (Binding.WorksheetIdentity.Length = 0 OrElse current.WorksheetIdentity.Length = 0)) Then
                    _reason = DocumentInvalidationReason.Unverifiable
                    Return DocumentLifecycleStatus.Unavailable
                End If

    ''' <summary>Stable capability keys shared by Office.js, Windows and Common.</summary>
    ''' <remarks>Capability IDs describe an actual host operation, not a statistical algorithm.</remarks>
    Public NotInheritable Class HostCapabilityIds
        Public Const ReadSelectedRange As String = "input.read-selected-range"
        Public Const WriteResultTables As String = "output.write-result-tables"
        Public Const CurrentWorksheet As String = "output.current-worksheet"
        Public Const NewWorksheet As String = "output.new-worksheet"
        Public Const NewWorkbook As String = "output.new-workbook"

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ForDestination(destination As SpreadsheetOutputDestination) As String
            Select Case destination
                Case SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet
                    Return CurrentWorksheet
                Case SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet
                    Return NewWorksheet
                Case SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook
                    Return NewWorkbook
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Serializable host report. A host must advertise only capabilities it implements.</summary>
    ''' <remarks>Transport DTO is mutable for Office.js JSON interop. Preflight never mutates it.</remarks>
    Public NotInheritable Class HostCapabilitySnapshot
        Public Sub New()
            Host = String.Empty
            Platform = String.Empty
            Capabilities = New List(Of String)()
        End Sub

        Public Property Host As String
        Public Property Platform As String
        ''' <summary>Compatibility indicator: True only for an Excel host. Existing JSON payloads retain this field.</summary>
        Public Property IsExcel As Boolean
        ''' <summary>
        ''' Explicit spreadsheet-host declaration. Non-Excel hosts must set this to True;
        ''' pre-01.05A Excel reports continue to work through IsExcel=True.
        ''' This is an admission flag, not an assertion that any operation is available.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Property IsSpreadsheetHost As Boolean
        Public Property Capabilities As List(Of String)

        Friend ReadOnly Property IsUsableSpreadsheetHost As Boolean
            Get
                Return Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Host) AndAlso (IsExcel OrElse IsSpreadsheetHost)
            End Get
        End Property

        Public Function Supports(capabilityId As String) As Boolean
            If Not IsUsableSpreadsheetHost OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(capabilityId) OrElse Capabilities Is Nothing Then Return False
            For Each item As String In Capabilities
                If String.Equals(item, capabilityId, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return True
            Next
            Return False
        End Function
    End Class

            Return New HostCapabilitySnapshot With {

                .Capabilities = New List(Of String) From {

    ''' <summary>

                                      stage As String, Optional timestamp As DateTimeOffset? = Nothing,
                                      Optional metadata As IDictionary(Of String, String) = Nothing) As DiagnosticRecord
            Dim code = Allowed(eventCode, "diagnostic.run.started", "diagnostic.validation.rejected",
                "diagnostic.output.attempted", "diagnostic.output.completed", "diagnostic.output.incomplete",
                "diagnostic.run.failed", "diagnostic.run.ended", "diagnostic.stage.entered",
                "output.sheet-name-adjusted", "diagnostic.host.ready", "diagnostic.host.unavailable",
                "diagnostic.host.retry", "diagnostic.user.cancelled", "diagnostic.output.consent", "diagnostic.analysis.completed",
                "diagnostic.command.invoked", "diagnostic.command.completed", "diagnostic.command.rejected")
            If code = "redacted" Then code = "diagnostic.event.redacted"
            Dim severity = DiagnosticSeverity.Information
            Select Case code
                Case "diagnostic.stage.entered" : severity = DiagnosticSeverity.Debug
                Case "diagnostic.validation.rejected", "diagnostic.output.incomplete", "diagnostic.event.redacted",
                     "output.sheet-name-adjusted", "diagnostic.host.unavailable", "diagnostic.command.rejected"
                    severity = DiagnosticSeverity.Warning
                Case "diagnostic.run.failed" : severity = DiagnosticSeverity.Error
            End Select
            Dim safe As New Dictionary(Of String, String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            If metadata IsNot Nothing Then
                ' At most three lookups/copies, regardless of source size. Never enumerate raw values.
                CopyValue(metadata, safe, "category", {"input", "host", "analysis", "output", "unexpected"})
                CopyValue(metadata, safe, "outcome", {"completed", "rejected", "failed", "cancelled", "incomplete", "ended"})
                CopyValue(metadata, safe, "host", {"windows", "office"})
            End If
            Return New DiagnosticRecord(code, severity, Allowed(operation, AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova, AnalysisIds.KruskalWallis, "office"),
                runId.ToString("N"), Allowed(stage, "invocation", "validation", "acquisition", "analysis", "output"),
                timestamp, New ReadOnlyDictionary(Of String, String)(safe))
        End Function

        Private Sub New(code As String, severity As DiagnosticSeverity, operation As String, runId As String,
                        stage As String, timestamp As DateTimeOffset?, metadata As IReadOnlyDictionary(Of String, String))
            Me.EventCode = code
            Me.Severity = severity
            Me.Operation = operation
            Me.RunId = runId
            Me.Stage = stage
            Me.Timestamp = timestamp
            Me.Metadata = metadata
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub CopyValue(source As IDictionary(Of String, String), target As Dictionary(Of String, String),
                                     key As String, values As String())
            ' Only canonical keys are copied; the source comparer cannot introduce new keys.
            Dim value As String = Nothing
            If source.TryGetValue(key, value) Then target.Add(key, Allowed(value, values))
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function Allowed(value As String, ParamArray values As String()) As String
            If value IsNot Nothing AndAlso value.Length <= 64 Then
                For Each candidate In values
                    If String.Equals(value, candidate, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return candidate
                Next
            End If

        Public Async Function StartAsync(operation As String, traceEnabled As Boolean) As Task(Of DiagnosticRunContext)
            Dim id As Guid

                id = Guid.NewGuid()
            End Try
            If id = Guid.Empty Then id = Guid.NewGuid()

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Explicit per-invocation correlation lifetime, including across awaits. EndAsync in
    ''' the host's Finally. This is an event scope, not execution/progress/cancellation state.
    ''' Hosts emit output.completed only after their existing writer reports completion.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class DiagnosticRunContext
        Private ReadOnly _sink As IDiagnosticSink
        Private ReadOnly _clock As Func(Of DateTimeOffset)
        Private ReadOnly _id As Guid
        Private ReadOnly _operation As String
        Private ReadOnly _trace As Boolean
        Private ReadOnly _gate As New Object()
        Private _ended As Boolean
        Friend Sub New(sink As IDiagnosticSink, clock As Func(Of DateTimeOffset), id As Guid, operation As String, trace As Boolean)
            _sink = sink
            _clock = clock
            _id = id
            _operation = operation
            _trace = trace
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property RunId As String
            Get
                Return _id.ToString("N")
            End Get
        End Property

        Public Async Function ReportAsync(code As String, stage As String,
                                         Optional metadata As IDictionary(Of String, String) = Nothing) As Task(Of DiagnosticDelivery)
            SyncLock _gate
                If _ended Then Return DiagnosticDelivery.Suppressed
                If code = "diagnostic.run.ended" Then _ended = True
            End SyncLock
            Try
                Dim timestamp As DateTimeOffset? = Nothing
                Try
                    timestamp = _clock()
                Catch
                    ' An unavailable clock removes the optional timestamp, not the operation.
                End Try
                Dim record = DiagnosticRecord.Create(code, _operation, _id, stage, timestamp, metadata)
                If record.Severity = DiagnosticSeverity.Debug AndAlso Not _trace Then Return DiagnosticDelivery.Suppressed
                If _sink Is Nothing Then Return DiagnosticDelivery.Unavailable
                Await _sink.EmitAsync(record).ConfigureAwait(False)
                Return DiagnosticDelivery.Delivered
            Catch
                ' Never log the sink's exception, recurse, retry or replace the real failure.
                Return DiagnosticDelivery.Unavailable
            End Try
        End Function

        Public Function EndAsync() As Task(Of DiagnosticDelivery)
            Return ReportAsync("diagnostic.run.ended", "invocation")
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>

    ''' Created/Running -> CancellationRequested -> Cancelled at a checkpoint.

        Private Sub New()

        Public Shared Function ByMethodKey(key As String, host As HostCapabilitySnapshot,
                                           destination As SpreadsheetOutputDestination) As FeatureAvailabilityInfo
            Dim help = HelpDestination.ForMethodKey(key)
            Return Evaluate(help, If(help.Metadata Is Nothing, Nothing, help.Metadata.AnalysisId), host, destination)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ByAnalysisId(id As String, host As HostCapabilitySnapshot,
                                            destination As SpreadsheetOutputDestination) As FeatureAvailabilityInfo
            Return Evaluate(HelpDestination.ForAnalysisId(id), id, host, destination)

        Private Shared Function Evaluate(help As HelpDestination, id As String, host As HostCapabilitySnapshot,
                                         destination As SpreadsheetOutputDestination) As FeatureAvailabilityInfo
            Dim descriptor As IAnalysisDescriptor = Nothing
            Dim registered As Boolean = False
            If AnalysisCatalog.TryGetById(id, descriptor) AndAlso descriptor.Availability = AnalysisAvailability.ImplementedInCommon Then
                ' Require real typed registrations; Planned is never evidence of execution.
                registered = True
                For Each inputType As Type In descriptor.InputTypes
                    Dim found As Boolean = False
                    For Each handler As IAnalysisHandler In AnalysisHandlerRegistry.All
                        If String.Equals(handler.AnalysisId, id, StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso
                           handler.InputType Is inputType AndAlso handler.OptionsType Is descriptor.OptionsType Then found = True
                    Next
