    ''' <summary>Pure launch policy. Candidates are not claims of page publication.
    ''' Actual per-page verification runs only in the documentation-origin browser resolver.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class HelpLaunchTarget
        Public Const ResolverUrl As String = GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl & "help-resolver/"
#If BESH_HELP_RESOLVER_PUBLISHED Then
        Public Const ResolverPublished As Boolean = True
#Else
        Public Const ResolverPublished As Boolean = False
#End If

        Private Sub New(latest As String, route As String, version As ProductVersionDescriptor, published As Boolean)
            LatestUrl = latest
            HomeUrl = GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl
            Url = latest
            If route Is Nothing OrElse version Is Nothing OrElse Not version.IsAvailable Then Return
            Dim relative = latest.Substring(GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl.Length)
            VersionCandidateUrl = GeneratedMethodMetadata.SiteBaseUrl & "/v" & version.ProductVersion & "/" & relative
            ResolverCandidateUrl = ResolverUrl & "?version=" & version.ProductVersion & "&route=" & route
            UsesResolver = published
            If published Then Url = ResolverCandidateUrl
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Url As String
        Public ReadOnly Property LatestUrl As String
        Public ReadOnly Property HomeUrl As String
        Public ReadOnly Property VersionCandidateUrl As String
        Public ReadOnly Property ResolverCandidateUrl As String
        Public ReadOnly Property UsesResolver As Boolean

        Public Shared Function Create(destination As HelpDestination, version As ProductVersionDescriptor,
                                      Optional published As Boolean = ResolverPublished) As HelpLaunchTarget
            If destination Is Nothing OrElse destination.IsFallback Then Return New HelpLaunchTarget(GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl, Nothing, version, False)
            Dim key = destination.Metadata.Key
            Dim known = HelpDestination.ForMethodKey(key)
            If known.IsFallback Then known = HelpDestination.ForPageKey(key)
            If known.IsFallback Then Return New HelpLaunchTarget(GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl, Nothing, version, False)
            Return New HelpLaunchTarget(known.Url, key, version, published)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function CreateHome(version As ProductVersionDescriptor,
                                          Optional published As Boolean = ResolverPublished) As HelpLaunchTarget
            Return New HelpLaunchTarget(GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl, "Home", version, published)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Exact allowlist, including strictly canonical resolver queries only after activation.
        ''' Never accepts arbitrary HTTPS links, raw version URLs or caller-provided path/domain data.</summary>
        Public Shared Function SafeOpenUrl(value As String, Optional published As Boolean = ResolverPublished) As String
            If String.Equals(value, GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            For Each metadata In GeneratedMethodMetadata.All
                If String.Equals(value, metadata.HelpUrl, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            Next
            For Each page In GeneratedMethodMetadata.Pages
                If String.Equals(value, page.HelpUrl, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            Next
            Dim prefix = ResolverUrl & "?version="
            If Not published OrElse value Is Nothing OrElse Not value.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl
            Dim parts = value.Substring(prefix.Length).Split(New String() {"&route="}, StringSplitOptions.None)
            If parts.Length <> 2 Then Return GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl
            Dim version As ProductVersionDescriptor = Nothing
            If Not ProductVersionDescriptor.TryParse(parts(0), version) OrElse Not String.Equals(parts(0), version.ProductVersion, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl
            Dim target As HelpLaunchTarget
            If String.Equals(parts(1), "Home", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                target = CreateHome(version, True)
            Else
                Dim destination = HelpDestination.ForMethodKey(parts(1))
                If destination.IsFallback Then destination = HelpDestination.ForPageKey(parts(1))
                target = Create(destination, version, True)
            End If
            If String.Equals(value, target.ResolverCandidateUrl, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            Return GeneratedMethodMetadata.HomeUrl
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' Version-first launch requires an explicitly published resolver; version alone is not deployment evidence.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ProductVersionDescriptor
        Private Sub New(value As Version)
            IsAvailable = value IsNot Nothing
            ProductVersion = If(IsAvailable, value.ToString(4), String.Empty)
            DisplayLabel = If(IsAvailable, "Version " & ProductVersion, "Version unavailable")
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property IsAvailable As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property ProductVersion As String
        Public ReadOnly Property DisplayLabel As String
        Public ReadOnly Property HelpRoutePolicy As String
            Get
                Return If(IsAvailable, "verified-version-first", "latest")
            End Get
        End Property

        Public Shared Function FromVersion(value As Version) As ProductVersionDescriptor
            Dim result As ProductVersionDescriptor = Nothing
            TryParse(If(value Is Nothing, Nothing, value.ToString()), result)
            Return result
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Four ASCII unsigned components, 0..65535; all-zero is unavailable.
        ''' Reject whitespace, signs, revision suffixes and incomplete versions.</summary>
        Public Shared Function TryParse(value As String, ByRef result As ProductVersionDescriptor) As Boolean
            result = New ProductVersionDescriptor(Nothing)
            If String.IsNullOrEmpty(value) Then Return False
            Dim parts As String() = value.Split("."c)
            If parts.Length <> 4 Then Return False
            Dim numbers(3) As Integer
            For i As Integer = 0 To 3
                If parts(i).Length = 0 Then Return False
                For Each ch As Char In parts(i)
                    If ch < "0"c OrElse ch > "9"c Then Return False
                Next
                If Not Integer.TryParse(parts(i), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, numbers(i)) OrElse numbers(i) > 65535 Then Return False
            Next
            If numbers(0) = 0 AndAlso numbers(1) = 0 AndAlso numbers(2) = 0 AndAlso numbers(3) = 0 Then Return False
            result = New ProductVersionDescriptor(New Version(numbers(0), numbers(1), numbers(2), numbers(3)))
            Return True
        End Function

        ''' Reject whitespace, signs, revision suffixes and incomplete versions.</summary>
        Public Shared Function TryParse(value As String, ByRef result As ProductVersionDescriptor) As Boolean
            result = New ProductVersionDescriptor(Nothing)
            If String.IsNullOrEmpty(value) Then Return False
            Dim parts As String() = value.Split("."c)
            If parts.Length <> 4 Then Return False
            Dim numbers(3) As Integer
            For i As Integer = 0 To 3
                If parts(i).Length = 0 Then Return False
                For Each ch As Char In parts(i)
                    If ch < "0"c OrElse ch > "9"c Then Return False
                Next
                If Not Integer.TryParse(parts(i), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, numbers(i)) OrElse numbers(i) > 65535 Then Return False
            Next
            If numbers(0) = 0 AndAlso numbers(1) = 0 AndAlso numbers(2) = 0 AndAlso numbers(3) = 0 Then Return False
            result = New ProductVersionDescriptor(New Version(numbers(0), numbers(1), numbers(2), numbers(3)))
            Return True
        End Function

        ''' session defaults, never an invented migration. Missing fields default separately.
        ''' Core finite alpha / seed and display normalization are the sole policy.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult
            If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})
            If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
            Dim codes As New List(Of String)()
            Dim runtime As New AnalysisDefaultsOptions(data.DefaultAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(0.05),
                data.DefaultRandomSeed.GetValueOrDefault(AnalysisDefaultsOptions.NoExplicitRandomSeed))
            If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.TraceEnabled.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.trace.missing")
            Dim display As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
                display.UseUpperBound = data.PValues.UseUpperBound.GetValueOrDefault(True)
                If Not data.PValues.UseUpperBound.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.upper-bound.missing")
                display.EnsureDefaults()
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If
            Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,
                data.TraceEnabled.GetValueOrDefault(True), display), If(codes.Count = 0, PreferenceStatus.Loaded,
                PreferenceStatus.Normalized), PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, codes)
        End Function

Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult

If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})

If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
Dim codes As New List(Of String)()

If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If

If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If

If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
                display.UseUpperBound = data.PValues.UseUpperBound.GetValueOrDefault(True)
                If Not data.PValues.UseUpperBound.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.upper-bound.missing")
                display.EnsureDefaults()
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If

If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If

If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")

Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,

    ''' <summary>Input preparation only: no fitting, matching, control limits or chart rendering.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AdvancedInputParsers
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ParseMatrix(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetMatrixParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetMatrixInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            Return Finish(Read(input, If(options, New SpreadsheetMatrixParseOptions()), -1, -1, -1,
                               False, False, False, False, Nothing, issues), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseClassification(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetClassificationParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetClassificationInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetClassificationParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetClassificationParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If config.ClassColumnIndex < 0 OrElse config.MinimumClasses < 2 Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "classification.options", "A class column and at least two classes are required.")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetClassificationInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim matrix As SpreadsheetMatrixInput = Read(input, config, config.ClassColumnIndex, -1, -1,
                False, False, False, False, Nothing, issues, config.IgnoreCategoryCase)
            If matrix Is Nothing Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetClassificationInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim levels As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue)()
            Dim seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each row As SpreadsheetAdvancedRow In matrix.Rows
                Dim level As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = row.LabelLevel
                If seen.Add(level.Key) Then levels.Add(level)
            Next
            If levels.Count < config.MinimumClasses Then Add(issues, Nothing, "classification.classes", "Too few distinct class labels among retained rows.")
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetClassificationInput(matrix, levels), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParsePsm(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetPsmParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPsmInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetPsmParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetPsmParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If config.TreatmentColumnIndex < 0 OrElse config.TreatedLevel Is Nothing OrElse config.ControlLevel Is Nothing OrElse
               config.TreatedLevel.Key = config.ControlLevel.Key Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "psm.options", "Distinct explicit treatment and control levels and a treatment column are required.")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPsmInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim matrix As SpreadsheetMatrixInput = Read(input, config, config.TreatmentColumnIndex, -1, -1,
                False, False, False, False, config, issues)
            If matrix Is Nothing Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPsmInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim treated As Integer = 0
            For Each row As SpreadsheetAdvancedRow In matrix.Rows
                If row.IsTreated.Value Then treated += 1
            Next
            If treated = 0 OrElse treated = matrix.RowCount Then Add(issues, Nothing, "psm.arms", "Both treatment arms must occur among complete rows.")
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetPsmInput(matrix, config.TreatedLevel, config.ControlLevel), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseSpc(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetSpcParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetSpcInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetSpcParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetSpcParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            Dim matrix As SpreadsheetMatrixInput = Read(input, config, -1, config.SubgroupColumnIndex, config.OrderColumnIndex,
                True, config.OrderColumnIndex >= 0, config.InterpretOrderAsDate, False, Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, New SpreadsheetSpcInput(matrix)), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseChartSource(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetChartSourceParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetChartSourceInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetChartSourceParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetChartSourceParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            Dim matrix As SpreadsheetMatrixInput = Read(input, config, -1, config.GroupColumnIndex, config.XColumnIndex,
                config.RequireNumericX OrElse config.RequireAscendingX OrElse config.InterpretXAsDate,
                config.RequireAscendingX, config.InterpretXAsDate, True, Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(If(matrix Is Nothing, Nothing, New SpreadsheetChartSourceInput(matrix)), issues)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Read(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetMatrixParseOptions,
                    labelIndex As Integer, groupIndex As Integer, coordinateIndex As Integer,
                    numericCoordinate As Boolean, ascending As Boolean, asDate As Boolean, orderWithinGroups As Boolean,
                    treatment As SpreadsheetPsmParseOptions, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue),
                    Optional ignoreLabelCase As Boolean = False) As SpreadsheetMatrixInput
            If config.CellPolicy Is Nothing OrElse config.MinimumRows < 1 OrElse config.MinimumColumns < 1 OrElse
               (config.Missing <> SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Reject AndAlso config.Missing <> SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip) OrElse
               (config.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required AndAlso config.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None) OrElse
               (asDate AndAlso coordinateIndex < 0) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "advanced.options", "Invalid policies, dimensions or date coordinate role; choose an explicit header mode.")
                Return Nothing
            End If
            Dim parsed As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRectangularDataFrameInput) =
                RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseDataFrame(input, New SpreadsheetDataFrameParseOptions With {.Header = config.Header})
            issues.AddRange(parsed.Validation.Issues)
            If Not parsed.Success Then Return Nothing
            Dim frame As SpreadsheetRectangularDataFrameInput = parsed.Data
            Dim used As New HashSet(Of Integer)()
            For Each index As Integer In New Integer() {labelIndex, groupIndex, coordinateIndex}
                If index < -1 OrElse index >= frame.ColumnCount OrElse (index >= 0 AndAlso Not used.Add(index)) Then
                    Add(issues, Nothing, "advanced.roles", "Roles must be distinct valid selected columns.")
                    Return Nothing
                End If
            Next
            Dim indices As New List(Of Integer)()
            If config.NumericColumnIndices Is Nothing Then
                For c As Integer = 0 To frame.ColumnCount - 1
                    If Not used.Contains(c) Then indices.Add(c)
                Next
            Else
                For Each c As Integer In config.NumericColumnIndices
                    If c < 0 OrElse c >= frame.ColumnCount OrElse Not used.Add(c) Then
                        Add(issues, Nothing, "advanced.roles", "Numeric columns must be unique and cannot overlap role columns.")
                        Return Nothing
                    End If
                    indices.Add(c)
                Next
            End If
            If indices.Count < config.MinimumColumns Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "matrix.columns", "Too few numeric columns.")
                Return Nothing
            End If
            Dim columns As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameColumn)()
            For Each c As Integer In indices
                columns.Add(frame.Columns(c))
            Next
            Dim rows As New List(Of SpreadsheetAdvancedRow)()
            Dim last As New Dictionary(Of String, Double)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For r As Integer = 0 To frame.RowCount - 1
                Dim values As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)()
                Dim missingCell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = Nothing
                Dim invalid As Boolean = False
                For Each c As Integer In indices
                    Dim cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, c)
                    Dim evaluation As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Evaluate(cell, config, issues)
                    If evaluation Is Nothing Then
                        invalid = True
                    ElseIf evaluation.IsMissing Then
                        If missingCell Is Nothing Then missingCell = cell
                    ElseIf Not evaluation.HasNumericValue Then
                        Add(issues, cell, "cell.not-numeric", "A finite numeric measurement is required.")
                        invalid = True
                    Else
                        values.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(evaluation.NumericValue, cell.SelectedRow, cell.SelectedColumn,
                                                                    cell.WorksheetRow, cell.WorksheetColumn))
                    End If
                Next
                Dim label As SpreadsheetFrameCell = Nothing
                Dim group As SpreadsheetFrameCell = Nothing
                Dim coordinate As SpreadsheetFrameCell = Nothing
                Dim coordinateValue As Nullable(Of Double) = Nothing
                Dim coordinateDate As Nullable(Of DateTime) = Nothing
                Dim treated As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing
                Dim labelLevel As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = Nothing
                For Each c As Integer In New Integer() {labelIndex, groupIndex, coordinateIndex}
                    If c < 0 Then Continue For
                    Dim cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, c)
                    Dim evaluation As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Evaluate(cell, config, issues)
                    If evaluation Is Nothing Then
                        invalid = True
                        Continue For
                    ElseIf evaluation.IsMissing Then
                        If missingCell Is Nothing Then missingCell = cell
                        Continue For
                    End If
                    If c = labelIndex Then
                        label = cell
                        labelLevel = New SpreadsheetCategoryValue(cell.ToCellValue(), ignoreLabelCase)
                        If treatment IsNot Nothing Then
                            Dim level As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = labelLevel
                            If level.Key = treatment.TreatedLevel.Key Then
                                treated = True
                            ElseIf level.Key = treatment.ControlLevel.Key Then
                                treated = False
                            Else
                                Add(issues, cell, "psm.treatment", "Treatment must match one of the two declared typed levels.")
                                invalid = True
                            End If
                        End If
                    ElseIf c = groupIndex Then
                        group = cell
                    Else
                        coordinate = cell
                        If numericCoordinate AndAlso Not evaluation.HasNumericValue Then
                            Add(issues, cell, "advanced.coordinate-type", "A finite numeric coordinate is required.")
                            invalid = True
                        ElseIf evaluation.HasNumericValue Then
                            coordinateValue = evaluation.NumericValue
                        End If
                        If asDate AndAlso coordinateValue.HasValue Then
                            Try
                                Dim dateEvaluation As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(
                                    cell.ToCellValue(), config.CellPolicy, input.DateSystem, True, input.DateSerialOrigin)
                                If Not dateEvaluation.HasDateValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("A verified date origin is required.")
                                coordinateDate = dateEvaluation.DateValue
                            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                                Add(issues, cell, "advanced.date", ex.Message)
                                invalid = True
                            End Try
                        End If
                    End If
                Next
                ' Check every role even when another field is missing; invalid data is never silently skipped.
                If invalid Then Continue For
                If missingCell IsNot Nothing Then
                    Add(issues, missingCell, "advanced.missing", "Incomplete source row.", config.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip)
                    Continue For
                End If
                If coordinateIndex < 0 Then coordinateValue = CDbl(values(0).SelectedRow)
                If ascending Then
                    Dim key As String = If(group Is Nothing OrElse Not orderWithinGroups, String.Empty, New SpreadsheetCategoryValue(group.ToCellValue()).Key)
                    Dim previous As Double = 0
                    If last.TryGetValue(key, previous) AndAlso coordinateValue.Value <= previous Then
                        Add(issues, coordinate, "advanced.order", "Coordinates must strictly increase in source order within each group.")
                        Continue For
                    End If
                    last(key) = coordinateValue.Value
                End If
                rows.Add(New SpreadsheetAdvancedRow(values, label, group, coordinate, coordinateValue, coordinateDate, treated, labelLevel))
            Next
            If rows.Count < config.MinimumRows Then Add(issues, Nothing, "matrix.rows", "Too few complete source rows.")
            If config.RequireSquare AndAlso rows.Count <> columns.Count Then Add(issues, Nothing, "matrix.square", "The retained numeric matrix must be square.")
            If New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then Return Nothing
            Return New SpreadsheetMatrixInput(frame, columns, rows, input.DateSerialOrigin)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Evaluate(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, config As SpreadsheetMatrixParseOptions,
                                         issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                Dim evaluation As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell.ToCellValue(), config.CellPolicy)
                If evaluation.IsError AndAlso Not evaluation.IsMissing Then
                    Add(issues, cell, "cell.spreadsheet-error", "Spreadsheet error cannot fill an analysis role; native metadata remains in the source snapshot.")
                    Return Nothing
                End If
                Return evaluation
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "cell.invalid-value", ex.Message)
                Return Nothing
            End Try
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell,
                               code As String, message As String, Optional warning As Boolean = False)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, If(warning, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error]),
                message, code, If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedColumn),
                If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetColumn)))
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function Finish(Of T As SpreadsheetAnalysisInput)(data As T, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of T)
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of T)(If(report.HasErrors, Nothing, data), report)
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

        Private Shared Function Evaluate(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, config As SpreadsheetMatrixParseOptions,

            Dim config As SpreadsheetClassificationParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetClassificationParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()

                Add(issues, Nothing, "classification.options", "A class column and at least two classes are required.")

    ''' <summary>
    ''' An explicit opt-in set of conversion rules. Defaults preserve Stage 3.04 numeric
    ''' input semantics: only Number is numeric, only Blank is missing, errors are rejected.

        Public Function GetNumericCulture() As CultureInfo
            Select Case NumericText
                Case SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy.Invariant
                    Return CultureInfo.InvariantCulture
                Case SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy.ExplicitCulture
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NumericCultureName) Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("An explicit culture name is required.", NameOf(NumericCultureName))
                    End If
                    Return CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(NumericCultureName)
                Case Else
                    Return CultureInfo.InvariantCulture

        Private Sub New()

        Public Shared Function Canonicalize(value As String) As String
            Dim code As String = If(value, String.Empty).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
            Select Case code
                Case "#NULL!", "#DIV/0!", "#VALUE!", "#REF!", "#NAME?", "#NUM!", "#N/A", "#GETTING_DATA", "#SPILL!", "#CALC!", "#FIELD!", "#BLOCKED!", "#CONNECT!", "#BUSY!", "#UNKNOWN!", "#PYTHON!", "#CIRC!"

                Case Else
                    Return String.Empty
            End Select

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Applies canonical interpretation without rewriting the source cell. No implicit
    ''' Boolean/text/date coercion, locale guesswork, or Excel error-string detection.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Evaluate(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue,
                                        Optional options As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = Nothing,
                                        Optional dateSystem As SpreadsheetDateSystem = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Unknown,
                                        Optional interpretNumberAsDate As Boolean = False) As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Return Evaluate(cell, options, dateSystem, interpretNumberAsDate, Nothing)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Evaluate(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue,
                                        options As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                        dateSystem As SpreadsheetDateSystem,
                                        interpretNumberAsDate As Boolean,
                                        dateSerialOrigin As Nullable(Of DateTime)) As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Dim policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions())
            Dim answer As New SpreadsheetCellEvaluation()
            If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank Then
                answer.IsMissing = True
                Return answer
            End If
            Select Case cell.Kind
                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                    answer.IsError = True
                    answer.Error = New SpreadsheetExcelErrorValue(cell.TextValue, cell.NativeErrorCode)
                    answer.IsMissing = policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.TreatAsMissing
                    Return answer

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                    If Double.IsNaN(cell.NumberValue) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(cell.NumberValue) Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Non-finite spreadsheet numbers are not valid input.", NameOf(cell))
                    End If
                    answer.NumericValue = cell.NumberValue
                    answer.HasNumericValue = Not interpretNumberAsDate OrElse policy.AllowDateSerialNumbers
                    If interpretNumberAsDate Then
                        Dim d As DateTime = DateTime.MinValue
                        If dateSerialOrigin.HasValue AndAlso dateSystem <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Unknown Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Specify either an Excel date system or a host date origin, not both.", NameOf(dateSerialOrigin))
                        End If
                        Dim validDate As Boolean = If(dateSerialOrigin.HasValue,
                            SpreadsheetDateSerialConverter.TryToDateTime(cell.NumberValue, dateSerialOrigin.GetValueOrDefault(), d),
                            ExcelDateSerialConverter.TryToDateTime(cell.NumberValue, dateSystem, d))
                        If Not validDate Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid date serial or unverified date origin.", NameOf(cell))
                        End If
                        answer.HasDateValue = True
                        answer.DateValue = d
                    End If

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text
                    Dim value As String = If(cell.TextValue, String.Empty)
                    If policy.MissingText = SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy.BlankOrEmptyText AndAlso value.Length = 0 Then
                        answer.IsMissing = True
                    ElseIf policy.MissingText = SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy.BlankOrWhitespaceText AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then
                        answer.IsMissing = True
                    ElseIf policy.NumericText <> SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy.Reject Then
                        Dim result As Double
                        ' Float allows a leading sign, decimals and exponent; thousands separators are not inferred.
                        If Double.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Float, policy.GetNumericCulture(), result) AndAlso
                            Not Double.IsNaN(result) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(result) Then
                            answer.HasNumericValue = True
                            answer.NumericValue = result
                        End If
                    End If

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                    If policy.AllowBooleanNumbers Then
                        answer.HasNumericValue = True
                        answer.NumericValue = If(cell.BooleanValue, 1.0R, 0.0R)
                    End If

                Case Else
                    Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(cell), "Unknown spreadsheet cell kind.")
            End Select
            Return answer
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ReadNumeric(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue,
                                           Optional options As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = Nothing) As Double
            Dim policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions())
            Dim result As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Evaluate(cell, policy)
            If result.IsError AndAlso policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("A spreadsheet error cell cannot be used as a numeric observation.", NameOf(cell))
            End If
            If Not result.HasNumericValue OrElse result.IsMissing Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("The cell is not a permitted numeric observation.", NameOf(cell))
            End If
            Return result.NumericValue
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Explicit host-origin date conversion: serial units are days from the supplied
    ''' midnight DateTime. No Excel 1900 phantom leap-day convention is applied.
    ''' Host adapters must normalize their serial units before invoking this converter.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetDateSerialConverter
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function TryToDateTime(serial As Double, origin As DateTime, ByRef value As DateTime) As Boolean
            value = DateTime.MinValue
            If Double.IsNaN(serial) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(serial) OrElse origin.TimeOfDay <> TimeSpan.Zero Then Return False
            Try
                value = origin.AddDays(serial)
                Return True
            Catch ex As ArgumentOutOfRangeException
                Return False
            End Try
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Excel date serial conversion with the historical phantom 1900-02-29 rejected.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ExcelDateSerialConverter
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function TryToDateTime(serial As Double, basis As SpreadsheetDateSystem, ByRef value As DateTime) As Boolean
            value = DateTime.MinValue
            If Double.IsNaN(serial) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(serial) OrElse serial < 0.0R Then Return False
            If basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1900 AndAlso basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904 Then Return False
            If basis = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1900 AndAlso serial >= 60.0R AndAlso serial < 61.0R Then Return False
            Dim oaValue As Double = If(basis = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904, serial + 1462.0R,
                                       If(serial < 60.0R, serial + 1.0R, serial))
            Try
                value = DateTime.FromOADate(oaValue)
                Return True
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Return False
            End Try
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ToSerial(value As DateTime, basis As SpreadsheetDateSystem) As Double
            If basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1900 AndAlso basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("The workbook date system must be known.", NameOf(basis))
            End If
            Dim oa As Double = value.ToOADate()
            Dim serial As Double = If(basis = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904, oa - 1462.0R,
                                      If(oa < 61.0R, oa - 1.0R, oa))
            If serial < 0.0R Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(value), "Excel dates before the workbook epoch are unsupported.")
            Return serial
        End Function
    End Class

                                        dateSystem As SpreadsheetDateSystem,
                                        interpretNumberAsDate As Boolean,
                                        dateSerialOrigin As Nullable(Of DateTime)) As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Dim policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions())
            Dim answer As New SpreadsheetCellEvaluation()
            If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank Then
                answer.IsMissing = True
                Return answer
            End If
            Select Case cell.Kind
                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                    answer.IsError = True
                    answer.Error = New SpreadsheetExcelErrorValue(cell.TextValue, cell.NativeErrorCode)
                    answer.IsMissing = policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.TreatAsMissing
                    Return answer

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                    If Double.IsNaN(cell.NumberValue) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(cell.NumberValue) Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Non-finite spreadsheet numbers are not valid input.", NameOf(cell))
                    End If
                    answer.NumericValue = cell.NumberValue
                    answer.HasNumericValue = Not interpretNumberAsDate OrElse policy.AllowDateSerialNumbers
                    If interpretNumberAsDate Then
                        Dim d As DateTime = DateTime.MinValue
                        If dateSerialOrigin.HasValue AndAlso dateSystem <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Unknown Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Specify either an Excel date system or a host date origin, not both.", NameOf(dateSerialOrigin))
                        End If
                        Dim validDate As Boolean = If(dateSerialOrigin.HasValue,
                            SpreadsheetDateSerialConverter.TryToDateTime(cell.NumberValue, dateSerialOrigin.GetValueOrDefault(), d),
                            ExcelDateSerialConverter.TryToDateTime(cell.NumberValue, dateSystem, d))
                        If Not validDate Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid date serial or unverified date origin.", NameOf(cell))
                        End If
                        answer.HasDateValue = True
                        answer.DateValue = d
                    End If

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text
                    Dim value As String = If(cell.TextValue, String.Empty)
                    If policy.MissingText = SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy.BlankOrEmptyText AndAlso value.Length = 0 Then
                        answer.IsMissing = True
                    ElseIf policy.MissingText = SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy.BlankOrWhitespaceText AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then
                        answer.IsMissing = True
                    ElseIf policy.NumericText <> SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy.Reject Then

                            Not Double.IsNaN(result) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(result) Then
                            answer.HasNumericValue = True
                            answer.NumericValue = result
                        End If
                    End If

                Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                    If policy.AllowBooleanNumbers Then

                        answer.NumericValue = If(cell.BooleanValue, 1.0R, 0.0R)
                    End If

        Public Shared Function ToSerial(value As DateTime, basis As SpreadsheetDateSystem) As Double
            If basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1900 AndAlso basis <> SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("The workbook date system must be known.", NameOf(basis))
            End If
            Dim oa As Double = value.ToOADate()
            Dim serial As Double = If(basis = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Excel1904, oa - 1462.0R,

Namespace ExcelCommon

    Public Enum SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation
        GroupsInColumns = 0
        GroupsInRows = 1
        LongFormat = 2
    End Enum

    Public Enum SpreadsheetHeaderMode
        Required = 0
        None = 1
        Auto = 2
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Opt-in grouped-range interpretation. In the wide-column mode, the first row supplies
    ''' group names when headers are required. In the wide-row mode, the first column supplies
    ''' names. Long format uses category and observation columns, with first-appearance order.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions
        Public Property Orientation As SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInColumns
        Public Property Header As SpreadsheetHeaderMode = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required
        Public Property CategoryColumnIndex As Integer = 0
        Public Property ValueColumnIndex As Integer = 1
        Public Property MinimumObservationsPerGroup As Integer = 2
        ' Defaults retain the existing ANOVA/KW parser contract. Univariate callers
        ' can explicitly allow one group, or require exactly two, without padding data.
        Public Property MinimumGroups As Integer = 2
        Public Property MaximumGroups As Integer = Integer.MaxValue
        Public Property WarnOnSkippedObservations As Boolean = False
        Public Property CellPolicy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions()

        ''' <summary>The Stage 3.04 wide-columns/header/blank-only numeric interpretation.</summary>
        Public Shared Function LegacyWideHeaders() As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions
            Return New SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions()
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult
        Public Sub New(data As GroupedNumericData, validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport)
            Me.New(data, validation, Array.Empty(Of UnivariateObservationSource)())
        End Sub

        Friend Sub New(data As GroupedNumericData, validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport,
                       sources As IEnumerable(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            If validation Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(validation))
            If validation.HasErrors AndAlso data IsNot Nothing Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("An invalid parse cannot contain grouped data.", NameOf(data))
            End If
            Me.Data = data
            Me.Validation = validation
            Me.ObservationSources = New System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection(Of UnivariateObservationSource)(
                New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)(sources))
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Data As GroupedNumericData
        Public ReadOnly Property Validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport
        Public ReadOnly Property ObservationSources As IReadOnlyList(Of UnivariateObservationSource)
        Public ReadOnly Property Success As Boolean
            Get
                Return Validation.IsValid AndAlso Data IsNot Nothing
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Side-effect-free configurable parser. Original GroupedNumericRangeParser.Parse(input)
    ''' remains the unchanged legacy entry point. This new parser never guesses culture,
    ''' errors, or date types; all conversions are explicit via CellPolicy.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ConfigurableGroupedNumericParser
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Parse(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                                     Optional options As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult
            Dim config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions = If(options, SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions.LegacyWideHeaders())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If Not ValidateShape(input, config, issues) Then
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If

            Dim names As New List(Of String)()
            Dim groups As New List(Of List(Of Double))()
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            Select Case config.Orientation
                Case SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInColumns
                    ParseWideColumns(input, config, names, groups, issues, sources)
                Case SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInRows
                    ParseWideRows(input, config, names, groups, issues, sources)
                Case SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.LongFormat
                    ParseLong(input, config, names, groups, issues, sources)
            End Select

            If names.Count < config.MinimumGroups Then
                Add(issues, input, "groups.too-few", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    If(config.MinimumGroups = 2, "At least two groups are required.",
                       "At least " & config.MinimumGroups.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " groups are required."), "groups")
            End If
            If names.Count > config.MaximumGroups Then
                Add(issues, input, "groups.too-many", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "At most " & config.MaximumGroups.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " groups are permitted.", "groups")
            End If
            For groupIndex As Integer = 0 To names.Count - 1
                If groups(groupIndex).Count < config.MinimumObservationsPerGroup Then
                    Add(issues, input, "groups.too-few-observations", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Group '" & names(groupIndex) & "' has fewer than " &
                        config.MinimumObservationsPerGroup.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " numeric observations.",
                        "groups[" & groupIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "]")
                End If
            Next
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)

            Dim dataGroups(groups.Count - 1)() As Double
            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Count - 1
                dataGroups(i) = groups(i).ToArray()
            Next
            Return New SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult(New GroupedNumericData(names.ToArray(), dataGroups),
                New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues), sources)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Result(data As GroupedNumericData, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult
            Return New SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function

        Private Shared Function HasErrors(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            For Each issue As SpreadsheetValidationIssue In issues
                If issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error] Then Return True
            Next
            Return False
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ValidateShape(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                                              config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                              issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If input Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "range.null", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "No spreadsheet range was supplied.", "input")
                Return False
            End If
            If input.RowCount < 1 OrElse input.ColumnCount < 1 OrElse input.Rows Is Nothing OrElse
                input.Rows.Count <> input.RowCount Then
                Add(issues, input, "range.shape", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The range dimensions do not match the supplied cells.", "rows")
                Return False
            End If
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim row As List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue) = input.Rows(r)
                If row Is Nothing OrElse row.Count <> input.ColumnCount Then
                    Add(issues, input, "range.not-rectangular", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "The range must contain the same number of cells in every row.", "rows", r + 1)
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            If Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation), config.Orientation) OrElse
                Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetHeaderMode), config.Header) OrElse
                config.MinimumObservationsPerGroup < 1 OrElse config.MinimumGroups < 1 OrElse
                config.MaximumGroups < config.MinimumGroups OrElse config.CellPolicy Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, input, "options.invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The grouped parsing options are invalid.", "options")
                Return False
            End If
            If config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.LongFormat Then
                If config.CategoryColumnIndex < 0 OrElse config.ValueColumnIndex < 0 OrElse
                    config.CategoryColumnIndex >= input.ColumnCount OrElse config.ValueColumnIndex >= input.ColumnCount OrElse
                    config.CategoryColumnIndex = config.ValueColumnIndex Then
                    Add(issues, input, "options.long-columns", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Long-format category and value columns must be distinct valid column indices.", "options.columns")
                    Return False
                End If
            ElseIf (config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInColumns AndAlso input.ColumnCount < config.MinimumGroups) OrElse
                   (config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInRows AndAlso input.RowCount < config.MinimumGroups) Then
                Add(issues, input, "range.too-few-groups", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    If(config.MinimumGroups = 2, "At least two group columns or group rows are required.",
                       "Too few group columns or group rows were supplied."), "rows")
                Return False
            End If
            Return True
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ParseWideColumns(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                            names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                            issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = HasWideHeader(input, config, True, issues)
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return
            For c As Integer = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                names.Add(If(headers, HeaderText(input.Rows(0)(c), c), AutoLabel(c)))
                groups.Add(New List(Of Double)())
                For r As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                    AddNumeric(input, config, input.Rows(r)(c), r, c, names(c), groups(c), issues, sources, c)
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub ParseWideRows(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                         names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                         issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = HasWideHeader(input, config, False, issues)
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim label As String = If(headers, HeaderText(input.Rows(r)(0), r), AutoLabel(r))
                names.Add(label)
                Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
                For c As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.ColumnCount - 1
                    AddNumeric(input, config, input.Rows(r)(c), r, c, label, values, issues, sources, r)
                Next
                groups.Add(values)
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function HasWideHeader(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                              columnGroups As Boolean,
                                              issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then Return True
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None Then Return False
            Dim textCount As Integer = 0
            Dim numericCount As Integer = 0
            Dim total As Integer = If(columnGroups, input.ColumnCount, input.RowCount)
            For n As Integer = 0 To total - 1
                Dim cell As SpreadsheetCellValue = If(columnGroups, input.Rows(0)(n), input.Rows(n)(0))
                If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank Then Continue For
                Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Nothing
                Try
                    ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        ex.Message, "header", If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End Try
                If ev.HasNumericValue AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                    numericCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool Then
                    textCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "An Excel error cannot be used to infer a header.", "header",
                        If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            If textCount > 0 AndAlso numericCount > 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header mixes names and numeric observations; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            If textCount = 0 AndAlso numericCount = 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header is empty; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                If(textCount > 0, "A header was detected.", "No header was detected."), "header")
            Return textCount > 0
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ParseLong(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                     names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                     issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Auto Then
                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(0)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Long-format header cannot be inferred from a blank or Excel-error value cell.", "header", 1, config.ValueColumnIndex + 1)
                    Return
                End If
                Try
                    Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(valueCell, config.CellPolicy)
                    headers = Not ev.HasNumericValue
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message,
                        "header", 1, config.ValueColumnIndex + 1)
                    Return
                End Try
                Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                    If(headers, "A long-format header was detected.", "No long-format header was detected."), "header")
            End If

            Dim lookup As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim labelKinds As New Dictionary(Of String, SpreadsheetCellKind)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For r As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim categoryCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(config.CategoryColumnIndex)
                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If (categoryCell Is Nothing OrElse categoryCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) AndAlso
                   (valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) Then
                    If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                        Add(issues, input, "rows.blank-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                            "An empty long-format row was skipped.", "rows", r + 1)
                    End If
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim label As String = String.Empty
                Dim kind As SpreadsheetCellKind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank
                If categoryCell IsNot Nothing Then kind = categoryCell.Kind
                Select Case kind
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text, SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                        If kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                            Add(issues, input, "groups.category-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                "An Excel error is not a valid category.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        label = If(categoryCell.TextValue, String.Empty).Trim()
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                        If Double.IsNaN(categoryCell.NumberValue) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(categoryCell.NumberValue) Then
                            Add(issues, input, "groups.category-invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                "Category labels must be finite.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        label = categoryCell.NumberValue.ToString("G15", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                        label = categoryCell.BooleanValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End Select
                If label.Length = 0 Then
                    Add(issues, input, "groups.category-missing", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "A long-format observation requires a category.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                    Continue For
                End If
                If labelKinds.ContainsKey(label) AndAlso labelKinds(label) <> kind Then
                    Add(issues, input, "groups.category-collision", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Distinct category cell types produce the same label: '" & label & "'.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim idx As Integer = 0
                If Not lookup.TryGetValue(label, idx) Then
                    idx = names.Count
                    lookup.Add(label, idx)
                    labelKinds.Add(label, kind)
                    names.Add(label)
                    groups.Add(New List(Of Double)())
                End If
                AddNumeric(input, config, valueCell, r, config.ValueColumnIndex, label, groups(idx), issues, sources, idx)
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub AddNumeric(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                      cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, r As Integer, c As Integer,
                                      groupName As String, values As List(Of Double),
                                      issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource), groupIndex As Integer)
            Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, input, "cell.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    ex.Message, "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                Return
            End Try
            If ev.IsError AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Excel error in group '" & groupName & "' is not a numeric observation.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            ElseIf ev.IsMissing Then
                If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                    Add(issues, input, "cell.missing-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                        "A missing observation was skipped in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                End If
            ElseIf Not ev.HasNumericValue Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Non-numeric value in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            Else
                sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(groupIndex, values.Count, r + 1, c + 1,
                    If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0), If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0),
                    input.WorkbookId, input.WorksheetId, input.WorksheetName, input.Address))
                values.Add(ev.NumericValue)
            End If
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function HeaderText(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, index As Integer) As String
            If cell IsNot Nothing Then
                Select Case cell.Kind
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text, SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                        Dim label As String = If(cell.TextValue, String.Empty).Trim()
                        If label.Length > 0 Then Return label
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                        Return cell.NumberValue.ToString("G15", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                        Return cell.BooleanValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End Select
            End If
            Return AutoLabel(index)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function AutoLabel(index As Integer) As String
            Return "Group " & (index + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                               code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                               message As String, fieldPath As String,
                               Optional selectedRow As Integer = 0, Optional selectedColumn As Integer = 0)
            Dim absoluteRow As Integer = 0
            Dim absoluteColumn As Integer = 0
            If input IsNot Nothing Then
                If selectedRow > 0 AndAlso input.StartRow > 0 Then absoluteRow = input.StartRow + selectedRow - 1
                If selectedColumn > 0 AndAlso input.StartColumn > 0 Then absoluteColumn = input.StartColumn + selectedColumn - 1
            End If
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, fieldPath,
                                                       selectedRow, selectedColumn, absoluteRow, absoluteColumn))
        End Sub
    End Class
End Namespace
