        Private Shared Function ValidateShape(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                                              config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                              issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If input Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "range.null", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "No spreadsheet range was supplied.", "input")
                Return False
            End If
            If input.RowCount < 1 OrElse input.ColumnCount < 1 OrElse input.Rows Is Nothing OrElse
                input.Rows.Count <> input.RowCount Then
                Add(issues, input, "range.shape", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The range dimensions do not match the supplied cells.", "rows")
                Return False
            End If
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim row As List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue) = input.Rows(r)
                If row Is Nothing OrElse row.Count <> input.ColumnCount Then
                    Add(issues, input, "range.not-rectangular", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "The range must contain the same number of cells in every row.", "rows", r + 1)
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            If Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation), config.Orientation) OrElse
                Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetHeaderMode), config.Header) OrElse
                config.MinimumObservationsPerGroup < 1 OrElse config.MinimumGroups < 1 OrElse
                config.MaximumGroups < config.MinimumGroups OrElse config.CellPolicy Is Nothing Then
                Add(issues, input, "options.invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The grouped parsing options are invalid.", "options")
                Return False
            End If
            If config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.LongFormat Then
                If config.CategoryColumnIndex < 0 OrElse config.ValueColumnIndex < 0 OrElse
                    config.CategoryColumnIndex >= input.ColumnCount OrElse config.ValueColumnIndex >= input.ColumnCount OrElse
                    config.CategoryColumnIndex = config.ValueColumnIndex Then
                    Add(issues, input, "options.long-columns", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Long-format category and value columns must be distinct valid column indices.", "options.columns")
                    Return False
                End If
            ElseIf (config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInColumns AndAlso input.ColumnCount < config.MinimumGroups) OrElse
                   (config.Orientation = SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.GroupsInRows AndAlso input.RowCount < config.MinimumGroups) Then
                Add(issues, input, "range.too-few-groups", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    If(config.MinimumGroups = 2, "At least two group columns or group rows are required.",
                       "Too few group columns or group rows were supplied."), "rows")
                Return False
            End If
            Return True
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ParseWideColumns(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                            names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                            issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = HasWideHeader(input, config, True, issues)
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return
            For c As Integer = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                names.Add(If(headers, HeaderText(input.Rows(0)(c), c), AutoLabel(c)))
                groups.Add(New List(Of Double)())
                For r As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                    AddNumeric(input, config, input.Rows(r)(c), r, c, names(c), groups(c), issues, sources, c)
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub ParseWideRows(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                         names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                         issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = HasWideHeader(input, config, False, issues)
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim label As String = If(headers, HeaderText(input.Rows(r)(0), r), AutoLabel(r))
                names.Add(label)
                Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
                For c As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.ColumnCount - 1
                    AddNumeric(input, config, input.Rows(r)(c), r, c, label, values, issues, sources, r)
                Next
                groups.Add(values)
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function HasWideHeader(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                              columnGroups As Boolean,
                                              issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then Return True
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None Then Return False
            Dim textCount As Integer = 0
            Dim numericCount As Integer = 0
            Dim total As Integer = If(columnGroups, input.ColumnCount, input.RowCount)
            For n As Integer = 0 To total - 1
                Dim cell As SpreadsheetCellValue = If(columnGroups, input.Rows(0)(n), input.Rows(n)(0))
                If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank Then Continue For
                Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Nothing
                Try
                    ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        ex.Message, "header", If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End Try
                If ev.HasNumericValue AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                    numericCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool Then
                    textCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "An Excel error cannot be used to infer a header.", "header",
                        If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            If textCount > 0 AndAlso numericCount > 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header mixes names and numeric observations; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            If textCount = 0 AndAlso numericCount = 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header is empty; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                If(textCount > 0, "A header was detected.", "No header was detected."), "header")
            Return textCount > 0
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ParseLong(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                     names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                     issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Auto Then
                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(0)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Long-format header cannot be inferred from a blank or Excel-error value cell.", "header", 1, config.ValueColumnIndex + 1)
                    Return
                End If
                Try
                    Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(valueCell, config.CellPolicy)
                    headers = Not ev.HasNumericValue
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message,
                        "header", 1, config.ValueColumnIndex + 1)
                    Return
                End Try
                Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                    If(headers, "A long-format header was detected.", "No long-format header was detected."), "header")
            End If

            Dim lookup As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim labelKinds As New Dictionary(Of String, SpreadsheetCellKind)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For r As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim categoryCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(config.CategoryColumnIndex)
                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If (categoryCell Is Nothing OrElse categoryCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) AndAlso
                   (valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) Then
                    If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                        Add(issues, input, "rows.blank-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                            "An empty long-format row was skipped.", "rows", r + 1)
                    End If
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim label As String = String.Empty
                Dim kind As SpreadsheetCellKind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank
                If categoryCell IsNot Nothing Then kind = categoryCell.Kind
                Select Case kind
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text, SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                        If kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                            Add(issues, input, "groups.category-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                "An Excel error is not a valid category.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        label = If(categoryCell.TextValue, String.Empty).Trim()
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                        If Double.IsNaN(categoryCell.NumberValue) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(categoryCell.NumberValue) Then
                            Add(issues, input, "groups.category-invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                "Category labels must be finite.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        label = categoryCell.NumberValue.ToString("G15", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                        label = categoryCell.BooleanValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End Select
                If label.Length = 0 Then
                    Add(issues, input, "groups.category-missing", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "A long-format observation requires a category.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                    Continue For
                End If
                If labelKinds.ContainsKey(label) AndAlso labelKinds(label) <> kind Then
                    Add(issues, input, "groups.category-collision", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Distinct category cell types produce the same label: '" & label & "'.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim idx As Integer = 0
                If Not lookup.TryGetValue(label, idx) Then
                    idx = names.Count
                    lookup.Add(label, idx)
                    labelKinds.Add(label, kind)
                    names.Add(label)
                    groups.Add(New List(Of Double)())
                End If
                AddNumeric(input, config, valueCell, r, config.ValueColumnIndex, label, groups(idx), issues, sources, idx)
            Next
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub AddNumeric(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                      cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, r As Integer, c As Integer,
                                      groupName As String, values As List(Of Double),
                                      issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource), groupIndex As Integer)
            Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, input, "cell.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    ex.Message, "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                Return
            End Try
            If ev.IsError AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Excel error in group '" & groupName & "' is not a numeric observation.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            ElseIf ev.IsMissing Then
                If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                    Add(issues, input, "cell.missing-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                        "A missing observation was skipped in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                End If
            ElseIf Not ev.HasNumericValue Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Non-numeric value in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            Else
                sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(groupIndex, values.Count, r + 1, c + 1,
                    If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0), If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0),
                    input.WorkbookId, input.WorksheetId, input.WorksheetName, input.Address))
                values.Add(ev.NumericValue)
            End If
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function HeaderText(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, index As Integer) As String
            If cell IsNot Nothing Then
                Select Case cell.Kind
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text, SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                        Dim label As String = If(cell.TextValue, String.Empty).Trim()
                        If label.Length > 0 Then Return label
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Number
                        Return cell.NumberValue.ToString("G15", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool
                        Return cell.BooleanValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End Select
            End If
            Return AutoLabel(index)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function AutoLabel(index As Integer) As String
            Return "Group " & (index + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                               code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                               message As String, fieldPath As String,
                               Optional selectedRow As Integer = 0, Optional selectedColumn As Integer = 0)
            Dim absoluteRow As Integer = 0
            Dim absoluteColumn As Integer = 0
            If input IsNot Nothing Then
                If selectedRow > 0 AndAlso input.StartRow > 0 Then absoluteRow = input.StartRow + selectedRow - 1
                If selectedColumn > 0 AndAlso input.StartColumn > 0 Then absoluteColumn = input.StartColumn + selectedColumn - 1
            End If
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, fieldPath,
                                                       selectedRow, selectedColumn, absoluteRow, absoluteColumn))
        End Sub
    End Class

Private Shared Function HasWideHeader(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                              columnGroups As Boolean,
                                              issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then Return True
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None Then Return False
            Dim textCount As Integer = 0
            Dim numericCount As Integer = 0
            Dim total As Integer = If(columnGroups, input.ColumnCount, input.RowCount)
            For n As Integer = 0 To total - 1
                Dim cell As SpreadsheetCellValue = If(columnGroups, input.Rows(0)(n), input.Rows(n)(0))
                If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank Then Continue For
                Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = Nothing
                Try
                    ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        ex.Message, "header", If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End Try
                If ev.HasNumericValue AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                    numericCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool Then
                    textCount += 1
                ElseIf cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "An Excel error cannot be used to infer a header.", "header",
                        If(columnGroups, 1, n + 1), If(columnGroups, n + 1, 1))
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            If textCount > 0 AndAlso numericCount > 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header mixes names and numeric observations; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            If textCount = 0 AndAlso numericCount = 0 Then
                Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The possible header is empty; choose Required or None explicitly.", "header")
                Return False
            End If
            Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                If(textCount > 0, "A header was detected.", "No header was detected."), "header")
            Return textCount > 0
        End Function

                                     names As List(Of String), groups As List(Of List(Of Double)),
                                     issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource))
            Dim headers As Boolean = config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required
            If config.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Auto Then
                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(0)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                    Add(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],

                    Return

                Try
                    Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(valueCell, config.CellPolicy)
                    headers = Not ev.HasNumericValue
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Add(issues, input, "header.invalid-cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message,
                        "header", 1, config.ValueColumnIndex + 1)
                    Return
                End Try
                Add(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                    If(headers, "A long-format header was detected.", "No long-format header was detected."), "header")
            End If

            Dim lookup As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim labelKinds As New Dictionary(Of String, SpreadsheetCellKind)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For r As Integer = If(headers, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1

                Dim valueCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(config.ValueColumnIndex)
                If (categoryCell Is Nothing OrElse categoryCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) AndAlso
                   (valueCell Is Nothing OrElse valueCell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank) Then
                    If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                        Add(issues, input, "rows.blank-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                            "An empty long-format row was skipped.", "rows", r + 1)
                    End If
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim label As String = String.Empty
                Dim kind As SpreadsheetCellKind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank
                If categoryCell IsNot Nothing Then kind = categoryCell.Kind
                Select Case kind
                    Case SpreadsheetCellKind.Text, SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError
                        If kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                            Add(issues, input, "groups.category-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                "An Excel error is not a valid category.", "category", r + 1, config.CategoryColumnIndex + 1)
                            Continue For

                        label = If(categoryCell.TextValue, String.Empty).Trim()

Private Shared Sub AddNumeric(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, config As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                      cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, r As Integer, c As Integer,
                                      groupName As String, values As List(Of Double),
                                      issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), sources As List(Of UnivariateObservationSource), groupIndex As Integer)
            Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                ev = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, config.CellPolicy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, input, "cell.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    ex.Message, "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                Return
            End Try
            If ev.IsError AndAlso Not ev.IsMissing Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Excel error in group '" & groupName & "' is not a numeric observation.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            ElseIf ev.IsMissing Then
                If config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                    Add(issues, input, "cell.missing-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                        "A missing observation was skipped in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                End If
            ElseIf Not ev.HasNumericValue Then
                Add(issues, input, "cell.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Non-numeric value in group '" & groupName & "'.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
            Else
                sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(groupIndex, values.Count, r + 1, c + 1,
                    If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0), If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0),
                    input.WorkbookId, input.WorksheetId, input.WorksheetName, input.Address))
                values.Add(ev.NumericValue)
            End If
        End Sub

    ''' <summary>Checked Core boundary with immutable original count table and count-cell provenance.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ContingencyCountSelection
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Private ReadOnly _core As Integer(,)
        Friend Sub New(table As SpreadsheetContingencyTableInput, core As Integer(,), sources As IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell), source As SpreadsheetRangeData)
            Me.Table = table
            _core = DirectCast(core.Clone(), Integer(,))
            Me.Sources = Array.AsReadOnly(sources.ToArray())
            WorkbookId = If(source.WorkbookId, String.Empty)
            WorksheetId = If(source.WorksheetId, String.Empty)
            WorksheetName = If(source.WorksheetName, String.Empty)
            SourceAddress = If(source.Address, String.Empty)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Table As SpreadsheetContingencyTableInput
        Public ReadOnly Property Sources As IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)
        Public ReadOnly Property WorkbookId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetName As String
        Public ReadOnly Property SourceAddress As String

            Get
                Return DirectCast(_core.Clone(), Integer(,))
            End Get
        End Property

    Public NotInheritable Class ContingencyInputPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>One parser: the established categorical count parser, followed by checked Int32 projection.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Parse(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions,
                                     Optional requireTwoByTwo As Boolean = False,
                                     Optional sourceRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Dim parsed = RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseContingencyCounts(input, options)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)(parsed.Validation.Issues)
            If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso (input Is Nothing OrElse sourceRows.Count <> input.RowCount OrElse sourceRows.Any(Function(r) r < 1) OrElse sourceRows.Distinct().Count() <> sourceRows.Count) Then
                issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.source-rows", "Source rows must match the selection and be positive and unique.", "source.rows"))
            End If
            If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso input IsNot Nothing AndAlso sourceRows.Count = input.RowCount AndAlso sourceRows.All(Function(r) r > 0) Then
                issues = issues.Select(Function(i) New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(i.Code, i.Severity, i.Message, i.FieldPath, i.SelectedRow, i.SelectedColumn,
                    If(i.SelectedRow > 0 AndAlso i.SelectedRow <= sourceRows.Count, sourceRows(i.SelectedRow - 1), i.WorksheetRow), i.WorksheetColumn)).ToList()
            End If
            If Not parsed.Success OrElse New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            Dim table = parsed.Data
            If requireTwoByTwo AndAlso (table.RowCount <> 2 OrElse table.ColumnCount <> 2) Then issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.two-by-two", "Wrong dimensions of input table, 2x2 is expected.", "counts"))
            Dim values = table.Counts
            Dim core(table.RowCount - 1, table.ColumnCount - 1) As Integer
            Dim sources As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)
            Dim firstRow = If(options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.HasColumnHeaders, 1, 0)
            Dim firstColumn = If(options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.HasRowLabels, 1, 0)
            ' Nothing options means the established parser's explicit default: both label axes.
            If options Is Nothing Then firstRow = 1 : firstColumn = 1
            For r = 0 To table.RowCount - 1
                For c = 0 To table.ColumnCount - 1
                    Dim sr = r + firstRow + 1, sc = c + firstColumn + 1
                    Dim wr = If(sourceRows IsNot Nothing, sourceRows(sr - 1), If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + sr - 1, 0))
                    Dim wc = If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + sc - 1, 0)
                    If values(r)(c) > Integer.MaxValue Then
                        issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("contingency.int32-count", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, "Count exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts", sr, sc, wr, wc))
                    Else
                        core(r, c) = CInt(values(r)(c))
                    End If
                    sources.Add(New SpreadsheetFrameCell(input.Rows(sr - 1)(sc - 1), sr, sc, wr, wc))
                Next
            Next
            If table.GrandTotal > Integer.MaxValue Then issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.int32-total", "Table total exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts.total"))
            Return Finish(If(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors, Nothing, New ContingencyCountSelection(table, core, sources, input)), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromDialog(a As Double, b As Double, c As Double, d As Double) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Return Parse(NumericSnapshot(New Double(,) {{a, b}, {c, d}}), New SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions With {.HasColumnHeaders = False, .HasRowLabels = False}, True)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NumericSnapshot(values As Double(,)) As SpreadsheetRangeData
            If values Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim snapshot As New SpreadsheetRangeData With {.RowCount = values.GetLength(0), .ColumnCount = values.GetLength(1)}
            For r = 0 To snapshot.RowCount - 1
                Dim row As New List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue)
                For c = 0 To snapshot.ColumnCount - 1
                    row.Add(SpreadsheetCellValue.NumberCell(values(r, c)))
                Next
                snapshot.Rows.Add(row)
            Next
            Return snapshot
        End Function

        Friend Shared Function ErrorIssue(code As String, message As String, field As String) As SpreadsheetValidationIssue
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, message, field)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Finish(data As ContingencyCountSelection, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class ProportionsRequest
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Friend Sub New(mode As ProportionsMode, hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis, n1 As Integer, r1 As Integer, n2 As Integer, r2 As Integer, both As Integer, alpha As Double, margin As Double)
            Me.Mode = mode : Me.Hypothesis = hypothesis
            Total1 = n1 : Responders1 = r1 : Total2 = n2 : Responders2 = r2 : Me.Both = both
            Me.Alpha = alpha : Me.Margin = margin
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Total1 As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Responders1 As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Total2 As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Responders2 As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Both As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Alpha As Double
        Public ReadOnly Property Margin As Double
        ''' <summary>Rows=response status, columns=control and experimental; no sign reversal.</summary>
        Public Function IndependentFisherTable() As Integer(,)
            Return New Integer(,) {{Responders1, Responders2}, {Total1 - Responders1, Total2 - Responders2}}
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Disjoint categories: row first condition yes/no, column second condition yes/no.
        ''' Owner-approved mutually exclusive counts; the difference direction is first minus second.</summary>
        Public Function PairedOutcomeTable() As Integer(,)
            Return New Integer(,) {{Both, Responders1}, {Responders2, Total1 - Responders1 - Responders2 - Both}}
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Core layout: concordant negative, first-only / second-only, concordant positive.
        ''' The same off-diagonal discordants are retained in both named conventions.</summary>
        Public Function CoreLiddellTable() As Integer(,)
            Return New Integer(,) {{Total1 - Both - Responders1 - Responders2, Responders1}, {Responders2, Both}}
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class ProportionsInputPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ModeFromChoices(singleSample As Boolean, independent As Boolean, paired As Boolean) As ProportionsMode
            If If(singleSample, 1, 0) + If(independent, 1, 0) + If(paired, 1, 0) <> 1 Then Return CType(-1, ProportionsMode)
            Return If(singleSample, ProportionsMode.SingleSample, If(independent, ProportionsMode.Independent, ProportionsMode.Paired))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ValidateMargin(hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis, margin As Double) As SpreadsheetValidationReport
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(IndependentProportionsHypothesis), hypothesis) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.mode", "Invalid proportions hypothesis.", "options.hypothesis"))
            ElseIf hypothesis <> IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Superiority AndAlso (Double.IsNaN(margin) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(margin) OrElse margin <= 0) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.margin", "The margin must be greater than 0.", "options.margin"))
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Validate(mode As ProportionsMode, hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis,
                                        n1 As Double, r1 As Double, n2 As Double, r2 As Double, both As Double,
                                        alpha As Double, margin As Double) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ProportionsRequest)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(ProportionsMode), mode) OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(IndependentProportionsHypothesis), hypothesis) Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.mode", "Invalid proportions mode/hypothesis.", "options.mode"))
            If Double.IsNaN(alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1 OrElse
                (mode = ProportionsMode.Independent AndAlso hypothesis <> IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Superiority AndAlso alpha >= 0.5) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.alpha", "Alpha is outside the supported interval for the selected hypothesis.", "options.alpha"))
            End If
            If mode = ProportionsMode.Independent Then issues.AddRange(ValidateMargin(hypothesis, margin).Issues)
            Dim values As Double() = If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, New Double() {n1, r1}, If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, New Double() {n1, r1, n2, r2}, New Double() {n1, r1, r2, both}))
            Dim fields As String() = If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, New String() {"total1", "responders1"}, If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, New String() {"total1", "responders1", "total2", "responders2"}, New String() {"total1", "firstOnly", "secondOnly", "both"}))
            Dim raw(0, values.Length - 1) As Double
            For c = 0 To values.Length - 1
                raw(0, c) = values(c)
            Next
            Dim parsed = RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseContingencyCounts(ContingencyInputPolicy.NumericSnapshot(raw), New SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions With {
                .HasColumnHeaders = False, .HasRowLabels = False, .MinimumRows = 1, .MinimumColumns = 1})
            For Each i In parsed.Validation.Issues
                issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(i.Code, i.Severity, i.Message, If(i.SelectedColumn > 0, "counts." & fields(i.SelectedColumn - 1), "counts"), i.SelectedRow, i.SelectedColumn))
            Next
            If values.Any(Function(v) v > Integer.MaxValue) Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.int32", "Count exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts"))
            If Not New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then
                If n1 <= 0 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.total", "Total sample size must be positive.", "counts.total1"))
                If r1 > n1 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.responders", "Total Number of observations is less then the Number of Responders", "counts.responders1"))
                If mode = ProportionsMode.Independent Then
                    If n2 <= 0 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.total", "Total sample size must be positive.", "counts.total2"))
                    If r2 > n2 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.responders", "Total Number of observations is less then the Number of Responders", "counts.responders2"))
                    If n1 + n2 > Integer.MaxValue Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.int32-total", "Combined sample size exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts"))
                ElseIf mode = ProportionsMode.Paired Then
                    If r1 + r2 + both > n1 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-accounting", "The disjoint first-only, second-only and both counts must not exceed N.", "counts.neither"))
                End If
            End If
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            Dim request As ProportionsRequest = Nothing
            If report.IsValid Then request = New ProportionsRequest(mode, hypothesis, CInt(n1), CInt(r1), If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, CInt(n2), 0), If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, 0, CInt(r2)), If(mode = ProportionsMode.Paired, CInt(both), 0), alpha, margin)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ProportionsRequest)(request, report)
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class ContingencyInputPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>One parser: the established categorical count parser, followed by checked Int32 projection.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Parse(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions,
                                     Optional requireTwoByTwo As Boolean = False,
                                     Optional sourceRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Dim parsed = RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseContingencyCounts(input, options)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)(parsed.Validation.Issues)
            If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso (input Is Nothing OrElse sourceRows.Count <> input.RowCount OrElse sourceRows.Any(Function(r) r < 1) OrElse sourceRows.Distinct().Count() <> sourceRows.Count) Then
                issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.source-rows", "Source rows must match the selection and be positive and unique.", "source.rows"))
            End If
            If sourceRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso input IsNot Nothing AndAlso sourceRows.Count = input.RowCount AndAlso sourceRows.All(Function(r) r > 0) Then
                issues = issues.Select(Function(i) New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(i.Code, i.Severity, i.Message, i.FieldPath, i.SelectedRow, i.SelectedColumn,
                    If(i.SelectedRow > 0 AndAlso i.SelectedRow <= sourceRows.Count, sourceRows(i.SelectedRow - 1), i.WorksheetRow), i.WorksheetColumn)).ToList()
            End If
            If Not parsed.Success OrElse New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            Dim table = parsed.Data
            If requireTwoByTwo AndAlso (table.RowCount <> 2 OrElse table.ColumnCount <> 2) Then issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.two-by-two", "Wrong dimensions of input table, 2x2 is expected.", "counts"))
            Dim values = table.Counts
            Dim core(table.RowCount - 1, table.ColumnCount - 1) As Integer
            Dim sources As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)
            Dim firstRow = If(options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.HasColumnHeaders, 1, 0)
            Dim firstColumn = If(options IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.HasRowLabels, 1, 0)
            ' Nothing options means the established parser's explicit default: both label axes.
            If options Is Nothing Then firstRow = 1 : firstColumn = 1
            For r = 0 To table.RowCount - 1
                For c = 0 To table.ColumnCount - 1
                    Dim sr = r + firstRow + 1, sc = c + firstColumn + 1
                    Dim wr = If(sourceRows IsNot Nothing, sourceRows(sr - 1), If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + sr - 1, 0))
                    Dim wc = If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + sc - 1, 0)
                    If values(r)(c) > Integer.MaxValue Then
                        issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("contingency.int32-count", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, "Count exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts", sr, sc, wr, wc))
                    Else
                        core(r, c) = CInt(values(r)(c))
                    End If
                    sources.Add(New SpreadsheetFrameCell(input.Rows(sr - 1)(sc - 1), sr, sc, wr, wc))
                Next
            Next
            If table.GrandTotal > Integer.MaxValue Then issues.Add(ErrorIssue("contingency.int32-total", "Table total exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts.total"))
            Return Finish(If(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors, Nothing, New ContingencyCountSelection(table, core, sources, input)), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromDialog(a As Double, b As Double, c As Double, d As Double) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Return Parse(NumericSnapshot(New Double(,) {{a, b}, {c, d}}), New SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions With {.HasColumnHeaders = False, .HasRowLabels = False}, True)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NumericSnapshot(values As Double(,)) As SpreadsheetRangeData
            If values Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim snapshot As New SpreadsheetRangeData With {.RowCount = values.GetLength(0), .ColumnCount = values.GetLength(1)}
            For r = 0 To snapshot.RowCount - 1
                Dim row As New List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue)
                For c = 0 To snapshot.ColumnCount - 1
                    row.Add(SpreadsheetCellValue.NumberCell(values(r, c)))
                Next
                snapshot.Rows.Add(row)
            Next
            Return snapshot
        End Function

        Friend Shared Function ErrorIssue(code As String, message As String, field As String) As SpreadsheetValidationIssue
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, message, field)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Finish(data As ContingencyCountSelection, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ContingencyCountSelection)(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function
    End Class

        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Friend Sub New(mode As ProportionsMode, hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis, n1 As Integer, r1 As Integer, n2 As Integer, r2 As Integer, both As Integer, alpha As Double, margin As Double)
            Me.Mode = mode : Me.Hypothesis = hypothesis

        ''' <summary>Rows=response status, columns=control and experimental; no sign reversal.</summary>
        Public Function IndependentFisherTable() As Integer(,)
            Return New Integer(,) {{Responders1, Responders2}, {Total1 - Responders1, Total2 - Responders2}}
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Disjoint categories: row first condition yes/no, column second condition yes/no.

Public NotInheritable Class ProportionsInputPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ModeFromChoices(singleSample As Boolean, independent As Boolean, paired As Boolean) As ProportionsMode
            If If(singleSample, 1, 0) + If(independent, 1, 0) + If(paired, 1, 0) <> 1 Then Return CType(-1, ProportionsMode)
            Return If(singleSample, ProportionsMode.SingleSample, If(independent, ProportionsMode.Independent, ProportionsMode.Paired))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ValidateMargin(hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis, margin As Double) As SpreadsheetValidationReport
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(IndependentProportionsHypothesis), hypothesis) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.mode", "Invalid proportions hypothesis.", "options.hypothesis"))
            ElseIf hypothesis <> IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Superiority AndAlso (Double.IsNaN(margin) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(margin) OrElse margin <= 0) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.margin", "The margin must be greater than 0.", "options.margin"))
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Validate(mode As ProportionsMode, hypothesis As IndependentProportionsHypothesis,
                                        n1 As Double, r1 As Double, n2 As Double, r2 As Double, both As Double,
                                        alpha As Double, margin As Double) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ProportionsRequest)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(ProportionsMode), mode) OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(IndependentProportionsHypothesis), hypothesis) Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.mode", "Invalid proportions mode/hypothesis.", "options.mode"))
            If Double.IsNaN(alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1 OrElse
                (mode = ProportionsMode.Independent AndAlso hypothesis <> IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Superiority AndAlso alpha >= 0.5) Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.alpha", "Alpha is outside the supported interval for the selected hypothesis.", "options.alpha"))
            End If
            If mode = ProportionsMode.Independent Then issues.AddRange(ValidateMargin(hypothesis, margin).Issues)
            Dim values As Double() = If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, New Double() {n1, r1}, If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, New Double() {n1, r1, n2, r2}, New Double() {n1, r1, r2, both}))
            Dim fields As String() = If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, New String() {"total1", "responders1"}, If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, New String() {"total1", "responders1", "total2", "responders2"}, New String() {"total1", "firstOnly", "secondOnly", "both"}))
            Dim raw(0, values.Length - 1) As Double
            For c = 0 To values.Length - 1
                raw(0, c) = values(c)
            Next
            Dim parsed = RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseContingencyCounts(ContingencyInputPolicy.NumericSnapshot(raw), New SpreadsheetContingencyCountParseOptions With {
                .HasColumnHeaders = False, .HasRowLabels = False, .MinimumRows = 1, .MinimumColumns = 1})
            For Each i In parsed.Validation.Issues
                issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(i.Code, i.Severity, i.Message, If(i.SelectedColumn > 0, "counts." & fields(i.SelectedColumn - 1), "counts"), i.SelectedRow, i.SelectedColumn))
            Next
            If values.Any(Function(v) v > Integer.MaxValue) Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.int32", "Count exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts"))
            If Not New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then
                If n1 <= 0 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.total", "Total sample size must be positive.", "counts.total1"))
                If r1 > n1 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.responders", "Total Number of observations is less then the Number of Responders", "counts.responders1"))
                If mode = ProportionsMode.Independent Then
                    If n2 <= 0 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.total", "Total sample size must be positive.", "counts.total2"))
                    If r2 > n2 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.responders", "Total Number of observations is less then the Number of Responders", "counts.responders2"))
                    If n1 + n2 > Integer.MaxValue Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.int32-total", "Combined sample size exceeds the Core Int32 boundary.", "counts"))
                ElseIf mode = ProportionsMode.Paired Then
                    If r1 + r2 + both > n1 Then issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-accounting", "The disjoint first-only, second-only and both counts must not exceed N.", "counts.neither"))
                End If
            End If
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            Dim request As ProportionsRequest = Nothing
            If report.IsValid Then request = New ProportionsRequest(mode, hypothesis, CInt(n1), CInt(r1), If(mode = ProportionsMode.Independent, CInt(n2), 0), If(mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample, 0, CInt(r2)), If(mode = ProportionsMode.Paired, CInt(both), 0), alpha, margin)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of ProportionsRequest)(request, report)
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Parsed grouped numeric input used by one-way ANOVA and other grouped-data workflows.
    ''' </summary>
    Public Class GroupedNumericData
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput

        Public Sub New(groupNames As String(), groups As Double()())
            If groupNames Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(groupNames))
            If groups Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(groups))

            Me.GroupNames = groupNames
            Me.Groups = groups
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property GroupNames As String()
        Public ReadOnly Property Groups As Double()()

        Public ReadOnly Property GroupCounts As Integer()
            Get
                Dim counts(Groups.Length - 1) As Integer
                For i As Integer = 0 To Groups.Length - 1
                    counts(i) = If(Groups(i) Is Nothing, 0, Groups(i).Length)
                Next
                Return counts
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Shared grouped-data parser. It deliberately knows nothing about Office.js, Excel-DNA,
    ''' COM, WinForms, or a browser. Host adapters only need to supply SpreadsheetRangeData.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class GroupedNumericRangeParser

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Parse(input As SpreadsheetRangeData) As GroupedNumericData
            If input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(input))

    ''' <summary>Host-neutral bounded acquisition policy. Chunk cells bound a response;
    ''' total cells/estimated bytes bound the retained snapshot, not just a response.
    ''' Byte estimates include transient buffers but cannot guarantee actual heap use.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class InputSizeLimits
        Public Sub New(Optional maxRangeCells As Long = 10000, Optional maxTotalCells As Long = 10000,
                       Optional maxRanges As Integer = 64, Optional maxChunkCells As Integer = 2000,
                       Optional maxEstimatedBytes As Double = 67108864,
                       Optional estimatedBytesPerCell As Double = 1024,
                       Optional timeBudgetMilliseconds As Double = 30000)
            If maxRangeCells < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(maxRangeCells))
            If maxTotalCells < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(maxTotalCells))
            If maxRanges < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(maxRanges))
            If maxChunkCells < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(maxChunkCells))
            ValidatePositive(maxEstimatedBytes, 9007199254740991R, NameOf(maxEstimatedBytes))
            ValidatePositive(estimatedBytesPerCell, 9007199254740991R, NameOf(estimatedBytesPerCell))
            ValidatePositive(timeBudgetMilliseconds, Integer.MaxValue, NameOf(timeBudgetMilliseconds))
            Me.MaxRangeCells = maxRangeCells
            Me.MaxTotalCells = maxTotalCells
            Me.MaxRanges = maxRanges
            Me.MaxChunkCells = maxChunkCells
            Me.MaxEstimatedBytes = maxEstimatedBytes
            Me.EstimatedBytesPerCell = estimatedBytesPerCell
            Me.TimeBudgetMilliseconds = timeBudgetMilliseconds
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub ValidatePositive(value As Double, maximum As Double, name As String)
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) OrElse value <= 0 OrElse value > maximum Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(name, "A finite positive bounded budget is required.")
            End If
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property MaxRangeCells As Long
        Public ReadOnly Property MaxTotalCells As Long
        Public ReadOnly Property MaxRanges As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property MaxChunkCells As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property MaxEstimatedBytes As Double
        Public ReadOnly Property EstimatedBytesPerCell As Double
        Public ReadOnly Property TimeBudgetMilliseconds As Double
    End Class

    ''' <summary>One operation's metadata preflight and cooperative checkpoints. Hosts must
    ''' add ALL rectangles before loading cells and call Checkpoint between payloads.
    ''' No spreadsheet address dialect, host dimensions or host objects are assumed.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class InputAcquisitionBudget
        Private ReadOnly _limits As InputSizeLimits
        Private ReadOnly _cancellation As CancellationToken
        Private ReadOnly _elapsedMilliseconds As Func(Of Double)
        Private _lastElapsed As Double

        Public Sub New(Optional limits As InputSizeLimits = Nothing,
                       Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing,
                       Optional elapsedMilliseconds As Func(Of Double) = Nothing)
            _limits = If(limits, New InputSizeLimits())
            _cancellation = cancellation
            Dim timer As Stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew()
            _elapsedMilliseconds = If(elapsedMilliseconds, Function() timer.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
            Checkpoint()
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property TotalCells As Long
        Public ReadOnly Property RangeCount As Integer

        Public Sub Checkpoint()
            _cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Dim elapsed As Double = _elapsedMilliseconds()
            If Double.IsNaN(elapsed) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(elapsed) OrElse elapsed < _lastElapsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Elapsed time must be finite, nonnegative and monotonic.")
            End If
            _lastElapsed = elapsed
            If elapsed > _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds Then
                Reject("input.time-budget", "timeBudgetMilliseconds", elapsed, _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds)
            End If
        End Sub

        Public Sub AddRange(rows As Long, columns As Long)
            Checkpoint()
            If rows < 1 OrElse columns < 1 Then
                Reject("input.dimensions", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "positive dimensions")
            End If
            If rows > Long.MaxValue \ columns Then
                Reject("input.cell-overflow", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Long.MaxValue)
            End If
            Dim cells As Long = rows * columns
            If cells > _limits.MaxRangeCells Then Reject("input.range-cells", "maxRangeCells", cells, _limits.MaxRangeCells)
            If RangeCount >= _limits.MaxRanges Then Reject("input.range-count", "maxRanges", CLng(RangeCount) + 1, _limits.MaxRanges)
            If cells > _limits.MaxTotalCells - TotalCells Then
                Reject("input.total-cells", "maxTotalCells", CDec(TotalCells) + CDec(cells), _limits.MaxTotalCells)
            End If

Public NotInheritable Class InputAcquisitionBudget
        Private ReadOnly _limits As InputSizeLimits
        Private ReadOnly _cancellation As CancellationToken
        Private ReadOnly _elapsedMilliseconds As Func(Of Double)
        Private _lastElapsed As Double

        Public Sub New(Optional limits As InputSizeLimits = Nothing,
                       Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing,
                       Optional elapsedMilliseconds As Func(Of Double) = Nothing)
            _limits = If(limits, New InputSizeLimits())
            _cancellation = cancellation
            Dim timer As Stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew()
            _elapsedMilliseconds = If(elapsedMilliseconds, Function() timer.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
            Checkpoint()
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property TotalCells As Long
        Public ReadOnly Property RangeCount As Integer

        Public Sub Checkpoint()
            _cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Dim elapsed As Double = _elapsedMilliseconds()
            If Double.IsNaN(elapsed) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(elapsed) OrElse elapsed < _lastElapsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Elapsed time must be finite, nonnegative and monotonic.")
            End If
            _lastElapsed = elapsed
            If elapsed > _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds Then
                Reject("input.time-budget", "timeBudgetMilliseconds", elapsed, _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds)
            End If
        End Sub

        Public Sub AddRange(rows As Long, columns As Long)
            Checkpoint()
            If rows < 1 OrElse columns < 1 Then
                Reject("input.dimensions", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "positive dimensions")
            End If
            If rows > Long.MaxValue \ columns Then
                Reject("input.cell-overflow", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Long.MaxValue)
            End If
            Dim cells As Long = rows * columns
            If cells > _limits.MaxRangeCells Then Reject("input.range-cells", "maxRangeCells", cells, _limits.MaxRangeCells)
            If RangeCount >= _limits.MaxRanges Then Reject("input.range-count", "maxRanges", CLng(RangeCount) + 1, _limits.MaxRanges)
            If cells > _limits.MaxTotalCells - TotalCells Then
                Reject("input.total-cells", "maxTotalCells", CDec(TotalCells) + CDec(cells), _limits.MaxTotalCells)
            End If
            Dim total As Long = TotalCells + cells
            Dim estimate As Double = CDbl(total) * _limits.EstimatedBytesPerCell
            If estimate > _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Reject("input.estimated-bytes", "maxEstimatedBytes", estimate, _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes)
            _TotalCells = total
            _RangeCount += 1
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub Reject(code As String, field As String, requested As Object, allowed As Object)
            Dim message As String = String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "Acquisition limit {0}: requested {1}; allowed {2}. Select less data or supply an explicit bounded policy.", field, requested, allowed)
            Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(
                New SpreadsheetValidationIssue() {New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, message, field)}))
        End Sub
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Host-neutral survival, subject/visit and mixed-model input parsing. No model fitting.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class LongitudinalParsers
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ParseSurvival(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                  Optional options As SpreadsheetSurvivalParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetSurvivalParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetSurvivalParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            Dim frame As SpreadsheetRectangularDataFrameInput = Prepare(input, config.Header, issues)
            If frame Is Nothing Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)(Nothing, issues)
            If config.CellPolicy Is Nothing OrElse config.MinimumObservations < 1 OrElse
               Not ValidMissing(config.Missing) OrElse
               Not ColumnsValid(frame.ColumnCount, New Integer() {config.TimeColumnIndex, config.StatusColumnIndex},
                                New Integer() {config.EntryColumnIndex, config.StratumColumnIndex}) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "survival.options", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Invalid survival column roles or parsing options.", "options")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If (config.EventText Is Nothing) Xor (config.CensorText Is Nothing) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "survival.status-coding", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Both text status labels must be supplied.", "options.status")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If config.EventText IsNot Nothing AndAlso (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.EventText) OrElse
                String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.CensorText) OrElse
                String.Equals(config.EventText, config.CensorText, If(config.IgnoreStatusCase, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase, StringComparison.Ordinal))) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "survival.status-coding", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Event and censor labels must be distinct nonblank text.", "options.status")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim rows As New List(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalObservation)()
            For r As Integer = 0 To frame.RowCount - 1
                Dim timeValue As Double = 0.0R
                Dim entryValue As Double = 0.0R
                Dim status As Boolean = False
                Dim stratum As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = Nothing
                Dim missing As Boolean = False
                Dim rowBad As Boolean = False
                Dim isMissing As Boolean = False
                If Not TryNumeric(frame.Cell(r, config.TimeColumnIndex), config.CellPolicy, issues, "survival.time", timeValue, isMissing) Then rowBad = True
                missing = missing OrElse isMissing
                If config.EntryColumnIndex >= 0 Then
                    isMissing = False
                    If Not TryNumeric(frame.Cell(r, config.EntryColumnIndex), config.CellPolicy, issues, "survival.entry", entryValue, isMissing) Then rowBad = True
                    missing = missing OrElse isMissing
                End If
                isMissing = False
                If Not TryStatus(frame.Cell(r, config.StatusColumnIndex), config, issues, status, isMissing) Then rowBad = True
                missing = missing OrElse isMissing
                If config.StratumColumnIndex >= 0 Then
                    isMissing = False
                    If Not TryCategory(frame.Cell(r, config.StratumColumnIndex), config.CellPolicy, config.IgnoreCategoryCase,
                                      issues, "survival.stratum", stratum, isMissing) Then rowBad = True
                    missing = missing OrElse isMissing
                End If
                If rowBad Then Continue For
                Dim source As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, config.TimeColumnIndex)
                If missing Then
                    MissingRow(issues, source, config.Missing, "survival.missing")
                    Continue For
                End If
                If (config.RequirePositiveTime AndAlso timeValue <= 0.0R) OrElse
                   (Not config.RequirePositiveTime AndAlso timeValue < 0.0R) OrElse entryValue < 0.0R OrElse entryValue >= timeValue Then
                    ' Entry defaults to zero. With RequirePositiveTime = False, zero is only valid
                    ' without delayed entry, since interval length must be positive when entry exists.
                    If Not (config.EntryColumnIndex < 0 AndAlso Not config.RequirePositiveTime AndAlso timeValue = 0.0R) Then
                        Add(issues, source, "survival.interval", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                            "Survival time/entry interval is invalid.", "time")
                        Continue For
                    End If
                End If
                Dim entry As SpreadsheetNumericObservation = Nothing
                If config.EntryColumnIndex >= 0 Then
                    entry = NumericObservation(frame.Cell(r, config.EntryColumnIndex), entryValue)
                End If
                rows.Add(New SpreadsheetSurvivalObservation(NumericObservation(source, timeValue), entry, status, stratum))
            Next
            If rows.Count < config.MinimumObservations Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "survival.too-few", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Too few valid survival rows.", "observations")
            End If
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetSurvivalInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetSurvivalInput(rows), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseRepeatedSubjects(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                    Optional options As SpreadsheetRepeatedParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRepeatedSubjectInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetRepeatedParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetRepeatedParseOptions())
