    ''' <summary>
    ''' Host-neutral spreadsheet-to-Core regression design bridge. No model is fitted and
    ''' no alternate formula grammar or statistical contrast calculation is implemented.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetModelInputCompiler
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Compile(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                        Optional options As SpreadsheetModelParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetModelInput)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetModelParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetModelParseOptions())
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If config.CellPolicy Is Nothing OrElse config.MinimumCompleteRows < 1 OrElse
               config.MaximumExpandedColumns < 1 OrElse
               Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy), config.Missing) OrElse
               Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetHeaderMode), config.Header) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.options", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Invalid model input options.", "options")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim frameResult = RectangularCategoricalParsers.ParseDataFrame(input,
                New SpreadsheetDataFrameParseOptions With {.Header = config.Header})
            issues.AddRange(frameResult.Validation.Issues)
            If Not frameResult.Success Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            Dim frame As SpreadsheetRectangularDataFrameInput = frameResult.Data
            Dim responseColumn As Integer = config.ResponseColumnIndex
            If responseColumn < 0 OrElse responseColumn >= frame.ColumnCount Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.response-role", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Response column is outside the selected range.", "options.response")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If

            Dim predictors As New List(Of Integer)()
            If config.PredictorColumnIndices Is Nothing Then
                For col As Integer = 0 To frame.ColumnCount - 1
                    If col <> responseColumn Then predictors.Add(col)
                Next
            Else
                predictors.AddRange(config.PredictorColumnIndices)
            End If
            If predictors.Count = 0 OrElse predictors.Distinct().Count() <> predictors.Count OrElse
               predictors.Any(Function(col) col < 0 OrElse col >= frame.ColumnCount OrElse col = responseColumn) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.predictor-role", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Select unique predictor columns that do not overlap the response.", "options.predictors")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim categorical As Integer() = If(config.CategoricalColumnIndices, Array.Empty(Of Integer)())
            Dim categories As New HashSet(Of Integer)(categorical)
            If categories.Count <> categorical.Length OrElse
               categories.Any(Function(col) Not predictors.Contains(col)) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.category-role", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Categorical column roles must be unique and selected as predictors.", "options.categorical")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If If(config.FormulaText, String.Empty).Contains("~") Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.rhs-only", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "The response is selected separately; supply only the formula right-hand side.", "options.formula")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If

            Dim names As New List(Of String)()
            Dim keys As New List(Of String)()
            Dim absoluteLetters As New List(Of String)()
            For Each c As Integer In predictors
                names.Add(frame.Columns(c).Name)
                keys.Add("V" & (c + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                absoluteLetters.Add(If(frame.Columns(c).WorksheetColumn > 0,
                    Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionVariableCatalog.NumberToLetters(frame.Columns(c).WorksheetColumn), String.Empty))
            Next
            Dim spec As Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
            Dim formulaError As String = Nothing
            Try
                Dim catalog = Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(names, keys, absoluteLetters,
                    config.AllowRelativeColumnLetters, config.AllowAbsoluteColumnLetters, config.AllowQuotedVariableNames)
                If Not Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(config.FormulaText, catalog, spec, formulaError) Then
                    Add(issues, Nothing, "model.formula", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        If(formulaError, "Invalid regression formula."), "options.formula")
                    Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
                End If
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.formula", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "options.formula")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End Try

            Dim required As New HashSet(Of String)(spec.RequiredRawVarKeys, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim factorKeys As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each term As Global.BESHStatNG.TermSpec In spec.TermSpecs.Values
                If term.Scale = Global.BESHStatNG.PredictorScale.Categorical AndAlso term.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing Then
                    For Each key As String In term.BaseVarKeys
                        ' Interaction term specs may be mixed-type; Core adds categorical
                        ' helper terms to TermSpecs for each actual factor base variable.
                        If spec.TermSpecs.ContainsKey(Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionDesignCore.MakeCategoricalEffectKey(key)) Then
                            factorKeys.Add(key)
                        End If
                    Next
                End If
            Next
            For p As Integer = 0 To predictors.Count - 1
                If required.Contains(keys(p)) AndAlso categories.Contains(predictors(p)) AndAlso Not factorKeys.Contains(keys(p)) Then
                    Add(issues, Nothing, "model.factor-required", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        "Categorical predictor '" & names(p) & "' must use factor(...) in the formula.", "options.formula")
                End If
            Next
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)

            ' Validate the response and *required* predictors first. Excluded/unreferenced
            ' columns never discard a case or change factor levels.
            Dim complete As New List(Of Integer)()
            Dim numericRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim typedRows As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue())()
            Dim responses As New List(Of Double)()
            For r As Integer = 0 To frame.RowCount - 1
                Dim responseCell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, responseColumn)
                Dim responseValue As Double = 0.0R
                Dim rowMissing As Boolean = False
                Dim rowInvalid As Boolean = False
                ReadNumeric(responseCell, config.CellPolicy, issues, "response", responseValue, rowMissing, rowInvalid)
                Dim numeric(predictors.Count - 1) As Double
                Dim typed(predictors.Count - 1) As SpreadsheetCategoryValue
                For p As Integer = 0 To predictors.Count - 1
                    If Not required.Contains(keys(p)) Then Continue For
                    Dim cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, predictors(p))
                    If categories.Contains(predictors(p)) Then
                        Dim missing As Boolean = False
                        Dim invalid As Boolean = False
                        typed(p) = ReadCategory(cell, config.CellPolicy, config.IgnoreCategoryCase, issues, missing, invalid)
                        rowMissing = rowMissing OrElse missing
                        rowInvalid = rowInvalid OrElse invalid
                    Else
                        Dim missing As Boolean = False
                        Dim invalid As Boolean = False
                        ReadNumeric(cell, config.CellPolicy, issues, "predictors", numeric(p), missing, invalid)
                        rowMissing = rowMissing OrElse missing
                        rowInvalid = rowInvalid OrElse invalid
                    End If
                Next
                If rowInvalid Then Continue For
                If rowMissing Then
                    Dim severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity = If(config.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip,
                        SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error])
                    Add(issues, responseCell, If(config.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip,
                        "model.incomplete-skipped", "model.incomplete"), severity,
                        "Incomplete model observation " & If(severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, "skipped.", "is not permitted."), "rows")
                    Continue For
                End If
                complete.Add(r)
                numericRows.Add(numeric)
                typedRows.Add(typed)
                responses.Add(responseValue)
            Next
            If complete.Count < config.MinimumCompleteRows Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.too-few", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Not enough complete model observations.", "rows")
            End If
            If HasErrors(issues) Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)

            Dim raw(complete.Count - 1, predictors.Count - 1) As Double
            Dim levels As New List(Of SpreadsheetModelCategoricalColumn)()
            For p As Integer = 0 To predictors.Count - 1
                If categories.Contains(predictors(p)) AndAlso required.Contains(keys(p)) Then
                    Dim observed As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue)()
                    Dim seenKeys As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    For i As Integer = 0 To complete.Count - 1
                        Dim category As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = typedRows(i)(p)
                        If seenKeys.Add(category.Key) Then observed.Add(category)
                    Next
                    ' Preserve original numeric/Boolean levels for Core factor(reference)
                    ' compatibility. Text or mixed-type categories need collision-free codes.
                    Dim allNumeric As Boolean = observed.All(Function(v) v.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Number)
                    Dim allBoolean As Boolean = observed.All(Function(v) v.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Bool)
                    Dim codes As New Dictionary(Of String, Double)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    Dim encountered As New List(Of SpreadsheetModelCategoryLevel)()
                    For ix As Integer = 0 To observed.Count - 1
                        Dim category As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = observed(ix)
                        Dim code As Double = If(allNumeric, category.NumberValue,
                            If(allBoolean, If(category.BooleanValue, 1.0R, 0.0R), CDbl(ix + 1)))
                        codes.Add(category.Key, code)
                        encountered.Add(New SpreadsheetModelCategoryLevel(category, code))
                    Next
                    For i As Integer = 0 To complete.Count - 1
                        raw(i, p) = codes(typedRows(i)(p).Key)
                    Next
                    levels.Add(New SpreadsheetModelCategoricalColumn(names(p), predictors(p) + 1, encountered))
                Else
                    For i As Integer = 0 To complete.Count - 1
                        raw(i, p) = numericRows(i)(p)
                    Next
                End If
            Next

            Dim built As Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionFormulaMatrixBuildResult = Nothing
            Try
                If Not Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionFormulaDesignService.TryBuildExpandedPredictorMatrixFromFormula(
                    rawX:=raw, result:=built, errorMessage:=formulaError,
                    predictorNames:=names, formulaText:=config.FormulaText,
                    baseKeys:=keys, absoluteColumnLetters:=absoluteLetters,
                    allowRelativeColumnLetters:=config.AllowRelativeColumnLetters,
                    allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=config.AllowAbsoluteColumnLetters,
                    allowQuotedVariableNames:=config.AllowQuotedVariableNames,
                    omitCategoricalReference:=config.IncludeIntercept) Then
                    Add(issues, Nothing, "model.design", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                        If(formulaError, "Unable to expand formula."), "options.formula")
                    Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
                End If
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.design", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "options.formula")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End Try
            If built Is Nothing OrElse built.ExpandedPredictorMatrix Is Nothing OrElse
               built.ExpandedPredictorNames Is Nothing OrElse
               built.ExpandedPredictorMatrix.GetLength(0) <> complete.Count OrElse
               built.ExpandedPredictorNames.Length <> built.ExpandedPredictorMatrix.GetLength(1) Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.design", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Core returned an incomplete design matrix or column schema.", "design")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim expanded As Double(,) = built.ExpandedPredictorMatrix
            Dim n As Integer = complete.Count
            Dim width As Integer = expanded.GetLength(1) + If(config.IncludeIntercept, 1, 0)
            If width < 1 OrElse width > config.MaximumExpandedColumns Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.design-width", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                    "Expanded design contains zero or too many columns.", "options.max-columns")
                Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim design(n - 1, width - 1) As Double
            Dim outputNames As New List(Of String)()
            If config.IncludeIntercept Then outputNames.Add("(Intercept)")
            outputNames.AddRange(built.ExpandedPredictorNames)
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                If config.IncludeIntercept Then design(i, 0) = 1.0R
                For j As Integer = 0 To expanded.GetLength(1) - 1
                    Dim value As Double = expanded(i, j)
                    If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then
                        Add(issues, Nothing, "model.nonfinite-design", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                            "Expanded design contains non-finite values.", "design")
                        Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
                    End If
                    design(i, j + If(config.IncludeIntercept, 1, 0)) = value
                Next
            Next
            Dim rank As Integer = EstimateRank(design)
            If rank < width Then
                Add(issues, Nothing, "model.rank-deficient", If(config.RejectRankDeficiency,
                    SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning),
                    "Design matrix has rank " & rank.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                    " of " & width.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & ".", "design")
                If HasErrors(issues) Then Return Finish(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim rows As New List(Of SpreadsheetModelSourceRow)()
            For Each r As Integer In complete
                Dim cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell = frame.Cell(r, responseColumn)
                rows.Add(New SpreadsheetModelSourceRow(cell.SelectedRow, cell.WorksheetRow))
            Next
            Dim model As New SpreadsheetModelInput(frame.Columns(responseColumn).Name, responses.ToArray(), raw,
                design, outputNames, names, built.RequiredRawPredictorNames, rows, levels,
                config.FormulaText, spec.NormalizedFormulaText, config.IncludeIntercept, rank,
                frame.WorkbookId, frame.WorksheetId, frame.SelectionRevision)
            Return Finish(model, issues)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ReadNumeric(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                      issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), path As String,
                                      ByRef value As Double, ByRef missing As Boolean, ByRef invalid As Boolean)
            Dim eval As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                eval = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell.ToCellValue(), policy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, path)
                invalid = True
                Return
            End Try
            If eval.IsError AndAlso policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.cell-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Error cell cannot be a model value.", path)
                invalid = True
            ElseIf eval.IsMissing Then
                missing = True
            ElseIf Not eval.HasNumericValue Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "A numeric cell is required.", path)
                invalid = True
            Else
                value = eval.NumericValue
            End If
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function ReadCategory(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                             ignoreCase As Boolean, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue),
                                             ByRef missing As Boolean, ByRef invalid As Boolean) As SpreadsheetCategoryValue
            Dim eval As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                eval = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell.ToCellValue(), policy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End Try
            If eval.IsError AndAlso policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.cell-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Error cell cannot be a category.", "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End If
            If eval.IsMissing Then
                missing = True
                Return Nothing
            End If
            Try
                Return New SpreadsheetCategoryValue(cell.ToCellValue(), ignoreCase)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.category-invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End Try
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Reorthogonalized MGS for preflight rank diagnostics, not a model fit.</summary>
        Private Shared Function EstimateRank(design As Double(,)) As Integer
            Dim n As Integer = design.GetLength(0)
            Dim p As Integer = design.GetLength(1)
            Dim maxNorm As Double = 0.0R
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim ss As Double = 0.0R
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    ss += design(r, c) * design(r, c)
                Next
                maxNorm = Math.Max(maxNorm, Math.Sqrt(ss))
            Next
            Dim tolerance As Double = maxNorm * 0.0000000001R
            Dim vectors As New List(Of Double())()
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim v(n - 1) As Double
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    v(r) = design(r, c)
                Next
                For pass As Integer = 1 To 2
                    For Each q As Double() In vectors
                        Dim dot As Double = 0.0R
                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                            dot += v(r) * q(r)
                        Next
                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                            v(r) -= dot * q(r)
                        Next
                    Next
                Next
                Dim sum As Double = 0.0R
                For Each number As Double In v
                    sum += number * number
                Next
                Dim norm As Double = Math.Sqrt(sum)
                If norm > tolerance Then
                    For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                        v(r) /= norm
                    Next
                    vectors.Add(v)
                End If
            Next
            Return vectors.Count
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell,
                               code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                               message As String, path As String)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, path,
                If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedColumn),
                If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetColumn)))
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function HasErrors(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            Return issues.Any(Function(issue) issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error])
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Finish(data As SpreadsheetModelInput, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetModelInput)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetModelInput)(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

            Dim numericRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim typedRows As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue())()
            Dim responses As New List(Of Double)()
            For r As Integer = 0 To frame.RowCount - 1

                Dim responseValue As Double = 0.0R
                Dim rowMissing As Boolean = False
                Dim rowInvalid As Boolean = False
                ReadNumeric(responseCell, config.CellPolicy, issues, "response", responseValue, rowMissing, rowInvalid)

                Dim typed(predictors.Count - 1) As SpreadsheetCategoryValue
                For p As Integer = 0 To predictors.Count - 1

                        Dim invalid As Boolean = False

                        rowInvalid = rowInvalid OrElse invalid

                        Dim invalid As Boolean = False

                    Dim encountered As New List(Of SpreadsheetModelCategoryLevel)()
                    For ix As Integer = 0 To observed.Count - 1
                        Dim category As SpreadsheetCategoryValue = observed(ix)
                        Dim code As Double = If(allNumeric, category.NumberValue,
                            If(allBoolean, If(category.BooleanValue, 1.0R, 0.0R), CDbl(ix + 1)))
                        codes.Add(category.Key, code)
                        encountered.Add(New SpreadsheetModelCategoryLevel(category, code))

                    Next

                        raw(i, p) = numericRows(i)(p)
                    Next

                If Not Global.BESHStatNG.RegressionFormulaDesignService.TryBuildExpandedPredictorMatrixFromFormula(

        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ReadNumeric(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                      issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), path As String,
                                      ByRef value As Double, ByRef missing As Boolean, ByRef invalid As Boolean)
            Dim eval As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                eval = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell.ToCellValue(), policy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, path)
                invalid = True
                Return
            End Try
            If eval.IsError AndAlso policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.cell-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Error cell cannot be a model value.", path)
                invalid = True
            ElseIf eval.IsMissing Then
                missing = True
            ElseIf Not eval.HasNumericValue Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "A numeric cell is required.", path)
                invalid = True
            Else
                value = eval.NumericValue
            End If
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function ReadCategory(cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell, policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                             ignoreCase As Boolean, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue),
                                             ByRef missing As Boolean, ByRef invalid As Boolean) As SpreadsheetCategoryValue
            Dim eval As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                eval = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell.ToCellValue(), policy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End Try
            If eval.IsError AndAlso policy.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then
                Add(issues, cell, "model.cell-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], "Error cell cannot be a category.", "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End If
            If eval.IsMissing Then
                missing = True
                Return Nothing
            End If
            Try
                Return New SpreadsheetCategoryValue(cell.ToCellValue(), ignoreCase)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Add(issues, cell, "model.category-invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], ex.Message, "predictors")
                invalid = True
                Return Nothing
            End Try
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Reorthogonalized MGS for preflight rank diagnostics, not a model fit.</summary>
        Private Shared Function EstimateRank(design As Double(,)) As Integer
            Dim n As Integer = design.GetLength(0)
            Dim p As Integer = design.GetLength(1)
            Dim maxNorm As Double = 0.0R
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim ss As Double = 0.0R
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    ss += design(r, c) * design(r, c)
                Next
                maxNorm = Math.Max(maxNorm, Math.Sqrt(ss))
            Next
            Dim tolerance As Double = maxNorm * 0.0000000001R
            Dim vectors As New List(Of Double())()
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim v(n - 1) As Double
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    v(r) = design(r, c)
                Next
                For pass As Integer = 1 To 2
                    For Each q As Double() In vectors
                        Dim dot As Double = 0.0R
                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                            dot += v(r) * q(r)
                        Next
                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                            v(r) -= dot * q(r)
                        Next
                    Next
                Next
                Dim sum As Double = 0.0R
                For Each number As Double In v
                    sum += number * number
                Next
                Dim norm As Double = Math.Sqrt(sum)
                If norm > tolerance Then
                    For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                        v(r) /= norm
                    Next
                    vectors.Add(v)
                End If
            Next
            Return vectors.Count
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), cell As SpreadsheetFrameCell,
                               code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                               message As String, path As String)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, severity, message, path,
                If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.SelectedColumn),
                If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetRow), If(cell Is Nothing, 0, cell.WorksheetColumn)))
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function HasErrors(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            Return issues.Any(Function(issue) issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error])
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Finish(data As SpreadsheetModelInput, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetModelInput)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetModelInput)(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function
    End Class

Private Shared Function EstimateRank(design As Double(,)) As Integer
            Dim n As Integer = design.GetLength(0)
            Dim p As Integer = design.GetLength(1)
            Dim maxNorm As Double = 0.0R
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim ss As Double = 0.0R
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    ss += design(r, c) * design(r, c)
                Next
                maxNorm = Math.Max(maxNorm, Math.Sqrt(ss))
            Next
            Dim tolerance As Double = maxNorm * 0.0000000001R
            Dim vectors As New List(Of Double())()
            For c As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim v(n - 1) As Double
                For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    v(r) = design(r, c)

                For pass As Integer = 1 To 2
                    For Each q As Double() In vectors
                        Dim dot As Double = 0.0R
                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                            dot += v(r) * q(r)

                        For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1

                        Next
                    Next

                Dim sum As Double = 0.0R
                For Each number As Double In v

                If norm > tolerance Then
                    For r As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                        v(r) /= norm
                    Next
                    vectors.Add(v)
                End If
            Next
            Return vectors.Count

    ''' <summary>Immutable complete blocks. Each cell carries its own original position.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetNumericBlocks
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Private ReadOnly _names As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Private ReadOnly _blocks As IReadOnlyList(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
        Public Sub New(names As IEnumerable(Of String), blocks As IEnumerable(Of IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)))
            _names = Array.AsReadOnly(names.ToArray())
            Dim copied As New List(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            For Each block In blocks
                Dim cells = block.ToArray()
                If cells.Length <> _names.Count OrElse cells.Any(Function(c) c Is Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid block.")
                copied.Add(Array.AsReadOnly(cells))
            Next
            _blocks = copied.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Names As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
            Get
                Return _names
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Blocks As IReadOnlyList(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            Get
                Return _blocks
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Matrix As Double(,)
            Get
                Dim values(_blocks.Count - 1, _names.Count - 1) As Double
                For r = 0 To _blocks.Count - 1
                    For c = 0 To _names.Count - 1
                        values(r, c) = _blocks(r)(c).Value
                    Next
                Next
                Return values
            End Get
        End Property

    ''' <summary>Alignment/complete-observation policy only. Acquisition and statistics remain with their owners.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PairedBlockInputPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), code As String, message As String,
                                 Optional row As Integer = 0, Optional col As Integer = 0, Optional physicalRow As Integer = 0,
                                 Optional physicalCol As Integer = 0, Optional warning As Boolean = False)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, If(warning, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error),
                       message, If(row > 0, $"input.rows[{row}].cells[{col}]", "input"), row, col, physicalRow, physicalCol))
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function Shape(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer), issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Rows Is Nothing OrElse input.RowCount < 1 OrElse input.ColumnCount < 1 OrElse
                input.Rows.Count <> input.RowCount OrElse input.Rows.Any(Function(r) r Is Nothing OrElse r.Count <> input.ColumnCount) Then
                Issue(issues, "alignment.shape", "A nonempty rectangular input is required.")
                Return False
            End If
            If rowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso (rowIds.Count <> input.RowCount OrElse rowIds.Any(Function(r) r < 1) OrElse rowIds.Distinct().Count() <> rowIds.Count) Then
                Issue(issues, "alignment.row-ids", "Source row IDs must be positive, unique and match the captured rows.")
                Return False
            End If
            Return True
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Physical(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, rows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer), index As Integer) As Integer
            Return If(rows IsNot Nothing, rows(index), If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + index, 0))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParsePairs(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetPairedParseOptions,
                                          Optional rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, rowIds, issues) Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            Dim parsed = TypedNumericRangeParsers.ParsePaired(input, options)
            For Each i In parsed.Validation.Issues
                issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(i.Code, i.Severity, i.Message, i.FieldPath, i.SelectedRow, i.SelectedColumn,
                    If(i.SelectedRow > 0, Physical(input, rowIds, i.SelectedRow - 1), i.WorksheetRow), i.WorksheetColumn))
            Next
            If Not parsed.Success Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            Dim pairs As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericPair)
            For Each p In parsed.Data.Pairs
                pairs.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericPair(Remap(p.First, input, rowIds), Remap(p.Second, input, rowIds)))
            Next
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(New SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput(parsed.Data.FirstName, parsed.Data.SecondName, pairs), New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Remap(o As SpreadsheetNumericObservation, input As SpreadsheetRangeData, rows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer)) As SpreadsheetNumericObservation
            Return New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(o.Value, o.SelectedRow, o.SelectedColumn, Physical(input, rows, o.SelectedRow - 1), o.WorksheetColumn)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseBlocks(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetBlockParseOptions,
                                           Optional rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing,
                                           Optional names As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, rowIds, issues) Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            If options Is Nothing OrElse options.MinimumBlocks < 1 OrElse options.MinimumTreatments < 1 OrElse
                Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy), options.Missing) OrElse
                (options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None AndAlso options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required) Then
                Issue(issues, "blocks.options", "Explicit None/Required headers and valid complete-block options are required.")
                Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            End If
            If input.ColumnCount < options.MinimumTreatments Then Issue(issues, "blocks.treatments", "Too few treatment columns.")
            Dim labels As New List(Of String)
            For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                labels.Add(If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso names.Count = input.ColumnCount, names(c), "Series" & (c + 1).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
                If options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then
                    Dim cell = input.Rows(0)(c)
                    If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind <> SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell.TextValue) Then
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.header", "An explicit text treatment header is required.", 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, 0))
                    Else
                        labels(c) = cell.TextValue
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            If names IsNot Nothing AndAlso names.Count <> input.ColumnCount Then Issue(issues, "blocks.names", "Treatment labels do not match columns.")
            If options.RequireUniqueNames AndAlso labels.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> labels.Count Then Issue(issues, "blocks.duplicate-name", "Treatment labels must be unique.")
            Dim blocks As New List(Of IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            For r = If(options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim cells As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)
                Dim incomplete As Boolean = False
                For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                    Dim physicalCol = If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0)
                    Try
                        Dim value = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(input.Rows(r)(c), options.CellPolicy)
                        If value.IsMissing Then
                            incomplete = True
                        ElseIf value.IsError OrElse Not value.HasNumericValue Then
                            Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", "A permitted finite numeric value is required.", r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)
                            incomplete = True
                        Else
                            cells.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(value.NumericValue, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol))
                        End If
                    Catch ex As ArgumentException
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", ex.Message, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)
                        incomplete = True
                    End Try
                Next
                If incomplete Then
                    Issue(issues, If(options.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip, "blocks.incomplete-skipped", "blocks.incomplete"),
                          "The entire incomplete block is excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(input, rowIds, r), warning:=options.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip)
                Else
                    blocks.Add(cells)
                End If
            Next
            If blocks.Count < options.MinimumBlocks Then Issue(issues, "blocks.too-few", "Too few complete blocks.")
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(If(report.HasErrors, Nothing, New SpreadsheetNumericBlocks(labels, blocks)), report)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Physical row identity requires explicit, equal workbook and worksheet identity.</summary>
        Public Shared Function AlignRows(first As SpreadsheetRangeData, firstRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                         second As SpreadsheetRangeData, secondRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                         Optional firstKeys As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing,
                                         Optional secondKeys As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRowAlignment)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Dim valid = Shape(first, firstRows, issues)
            valid = Shape(second, secondRows, issues) AndAlso valid
            If valid Then
                If first.ColumnCount <> second.ColumnCount Then Issue(issues, "alignment.columns", "Paired matrices require the same number of columns.")
                Dim keyed = firstKeys IsNot Nothing OrElse secondKeys IsNot Nothing
                If Not keyed AndAlso (firstRows Is Nothing OrElse secondRows Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrEmpty(first.WorkbookId) OrElse
                    String.IsNullOrEmpty(first.WorksheetId) OrElse first.WorkbookId <> second.WorkbookId OrElse first.WorksheetId <> second.WorksheetId) Then
                    Issue(issues, "alignment.identity", "Physical-row pairing requires verified equal workbook/worksheet identities and row IDs.")
                End If
                If keyed AndAlso (Not ValidKeys(firstKeys, first.RowCount) OrElse Not ValidKeys(secondKeys, second.RowCount)) Then
                    Issue(issues, "alignment.keys", "Both explicit subject-key lists must be complete, unique and match their selections.")
                End If
                If Not New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then
                    Dim lookup As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    For r = 0 To second.RowCount - 1
                        lookup.Add(If(keyed, secondKeys(r), secondRows(r).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), r + 1)
                    Next
                    Dim a As New List(Of Integer), b As New List(Of Integer)
                    For r = 0 To first.RowCount - 1
                        Dim k = If(keyed, firstKeys(r), firstRows(r).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                        If lookup.ContainsKey(k) Then
                            a.Add(r + 1) : b.Add(lookup(k))
                        Else
                            Issue(issues, "alignment.unmatched-first", "Unmatched first-selection row excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(first, firstRows, r), warning:=True)
                        End If
                    Next
                    For r = 0 To second.RowCount - 1
                        If Not b.Contains(r + 1) Then Issue(issues, "alignment.unmatched-second", "Unmatched second-selection row excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(second, secondRows, r), warning:=True)
                    Next
                    If a.Count > 0 Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRowAlignment)(New SpreadsheetRowAlignment(a, b), New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))

            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, rowIds, issues) Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            If options Is Nothing OrElse options.MinimumBlocks < 1 OrElse options.MinimumTreatments < 1 OrElse
                Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy), options.Missing) OrElse
                (options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None AndAlso options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required) Then
                Issue(issues, "blocks.options", "Explicit None/Required headers and valid complete-block options are required.")
                Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            End If
            If input.ColumnCount < options.MinimumTreatments Then Issue(issues, "blocks.treatments", "Too few treatment columns.")
            Dim labels As New List(Of String)
            For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                labels.Add(If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso names.Count = input.ColumnCount, names(c), "Series" & (c + 1).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
                If options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then
                    Dim cell = input.Rows(0)(c)
                    If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind <> SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell.TextValue) Then
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.header", "An explicit text treatment header is required.", 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, 0))
                    Else

                    End If

            Next

            If options.RequireUniqueNames AndAlso labels.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> labels.Count Then Issue(issues, "blocks.duplicate-name", "Treatment labels must be unique.")
            Dim blocks As New List(Of IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            For r = If(options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim cells As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)
                Dim incomplete As Boolean = False
                For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                    Dim physicalCol = If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0)
                    Try
                        Dim value = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(input.Rows(r)(c), options.CellPolicy)
                        If value.IsMissing Then
                            incomplete = True
                        ElseIf value.IsError OrElse Not value.HasNumericValue Then
                            Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", "A permitted finite numeric value is required.", r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)
                            incomplete = True
                        Else
                            cells.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(value.NumericValue, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol))
                        End If
                    Catch ex As ArgumentException
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", ex.Message, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)

                          "The entire incomplete block is excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(input, rowIds, r), warning:=options.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip)
                Else
                    blocks.Add(cells)
                End If
            Next
            If blocks.Count < options.MinimumBlocks Then Issue(issues, "blocks.too-few", "Too few complete blocks.")

            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(If(report.HasErrors, Nothing, New SpreadsheetNumericBlocks(labels, blocks)), report)

        ''' <summary>Physical row identity requires explicit, equal workbook and worksheet identity.</summary>
        Public Shared Function AlignRows(first As SpreadsheetRangeData, firstRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                         second As SpreadsheetRangeData, secondRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                         Optional firstKeys As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing,
                                         Optional secondKeys As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRowAlignment)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Dim valid = Shape(first, firstRows, issues)
            valid = Shape(second, secondRows, issues) AndAlso valid
            If valid Then
                If first.ColumnCount <> second.ColumnCount Then Issue(issues, "alignment.columns", "Paired matrices require the same number of columns.")
                Dim keyed = firstKeys IsNot Nothing OrElse secondKeys IsNot Nothing
                If Not keyed AndAlso (firstRows Is Nothing OrElse secondRows Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrEmpty(first.WorkbookId) OrElse
                    String.IsNullOrEmpty(first.WorksheetId) OrElse first.WorkbookId <> second.WorkbookId OrElse first.WorksheetId <> second.WorksheetId) Then
                    Issue(issues, "alignment.identity", "Physical-row pairing requires verified equal workbook/worksheet identities and row IDs.")
                End If
                If keyed AndAlso (Not ValidKeys(firstKeys, first.RowCount) OrElse Not ValidKeys(secondKeys, second.RowCount)) Then
                    Issue(issues, "alignment.keys", "Both explicit subject-key lists must be complete, unique and match their selections.")
                End If
                If Not New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues).HasErrors Then
                    Dim lookup As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    For r = 0 To second.RowCount - 1
                        lookup.Add(If(keyed, secondKeys(r), secondRows(r).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), r + 1)
                    Next
                    Dim a As New List(Of Integer), b As New List(Of Integer)
                    For r = 0 To first.RowCount - 1
                        Dim k = If(keyed, firstKeys(r), firstRows(r).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                        If lookup.ContainsKey(k) Then
                            a.Add(r + 1) : b.Add(lookup(k))
                        Else
                            Issue(issues, "alignment.unmatched-first", "Unmatched first-selection row excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(first, firstRows, r), warning:=True)
                        End If
                    Next
                    For r = 0 To second.RowCount - 1
                        If Not b.Contains(r + 1) Then Issue(issues, "alignment.unmatched-second", "Unmatched second-selection row excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(second, secondRows, r), warning:=True)
                    Next
                    If a.Count > 0 Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRowAlignment)(New SpreadsheetRowAlignment(a, b), New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
                    Issue(issues, "alignment.empty", "No aligned observations remain.")
                End If
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetRowAlignment)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseBlocks(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetBlockParseOptions,
                                           Optional rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing,
                                           Optional names As IReadOnlyList(Of String) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, rowIds, issues) Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            If options Is Nothing OrElse options.MinimumBlocks < 1 OrElse options.MinimumTreatments < 1 OrElse
                Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy), options.Missing) OrElse
                (options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None AndAlso options.Header <> SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required) Then
                Issue(issues, "blocks.options", "Explicit None/Required headers and valid complete-block options are required.")
                Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            End If
            If input.ColumnCount < options.MinimumTreatments Then Issue(issues, "blocks.treatments", "Too few treatment columns.")
            Dim labels As New List(Of String)
            For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                labels.Add(If(names IsNot Nothing AndAlso names.Count = input.ColumnCount, names(c), "Series" & (c + 1).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
                If options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then
                    Dim cell = input.Rows(0)(c)
                    If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind <> SpreadsheetCellKind.Text OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell.TextValue) Then
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.header", "An explicit text treatment header is required.", 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, 0))
                    Else
                        labels(c) = cell.TextValue
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            If names IsNot Nothing AndAlso names.Count <> input.ColumnCount Then Issue(issues, "blocks.names", "Treatment labels do not match columns.")
            If options.RequireUniqueNames AndAlso labels.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> labels.Count Then Issue(issues, "blocks.duplicate-name", "Treatment labels must be unique.")
            Dim blocks As New List(Of IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            For r = If(options.Header = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required, 1, 0) To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim cells As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)
                Dim incomplete As Boolean = False
                For c = 0 To input.ColumnCount - 1
                    Dim physicalCol = If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0)
                    Try
                        Dim value = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(input.Rows(r)(c), options.CellPolicy)
                        If value.IsMissing Then
                            incomplete = True
                        ElseIf value.IsError OrElse Not value.HasNumericValue Then
                            Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", "A permitted finite numeric value is required.", r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)
                            incomplete = True
                        Else
                            cells.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(value.NumericValue, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol))
                        End If
                    Catch ex As ArgumentException
                        Issue(issues, "blocks.numeric", ex.Message, r + 1, c + 1, Physical(input, rowIds, r), physicalCol)
                        incomplete = True
                    End Try
                Next
                If incomplete Then
                    Issue(issues, If(options.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip, "blocks.incomplete-skipped", "blocks.incomplete"),
                          "The entire incomplete block is excluded.", r + 1, 0, Physical(input, rowIds, r), warning:=options.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip)
                Else
                    blocks.Add(cells)
                End If
            Next
            If blocks.Count < options.MinimumBlocks Then Issue(issues, "blocks.too-few", "Too few complete blocks.")
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNumericBlocks)(If(report.HasErrors, Nothing, New SpreadsheetNumericBlocks(labels, blocks)), report)
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseNested(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                           Optional missing As SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNestedInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, rowIds, issues) Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNestedInput)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            If input.ColumnCount < 3 Then
                Issue(issues, "nested.roles", "Group, nested group and response columns are required.")
                Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNestedInput)(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            End If
            Dim numeric As New SpreadsheetRangeData With {.RowCount = input.RowCount, .ColumnCount = input.ColumnCount - 2, .StartRow = input.StartRow}
            Dim groups As New List(Of String), nested As New List(Of String)
            For r = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                Dim g = Label(input.Rows(r)(0)), n = Label(input.Rows(r)(1))
                groups.Add(g) : nested.Add(n)
                Dim cells = input.Rows(r).Skip(2).ToList()
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n) Then
                    Issue(issues, "nested.missing-label", "Missing group/nested label; the entire observation is excluded.", r + 1, If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g), 1, 2), Physical(input, rowIds, r), warning:=missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Skip)
                    cells(0) = SpreadsheetCellValue.BlankCell()
                End If
                numeric.Rows.Add(cells)
            Next
            Dim parsed = ParseBlocks(numeric, New SpreadsheetBlockParseOptions With {.MinimumTreatments = 1, .Missing = missing}, rowIds)
            issues.AddRange(parsed.Validation.Issues)
            Dim report As New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            If Not parsed.Success OrElse report.HasErrors Then Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNestedInput)(Nothing, report)
            ' Restore original response column positions; labels are a hierarchical pair, never a global subgroup key.
            Dim mapped As New List(Of IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation))
            Dim keptGroups As New List(Of String), keptNested As New List(Of String)
            For Each block In parsed.Data.Blocks
                Dim r = block(0).SelectedRow - 1
                keptGroups.Add(groups(r)) : keptNested.Add(nested(r))
                mapped.Add(block.Select(Function(o) New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(o.Value, o.SelectedRow, o.SelectedColumn + 2, o.WorksheetRow, If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + o.SelectedColumn + 1, 0))))
            Next
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetNestedInput)(New SpreadsheetNestedInput(keptGroups, keptNested, New SpreadsheetNumericBlocks(parsed.Data.Names, mapped)), report)
        End Function

Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public Enum PairedDifferenceDirection
        FirstMinusSecond = 0
        SecondMinusFirst = 1
    End Enum
    Public Enum PairedAlternative
        TwoSided = 0
        Less = 1
        Greater = 2
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>Numeric request validation; host cultures and control state are captured by the caller.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class PairedOptionPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Validate(alpha As Double, alternative As PairedAlternative, direction As PairedDifferenceDirection) As SpreadsheetValidationReport
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Finite(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1 Then Add(issues, "paired.alpha", "Alpha must be finite and strictly between zero and one.", "options.alpha")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(PairedAlternative), alternative) Then Add(issues, "paired.alternative", "Unknown alternative.", "options.alternative")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(PairedDifferenceDirection), direction) Then Add(issues, "paired.direction", "Unknown difference direction.", "options.direction")
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ValidateLimits(enabled As Boolean, lower As Double, upper As Double) As SpreadsheetValidationReport
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If enabled Then
                If Not Finite(lower) OrElse Not Finite(upper) Then
                    Add(issues, "bland.limits.finite", "Acceptable limits must be finite.", "options.limits")
                ElseIf lower > upper Then
                    Add(issues, "bland.limits.order", "The lower acceptable limit must not exceed the upper acceptable limit.", "options.limits")
                End If
            End If
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Exact legacy UI fallback/precedence, with no fitting or unit conversion.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ProjectBland(modeIndex As Integer, scaleIndex As Integer, bootstrap As Boolean, bca As Boolean, jackknife As Boolean) As Agreement.BlandAltmanOptions
            Return New Agreement.BlandAltmanOptions With {
                .Mode = If(modeIndex = 1, Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.SimplePairs, If(modeIndex = 2, Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.RepeatedBySubject, Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.Auto)),
                .Scale = If(scaleIndex >= 0 AndAlso scaleIndex <= 4, CType(scaleIndex, Agreement.BlandAltmanScale), Agreement.BlandAltmanScale.RawDifference),
                .CiMethod = If(bootstrap, Agreement.AgreementCiMethod.BootstrapPercentile, If(bca, Agreement.AgreementCiMethod.BootstrapBCa, If(jackknife, Agreement.AgreementCiMethod.Jackknife, Agreement.AgreementCiMethod.Analytical)))
            }
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ValidateBland(options As Agreement.BlandAltmanOptions, x As IReadOnlyList(Of Double), y As IReadOnlyList(Of Double)) As SpreadsheetValidationReport
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If options Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing OrElse y Is Nothing OrElse x.Count = 0 OrElse x.Count <> y.Count Then
                Add(issues, "bland.shape", "Matching nonempty paired values and options are required.", "input")
                Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
            End If
            issues.AddRange(Validate(options.Alpha, PairedAlternative.TwoSided, PairedDifferenceDirection.SecondMinusFirst).Issues)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(Agreement.BlandAltmanScale), options.Scale) Then Add(issues, "bland.scale", "Unknown scale.", "options.scale")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode), options.Mode) Then Add(issues, "bland.mode", "Unknown mode.", "options.mode")
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(Agreement.AgreementCiMethod), options.CiMethod) Then Add(issues, "bland.ci", "Unknown interval method.", "options.ci")
            If options.SubjectIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.SubjectIds.Length <> x.Count Then Add(issues, "bland.subjects", "Subject IDs must match the paired observations.", "options.subjectIds")
            If options.Mode = Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.RepeatedBySubject AndAlso options.SubjectIds Is Nothing AndAlso Not options.AllowFallbackToSimple Then Add(issues, "bland.subjects.required", "Repeated mode requires subject IDs when fallback is disabled.", "options.subjectIds")
            For i = 0 To x.Count - 1
                Dim requiresSubject = options.Mode = Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.RepeatedBySubject OrElse
                    (options.Mode = Agreement.RepeatedBlandAltmanMode.Auto AndAlso options.SubjectIds IsNot Nothing)
                If requiresSubject AndAlso options.SubjectIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso options.SubjectIds.Length = x.Count Then
                    Dim subject = options.SubjectIds(i)
                    If subject Is Nothing OrElse Convert.IsDBNull(subject) OrElse
                        (TypeOf subject Is String AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DirectCast(subject, String))) Then
                        issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("bland.subject.filtered", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, "Missing-subject whole pair is filtered by the engine before scale transformation.", "input.pairs", i + 1))
                        Continue For
                    End If
                End If
                ' The authoritative engine filters nonfinite whole pairs before transforming.
                If Not Finite(x(i)) OrElse Not Finite(y(i)) Then
                    issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("bland.pair.filtered", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning, "Nonfinite whole pair is filtered by the engine.", "input.pairs", i + 1))
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim invalid As Boolean = False
                Select Case options.Scale
                    Case Agreement.BlandAltmanScale.PercentOfMean : invalid = invalid OrElse (x(i) + y(i)) * 0.5 = 0
                    Case Agreement.BlandAltmanScale.PercentOfReference : invalid = invalid OrElse x(i) = 0
                    Case Agreement.BlandAltmanScale.PercentOfTest : invalid = invalid OrElse y(i) = 0
                    Case Agreement.BlandAltmanScale.LogRatio : invalid = invalid OrElse x(i) <= 0 OrElse y(i) <= 0
                End Select
                If invalid Then issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("bland.scale.domain", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, "Paired values are outside the active scale's domain.", "input.pairs", i + 1))
            Next
            Return New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub Add(issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), code As String, message As String, field As String)
            issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, message, field))
        End Sub
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetFrameCell
        Public Sub New(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, selectedRow As Integer, selectedColumn As Integer,
                       worksheetRow As Integer, worksheetColumn As Integer)
            If selectedRow < 1 OrElse selectedColumn < 1 OrElse worksheetRow < 0 OrElse worksheetColumn < 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(selectedRow))
            End If
            Dim value As SpreadsheetCellValue = If(cell, SpreadsheetCellValue.BlankCell())
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetCellKind), value.Kind) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unknown cell kind.", NameOf(cell))
            If value.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Number AndAlso (Double.IsNaN(value.NumberValue) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value.NumberValue)) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Non-finite spreadsheet number.", NameOf(cell))
            End If
            Me.Kind = value.Kind
            Me.NumberValue = value.NumberValue
            Me.TextValue = If(value.TextValue, String.Empty)
            Me.BooleanValue = value.BooleanValue
            Me.NumberFormat = If(value.NumberFormat, String.Empty)
            Me.NativeErrorCode = If(value.NativeErrorCode, String.Empty)
            Me.SelectedRow = selectedRow
            Me.SelectedColumn = selectedColumn
            Me.WorksheetRow = worksheetRow
            Me.WorksheetColumn = worksheetColumn
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As SpreadsheetCellKind
        Public ReadOnly Property NumberValue As Double
        Public ReadOnly Property TextValue As String
        Public ReadOnly Property BooleanValue As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property NumberFormat As String
        Public ReadOnly Property NativeErrorCode As String
        Public ReadOnly Property SelectedRow As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property SelectedColumn As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetRow As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetColumn As Integer
        Public Function ToCellValue() As SpreadsheetCellValue
            Return New SpreadsheetCellValue With {.Kind = Kind, .NumberValue = NumberValue,
                .TextValue = TextValue, .BooleanValue = BooleanValue, .NumberFormat = NumberFormat,
                .NativeErrorCode = NativeErrorCode}
        End Function

    ''' <summary>Typed, defensively copied rectangle. Data rows exclude an optional heading row.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetRectangularDataFrameInput
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Private ReadOnly _columns As ReadOnlyCollection(Of SpreadsheetFrameColumn)
        Private ReadOnly _rows As ReadOnlyCollection(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell))

        Public Sub New(columns As IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetFrameColumn), rows As IEnumerable(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)),
                       workbookName As String, worksheetName As String, worksheetId As String,
                       Optional workbookId As String = Nothing, Optional sourceAddress As String = Nothing,
                       Optional selectionId As String = Nothing, Optional selectionRevision As String = Nothing,
                       Optional dateSystem As SpreadsheetDateSystem = SpreadsheetDateSystem.Unknown)
            If columns Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columns))
            If rows Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(rows))
            Dim columnCopy As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameColumn)(columns)
            If columnCopy.Count = 0 OrElse columnCopy.Contains(Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid columns.", NameOf(columns))
            Dim rowCopy As New List(Of IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell))()
            For Each row As IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell) In rows
                If row Is Nothing OrElse row.Count <> columnCopy.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid frame row width.", NameOf(rows))
                Dim item As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)(row)
                If item.Contains(Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Frame cells cannot be null.", NameOf(rows))
                rowCopy.Add(item.AsReadOnly())
            Next
            _columns = columnCopy.AsReadOnly()
            _rows = rowCopy.AsReadOnly()
            Me.WorkbookId = If(workbookId, String.Empty)
            Me.SourceAddress = If(sourceAddress, String.Empty)
            Me.SelectionId = If(selectionId, String.Empty)
            Me.SelectionRevision = If(selectionRevision, String.Empty)
            Me.DateSystem = dateSystem
            Me.WorkbookName = If(workbookName, String.Empty)
            Me.WorksheetName = If(worksheetName, String.Empty)
            Me.WorksheetId = If(worksheetId, String.Empty)
        End Sub

            If rowLevels Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(rowLevels))
            If columnLevels Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columnLevels))
            If counts Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(counts))
            Dim rr As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue)(rowLevels)
            Dim cc As New List(Of SpreadsheetCategoryValue)(columnLevels)
            If rr.Count = 0 OrElse cc.Count = 0 OrElse rr.Contains(Nothing) OrElse cc.Contains(Nothing) OrElse counts.Length <> rr.Count Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Contingency matrix dimensions are inconsistent.", NameOf(counts))
            End If
            Dim copiedCounts(rr.Count - 1)() As Long
            _counts = copiedCounts
            Dim total As Long = 0
            For r As Integer = 0 To rr.Count - 1
                If counts(r) Is Nothing OrElse counts(r).Length <> cc.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Contingency matrix is not rectangular.", NameOf(counts))
                _counts(r) = DirectCast(counts(r).Clone(), Long())
                For Each count As Long In _counts(r)
                    If count < 0 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(counts), "Negative counts are invalid.")
                    total = CheckedAdd(total, count)
                Next
            Next

            _columnLevels = cc.AsReadOnly()
