Public Shared Function Apply(catalog As IEnumerable(Of String), selectedIndices As IEnumerable(Of Integer),
                                     existing As RegressionEffectModel, operation As RegressionEffectOperation,
                                     Optional degree As Integer = 2, Optional maximumEffects As Integer = Integer.MaxValue,
                                     Optional limits As RegressionEffectAuthoringLimits = Nothing) As RegressionEffectResult
            Dim model = If(existing, New RegressionEffectModel())
            Dim effects = model.Effects.ToList()
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            Dim vars = If(catalog, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()).ToList()
            Dim indices = If(selectedIndices, Enumerable.Empty(Of Integer)()).Distinct().OrderBy(Function(i) i).ToList()
            If operation = RegressionEffectOperation.Polynomial AndAlso degree < 2 Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("degree", "Polynomial degree must be >= 2."))
                Return New RegressionEffectResult(model, issues)
            End If
            Dim interaction = operation = RegressionEffectOperation.PairwiseInteractions OrElse operation = RegressionEffectOperation.CustomInteraction
            If indices.Count < If(interaction, 2, 1) Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("selection", If(interaction, "Please select at least two variables.", "Please select variable(s).")))
                Return New RegressionEffectResult(model, issues)
            End If
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(RegressionEffectOperation), operation) OrElse maximumEffects < 0 Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("operation", "Invalid authoring operation or budget."))
                Return New RegressionEffectResult(model, issues)
            End If
            If limits IsNot Nothing AndAlso (vars.Count > limits.MaximumCatalogSize OrElse
                vars.Any(Function(k) k IsNot Nothing AndAlso k.Length > limits.MaximumKeyLength) OrElse
                (operation = RegressionEffectOperation.CustomInteraction AndAlso indices.Count > limits.MaximumInteractionWidth) OrElse
                (operation = RegressionEffectOperation.Polynomial AndAlso degree > limits.MaximumDegree)) Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("input-budget", "Authoring input budget exceeded."))
                Return New RegressionEffectResult(model, issues)
            End If
            Dim selected As New List(Of String)
            For Each i In indices
                If i < 0 OrElse i >= vars.Count OrElse vars(i) Is Nothing OrElse vars(i).Length = 0 Then
                    issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("unknown-variable", "Selected variable is missing from the catalog."))
                Else
                    selected.Add(vars(i))
                End If
            Next
            ' A malformed interaction selection must not silently become a narrower interaction.
            If interaction AndAlso issues.Count > 0 Then Return New RegressionEffectResult(model, issues)
            For Each key In selected
                If interaction Then Exit For
                Dim termKey = key
                Dim kind = "MainEffect"
                Dim scale = PredictorScale.Continuous
                Dim label = RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(key)
                Dim categorical = HasCategorical(effects, key)
                Select Case operation
                    Case RegressionEffectOperation.ContinuousMain
                        If categorical Then
                            issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("categorical-conflict", "Variable '" & label & "' is already marked as categorical. Remove it first if you want to use it as continuous.", key, presentationSnapshot:=New RegressionEffectModel(effects, model.IncludeIntercept)))
                            Continue For
                        End If
                    Case RegressionEffectOperation.CategoricalMain
                        termKey = RegressionDesignCore.MakeCategoricalEffectKey(key)
                        If effects.Any(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys.Contains(key, StringComparer.Ordinal)) AndAlso Not categorical Then
                            issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("used-conflict", "Variable '" & label & "' is already used in the model. Remove its existing term(s) before adding it as categorical.", key, presentationSnapshot:=New RegressionEffectModel(effects, model.IncludeIntercept)))
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        scale = PredictorScale.Categorical
                    Case RegressionEffectOperation.Polynomial
                        If categorical Then
                            issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("categorical-polynomial", "Polynomial terms are not supported for categorical predictors.", key, presentationSnapshot:=New RegressionEffectModel(effects, model.IncludeIntercept)))
                            Continue For
                        End If
                        termKey = RegressionDesignCore.MakePolynomialEffectKey(key, degree)
                        kind = "Polynomial" : label &= "^" & degree.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End Select
                AddEffect(effects, termKey, New TermSpec With {.Kind = kind, .BaseVarKeys = New List(Of String) From {key},
                    .Degree = If(kind = "Polynomial", degree, 1), .DisplayNameForCoef = label, .Scale = scale}, issues, maximumEffects)
            Next
            If interaction Then
                If operation = RegressionEffectOperation.CustomInteraction Then
                    AddInteraction(effects, selected, issues, maximumEffects)
                Else
                    For a = 0 To selected.Count - 2
                        For b = a + 1 To selected.Count - 1
                            AddInteraction(effects, New List(Of String) From {selected(a), selected(b)}, issues, maximumEffects)
                        Next
                    Next
                End If
            End If
            Return New RegressionEffectResult(New RegressionEffectModel(effects, model.IncludeIntercept), issues, effects.Count <> model.Effects.Count)
        End Function

Private Shared Sub AddEffect(effects As List(Of RegressionAuthoredEffect), key As String, spec As TermSpec,
                                     issues As List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic), limit As Integer)
            If effects.Any(Function(e) String.Equals(e.Key, key, StringComparison.Ordinal)) Then Return
            If effects.Count >= limit Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("effect-budget", "Effect budget exceeded.", effectKey:=key)) : Return
            End If
            spec.Order = effects.Count
            effects.Add(New RegressionAuthoredEffect(key, spec))
        End Sub

Public Shared Function InspectHierarchy(model As RegressionEffectModel) As IReadOnlyList(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            If model Is Nothing Then Return issues.AsReadOnly()
            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim s = e.Spec
                If s Is Nothing OrElse s.Kind <> "Interaction" OrElse s.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing Then Continue For
                For Each key In s.BaseVarKeys
                    Dim present = model.Effects.Any(Function(p) p.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Spec.Kind = "MainEffect" AndAlso p.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Spec.BaseVarKeys.SequenceEqual({key}, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                    issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic(If(present, "parent-available", "parent-missing"),
                        If(present, "Parent main effect is available.", "Interaction has no parent main effect."), key, e.Key, RegressionEffectSeverity.Warning))

Public Shared Function Inspect(model As RegressionEffectModel, catalog As IEnumerable(Of String)) As IReadOnlyList(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            If model Is Nothing Then
                issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("model", "Model snapshot is required."))
                Return issues.AsReadOnly()
            End If
            Dim keys As New HashSet(Of String)(If(catalog, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()), StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For i = 0 To model.Effects.Count - 1
                Dim e = model.Effects(i), s = e.Spec
                If Not seen.Add(e.Key) Then issues.Add(New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("duplicate-effect", "Duplicate effect identity.", effectKey:=e.Key))
                If s Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys.Count = 0 Then

    ''' <summary>Version 1 typed serialization uses XML escaping, ordered effects/base keys, invariant
    ''' IEEE-754 double bits, explicit null lists/strings and a separate intercept flag. Only Core's
    ''' existing default treatment/reference coding is supported; no contrast inference is added.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class RegressionEffectSerialization
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Serialize(model As RegressionEffectModel) As String
            If model Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(model))
            Dim root As New XElement("regression-effects", New XAttribute("version", "1"),
                New XAttribute("intercept", If(model.IncludeIntercept, "true", "false")), New XAttribute("contrast", "core-default"))
            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim node As New XElement("effect", Text("key", e.Key)), s = e.Spec
                If s Is Nothing Then
                    node.Add(New XElement("spec", New XAttribute("null", "true")))
                Else
                    node.Add(New XElement("spec", Text("kind", s.Kind), Strings("bases", s.BaseVarKeys), Strings("display-bases", s.BaseVarDisplayNames),
                        Text("degree", s.Degree.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Text("label", s.DisplayNameForCoef),
                        Text("order", s.Order.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), Text("scale", CInt(s.Scale).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                        Text("reference", If(s.ReferenceValue.HasValue, DoubleBits(s.ReferenceValue.GetValueOrDefault()), Nothing)),
                        Strings("observed", If(s.ObservedLevels Is Nothing, Nothing, s.ObservedLevels.Select(Function(v) DoubleBits(v))))))
                End If
                root.Add(node)
            Next
            Return root.ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function TryDeserialize(serialized As String, ByRef model As RegressionEffectModel,
                                              ByRef diagnostic As RegressionEffectDiagnostic,
                                              Optional maximumCharacters As Integer = 4194304) As Boolean
            model = Nothing : diagnostic = Nothing
            Try
                If serialized Is Nothing OrElse serialized.Length > maximumCharacters OrElse serialized.IndexOf("<!", StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0 Then Throw New FormatException("Invalid serialized spec or size budget.")
                Dim root = XElement.Parse(serialized, LoadOptions.PreserveWhitespace)
                If root.Name <> "regression-effects" OrElse CStr(root.Attribute("version")) <> "1" OrElse CStr(root.Attribute("contrast")) <> "core-default" Then Throw New FormatException("Unsupported spec version or contrast.")
                Dim intercept = CStr(root.Attribute("intercept"))
                If intercept <> "true" AndAlso intercept <> "false" Then Throw New FormatException("Invalid intercept.")
                Dim effects As New List(Of RegressionAuthoredEffect)
                For Each node In root.Elements("effect")
                    Dim sn = node.Element("spec"), s As TermSpec = Nothing
                    If sn Is Nothing Then Throw New FormatException("Missing spec.")
                    If CStr(sn.Attribute("null")) <> "true" Then
                        Dim observed = ReadStrings(sn.Element("observed")), ref = ReadText(sn.Element("reference"))
                        s = New TermSpec With {.Kind = ReadText(sn.Element("kind")), .BaseVarKeys = ReadStrings(sn.Element("bases")),
                            .BaseVarDisplayNames = ReadStrings(sn.Element("display-bases")), .Degree = Integer.Parse(ReadText(sn.Element("degree")), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                            .DisplayNameForCoef = ReadText(sn.Element("label")), .Order = Integer.Parse(ReadText(sn.Element("order")), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                            .Scale = CType(Integer.Parse(ReadText(sn.Element("scale")), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), PredictorScale),
                            .ReferenceValue = If(ref Is Nothing, CType(Nothing, Nullable(Of Double)), ReadDoubleBits(ref)),
                            .ObservedLevels = If(observed Is Nothing, Nothing, observed.Select(Function(v) ReadDoubleBits(v)).ToList())}
                    End If
                    effects.Add(New RegressionAuthoredEffect(ReadText(node.Element("key")), s))
                Next
                Dim candidate As New RegressionEffectModel(effects, intercept = "true")
                ' Reject unknown fields and noncanonical input rather than silently discarding settings.
                If Serialize(candidate) <> serialized Then Throw New FormatException("Spec is not canonical version 1.")
                model = candidate : Return True
            Catch ex As Exception When TypeOf ex Is FormatException OrElse TypeOf ex Is ArgumentException OrElse TypeOf ex Is OverflowException OrElse TypeOf ex Is System.Xml.XmlException
                diagnostic = New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("serialization", "Invalid or unsupported canonical authoring spec.")
                Return False
            End Try
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Text(name As String, value As String) As XElement
            If value Is Nothing Then Return New XElement(name, New XAttribute("null", "true"))
            If value.IndexOf(Convert.ToChar(13)) >= 0 OrElse value.IndexOf(Convert.ToChar(10)) >= 0 Then Return EncodedText(name, value)
            Try
                System.Xml.XmlConvert.VerifyXmlChars(value)
                Return New XElement(name, value)
            Catch ex As System.Xml.XmlException
                Return EncodedText(name, value)
            End Try
        End Function
        Private Shared Function DoubleBits(value As Double) As String
            Return BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(value).ToString("X16", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ReadDoubleBits(value As String) As Double
            Return BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(Long.Parse(value, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
        End Function
        Private Shared Function EncodedText(name As String, value As String) As XElement
                ' Lossless .NET UTF-16 code units, even when XML 1.0 cannot carry the string.
                Dim bytes(value.Length * 2 - 1) As Byte
                For i = 0 To value.Length - 1
                    Dim unit = Convert.ToUInt16(value(i))
                    bytes(2 * i) = CByte(unit And 255) : bytes(2 * i + 1) = CByte(unit >> 8)
                Next
                Return New XElement(name, New XAttribute("encoding", "utf16le-base64"), Convert.ToBase64String(bytes))
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Strings(name As String, values As IEnumerable(Of String)) As XElement
            If values Is Nothing Then Return New XElement(name, New XAttribute("null", "true"))
            Return New XElement(name, values.Select(Function(v) Text("value", v)))
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ReadText(node As XElement) As String
            If node Is Nothing Then Throw New FormatException("Missing field.")
            If CStr(node.Attribute("encoding")) = "utf16le-base64" Then
                Dim bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(node.Value)
                If bytes.Length Mod 2 <> 0 Then Throw New FormatException("Invalid code-unit encoding.")
                Dim chars(bytes.Length \ 2 - 1) As Char
                For i = 0 To chars.Length - 1
                    chars(i) = Convert.ToChar(CUShort(CInt(bytes(2 * i)) Or (CInt(bytes(2 * i + 1)) << 8)))
                Next
                Return New String(chars)
            End If
            Return If(CStr(node.Attribute("null")) = "true", Nothing, node.Value)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ReadStrings(node As XElement) As List(Of String)
            If node Is Nothing Then Throw New FormatException("Missing field.")
            If CStr(node.Attribute("null")) = "true" Then Return Nothing
            Return node.Elements("value").Select(Function(n) ReadText(n)).ToList()
        End Function

        ''' <summary>RHS uses relative source-column tokens, avoiding name-based parser ambiguity.
        ''' The supplied ordered catalog is part of the projection contract, and must also be used
        ''' by the model-input compiler. Parser-normalized interaction ordering must be identical.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ProjectFormula(model As RegressionEffectModel, orderedCatalog As IEnumerable(Of String)) As RegressionEffectFormulaProjection
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)
            Dim keys = If(orderedCatalog, Enumerable.Empty(Of String)()).ToList()
            If model Is Nothing OrElse keys.Any(Function(k) k Is Nothing OrElse k.Length = 0) OrElse keys.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> keys.Count Then
                Return NotRepresentable("Invalid or ambiguous source catalog.")
            End If
            If model.Effects.Count = 0 Then Return NotRepresentable("Empty models require the explicit typed spec; blank RHS means all main effects in Core.")
            If keys.Any(Function(k) k.Trim() <> k) Then Return NotRepresentable("Core design integration trims raw keys; whitespace identity requires the typed spec.")
            If RegressionEffectAuthoringPolicy.Inspect(model, keys).Count > 0 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid or incomplete term metadata; inspect the typed spec.")
            If model.Effects.Select(Function(e) e.Key).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> model.Effects.Count Then Return NotRepresentable("Duplicate effect identities.")
            Dim polynomialBases = model.Effects.Where(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.Kind = "Polynomial" AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing).SelectMany(Function(e) e.Spec.BaseVarKeys).ToArray()
            If model.Effects.Any(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.Kind = "Interaction" AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys.Any(Function(k) polynomialBases.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal))) Then
                Return NotRepresentable("Existing Core polynomial/interaction display-name paths differ; retain typed terms (C08-CORE-LABEL-01).")
            End If
            Dim specs = model.ToTermSpecs(), terms As New List(Of String)
            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim s = e.Spec
                If s Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys.Count = 0 OrElse s.BaseVarKeys.Any(Function(k) Not keys.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal)) Then Return NotRepresentable("Missing raw variable or term metadata.", e.Key)
                If s.ObservedLevels IsNot Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarDisplayNames IsNot Nothing Then Return NotRepresentable("RHS cannot preserve observed levels or custom display metadata; retain typed serialization.", e.Key)
                Dim tokens As New List(Of String)
                For Each key In s.BaseVarKeys
                    Dim token = RegressionVariableCatalog.NumberToLetters(keys.IndexOf(key) + 1)
                    Dim cat As TermSpec = Nothing
                    If s.Kind = "MainEffect" AndAlso s.Scale = PredictorScale.Categorical Then
                        cat = s
                    ElseIf s.Kind = "Interaction" Then
                        specs.TryGetValue(RegressionDesignCore.MakeCategoricalEffectKey(key), cat)
                    End If
                    If cat IsNot Nothing Then
                        If cat.ReferenceValue.HasValue AndAlso (Double.IsNaN(cat.ReferenceValue.Value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(cat.ReferenceValue.Value)) Then Return NotRepresentable("Nonfinite factor reference.", e.Key)
                        token = "factor(" & token & If(cat.ReferenceValue.HasValue, ", ref=" & cat.ReferenceValue.GetValueOrDefault().ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "") & ")"
                    End If
                    tokens.Add(token)
                Next
                Select Case s.Kind
                    Case "MainEffect"
                        If tokens.Count <> 1 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid main effect.", e.Key)
                        terms.Add(tokens(0))
                    Case "Polynomial"
                        If tokens.Count <> 1 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid polynomial.", e.Key)
                        terms.Add(tokens(0) & "^" & s.Degree.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    Case "Interaction"
                        terms.Add(String.Join(":", tokens))
                    Case Else
                        Return NotRepresentable("Unsupported term kind.", e.Key)
                End Select
            Next
            Dim catalog = RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(keys.Select(Function(k) RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(k)), keys)
            Dim parsed As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing, message As String = Nothing
            If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(String.Join(" + ", terms), catalog, parsed, message) Then Return NotRepresentable(message)
            Dim reparsed As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
            If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(parsed.NormalizedFormulaText, catalog, reparsed, message) Then Return NotRepresentable(message)
            For Each pair In parsed.TermSpecs
                If Not reparsed.TermSpecs.ContainsKey(pair.Key) OrElse Not Nullable.Equals(pair.Value.ReferenceValue, reparsed.TermSpecs(pair.Key).ReferenceValue) Then
                    Return NotRepresentable("Core normalized reference text loses precision on this runtime; retain typed metadata (C08-FORMULA-REF-01).", pair.Key)
                End If
            Next
            If Not parsed.EffectItems.SequenceEqual(model.Effects.Select(Function(e) e.Key), StringComparer.Ordinal) Then Return NotRepresentable("Core normalization changes effect identity or interaction order.")
            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim a = e.Spec, b = parsed.TermSpecs(e.Key)
                If a.Kind <> b.Kind OrElse a.Degree <> b.Degree OrElse a.Scale <> b.Scale OrElse a.Order <> b.Order OrElse
                    Not a.BaseVarKeys.SequenceEqual(b.BaseVarKeys, StringComparer.Ordinal) OrElse a.DisplayNameForCoef <> b.DisplayNameForCoef OrElse
                    Not Nullable.Equals(a.ReferenceValue, b.ReferenceValue) Then Return NotRepresentable("RHS would change term metadata.", e.Key)
            Next
            Return New RegressionEffectFormulaProjection(parsed.NormalizedFormulaText, issues)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function NotRepresentable(message As String, Optional effectKey As String = Nothing) As RegressionEffectFormulaProjection
            Return New RegressionEffectFormulaProjection(Nothing, {New RegressionEffectDiagnostic("formula-not-representable", message, effectKey:=effectKey)})
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ProjectFormula(model As RegressionEffectModel, orderedCatalog As IEnumerable(Of String)) As RegressionEffectFormulaProjection

            End If
            If model.Effects.Count = 0 Then Return NotRepresentable("Empty models require the explicit typed spec; blank RHS means all main effects in Core.")
            If keys.Any(Function(k) k.Trim() <> k) Then Return NotRepresentable("Core design integration trims raw keys; whitespace identity requires the typed spec.")
            If RegressionEffectAuthoringPolicy.Inspect(model, keys).Count > 0 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid or incomplete term metadata; inspect the typed spec.")
            If model.Effects.Select(Function(e) e.Key).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> model.Effects.Count Then Return NotRepresentable("Duplicate effect identities.")
            Dim polynomialBases = model.Effects.Where(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.Kind = "Polynomial" AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing).SelectMany(Function(e) e.Spec.BaseVarKeys).ToArray()
            If model.Effects.Any(Function(e) e.Spec IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.Kind = "Interaction" AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys IsNot Nothing AndAlso e.Spec.BaseVarKeys.Any(Function(k) polynomialBases.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal))) Then

            End If

            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim s = e.Spec
                If s Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarKeys.Count = 0 OrElse s.BaseVarKeys.Any(Function(k) Not keys.Contains(k, StringComparer.Ordinal)) Then Return NotRepresentable("Missing raw variable or term metadata.", e.Key)
                If s.ObservedLevels IsNot Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarDisplayNames IsNot Nothing Then Return NotRepresentable("RHS cannot preserve observed levels or custom display metadata; retain typed serialization.", e.Key)
                Dim tokens As New List(Of String)
                For Each key In s.BaseVarKeys
                    Dim token = RegressionVariableCatalog.NumberToLetters(keys.IndexOf(key) + 1)
                    Dim cat As TermSpec = Nothing
                    If s.Kind = "MainEffect" AndAlso s.Scale = PredictorScale.Categorical Then
                        cat = s
                    ElseIf s.Kind = "Interaction" Then
                        specs.TryGetValue(RegressionDesignCore.MakeCategoricalEffectKey(key), cat)
                    End If
                    If cat IsNot Nothing Then
                        If cat.ReferenceValue.HasValue AndAlso (Double.IsNaN(cat.ReferenceValue.Value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(cat.ReferenceValue.Value)) Then Return NotRepresentable("Nonfinite factor reference.", e.Key)

                    End If
                    tokens.Add(token)
                Next
                Select Case s.Kind
                    Case "MainEffect"
                        If tokens.Count <> 1 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid main effect.", e.Key)
                        terms.Add(tokens(0))
                    Case "Polynomial"
                        If tokens.Count <> 1 Then Return NotRepresentable("Invalid polynomial.", e.Key)
                        terms.Add(tokens(0) & "^" & s.Degree.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    Case "Interaction"
                        terms.Add(String.Join(":", tokens))
                    Case Else
                        Return NotRepresentable("Unsupported term kind.", e.Key)
                End Select
            Next
            Dim catalog = RegressionVariableCatalog.Build(keys.Select(Function(k) RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(k)), keys)
            Dim parsed As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing, message As String = Nothing
            If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(String.Join(" + ", terms), catalog, parsed, message) Then Return NotRepresentable(message)
            Dim reparsed As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing
            If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(parsed.NormalizedFormulaText, catalog, reparsed, message) Then Return NotRepresentable(message)
            For Each pair In parsed.TermSpecs
                If Not reparsed.TermSpecs.ContainsKey(pair.Key) OrElse Not Nullable.Equals(pair.Value.ReferenceValue, reparsed.TermSpecs(pair.Key).ReferenceValue) Then

            Next
            If Not parsed.EffectItems.SequenceEqual(model.Effects.Select(Function(e) e.Key), StringComparer.Ordinal) Then Return NotRepresentable("Core normalization changes effect identity or interaction order.")
            For Each e In model.Effects
                Dim a = e.Spec, b = parsed.TermSpecs(e.Key)
                If a.Kind <> b.Kind OrElse a.Degree <> b.Degree OrElse a.Scale <> b.Scale OrElse a.Order <> b.Order OrElse
                    Not a.BaseVarKeys.SequenceEqual(b.BaseVarKeys, StringComparer.Ordinal) OrElse a.DisplayNameForCoef <> b.DisplayNameForCoef OrElse
                    Not Nullable.Equals(a.ReferenceValue, b.ReferenceValue) Then Return NotRepresentable("RHS would change term metadata.", e.Key)
            Next

        End Function

        End Function

            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionEffectDiagnostic)

                If s.ObservedLevels IsNot Nothing OrElse s.BaseVarDisplayNames IsNot Nothing Then Return NotRepresentable("RHS cannot preserve observed levels or custom display metadata; retain typed serialization.", e.Key)
                Dim tokens As New List(Of String)

                        token = "factor(" & token & If(cat.ReferenceValue.HasValue, ", ref=" & cat.ReferenceValue.GetValueOrDefault().ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "") & ")"
                    End If
                    tokens.Add(token)

                    Case "Polynomial"

                        terms.Add(tokens(0) & "^" & s.Degree.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))

            If Not RegressionFormulaParser.TryParseFormulaToDesignSpec(String.Join(" + ", terms), catalog, parsed, message) Then Return NotRepresentable(message)
            Dim reparsed As RegressionFormulaDesignSpec = Nothing

            For Each e In model.Effects

            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1

    ''' <summary>Detached frame and explicit origin sidecar. Joined logical columns are
    ''' never represented as an invented contiguous worksheet rectangle.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetTransportFrame
        Inherits SpreadsheetAnalysisInput
        Private ReadOnly snapshot As SpreadsheetRangeData
        Private ReadOnly origins As SpreadsheetRangeData()
        Private ReadOnly rows As Integer()
        Private ReadOnly sourceRows As Integer(,)
        Private ReadOnly areaColumns As Integer()
        Private ReadOnly localColumns As Integer()

        Friend Sub New(data As SpreadsheetRangeData, areas As SpreadsheetRangeData(), rowIds As Integer(),
                       selectedRows As Integer(,), columnAreas As Integer(), columnOffsets As Integer())
            snapshot = SpreadsheetSelectionTransport.Copy(data)
            origins = areas.Select(Function(a) SpreadsheetSelectionTransport.Copy(a)).ToArray()
            rows = CType(rowIds.Clone(), Integer())
            sourceRows = CType(selectedRows.Clone(), Integer(,))
            areaColumns = CType(columnAreas.Clone(), Integer())
            localColumns = CType(columnOffsets.Clone(), Integer())
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Data As SpreadsheetRangeData
            Get
                Return SpreadsheetSelectionTransport.Copy(snapshot)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property RowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer)
            Get
                Return Array.AsReadOnly(rows)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Areas As IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetRangeData)
            Get
                Return Array.AsReadOnly(origins.Select(Function(a) SpreadsheetSelectionTransport.Copy(a)).ToArray())
            End Get
        End Property
        Public Function SourceAt(rowIndex As Integer, columnIndex As Integer) As SpreadsheetTransportCoordinate
            If rowIndex < 0 OrElse rowIndex >= rows.Length OrElse columnIndex < 0 OrElse columnIndex >= areaColumns.Length Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException()
            Dim area = areaColumns(columnIndex), column = localColumns(columnIndex)
            Return New SpreadsheetTransportCoordinate(area, sourceRows(rowIndex, area), column + 1, rows(rowIndex),
                If(origins(area).StartColumn > 0, origins(area).StartColumn + column, 0), origins(area))
        End Function

        Public Function ToCoreDataTable(names As String(), Optional policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = Nothing) As Global.BESHStatNG.CoreDataTable
            If rows.Any(Function(r) r <= 0) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Physical row provenance is required for this Core bridge.")
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Dim options = If(policy, New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions())
            For r = 0 To snapshot.RowCount - 1
                For c = 0 To snapshot.ColumnCount - 1
                    Try
                        Dim cell = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(snapshot.Rows(r)(c), options)
                        If cell.IsError AndAlso options.Errors = SpreadsheetErrorPolicy.Reject Then Throw New ArgumentException("A source error cell is not permitted.")
                    Catch ex As ArgumentException
                        Dim source = SourceAt(r, c)
                        issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue("transport.cell", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error, ex.Message,
                            "ranges[" & source.AreaIndex.ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "].cells",
                            source.SelectedRow, source.SelectedColumn, source.WorksheetRow, source.WorksheetColumn))
                    End Try
                Next
            Next
            If issues.Count > 0 Then Throw New SpreadsheetInputValidationException(New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
            Dim result = SpreadsheetCoreTableBridge.ToCoreDataTable(snapshot, names, policy)
            result.RowIds = CType(rows.Clone(), Integer())
            result.FirstSourceRow = rows(0)
            result.SourceInfo.FirstSourceRow = rows(0)
            result.FirstSourceColumn = snapshot.StartColumn
            result.SourceInfo.FirstSourceColumn = snapshot.StartColumn
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Canonical structural transport. Interpretation remains in existing
    ''' typed parsers/cell policies; no numeric conversion, header guessing or row filtering.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetSelectionTransport
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Capture(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, Optional rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, issues, "input") Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim rows = If(rowIds Is Nothing, Enumerable.Range(0, input.RowCount).Select(Function(r) If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0)).ToArray(), rowIds.ToArray())
            If rows.Length <> input.RowCount OrElse rows.Any(Function(r) r < 0) OrElse
                (rows.Any(Function(r) r > 0) AndAlso (rows.Any(Function(r) r = 0) OrElse rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length)) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.row-map", "Row identities must match the frame and be unique positive rows, or all unknown.", "rowIds")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim selected(input.RowCount - 1, 0) As Integer
            For r = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                selected(r, 0) = r + 1
            Next
            Return Result(New SpreadsheetTransportFrame(input, {input}, rows, selected, New Integer(input.ColumnCount - 1) {}, Enumerable.Range(0, input.ColumnCount).ToArray()), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function JoinColumns(input As SpreadsheetRangeSetData, alignment As SpreadsheetAreaAlignment,
                                           Optional limits As InputSizeLimits = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Ranges Is Nothing OrElse input.Ranges.Count = 0 Then
                Add(issues, "transport.ranges", "At least one captured area is required.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetAreaAlignment), alignment) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.alignment", "An explicit supported physical-row alignment is required.", "alignment")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim budget As New InputAcquisitionBudget(limits)
            For i = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                If Shape(area, issues, "ranges[" & i.ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "]") Then
                    Try
                        budget.AddRange(area.RowCount, area.ColumnCount)
                    Catch ex As SpreadsheetInputValidationException
                        Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)(Nothing, ex.Report)
                    End Try
                    If area.StartRow <= 0 OrElse area.StartColumn <= 0 OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(area.WorkbookName) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(area.WorksheetName) Then
                        Add(issues, "transport.identity", "A physical join requires captured workbook, worksheet and positive coordinates.", "ranges", area)
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Count > 0 Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim first = input.Ranges(0)
            For i = 1 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                If Not SameSource(first, area) OrElse first.DateSystem <> area.DateSystem OrElse Not Nullable.Equals(first.DateSerialOrigin, area.DateSerialOrigin) Then
                    Add(issues, "transport.identity", "Areas do not have the same captured workbook/worksheet/date context.", "ranges", area)
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Count > 0 Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim start = input.Ranges.Max(Function(a) a.StartRow)
            Dim finish = input.Ranges.Min(Function(a) a.StartRow + a.RowCount - 1)
            If alignment = SpreadsheetAreaAlignment.RequireIdenticalRows AndAlso input.Ranges.Any(Function(a) a.StartRow <> first.StartRow OrElse a.RowCount <> first.RowCount) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.row-alignment", "Selected areas have different physical rows; ordinal pairing is forbidden.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If finish < start Then
                Add(issues, "transport.no-common-rows", "Selections have no common physical worksheet rows.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim occupied As New HashSet(Of Integer)
            Dim columnAreas As New List(Of Integer), columnOffsets As New List(Of Integer)
            For i = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                For c = 0 To area.ColumnCount - 1
                    If Not occupied.Add(area.StartColumn + c) Then Add(issues, "transport.duplicate-cell", "Overlapping/repeated selected cells are not independent columns.", "ranges", area)
                    columnAreas.Add(i) : columnOffsets.Add(c)
                Next
                If area.StartRow <> start OrElse area.RowCount <> finish - start + 1 Then
                    Add(issues, "transport.rows-excluded", "Only explicitly requested common physical rows are retained; original areas remain in the sidecar.", "ranges", area, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim rowIds = Enumerable.Range(start, finish - start + 1).ToArray()
            Dim selected(rowIds.Length - 1, input.Ranges.Count - 1) As Integer
            Dim data As New SpreadsheetRangeData With {.RowCount = rowIds.Length, .ColumnCount = columnAreas.Count,
                .WorkbookName = first.WorkbookName, .WorkbookId = first.WorkbookId, .WorksheetName = first.WorksheetName,
                .WorksheetId = first.WorksheetId, .DateSystem = first.DateSystem, .DateSerialOrigin = first.DateSerialOrigin,
                .SelectionId = input.SelectionId, .AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.Unknown}
            For r = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                Dim cells As New List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue)
                For a = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                    selected(r, a) = rowIds(r) - input.Ranges(a).StartRow + 1
                Next
                For c = 0 To columnAreas.Count - 1
                    cells.Add(CloneCell(input.Ranges(columnAreas(c)).Rows(selected(r, columnAreas(c)) - 1)(columnOffsets(c))))
                Next
                data.Rows.Add(cells)
            Next
            Return Result(New SpreadsheetTransportFrame(data, input.Ranges.ToArray(), rowIds, selected, columnAreas.ToArray(), columnOffsets.ToArray()), issues)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function SameSource(a As SpreadsheetRangeData, b As SpreadsheetRangeData) As Boolean

        Public Shared Function Capture(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, Optional rowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If Not Shape(input, issues, "input") Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim rows = If(rowIds Is Nothing, Enumerable.Range(0, input.RowCount).Select(Function(r) If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0)).ToArray(), rowIds.ToArray())
            If rows.Length <> input.RowCount OrElse rows.Any(Function(r) r < 0) OrElse
                (rows.Any(Function(r) r > 0) AndAlso (rows.Any(Function(r) r = 0) OrElse rows.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length)) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.row-map", "Row identities must match the frame and be unique positive rows, or all unknown.", "rowIds")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim selected(input.RowCount - 1, 0) As Integer
            For r = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                selected(r, 0) = r + 1
            Next
            Return Result(New SpreadsheetTransportFrame(input, {input}, rows, selected, New Integer(input.ColumnCount - 1) {}, Enumerable.Range(0, input.ColumnCount).ToArray()), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function JoinColumns(input As SpreadsheetRangeSetData, alignment As SpreadsheetAreaAlignment,
                                           Optional limits As InputSizeLimits = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Ranges Is Nothing OrElse input.Ranges.Count = 0 Then
                Add(issues, "transport.ranges", "At least one captured area is required.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetAreaAlignment), alignment) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.alignment", "An explicit supported physical-row alignment is required.", "alignment")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim budget As New InputAcquisitionBudget(limits)
            For i = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                If Shape(area, issues, "ranges[" & i.ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "]") Then
                    Try
                        budget.AddRange(area.RowCount, area.ColumnCount)
                    Catch ex As SpreadsheetInputValidationException
                        Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetTransportFrame)(Nothing, ex.Report)
                    End Try
                    If area.StartRow <= 0 OrElse area.StartColumn <= 0 OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(area.WorkbookName) OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(area.WorksheetName) Then
                        Add(issues, "transport.identity", "A physical join requires captured workbook, worksheet and positive coordinates.", "ranges", area)
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Count > 0 Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim first = input.Ranges(0)
            For i = 1 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                If Not SameSource(first, area) OrElse first.DateSystem <> area.DateSystem OrElse Not Nullable.Equals(first.DateSerialOrigin, area.DateSerialOrigin) Then
                    Add(issues, "transport.identity", "Areas do not have the same captured workbook/worksheet/date context.", "ranges", area)
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Count > 0 Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim start = input.Ranges.Max(Function(a) a.StartRow)
            Dim finish = input.Ranges.Min(Function(a) a.StartRow + a.RowCount - 1)
            If alignment = SpreadsheetAreaAlignment.RequireIdenticalRows AndAlso input.Ranges.Any(Function(a) a.StartRow <> first.StartRow OrElse a.RowCount <> first.RowCount) Then
                Add(issues, "transport.row-alignment", "Selected areas have different physical rows; ordinal pairing is forbidden.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            If finish < start Then
                Add(issues, "transport.no-common-rows", "Selections have no common physical worksheet rows.", "ranges")
                Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim occupied As New HashSet(Of Integer)
            Dim columnAreas As New List(Of Integer), columnOffsets As New List(Of Integer)
            For i = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1
                Dim area = input.Ranges(i)
                For c = 0 To area.ColumnCount - 1
                    If Not occupied.Add(area.StartColumn + c) Then Add(issues, "transport.duplicate-cell", "Overlapping/repeated selected cells are not independent columns.", "ranges", area)
                    columnAreas.Add(i) : columnOffsets.Add(c)
                Next
                If area.StartRow <> start OrElse area.RowCount <> finish - start + 1 Then
                    Add(issues, "transport.rows-excluded", "Only explicitly requested common physical rows are retained; original areas remain in the sidecar.", "ranges", area, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
                End If
            Next
            If issues.Any(Function(i) i.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Error) Then Return Result(Nothing, issues)
            Dim rowIds = Enumerable.Range(start, finish - start + 1).ToArray()
            Dim selected(rowIds.Length - 1, input.Ranges.Count - 1) As Integer
            Dim data As New SpreadsheetRangeData With {.RowCount = rowIds.Length, .ColumnCount = columnAreas.Count,
                .WorkbookName = first.WorkbookName, .WorkbookId = first.WorkbookId, .WorksheetName = first.WorksheetName,
                .WorksheetId = first.WorksheetId, .DateSystem = first.DateSystem, .DateSerialOrigin = first.DateSerialOrigin,
                .SelectionId = input.SelectionId, .AddressDialect = SpreadsheetAddressDialect.Unknown}
            For r = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1

                For a = 0 To input.Ranges.Count - 1

                Next
                For c = 0 To columnAreas.Count - 1
                    cells.Add(CloneCell(input.Ranges(columnAreas(c)).Rows(selected(r, columnAreas(c)) - 1)(columnOffsets(c))))
                Next
                data.Rows.Add(cells)
            Next
            Return Result(New SpreadsheetTransportFrame(data, input.Ranges.ToArray(), rowIds, selected, columnAreas.ToArray(), columnOffsets.ToArray()), issues)
        End Function

                String.Equals(a.WorksheetName, b.WorksheetName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso

                String.Equals(If(a.WorksheetId, ""), If(b.WorksheetId, ""), StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso

    ''' <summary>Stable severity for host-neutral spreadsheet input diagnostics.</summary>
    Public Enum SpreadsheetValidationSeverity
        Information = 0
        Warning = 1
        [Error] = 2
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Describes a specific validation problem. SelectedRow/Column are 1-based offsets within
    ''' the supplied range; WorksheetRow/Column are 1-based Excel coordinates or zero if unknown.
    ''' No host objects or mutable spreadsheet cell references are retained.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetValidationIssue
        Public Sub New(code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                       message As String, fieldPath As String,
                       Optional selectedRow As Integer = 0, Optional selectedColumn As Integer = 0,
                       Optional worksheetRow As Integer = 0, Optional worksheetColumn As Integer = 0)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code) Then Throw New ArgumentException("An issue code is required.", NameOf(code))
            If selectedRow < 0 OrElse selectedColumn < 0 OrElse worksheetRow < 0 OrElse worksheetColumn < 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(selectedRow), "Validation coordinates must be nonnegative.")
            End If
            Me.Code = code
            Me.Severity = severity
            Me.Message = If(message, String.Empty)
            Me.FieldPath = If(fieldPath, String.Empty)
            Me.SelectedRow = selectedRow
            Me.SelectedColumn = selectedColumn
            Me.WorksheetRow = worksheetRow
            Me.WorksheetColumn = worksheetColumn
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Code As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity
        Public ReadOnly Property Message As String
        Public ReadOnly Property FieldPath As String
        Public ReadOnly Property SelectedRow As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property SelectedColumn As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetRow As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetColumn As Integer
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Immutable snapshot of diagnostic issues returned by a parser.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SpreadsheetValidationReport
        Private ReadOnly _issues As ReadOnlyCollection(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)

        Public Sub New(issues As IEnumerable(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue))
            If issues Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(issues))
            Dim items As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            For Each item As SpreadsheetValidationIssue In issues
                If item Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null validation issues are not allowed.", NameOf(issues))
                items.Add(item)
            Next
            _issues = items.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Issues As IReadOnlyList(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)
            Get
                Return _issues
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property HasErrors As Boolean
            Get
                Return _issues.Any(Function(issue) issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error])
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property HasWarnings As Boolean
            Get
                Return _issues.Any(Function(issue) issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning)
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property IsValid As Boolean
            Get
                Return Not HasErrors
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

                          report.Issues(0).Message, "Spreadsheet input validation failed."), "input")
            If report Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(report))
            Me.Report = report
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Report As SpreadsheetValidationReport
    End Class

Namespace ExcelCommon

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Host-independent scalar, vector, complete-pair, and grouped numeric input adapters.
    ''' All errors use the 01.03 validation report and preserve 01.02 cell policies.
    ''' Existing grouped parser entry points and the Stage 3.04 dispatcher are untouched.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class TypedNumericRangeParsers
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ParseScalar(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                          Optional cellPolicy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetScalarNumericInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If Not ValidRange(input, issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetScalarNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            If input.RowCount <> 1 OrElse input.ColumnCount <> 1 Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "scalar.shape", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "A scalar must be selected as exactly one cell.", "range")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetScalarNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim value As SpreadsheetNumericObservation = Nothing
            ReadObservation(input, 0, 0, If(cellPolicy, New SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions()), issues, value)
            If value Is Nothing AndAlso Not AnyError(issues) Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "scalar.missing", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "A scalar numeric value is required.", "value", 1, 1)
            End If
            If AnyError(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetScalarNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetScalarNumericInput(value), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParseVector(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                          Optional options As SpreadsheetVectorParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If Not ValidRange(input, issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetVectorParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetVectorParseOptions())
            If Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetVectorOrientation), config.Orientation) OrElse
               Not ValidOptions(config.Header, config.Missing, config.CellPolicy, config.MinimumObservations) Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "options.invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "Vector parsing options are invalid.", "options")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim inColumn As Boolean
            Select Case config.Orientation
                Case SpreadsheetVectorOrientation.Auto
                    If input.ColumnCount = 1 Then
                        inColumn = True
                    ElseIf input.RowCount = 1 Then
                        inColumn = False
                    Else
                        AddIssue(issues, input, "vector.orientation-ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                                 "Choose a vector row or column for a two-dimensional range.", "options.orientation")
                        Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
                    End If
                Case SpreadsheetVectorOrientation.Column
                    inColumn = True
                Case SpreadsheetVectorOrientation.Row
                    inColumn = False
            End Select
            Dim fixedIndex As Integer = If(inColumn, config.ColumnIndex, config.RowIndex)
            If fixedIndex < 0 OrElse fixedIndex >= If(inColumn, input.ColumnCount, input.RowCount) Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "vector.index", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "Selected vector row or column is outside the range.", "options.index")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If

            Dim initial As SpreadsheetCellValue = If(inColumn, input.Rows(0)(fixedIndex), input.Rows(fixedIndex)(0))
            Dim firstRow As Integer = If(inColumn, 0, fixedIndex)
            Dim firstColumn As Integer = If(inColumn, fixedIndex, 0)
            Dim header As Boolean = ResolveHeader(input, initial, Nothing, config.Header, config.CellPolicy,
                                                   firstRow, firstColumn, -1, -1, issues)
            If AnyError(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim name As String = If(header, LabelText(initial), "Vector 1")
            Dim observations As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericObservation)()
            For i As Integer = If(header, 1, 0) To If(inColumn, input.RowCount, input.ColumnCount) - 1
                Dim r As Integer = If(inColumn, i, fixedIndex)
                Dim c As Integer = If(inColumn, fixedIndex, i)
                Dim found As SpreadsheetNumericObservation = Nothing
                Dim valid As Boolean = ReadObservation(input, r, c, config.CellPolicy, issues, found)
                If Not valid Then Continue For
                If found IsNot Nothing Then
                    observations.Add(found)
                ElseIf config.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Reject Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "vector.missing", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                             "A missing vector observation is not permitted.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                ElseIf config.WarnOnSkippedObservations Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "vector.missing-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                             "A missing vector observation was skipped.", "observations", r + 1, c + 1)
                End If
            Next
            If observations.Count < config.MinimumObservations Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "vector.too-few", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "The numeric vector has too few observations.", "observations")
            End If
            If AnyError(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetVectorNumericInput(name, observations), issues)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ParsePaired(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                          Optional options As SpreadsheetPairedParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If Not ValidRange(input, issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim config As SpreadsheetPairedParseOptions = If(options, New SpreadsheetPairedParseOptions())
            If Not System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetPairOrientation), config.Orientation) OrElse
               Not ValidOptions(config.Header, config.Missing, config.CellPolicy, config.MinimumPairs) Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "options.invalid", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "Paired parsing options are invalid.", "options")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If
            Dim columns As Boolean = config.Orientation = SpreadsheetPairOrientation.TwoColumns
            Dim available As Integer = If(columns, input.ColumnCount, input.RowCount)
            If config.FirstIndex < 0 OrElse config.SecondIndex < 0 OrElse config.FirstIndex >= available OrElse
               config.SecondIndex >= available OrElse config.FirstIndex = config.SecondIndex Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "paired.indices", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "The two paired series must be distinct valid rows or columns.", "options.indices")
                Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            End If

            Dim r1 As Integer = If(columns, 0, config.FirstIndex)
            Dim c1 As Integer = If(columns, config.FirstIndex, 0)
            Dim r2 As Integer = If(columns, 0, config.SecondIndex)
            Dim c2 As Integer = If(columns, config.SecondIndex, 0)
            Dim firstHeaderCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r1)(c1)
            Dim secondHeaderCell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r2)(c2)
            Dim header As Boolean = ResolveHeader(input, firstHeaderCell, secondHeaderCell,
                                                   config.Header, config.CellPolicy, r1, c1, r2, c2, issues)
            If AnyError(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Dim firstName As String = If(header, LabelText(firstHeaderCell), "Series 1")
            Dim secondName As String = If(header, LabelText(secondHeaderCell), "Series 2")
            Dim pairs As New List(Of SpreadsheetNumericPair)()
            For i As Integer = If(header, 1, 0) To If(columns, input.RowCount, input.ColumnCount) - 1
                Dim firstRow As Integer = If(columns, i, config.FirstIndex)
                Dim firstColumn As Integer = If(columns, config.FirstIndex, i)
                Dim secondRow As Integer = If(columns, i, config.SecondIndex)
                Dim secondColumn As Integer = If(columns, config.SecondIndex, i)
                Dim first As SpreadsheetNumericObservation = Nothing
                Dim second As SpreadsheetNumericObservation = Nothing
                Dim firstValid As Boolean = ReadObservation(input, firstRow, firstColumn, config.CellPolicy, issues, first)
                Dim secondValid As Boolean = ReadObservation(input, secondRow, secondColumn, config.CellPolicy, issues, second)
                If Not firstValid OrElse Not secondValid Then Continue For
                If first IsNot Nothing AndAlso second IsNot Nothing Then
                    pairs.Add(New SpreadsheetNumericPair(first, second))
                ElseIf config.Missing = SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy.Reject Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "paired.incomplete", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                             "Both observations are required for an aligned pair.", "pairs",
                             If(first Is Nothing, firstRow + 1, secondRow + 1),
                             If(first Is Nothing, firstColumn + 1, secondColumn + 1))
                ElseIf config.WarnOnSkippedPairs Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "paired.incomplete-skipped", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning,
                             "A whole incomplete pair was skipped to preserve alignment.", "pairs",
                             If(first Is Nothing, firstRow + 1, secondRow + 1),
                             If(first Is Nothing, firstColumn + 1, secondColumn + 1))
                End If
            Next
            If pairs.Count < config.MinimumPairs Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "paired.too-few", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "Too few complete numeric pairs were supplied.", "pairs")
            End If
            If AnyError(issues) Then Return Finish(Of SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput)(Nothing, issues)
            Return Finish(New SpreadsheetPairedNumericInput(firstName, secondName, pairs), issues)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Delegates to the 01.03 configurable grouped parser; no competing grouped algorithm.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ParseGrouped(input As SpreadsheetRangeData,
                          Optional options As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions = Nothing) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of GroupedNumericData)
            Dim original As SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult = ConfigurableGroupedNumericParser.Parse(input, options)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of GroupedNumericData)(original.Data, original.Validation)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Finish(Of T As SpreadsheetAnalysisInput)(data As T,
                        issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of T)
            Return New SpreadsheetTypedParseResult(Of T)(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues))
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ValidOptions(header As SpreadsheetHeaderMode, missing As SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy,
                           policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions, minimum As Integer) As Boolean
            Return System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetHeaderMode), header) AndAlso
                   System.Enum.IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetIncompleteObservationPolicy), missing) AndAlso
                   policy IsNot Nothing AndAlso minimum > 0
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ValidRange(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If input Is Nothing Then
                AddIssue(issues, Nothing, "range.null", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "No spreadsheet range was supplied.", "input")
                Return False
            End If
            If input.RowCount < 1 OrElse input.ColumnCount < 1 OrElse input.Rows Is Nothing OrElse
               input.Rows.Count <> input.RowCount OrElse input.StartRow < 0 OrElse input.StartColumn < 0 Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "range.shape", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "The range shape or source coordinates are invalid.", "range")
                Return False
            End If
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.RowCount - 1
                If input.Rows(r) Is Nothing OrElse input.Rows(r).Count <> input.ColumnCount Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "range.not-rectangular", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                             "All rows must match the declared range width.", "range", r + 1)
                    Return False
                End If
            Next
            Return True
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ReadObservation(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, row As Integer, column As Integer,
                             policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                             issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue),
                             ByRef observation As SpreadsheetNumericObservation) As Boolean
            observation = Nothing
            Dim cell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(row)(column)
            Dim evaluated As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation
            Try
                evaluated = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, policy)
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                AddIssue(issues, input, "cell.invalid-value", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         ex.Message, "observations", row + 1, column + 1)
                Return False
            End Try
            If evaluated.IsMissing Then Return True
            If evaluated.IsError Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "cell.excel-error", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "An Excel error cannot be used as a numeric observation.", "observations", row + 1, column + 1)
                Return False
            End If
            If Not evaluated.HasNumericValue Then
                AddIssue(issues, input, "cell.not-numeric", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                         "This cell is not numeric under the selected conversion policy.", "observations", row + 1, column + 1)
                Return False
            End If
            observation = New SpreadsheetNumericObservation(evaluated.NumericValue, row + 1, column + 1,
                If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + row, 0),
                If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + column, 0))
            Return True
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ResolveHeader(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, first As SpreadsheetCellValue,
                  second As SpreadsheetCellValue, mode As SpreadsheetHeaderMode,
                  policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions, firstRow As Integer, firstColumn As Integer,
                  secondRow As Integer, secondColumn As Integer,
                  issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)) As Boolean
            If mode = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.None Then Return False
            If mode = SpreadsheetHeaderMode.Required Then Return True
            Dim firstNumber As Boolean = False
            Dim firstText As Boolean = HeaderIsLabel(first, policy, firstNumber)
            If secondRow < 0 Then
                If firstText Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                             "A vector header was detected.", "header", firstRow + 1, firstColumn + 1)
                    Return True
                End If
                If firstNumber Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                             "No vector header was detected.", "header", firstRow + 1, firstColumn + 1)
                    Return False
                End If
            Else
                Dim secondNumber As Boolean = False
                Dim secondText As Boolean = HeaderIsLabel(second, policy, secondNumber)
                If firstText AndAlso secondText Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                             "Paired-series headers were detected.", "header")
                    Return True
                End If
                If firstNumber AndAlso secondNumber Then
                    AddIssue(issues, input, "header.inferred", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information,
                             "No paired-series headers were detected.", "header")
                    Return False
                End If
            End If
            AddIssue(issues, input, "header.ambiguous", SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error],
                     "Header inference is ambiguous. Choose Required or None explicitly.", "header",
                     firstRow + 1, firstColumn + 1)
            Return False
        End Function

        Private Shared Function HeaderIsLabel(cell As SpreadsheetCellValue, policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions,
                                             ByRef numeric As Boolean) As Boolean
            numeric = False
            If cell Is Nothing OrElse cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Blank OrElse
               cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then Return False
            Try
                Dim ev As SpreadsheetCellEvaluation = SpreadsheetCellValuePolicy.Evaluate(cell, policy)
                If ev.IsMissing Then Return False
                numeric = ev.HasNumericValue
                If numeric Then Return False
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                Return False
            End Try
            Return cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.Text AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell.TextValue)
        End Function

Private Shared Function ReadObservation(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, row As Integer, column As Integer,

                             issues As List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue),
