    ''' <summary>
    ''' Univariate input-role selection and validation. Explicit raw snapshots compose the
    ''' existing configurable parser. Imported compatibility entry points reuse DataObj's
    ''' established cleaning/grouping; they intentionally do not impose raw-parser defaults.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class UnivariateSelectionPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function InputRoles(twoSample As Boolean, byId As Boolean) As UnivariateInputRoles
            Return New UnivariateInputRoles(twoSample OrElse byId, twoSample OrElse byId)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' groupIdentifiers, when present, is a separate single-column snapshot aligned to
        ''' the single-column data snapshot. Otherwise the explicit parser column roles apply.
        ''' physicalRowIds optionally supplies original physical rows for a compacted snapshot.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Parse(data As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                     Optional groupIdentifiers As SpreadsheetRangeData = Nothing,
                                     Optional physicalRowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing,
                                     Optional groupPhysicalRowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If options Is Nothing Then
                Return Failure("options.invalid", "Explicit univariate parsing options are required.", "options")
            End If
            Dim policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = options.CellPolicy
            If policy IsNot Nothing Then
                If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy), policy.MissingText) OrElse
                   Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetErrorPolicy), policy.Errors) OrElse
                   Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy), policy.NumericText) Then
                    Return Failure("options.invalid", "The cell interpretation options are invalid.", "options.cellPolicy")
                End If
                Try
                    policy.GetNumericCulture()
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Return Failure("options.invalid", "The numeric culture is invalid.", "options.cellPolicy.numericCulture")
                End Try
            End If
            If data IsNot Nothing AndAlso (data.StartRow < 0 OrElse data.StartColumn < 0) Then
                Return Failure("range.shape", "Source coordinates must be nonnegative.", "source")
            End If
            If physicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then
                If data Is Nothing OrElse physicalRowIds.Count <> data.RowCount OrElse
                   physicalRowIds.Where(Function(row, index) row < 1 OrElse (index > 0 AndAlso row <= physicalRowIds(index - 1))).Any() Then
                    Return Failure("source.row-ids", "Source rows must match the snapshot and be positive and strictly increasing.", "source.rowIds")
                End If
            End If
            Dim input As SpreadsheetRangeData = data
            If groupPhysicalRowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso groupIdentifiers Is Nothing Then
                Return Failure("roles.rows", "Group source rows require a group-identifier snapshot.", "roles")
            End If
            If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing Then
                If options.Orientation <> SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.LongFormat OrElse
                   options.CategoryColumnIndex <> 0 OrElse options.ValueColumnIndex <> 1 Then
                    Return Failure("options.long-columns", "Separate ranges require long-format category role 0 and value role 1.", "options.columns")
                End If
                If Not IsColumn(data) OrElse Not IsColumn(groupIdentifiers) Then
                    Return Failure("roles.shape", "Data and group identifiers must each be one rectangular column.", "roles")
                End If
                If Not SameIdentity(data.WorkbookId, groupIdentifiers.WorkbookId) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorkbookName, groupIdentifiers.WorkbookName) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorksheetId, groupIdentifiers.WorksheetId) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorksheetName, groupIdentifiers.WorksheetName) Then
                    Return Failure("roles.worksheet", "Data and group identifiers must be on the same worksheet.", "roles")
                End If
                If data.RowCount <> groupIdentifiers.RowCount OrElse data.StartRow <> groupIdentifiers.StartRow Then
                    Return Failure("roles.rows", "Data and group identifiers must have matching source rows.", "roles")
                End If
                If groupIdentifiers.StartRow < 0 OrElse groupIdentifiers.StartColumn < 0 Then
                    Return Failure("range.shape", "Source coordinates must be nonnegative.", "source")
                End If
                If groupPhysicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim expected As IEnumerable(Of Integer) = physicalRowIds
                    If expected Is Nothing AndAlso data.StartRow > 0 Then expected = Enumerable.Range(data.StartRow, data.RowCount)
                    If expected Is Nothing OrElse Not groupPhysicalRowIds.SequenceEqual(expected) Then
                        Return Failure("roles.rows", "Data and group identifiers must have matching physical source rows.", "roles")
                    End If
                End If
                input = New SpreadsheetRangeData With {
                    .RowCount = data.RowCount, .ColumnCount = 2, .StartRow = data.StartRow,
                    .WorkbookId = data.WorkbookId, .WorksheetId = data.WorksheetId,
                    .WorksheetName = data.WorksheetName, .Address = data.Address}
                For r As Integer = 0 To data.RowCount - 1
                    input.Rows.Add(New List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue) From {groupIdentifiers.Rows(r)(0), data.Rows(r)(0)})
                Next
            End If
            Dim parsed As SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult = ConfigurableGroupedNumericParser.Parse(input, options)
            For Each issue As SpreadsheetValidationIssue In parsed.Validation.Issues
                Dim origin As SpreadsheetRangeData = data
                Dim selectedColumn As Integer = issue.SelectedColumn
                If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing AndAlso selectedColumn > 0 Then
                    origin = If(selectedColumn = 1, groupIdentifiers, data)
                    selectedColumn = 1
                End If
                Dim physicalRow As Integer = issue.WorksheetRow
                If issue.SelectedRow > 0 AndAlso physicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then physicalRow = physicalRowIds(issue.SelectedRow - 1)
                Dim physicalColumn As Integer = issue.WorksheetColumn
                If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing AndAlso selectedColumn > 0 Then
                    physicalColumn = If(origin.StartColumn > 0, origin.StartColumn, 0)
                End If
                issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(issue.Code, issue.Severity, issue.Message, issue.FieldPath,
                    issue.SelectedRow, selectedColumn, physicalRow, physicalColumn))
            Next
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            Dim sourceErrors As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)()
            CaptureErrors(data, physicalRowIds, sourceErrors)
            If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing Then CaptureErrors(groupIdentifiers, physicalRowIds, sourceErrors)
            If parsed.Success Then
                For Each source As UnivariateObservationSource In parsed.ObservationSources
                    Dim column As Integer = If(groupIdentifiers Is Nothing, source.SelectedColumn, 1)
                    Dim row As Integer = If(physicalRowIds Is Nothing, source.WorksheetRow, physicalRowIds(source.SelectedRow - 1))
                    sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(source.GroupIndex, source.ObservationIndex,
                        source.SelectedRow, column, row, If(data.StartColumn > 0, data.StartColumn + column - 1, 0),
                        data.WorkbookId, data.WorksheetId, data.WorksheetName, data.Address))
                Next
            End If
            Return New UnivariateSelectionResult(parsed.Data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues), sources, sourceErrors)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Preserves the form's per-column import, independent missing rows and names.
        ''' No new finite/group-size rules are imposed on the existing Windows route.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function SelectImportedColumns(columns As IReadOnlyList(Of Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If columns Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columns))
            Return SelectCapturedColumns(columns.Select(AddressOf CaptureImportedColumn).ToArray())
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Capture immediately after each import to preserve conversion/exception timing
        ''' and avoid retaining all of the importer's raw matrices during acquisition.</summary>
        Public Shared Function CaptureImportedColumn(column As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj) As UnivariateImportedColumn
            If column Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(column))
            If column.FinalData Is Nothing Then
                Return New UnivariateImportedColumn(Nothing, Array.Empty(Of Double)(), Array.Empty(Of UnivariateObservationSource)(), False)
            End If
            Dim values As Double() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(column.DataDbl, 0)
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                sources.Add(ImportedSource(column, 0, i, i, 1))
            Next
            Return New UnivariateImportedColumn(column.varNames(0), values, sources, True)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function SelectCapturedColumns(columns As IReadOnlyList(Of UnivariateImportedColumn)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If columns Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columns))
            Dim names As New List(Of String)()
            Dim groups As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For Each column As UnivariateImportedColumn In columns
                If column Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("An imported column cannot be null.", NameOf(columns))
                If Not column.HasData Then Continue For
                Dim groupIndex As Integer = groups.Count
                groups.Add(column.Values.ToArray())
                names.Add(column.Name)
                For Each source As UnivariateObservationSource In column.Sources
                    sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(groupIndex, source.ObservationIndex,
                        source.SelectedRow, source.SelectedColumn, source.WorksheetRow, source.WorksheetColumn,
                        source.WorkbookId, source.WorksheetId, source.WorksheetName, source.Address))
                Next
            Next
            If groups.Count = 0 Then Return Failure("groups.no-valid-data", "No valid data", "data")
            Return Valid(New GroupedNumericData(names.ToArray(), groups.ToArray()), sources)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Reuses Core's Object.Equals grouping and current-culture conversion verbatim.
        ''' This compatibility entry point expects the existing two-column cleaned import.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function SelectImportedById(imported As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If imported Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(imported))
            Dim values As Double()() = imported.DataByID2ByColumn()
            Dim ids As Object() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(imported.FinalData, 0).Distinct().ToArray()
            Dim names As String() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.Array2strArray(ids)
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For g As Integer = 0 To ids.Length - 1
                Dim observation As Integer = 0
                For r As Integer = 0 To imported.FinalData.GetLength(0) - 1
                    If Object.Equals(ids(g), imported.FinalData(r, 0)) Then
                        sources.Add(ImportedSource(imported, g, observation, r, 2))
                        observation += 1
                    End If
                Next
            Next
            Return Valid(New GroupedNumericData(names, values), sources)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ImportedSource(imported As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj, group As Integer,
                                               observation As Integer, rowIndex As Integer, column As Integer) As UnivariateObservationSource
            Dim source As Global.BESHStatNG.DataSourceInfo = imported.SourceInfo
            Dim physicalRow As Integer = If(imported.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowIndex < imported.RowIds.Length, imported.RowIds(rowIndex), 0)
            Dim selectedRow As Integer = If(physicalRow > 0 AndAlso source IsNot Nothing AndAlso source.FirstSourceRow > 0,
                                            physicalRow - source.FirstSourceRow + 1, 0)
            ' The legacy importer does not capture workbook IDs or physical source columns.
            Return New UnivariateObservationSource(group, observation, selectedRow, column, physicalRow, 0,
                Nothing, Nothing, If(source Is Nothing, Nothing, source.SheetName), If(source Is Nothing, Nothing, source.Address))
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Valid(data As GroupedNumericData, sources As IEnumerable(Of UnivariateObservationSource)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            Return New UnivariateSelectionResult(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(Array.Empty(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()), sources)
        End Function

                New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], message, field)}),
                Array.Empty(Of UnivariateObservationSource)())

        Private Shared Function IsColumn(input As SpreadsheetRangeData) As Boolean
            Return input IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.ColumnCount = 1 AndAlso input.RowCount > 0 AndAlso
                input.Rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.Rows.Count = input.RowCount AndAlso
                input.Rows.All(Function(row) row IsNot Nothing AndAlso row.Count = 1)

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function InputRoles(twoSample As Boolean, byId As Boolean) As UnivariateInputRoles
            Return New UnivariateInputRoles(twoSample OrElse byId, twoSample OrElse byId)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' groupIdentifiers, when present, is a separate single-column snapshot aligned to
        ''' the single-column data snapshot. Otherwise the explicit parser column roles apply.
        ''' physicalRowIds optionally supplies original physical rows for a compacted snapshot.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Parse(data As SpreadsheetRangeData, options As SpreadsheetGroupedParseOptions,
                                     Optional groupIdentifiers As SpreadsheetRangeData = Nothing,
                                     Optional physicalRowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing,
                                     Optional groupPhysicalRowIds As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer) = Nothing) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            Dim issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()
            If options Is Nothing Then
                Return Failure("options.invalid", "Explicit univariate parsing options are required.", "options")
            End If
            Dim policy As SpreadsheetCellPolicyOptions = options.CellPolicy
            If policy IsNot Nothing Then
                If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetMissingTextPolicy), policy.MissingText) OrElse
                   Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetErrorPolicy), policy.Errors) OrElse
                   Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetNumericTextPolicy), policy.NumericText) Then
                    Return Failure("options.invalid", "The cell interpretation options are invalid.", "options.cellPolicy")
                End If
                Try
                    policy.GetNumericCulture()
                Catch ex As ArgumentException
                    Return Failure("options.invalid", "The numeric culture is invalid.", "options.cellPolicy.numericCulture")
                End Try
            End If
            If data IsNot Nothing AndAlso (data.StartRow < 0 OrElse data.StartColumn < 0) Then
                Return Failure("range.shape", "Source coordinates must be nonnegative.", "source")
            End If
            If physicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then
                If data Is Nothing OrElse physicalRowIds.Count <> data.RowCount OrElse
                   physicalRowIds.Where(Function(row, index) row < 1 OrElse (index > 0 AndAlso row <= physicalRowIds(index - 1))).Any() Then
                    Return Failure("source.row-ids", "Source rows must match the snapshot and be positive and strictly increasing.", "source.rowIds")
                End If
            End If
            Dim input As SpreadsheetRangeData = data
            If groupPhysicalRowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso groupIdentifiers Is Nothing Then
                Return Failure("roles.rows", "Group source rows require a group-identifier snapshot.", "roles")
            End If
            If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing Then
                If options.Orientation <> SpreadsheetGroupedOrientation.LongFormat OrElse
                   options.CategoryColumnIndex <> 0 OrElse options.ValueColumnIndex <> 1 Then
                    Return Failure("options.long-columns", "Separate ranges require long-format category role 0 and value role 1.", "options.columns")
                End If
                If Not IsColumn(data) OrElse Not IsColumn(groupIdentifiers) Then
                    Return Failure("roles.shape", "Data and group identifiers must each be one rectangular column.", "roles")
                End If
                If Not SameIdentity(data.WorkbookId, groupIdentifiers.WorkbookId) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorkbookName, groupIdentifiers.WorkbookName) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorksheetId, groupIdentifiers.WorksheetId) OrElse
                   Not SameIdentity(data.WorksheetName, groupIdentifiers.WorksheetName) Then
                    Return Failure("roles.worksheet", "Data and group identifiers must be on the same worksheet.", "roles")
                End If
                If data.RowCount <> groupIdentifiers.RowCount OrElse data.StartRow <> groupIdentifiers.StartRow Then
                    Return Failure("roles.rows", "Data and group identifiers must have matching source rows.", "roles")
                End If
                If groupIdentifiers.StartRow < 0 OrElse groupIdentifiers.StartColumn < 0 Then
                    Return Failure("range.shape", "Source coordinates must be nonnegative.", "source")
                End If
                If groupPhysicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim expected As IEnumerable(Of Integer) = physicalRowIds
                    If expected Is Nothing AndAlso data.StartRow > 0 Then expected = Enumerable.Range(data.StartRow, data.RowCount)
                    If expected Is Nothing OrElse Not groupPhysicalRowIds.SequenceEqual(expected) Then
                        Return Failure("roles.rows", "Data and group identifiers must have matching physical source rows.", "roles")
                    End If
                End If
                input = New SpreadsheetRangeData With {
                    .RowCount = data.RowCount, .ColumnCount = 2, .StartRow = data.StartRow,
                    .WorkbookId = data.WorkbookId, .WorksheetId = data.WorksheetId,
                    .WorksheetName = data.WorksheetName, .Address = data.Address}
                For r As Integer = 0 To data.RowCount - 1
                    input.Rows.Add(New List(Of SpreadsheetCellValue) From {groupIdentifiers.Rows(r)(0), data.Rows(r)(0)})
                Next
            End If
            Dim parsed As SpreadsheetGroupedParseResult = ConfigurableGroupedNumericParser.Parse(input, options)
            For Each issue As SpreadsheetValidationIssue In parsed.Validation.Issues
                Dim origin As SpreadsheetRangeData = data
                Dim selectedColumn As Integer = issue.SelectedColumn
                If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing AndAlso selectedColumn > 0 Then
                    origin = If(selectedColumn = 1, groupIdentifiers, data)
                    selectedColumn = 1
                End If
                Dim physicalRow As Integer = issue.WorksheetRow
                If issue.SelectedRow > 0 AndAlso physicalRowIds IsNot Nothing Then physicalRow = physicalRowIds(issue.SelectedRow - 1)
                Dim physicalColumn As Integer = issue.WorksheetColumn
                If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing AndAlso selectedColumn > 0 Then
                    physicalColumn = If(origin.StartColumn > 0, origin.StartColumn, 0)
                End If
                issues.Add(New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(issue.Code, issue.Severity, issue.Message, issue.FieldPath,
                    issue.SelectedRow, selectedColumn, physicalRow, physicalColumn))
            Next
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            Dim sourceErrors As New List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell)()
            CaptureErrors(data, physicalRowIds, sourceErrors)
            If groupIdentifiers IsNot Nothing Then CaptureErrors(groupIdentifiers, physicalRowIds, sourceErrors)
            If parsed.Success Then
                For Each source As UnivariateObservationSource In parsed.ObservationSources
                    Dim column As Integer = If(groupIdentifiers Is Nothing, source.SelectedColumn, 1)
                    Dim row As Integer = If(physicalRowIds Is Nothing, source.WorksheetRow, physicalRowIds(source.SelectedRow - 1))
                    sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(source.GroupIndex, source.ObservationIndex,
                        source.SelectedRow, column, row, If(data.StartColumn > 0, data.StartColumn + column - 1, 0),
                        data.WorkbookId, data.WorksheetId, data.WorksheetName, data.Address))
                Next
            End If
            Return New UnivariateSelectionResult(parsed.Data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(issues), sources, sourceErrors)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Preserves the form's per-column import, independent missing rows and names.
        ''' No new finite/group-size rules are imposed on the existing Windows route.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function SelectImportedColumns(columns As IReadOnlyList(Of Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If columns Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columns))
            Return SelectCapturedColumns(columns.Select(AddressOf CaptureImportedColumn).ToArray())
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Capture immediately after each import to preserve conversion/exception timing
        ''' and avoid retaining all of the importer's raw matrices during acquisition.</summary>
        Public Shared Function CaptureImportedColumn(column As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj) As UnivariateImportedColumn
            If column Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(column))
            If column.FinalData Is Nothing Then
                Return New UnivariateImportedColumn(Nothing, Array.Empty(Of Double)(), Array.Empty(Of UnivariateObservationSource)(), False)
            End If
            Dim values As Double() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(column.DataDbl, 0)
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                sources.Add(ImportedSource(column, 0, i, i, 1))
            Next
            Return New UnivariateImportedColumn(column.varNames(0), values, sources, True)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function SelectCapturedColumns(columns As IReadOnlyList(Of UnivariateImportedColumn)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If columns Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(columns))
            Dim names As New List(Of String)()
            Dim groups As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For Each column As UnivariateImportedColumn In columns
                If column Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("An imported column cannot be null.", NameOf(columns))
                If Not column.HasData Then Continue For
                Dim groupIndex As Integer = groups.Count
                groups.Add(column.Values.ToArray())
                names.Add(column.Name)
                For Each source As UnivariateObservationSource In column.Sources
                    sources.Add(New UnivariateObservationSource(groupIndex, source.ObservationIndex,
                        source.SelectedRow, source.SelectedColumn, source.WorksheetRow, source.WorksheetColumn,
                        source.WorkbookId, source.WorksheetId, source.WorksheetName, source.Address))
                Next
            Next
            If groups.Count = 0 Then Return Failure("groups.no-valid-data", "No valid data", "data")
            Return Valid(New GroupedNumericData(names.ToArray(), groups.ToArray()), sources)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Reuses Core's Object.Equals grouping and current-culture conversion verbatim.
        ''' This compatibility entry point expects the existing two-column cleaned import.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function SelectImportedById(imported As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            If imported Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(imported))
            Dim values As Double()() = imported.DataByID2ByColumn()
            Dim ids As Object() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.GetColumn(imported.FinalData, 0).Distinct().ToArray()
            Dim names As String() = Global.BESHStatNG.DataManagement.ArrayUtilities.Array2strArray(ids)
            Dim sources As New List(Of UnivariateObservationSource)()
            For g As Integer = 0 To ids.Length - 1
                Dim observation As Integer = 0
                For r As Integer = 0 To imported.FinalData.GetLength(0) - 1
                    If Object.Equals(ids(g), imported.FinalData(r, 0)) Then
                        sources.Add(ImportedSource(imported, g, observation, r, 2))
                        observation += 1
                    End If
                Next
            Next
            Return Valid(New GroupedNumericData(names, values), sources)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ImportedSource(imported As Global.BESHStatNG.DataObj, group As Integer,
                                               observation As Integer, rowIndex As Integer, column As Integer) As UnivariateObservationSource
            Dim source As Global.BESHStatNG.DataSourceInfo = imported.SourceInfo
            Dim physicalRow As Integer = If(imported.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowIndex < imported.RowIds.Length, imported.RowIds(rowIndex), 0)
            Dim selectedRow As Integer = If(physicalRow > 0 AndAlso source IsNot Nothing AndAlso source.FirstSourceRow > 0,
                                            physicalRow - source.FirstSourceRow + 1, 0)
            ' The legacy importer does not capture workbook IDs or physical source columns.
            Return New UnivariateObservationSource(group, observation, selectedRow, column, physicalRow, 0,
                Nothing, Nothing, If(source Is Nothing, Nothing, source.SheetName), If(source Is Nothing, Nothing, source.Address))
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Valid(data As GroupedNumericData, sources As IEnumerable(Of UnivariateObservationSource)) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            Return New UnivariateSelectionResult(data, New SpreadsheetValidationReport(Array.Empty(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)()), sources)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Failure(code As String, message As String, field As String) As UnivariateSelectionResult
            Return New UnivariateSelectionResult(Nothing, New SpreadsheetValidationReport({
                New SpreadsheetValidationIssue(code, SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.[Error], message, field)}),
                Array.Empty(Of UnivariateObservationSource)())
        End Function
        Private Shared Function IsColumn(input As SpreadsheetRangeData) As Boolean
            Return input IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.ColumnCount = 1 AndAlso input.RowCount > 0 AndAlso
                input.Rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso input.Rows.Count = input.RowCount AndAlso
                input.Rows.All(Function(row) row IsNot Nothing AndAlso row.Count = 1)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function SameIdentity(first As String, second As String) As Boolean
            Return String.Equals(If(first, String.Empty), If(second, String.Empty), StringComparison.Ordinal)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub CaptureErrors(input As SpreadsheetRangeData, physicalRows As IReadOnlyList(Of Integer),
                                         errors As List(Of SpreadsheetFrameCell))
            If input Is Nothing OrElse input.Rows Is Nothing Then Return
            For r As Integer = 0 To input.Rows.Count - 1
                If input.Rows(r) Is Nothing Then Continue For
                For c As Integer = 0 To input.Rows(r).Count - 1
                    Dim cell As SpreadsheetCellValue = input.Rows(r)(c)
                    If cell IsNot Nothing AndAlso cell.Kind = SpreadsheetCellKind.CellError Then
                        errors.Add(New SpreadsheetFrameCell(cell, r + 1, c + 1,
                            If(physicalRows IsNot Nothing AndAlso r < physicalRows.Count, physicalRows(r),
                               If(input.StartRow > 0, input.StartRow + r, 0)),
                            If(input.StartColumn > 0, input.StartColumn + c, 0)))
                    End If
                Next
            Next
        End Sub
    End Class

            Dim names As New List(Of String)()
            Dim groups As New List(Of Double())()

            For Each column As UnivariateImportedColumn In columns
                If column Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("An imported column cannot be null.", NameOf(columns))

            Next

    ''' <summary>Additive opt-in intent; does not extend OutputArtifactKind or its v1 family.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class CompositeOutputItem
        Private Sub New(id As String, artifactId As String, kind As CompositeOutputKind,
                        rows As Integer, columns As Integer, text As String, relatedId As String, url As String)
            CompositeText.Check(id, False)
            Me.Id = id
            Me.ArtifactId = artifactId
            Me.Kind = kind
            RowCount = rows
            ColumnCount = columns
            Me.Text = text
            RelatedArtifactId = relatedId
            LinkTarget = url
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Id As String
        Public ReadOnly Property ArtifactId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As CompositeOutputKind
        Public ReadOnly Property RowCount As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property ColumnCount As Integer

        Public ReadOnly Property RelatedArtifactId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property LinkTarget As String

        ''' <summary>Tables use captured matrix dimensions. Other artifacts need explicit positive
        ''' dimensions to become visible; 0 x 0 explicitly retains a nonspatial entry.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromArtifact(artifact As OutputArtifact, Optional rows As Integer = 0,
                                           Optional columns As Integer = 0) As CompositeOutputItem
            If artifact Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(artifact))
            Dim kind As CompositeOutputKind
            Dim text As String = String.Empty
            If TypeOf artifact Is OutputTableArtifact Then
                If rows <> 0 OrElse columns <> 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Table dimensions come from its matrix.")
                Dim table = DirectCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                rows = table.RowCount : columns = table.ColumnCount
                kind = CompositeOutputKind.Table
            ElseIf TypeOf artifact Is OutputDiagnosticArtifact Then
                Dim diagnostic = DirectCast(artifact, OutputDiagnosticArtifact)
                kind = CompositeOutputKind.Diagnostic
                text = diagnostic.Severity.ToString().ToUpperInvariant() & " [" & diagnostic.Code & "] " &
                    diagnostic.Message & If(diagnostic.FieldPath.Length = 0, "", " (" & diagnostic.FieldPath & ")")
            Else
                Dim plot = DirectCast(artifact, OutputPlotArtifact)
                kind = CompositeOutputKind.PlotPlaceholder
                Dim newline = Convert.ToChar(10).ToString()
                text = "CHART PLACEHOLDER (not rendered): " & plot.Purpose & newline &
                    plot.Caption & newline & plot.Description & newline & "Logical reference: " & plot.ReferenceKey
            End If
            CheckDimensions(rows, columns, kind <> CompositeOutputKind.Table)
            CompositeText.Check(text, True)
            Return New CompositeOutputItem(artifact.Id, artifact.Id, kind, rows, columns, text, Nothing, Nothing)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Note(id As String, text As String, rows As Integer, columns As Integer,
                                    Optional relatedArtifactId As String = Nothing) As CompositeOutputItem
            CheckDimensions(rows, columns, False)
            If rows = 0 OrElse columns = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Notes require positive dimensions.")
            CompositeText.Check(text, False)
            Return New CompositeOutputItem(id, Nothing, CompositeOutputKind.Note, rows, columns, text, relatedArtifactId, Nothing)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>HTTPS only. Hosts currently degrade to explicit literal linked text; never a formula.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Link(id As String, displayText As String, target As String, rows As Integer,
                                    columns As Integer, Optional relatedArtifactId As String = Nothing) As CompositeOutputItem
            ValidateLink(target)
            Dim noteItem = Note(id, displayText, rows, columns, relatedArtifactId)
            CompositeText.Check(displayText & " [link not active: " & target & "]", False)
            Return New CompositeOutputItem(noteItem.Id, Nothing, CompositeOutputKind.Link, rows, columns,
                displayText, relatedArtifactId, target)
        End Function

        Public Shared Sub ValidateLink(target As String)
            CompositeText.Check(target, False)
            Dim parsed As Uri = Nothing
            If target.Length > 2048 OrElse Not Regex.IsMatch(target, "\Ahttps://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(?:[/?#][^\s\\]*)?\z") OrElse target.Contains("@") OrElse
               target.Any(Function(c) Char.IsWhiteSpace(c) OrElse Char.IsControl(c) OrElse c = "\"c) OrElse
               Not Uri.TryCreate(target, UriKind.Absolute, parsed) OrElse parsed.Scheme <> Uri.UriSchemeHttps OrElse
               String.IsNullOrEmpty(parsed.Host) OrElse parsed.UserInfo.Length <> 0 OrElse Not parsed.IsDefaultPort Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Link target must be an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials, whitespace or custom ports.")
            End If
            If parsed.Host.Length > 253 OrElse Not Regex.IsMatch(parsed.Host,
                "\A(?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?\.)+[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?\z") Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Link target requires a bounded DNS hostname with at least two labels.")
            End If
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub CheckDimensions(rows As Integer, columns As Integer, paired As Boolean)
            If rows < 0 OrElse columns < 0 OrElse (paired AndAlso ((rows = 0) <> (columns = 0))) Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid composite dimensions; nonspatial intent is exactly 0 x 0.")
            End If
        End Sub
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class CompositeOutputPlanner
        Public Shared Function Create(documentId As String, document As OutputDocument, items As IEnumerable(Of CompositeOutputItem),
                                      decision As OutputTargetDecision, Optional options As OutputLayoutOptions = Nothing,
                                      Optional reservations As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing) As CompositeOutputPlan
            CompositeText.Check(documentId, False)
            If document Is Nothing OrElse items Is Nothing OrElse decision Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("composite")
            decision.EnsureSupported()
            Dim limits = If(options, New OutputLayoutOptions())
            If limits.MaxRows > 1048576 OrElse limits.MaxColumns > 16384 OrElse
               decision.StartRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse decision.StartColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite grid exceeds Excel or target limits.")
            limits = New OutputLayoutOptions(limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables, Math.Min(limits.MaxRows, decision.Facts.MaxRows), Math.Min(limits.MaxColumns, decision.Facts.MaxColumns))
            Dim occupied As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            If reservations IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each rectangle In reservations
                    If rectangle Is Nothing OrElse rectangle.EndRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse rectangle.EndColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid reservation.")
                    occupied.Add(rectangle)
                Next
            End If
            Dim ids As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim placed As New List(Of CompositeOutputPlacement)()
            Dim sourceIndex As Integer = 0
            Dim previous As Long = 0
            Dim right As Integer = decision.StartColumn
            For Each item In items
                If item Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null composite item.")
                If Not ids.Add(item.Id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate composite item ID.")
                If item.RowCount > limits.MaxRows OrElse item.ColumnCount > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dimensions", "Composite dimensions exceed the configured grid.")
                Dim referenceIndex As Integer? = Nothing
                If item.ArtifactId IsNot Nothing Then
                    If sourceIndex >= document.Artifacts.Count OrElse document.Artifacts(sourceIndex).Id <> item.ArtifactId Then Throw New ArgumentException("Missing/reordered artifact reference.")
                    Dim expected = CompositeOutputItem.FromArtifact(document.Artifacts(sourceIndex),
                        If(item.Kind = CompositeOutputKind.Table, 0, item.RowCount), If(item.Kind = CompositeOutputKind.Table, 0, item.ColumnCount))
                    If item.Kind <> expected.Kind OrElse item.Text <> expected.Text OrElse item.RowCount <> expected.RowCount OrElse
                       item.ColumnCount <> expected.ColumnCount Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale composite source reference.")
                    referenceIndex = sourceIndex : sourceIndex += 1
                ElseIf item.RelatedArtifactId IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not document.Artifacts.Any(Function(a) a.Id = item.RelatedArtifactId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Missing annotation anchor.")
                End If
                Dim bounds As OutputRectangle = Nothing
                If item.RowCount > 0 AndAlso item.ColumnCount > 0 Then
                    bounds = OutputSpatialGeometry.NextBounds(decision.StartRow, decision.StartColumn, previous,
                        item.RowCount, item.ColumnCount, limits, occupied)
                    previous = bounds.EndRow : right = Math.Max(right, bounds.EndColumn)
                End If
                placed.Add(New CompositeOutputPlacement(item, placed.Count, referenceIndex, bounds))
            Next
            If sourceIndex <> document.Artifacts.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Every source artifact must have an explicit composite entry.")
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If previous > 0 Then used = New OutputRectangle(decision.StartRow, decision.StartColumn, CInt(previous), right)
            Return New CompositeOutputPlan(documentId, document, decision, limits, placed, used, occupied)
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Shared stack arithmetic for default table layouts and opt-in composite layouts.</summary>
    Friend NotInheritable Class OutputSpatialGeometry
        Public Shared Function NextBounds(startRow As Integer, startColumn As Integer, previousEnd As Long,
                                          rows As Integer, columns As Integer, limits As OutputLayoutOptions,
                                          reservations As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle)) As OutputRectangle
            Dim first As Long = If(previousEnd = 0, CLng(startRow), previousEnd + 1L + limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables)
            Dim last As Long = first + CLng(rows) - 1L
            Dim right As Long = CLng(startColumn) + CLng(columns) - 1L
            If rows <= 0 OrElse columns <= 0 OrElse last > limits.MaxRows OrElse right > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dimensions", "Output rectangle exceeds the configured grid.")
            Dim bounds As New OutputRectangle(CInt(first), startColumn, CInt(last), CInt(right))
            For Each reservation In reservations
                If bounds.Intersects(reservation) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Output rectangle collides with reservation: " & bounds.ToString())
            Next
            Return bounds
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class CompositeOutputPlanner
        Public Shared Function Create(documentId As String, document As OutputDocument, items As IEnumerable(Of CompositeOutputItem),
                                      decision As OutputTargetDecision, Optional options As OutputLayoutOptions = Nothing,
                                      Optional reservations As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing) As CompositeOutputPlan
            CompositeText.Check(documentId, False)
            If document Is Nothing OrElse items Is Nothing OrElse decision Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("composite")
            decision.EnsureSupported()
            Dim limits = If(options, New OutputLayoutOptions())
            If limits.MaxRows > 1048576 OrElse limits.MaxColumns > 16384 OrElse
               decision.StartRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse decision.StartColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite grid exceeds Excel or target limits.")
            limits = New OutputLayoutOptions(limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables, Math.Min(limits.MaxRows, decision.Facts.MaxRows), Math.Min(limits.MaxColumns, decision.Facts.MaxColumns))
            Dim occupied As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            If reservations IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each rectangle In reservations
                    If rectangle Is Nothing OrElse rectangle.EndRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse rectangle.EndColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid reservation.")
                    occupied.Add(rectangle)
                Next
            End If
            Dim ids As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            Dim placed As New List(Of CompositeOutputPlacement)()
            Dim sourceIndex As Integer = 0
            Dim previous As Long = 0
            Dim right As Integer = decision.StartColumn
            For Each item In items
                If item Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null composite item.")
                If Not ids.Add(item.Id) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate composite item ID.")
                If item.RowCount > limits.MaxRows OrElse item.ColumnCount > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dimensions", "Composite dimensions exceed the configured grid.")
                Dim referenceIndex As Integer? = Nothing
                If item.ArtifactId IsNot Nothing Then
                    If sourceIndex >= document.Artifacts.Count OrElse document.Artifacts(sourceIndex).Id <> item.ArtifactId Then Throw New ArgumentException("Missing/reordered artifact reference.")
                    Dim expected = CompositeOutputItem.FromArtifact(document.Artifacts(sourceIndex),
                        If(item.Kind = CompositeOutputKind.Table, 0, item.RowCount), If(item.Kind = CompositeOutputKind.Table, 0, item.ColumnCount))
                    If item.Kind <> expected.Kind OrElse item.Text <> expected.Text OrElse item.RowCount <> expected.RowCount OrElse
                       item.ColumnCount <> expected.ColumnCount Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale composite source reference.")
                    referenceIndex = sourceIndex : sourceIndex += 1
                ElseIf item.RelatedArtifactId IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not document.Artifacts.Any(Function(a) a.Id = item.RelatedArtifactId) Then
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Missing annotation anchor.")
                End If
                Dim bounds As OutputRectangle = Nothing
                If item.RowCount > 0 AndAlso item.ColumnCount > 0 Then
                    bounds = OutputSpatialGeometry.NextBounds(decision.StartRow, decision.StartColumn, previous,
                        item.RowCount, item.ColumnCount, limits, occupied)
                    previous = bounds.EndRow : right = Math.Max(right, bounds.EndColumn)
                End If
                placed.Add(New CompositeOutputPlacement(item, placed.Count, referenceIndex, bounds))
            Next
            If sourceIndex <> document.Artifacts.Count Then Throw New ArgumentException("Every source artifact must have an explicit composite entry.")
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If previous > 0 Then used = New OutputRectangle(decision.StartRow, decision.StartColumn, CInt(previous), right)
            Return New CompositeOutputPlan(documentId, document, decision, limits, placed, used, occupied)
        End Function
    End Class

Friend NotInheritable Class OutputSpatialGeometry
        Public Shared Function NextBounds(startRow As Integer, startColumn As Integer, previousEnd As Long,
                                          rows As Integer, columns As Integer, limits As OutputLayoutOptions,
                                          reservations As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle)) As OutputRectangle
            Dim first As Long = If(previousEnd = 0, CLng(startRow), previousEnd + 1L + limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables)
            Dim last As Long = first + CLng(rows) - 1L
            Dim right As Long = CLng(startColumn) + CLng(columns) - 1L
            If rows <= 0 OrElse columns <= 0 OrElse last > limits.MaxRows OrElse right > limits.MaxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dimensions", "Output rectangle exceeds the configured grid.")
            Dim bounds As New OutputRectangle(CInt(first), startColumn, CInt(last), CInt(right))
            For Each reservation In reservations
                If bounds.Intersects(reservation) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Output rectangle collides with reservation: " & bounds.ToString())
            Next
            Return bounds
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class OfficeCompositeOutputPlanAdapter
        Public Shared Function Prepare(plan As CompositeOutputPlan, semantics As OutputSemanticPlan) As OfficeCompositeOutputPlan
            If plan Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(plan))
            If plan.Target.EffectiveDestination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite live output requires a new worksheet; current-sheet composite insertion is disabled.")
            Dim limits As New InputSizeLimits()
            If plan.Items.Count > limits.MaxRanges OrElse plan.Reservations.Count > limits.MaxRanges Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite item/reservation limit exceeded.")
            Dim cells As Long = 0
            Dim bytes As Long = 0
            Dim placements As New List(Of OutputBlockPlacement)()
            Dim tableBounds As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            For Each entry In plan.Items
                Dim item = entry.Item
                cells += CLng(item.RowCount) * item.ColumnCount
                bytes += 4096L + CLng(item.Text.Length) * 2L
                If cells > limits.MaxTotalCells OrElse bytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite transport memory limit exceeded.")
                If Not entry.SourceIndex.HasValue Then Continue For
                Dim artifact = plan.SourceDocument.Artifacts(entry.SourceIndex.Value)
                Dim table = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim bounds = If(table Is Nothing, Nothing, entry.Bounds)
                If bounds IsNot Nothing Then tableBounds.Add(bounds)
                placements.Add(New OutputBlockPlacement(artifact, entry.SourceIndex.Value,
                    If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount), If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount),
                    bounds, plan.Target.StartRow, plan.Target.StartColumn, 0))
            Next
            Dim target = plan.Target.ToTarget()
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If tableBounds.Count > 0 Then
                used = New OutputRectangle(tableBounds.Min(Function(b) b.StartRow), tableBounds.Min(Function(b) b.StartColumn),
                    tableBounds.Max(Function(b) b.EndRow), tableBounds.Max(Function(b) b.EndColumn))
                target.StartRow = used.StartRow : target.StartColumn = used.StartColumn
            End If
            Dim layout As New OutputLayoutPlan(target, plan.Options, placements, used, plan.Reservations)
            ' Reuses complete scalar/type/provenance/semantic and per-table format validation.
            Dim tables = OfficeOutputPlanAdapter.Prepare(plan.SourceDocument, semantics, layout, autoFit:=False)
            Dim result As New OfficeCompositeOutputPlan(plan, tables)
            For Each item In result.Items
                For Each value In New String() {item.Id, item.Kind, item.ArtifactId, item.RelatedArtifactId, item.Text,
                    item.LinkTarget, item.Caption, item.Severity, item.Code, item.FieldPath, item.Message, item.ReferenceKey, item.Purpose, item.Description}
                    If value Is Nothing Then Continue For
                    CompositeText.Check(value, True)
                    bytes += 1024L + CLng(value.Length) * 2L
                Next
            Next
            For Each table In tables.Tables
                For Each cell In table.Cells
                    bytes += 1024L + CLng(cell.NumberFormat.Length) * 2L + If(cell.Value.TextValue Is Nothing, 0L, CLng(cell.Value.TextValue.Length) * 2L)
                Next
            Next
            If bytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite aggregate byte limit exceeded.")
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class OfficeCompositeOutputPlanAdapter
        Public Shared Function Prepare(plan As CompositeOutputPlan, semantics As OutputSemanticPlan) As OfficeCompositeOutputPlan
            If plan Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(plan))
            If plan.Target.EffectiveDestination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite live output requires a new worksheet; current-sheet composite insertion is disabled.")
            Dim limits As New InputSizeLimits()
            If plan.Items.Count > limits.MaxRanges OrElse plan.Reservations.Count > limits.MaxRanges Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite item/reservation limit exceeded.")
            Dim cells As Long = 0
            Dim bytes As Long = 0
            Dim placements As New List(Of OutputBlockPlacement)()
            Dim tableBounds As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            For Each entry In plan.Items
                Dim item = entry.Item
                cells += CLng(item.RowCount) * item.ColumnCount
                bytes += 4096L + CLng(item.Text.Length) * 2L
                If cells > limits.MaxTotalCells OrElse bytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite transport memory limit exceeded.")
                If Not entry.SourceIndex.HasValue Then Continue For
                Dim artifact = plan.SourceDocument.Artifacts(entry.SourceIndex.Value)
                Dim table = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim bounds = If(table Is Nothing, Nothing, entry.Bounds)
                If bounds IsNot Nothing Then tableBounds.Add(bounds)
                placements.Add(New OutputBlockPlacement(artifact, entry.SourceIndex.Value,
                    If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount), If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount),
                    bounds, plan.Target.StartRow, plan.Target.StartColumn, 0))
            Next
            Dim target = plan.Target.ToTarget()
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If tableBounds.Count > 0 Then
                used = New OutputRectangle(tableBounds.Min(Function(b) b.StartRow), tableBounds.Min(Function(b) b.StartColumn),
                    tableBounds.Max(Function(b) b.EndRow), tableBounds.Max(Function(b) b.EndColumn))
                target.StartRow = used.StartRow : target.StartColumn = used.StartColumn
            End If
            Dim layout As New OutputLayoutPlan(target, plan.Options, placements, used, plan.Reservations)
            ' Reuses complete scalar/type/provenance/semantic and per-table format validation.
            Dim tables = OfficeOutputPlanAdapter.Prepare(plan.SourceDocument, semantics, layout, autoFit:=False)
            Dim result As New OfficeCompositeOutputPlan(plan, tables)
            For Each item In result.Items
                For Each value In New String() {item.Id, item.Kind, item.ArtifactId, item.RelatedArtifactId, item.Text,
                    item.LinkTarget, item.Caption, item.Severity, item.Code, item.FieldPath, item.Message, item.ReferenceKey, item.Purpose, item.Description}
                    If value Is Nothing Then Continue For
                    CompositeText.Check(value, True)
                    bytes += 1024L + CLng(value.Length) * 2L
                Next
            Next
            For Each table In tables.Tables
                For Each cell In table.Cells
                    bytes += 1024L + CLng(cell.NumberFormat.Length) * 2L + If(cell.Value.TextValue Is Nothing, 0L, CLng(cell.Value.TextValue.Length) * 2L)
                Next
            Next
            If bytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Composite aggregate byte limit exceeded.")
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class

    Public NotInheritable Class OfficeOutputValue
        Private Sub New(kind As String, Optional number As Double? = Nothing,
                        Optional text As String = Nothing, Optional booleanValue As Boolean? = Nothing)
            Me.Kind = kind
            NumberValue = number
            TextValue = text
            Me.BooleanValue = booleanValue
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As String
        Public ReadOnly Property NumberValue As Double?
        Public ReadOnly Property TextValue As String
        Public ReadOnly Property BooleanValue As Boolean?

        Public Shared Function FromCell(cell As OutputCell) As OfficeOutputValue
            If cell Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(cell))
            Select Case cell.Kind
                Case OutputCellKind.Blank : Return New OfficeOutputValue("blank")
                Case OutputCellKind.Text : Return New OfficeOutputValue("text", text:=cell.TextValue)
                Case OutputCellKind.BooleanValue : Return New OfficeOutputValue("boolean", booleanValue:=cell.BooleanValue)
                Case OutputCellKind.Number
                    Dim number As Double
                    If cell.NumberKind = OutputNumberKind.Binary64 Then
                        number = cell.BinaryValue.Value
                    ElseIf cell.NumberKind = OutputNumberKind.ExactDecimal Then
                        Dim exact As Decimal = cell.DecimalValue.Value
                        number = CDbl(exact)
                        If Not ExactlyRepresented(exact, number) Then
                            Throw New ArgumentException("Office output cannot losslessly transport this exact decimal/integer as binary64.")
                        End If
                    Else
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Unknown output number kind.")
                    End If
                    If Double.IsNaN(number) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(number) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nonfinite Office output number.")
                    Return New OfficeOutputValue("number", number:=number)
                Case Else
                    ' No formula dialect or native error transport is authorized in this adapter.
                    Throw New ArgumentException("Office output does not support error or trusted formula cells.")
            End Select
        End Function

        Private Shared Function ExactlyRepresented(exact As Decimal, number As Double) As Boolean
            Dim parts As Integer() = Decimal.GetBits(exact)
            Dim numerator As BigInteger = New BigInteger(CLng(parts(0)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(1)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 32) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(2)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 64)
            If parts(3) < 0 Then numerator = -numerator
            Dim denominator As BigInteger = BigInteger.Pow(10, (parts(3) >> 16) And &HFF)
            Dim bits As Long = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(number)
            Dim exponentBits As Integer = CInt((bits >> 52) And &H7FFL)
            Dim significand As BigInteger = New BigInteger(bits And &HFFFFFFFFFFFFFL)
            Dim exponent As Integer = -1074
            If exponentBits <> 0 Then
                significand += BigInteger.One << 52
                exponent = exponentBits - 1075
            End If
            If bits < 0 Then significand = -significand
            If exponent >= 0 Then Return numerator = (significand << exponent) * denominator
            Return (numerator << -exponent) = significand * denominator
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Shared Function Prepare(document As OutputDocument, semantics As OutputSemanticPlan,
                                       layout As OutputLayoutPlan, Optional autoFit As Boolean = True) As OfficeOutputPlan
            If document Is Nothing OrElse semantics Is Nothing OrElse layout Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("plan")
            If Not Object.ReferenceEquals(document, semantics.SourceDocument) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale semantic source document.")
            If layout.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet AndAlso
               layout.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported Office output destination.")
            If layout.StartRow < 1 OrElse layout.StartRow > 1048576 OrElse layout.StartColumn < 1 OrElse layout.StartColumn > 16384 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Office output target is outside the worksheet grid.")
            End If
            If document.Artifacts.Count <> semantics.Artifacts.Count OrElse document.Artifacts.Count <> layout.Placements.Count Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Output plan artifact count mismatch.")
            End If
            ' Reuse the prototype's existing 01.10 bounds as adapter memory guards, not a new product output quota.
            Dim limits As New InputSizeLimits()
            If document.Artifacts.Count > limits.MaxRanges Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter artifact limit exceeded.")
            Dim totalCells As Long = 0
            Dim estimatedBytes As Long = 0
            If layout.WorksheetName Is Nothing OrElse layout.WorksheetName.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid Office worksheet name transport.")
            Dim tables As New List(Of OfficeOutputTable)()
            Dim ordinal As Integer = 0
            Dim policy = semantics.Policy
            Dim format As String = Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.BuildExcelNumberFormat(
                New PValuePresentationSettings With {.DecimalPlaces = policy.DecimalPlaces,
                    .SmallValueDisplay = policy.SmallValueDisplay, .UseUpperBound = policy.UseUpperBound})
            For index As Integer = 0 To document.Artifacts.Count - 1
                Dim artifact = document.Artifacts(index)
                If artifact.Id.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office artifact ID is too long.")
                Dim block = layout.Placements(index)
                Dim styled = semantics.Artifacts(index)
                Dim table = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim rows As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount)
                Dim columns As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount)
                If Not Object.ReferenceEquals(block.Artifact, artifact) OrElse block.Index <> index OrElse
                   block.ArtifactId <> styled.ArtifactId OrElse block.Kind <> styled.Kind OrElse
                   block.RowCount <> rows OrElse block.ColumnCount <> columns OrElse
                   styled.RowCount <> rows OrElse styled.ColumnCount <> columns OrElse
                   styled.Cells.Count <> CLng(rows) * columns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output identity/order/shape mismatch.")
                If table Is Nothing Then
                    If block.Bounds IsNot Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nonspatial artifact has worksheet bounds.")
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim tableOrdinal As Integer = ordinal
                ordinal += 1
                If rows = 0 OrElse columns = 0 Then
                    If block.Bounds IsNot Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Zero-area table has worksheet bounds.")
                    Continue For
                End If
                totalCells += CLng(rows) * columns
                If totalCells > limits.MaxTotalCells Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter cell limit exceeded.")
                Dim bounds = block.Bounds
                If bounds Is Nothing OrElse bounds.EndRow > 1048576 OrElse bounds.EndColumn > 16384 OrElse
                   bounds.EndRow - bounds.StartRow + 1 <> rows OrElse bounds.EndColumn - bounds.StartColumn + 1 <> columns OrElse
                   layout.UsedBounds Is Nothing OrElse Not layout.UsedBounds.Contains(bounds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output rectangle mismatch.")
                For Each prior In tables
                    If prior.Bounds.Intersects(bounds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Overlapping output rectangles.")
                Next
                Dim cells As New List(Of OfficeOutputCell)()
                Dim canonical As New OutputCellTable(table)
                For cellIndex As Integer = 0 To styled.Cells.Count - 1
                    Dim style = styled.Cells(cellIndex)
                    Dim row As Integer = cellIndex \ columns
                    Dim column As Integer = cellIndex Mod columns
                    Dim expected = canonical.CellAt(row, column)
                    If style.ArtifactId <> artifact.Id OrElse style.Row <> row OrElse style.Column <> column OrElse
                       Not SameCell(expected, style.Cell) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale or reordered semantic cell.")
                    Dim resolvedFormat As String
                    Select Case style.NumberFormat.Kind
                        Case OutputNumberFormatKind.General : resolvedFormat = "General"
                        Case OutputNumberFormatKind.PValue : resolvedFormat = format
                        Case Else : Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported Office number format intent.")
                    End Select
                    Dim projected As New OfficeOutputCell(style, resolvedFormat)
                    Dim text As String = projected.Value.TextValue
                    If text IsNot Nothing AndAlso text.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office text exceeds the worksheet cell limit.")
                    estimatedBytes += 1024L + If(text Is Nothing, 0L, (CLng(text.Length) + 1L) * 2L) + CLng(resolvedFormat.Length) * 2L
                    If estimatedBytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter byte limit exceeded.")
                    cells.Add(projected)
                Next
                tables.Add(New OfficeOutputTable(block, tableOrdinal, cells, autoFit))
            Next
            If (tables.Count = 0) <> (layout.UsedBounds Is Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output envelope mismatch.")
            Return New OfficeOutputPlan(layout, ordinal, tables, format)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function SameCell(left As OutputCell, right As OutputCell) As Boolean
            If right Is Nothing OrElse left.Kind <> right.Kind OrElse left.NumberKind <> right.NumberKind Then Return False

            Dim exponentBits As Integer = CInt((bits >> 52) And &H7FFL)

            Dim exponent As Integer = -1074

Public NotInheritable Class OfficeOutputPlanAdapter
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Prepare(document As OutputDocument, semantics As OutputSemanticPlan,
                                       layout As OutputLayoutPlan, Optional autoFit As Boolean = True) As OfficeOutputPlan
            If document Is Nothing OrElse semantics Is Nothing OrElse layout Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("plan")
            If Not Object.ReferenceEquals(document, semantics.SourceDocument) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale semantic source document.")
            If layout.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet AndAlso
               layout.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet Then Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported Office output destination.")
            If layout.StartRow < 1 OrElse layout.StartRow > 1048576 OrElse layout.StartColumn < 1 OrElse layout.StartColumn > 16384 Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Office output target is outside the worksheet grid.")
            End If
            If document.Artifacts.Count <> semantics.Artifacts.Count OrElse document.Artifacts.Count <> layout.Placements.Count Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Output plan artifact count mismatch.")
            End If
            ' Reuse the prototype's existing 01.10 bounds as adapter memory guards, not a new product output quota.
            Dim limits As New InputSizeLimits()
            If document.Artifacts.Count > limits.MaxRanges Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter artifact limit exceeded.")
            Dim totalCells As Long = 0
            Dim estimatedBytes As Long = 0
            If layout.WorksheetName Is Nothing OrElse layout.WorksheetName.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid Office worksheet name transport.")
            Dim tables As New List(Of OfficeOutputTable)()
            Dim ordinal As Integer = 0
            Dim policy = semantics.Policy
            Dim format As String = Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.BuildExcelNumberFormat(
                New PValuePresentationSettings With {.DecimalPlaces = policy.DecimalPlaces,
                    .SmallValueDisplay = policy.SmallValueDisplay, .UseUpperBound = policy.UseUpperBound})
            For index As Integer = 0 To document.Artifacts.Count - 1
                Dim artifact = document.Artifacts(index)
                If artifact.Id.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office artifact ID is too long.")
                Dim block = layout.Placements(index)
                Dim styled = semantics.Artifacts(index)
                Dim table = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim rows As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount)
                Dim columns As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount)
                If Not Object.ReferenceEquals(block.Artifact, artifact) OrElse block.Index <> index OrElse
                   block.ArtifactId <> styled.ArtifactId OrElse block.Kind <> styled.Kind OrElse
                   block.RowCount <> rows OrElse block.ColumnCount <> columns OrElse
                   styled.RowCount <> rows OrElse styled.ColumnCount <> columns OrElse
                   styled.Cells.Count <> CLng(rows) * columns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output identity/order/shape mismatch.")
                If table Is Nothing Then
                    If block.Bounds IsNot Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Nonspatial artifact has worksheet bounds.")
                    Continue For
                End If
                Dim tableOrdinal As Integer = ordinal
                ordinal += 1
                If rows = 0 OrElse columns = 0 Then
                    If block.Bounds IsNot Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Zero-area table has worksheet bounds.")
                    Continue For
                End If
                totalCells += CLng(rows) * columns
                If totalCells > limits.MaxTotalCells Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter cell limit exceeded.")
                Dim bounds = block.Bounds
                If bounds Is Nothing OrElse bounds.EndRow > 1048576 OrElse bounds.EndColumn > 16384 OrElse
                   bounds.EndRow - bounds.StartRow + 1 <> rows OrElse bounds.EndColumn - bounds.StartColumn + 1 <> columns OrElse
                   layout.UsedBounds Is Nothing OrElse Not layout.UsedBounds.Contains(bounds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output rectangle mismatch.")
                For Each prior In tables
                    If prior.Bounds.Intersects(bounds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Overlapping output rectangles.")
                Next
                Dim cells As New List(Of OfficeOutputCell)()
                Dim canonical As New OutputCellTable(table)
                For cellIndex As Integer = 0 To styled.Cells.Count - 1
                    Dim style = styled.Cells(cellIndex)
                    Dim row As Integer = cellIndex \ columns
                    Dim column As Integer = cellIndex Mod columns
                    Dim expected = canonical.CellAt(row, column)
                    If style.ArtifactId <> artifact.Id OrElse style.Row <> row OrElse style.Column <> column OrElse
                       Not SameCell(expected, style.Cell) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Stale or reordered semantic cell.")
                    Dim resolvedFormat As String
                    Select Case style.NumberFormat.Kind
                        Case OutputNumberFormatKind.General : resolvedFormat = "General"
                        Case OutputNumberFormatKind.PValue : resolvedFormat = format
                        Case Else : Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported Office number format intent.")
                    End Select
                    Dim projected As New OfficeOutputCell(style, resolvedFormat)
                    Dim text As String = projected.Value.TextValue
                    If text IsNot Nothing AndAlso text.Length > 32767 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office text exceeds the worksheet cell limit.")
                    estimatedBytes += 1024L + If(text Is Nothing, 0L, (CLng(text.Length) + 1L) * 2L) + CLng(resolvedFormat.Length) * 2L
                    If estimatedBytes > limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Throw New ArgumentException("Office output adapter byte limit exceeded.")
                    cells.Add(projected)
                Next
                tables.Add(New OfficeOutputTable(block, tableOrdinal, cells, autoFit))
            Next
            If (tables.Count = 0) <> (layout.UsedBounds Is Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output envelope mismatch.")
            Return New OfficeOutputPlan(layout, ordinal, tables, format)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function SameCell(left As OutputCell, right As OutputCell) As Boolean
            If right Is Nothing OrElse left.Kind <> right.Kind OrElse left.NumberKind <> right.NumberKind Then Return False
            Select Case left.Kind
                Case OutputCellKind.Blank : Return True
                Case OutputCellKind.Text : Return String.Equals(left.TextValue, right.TextValue, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                Case OutputCellKind.BooleanValue : Return left.BooleanValue.Value = right.BooleanValue.Value
                Case OutputCellKind.Number
                    If left.NumberKind = OutputNumberKind.ExactDecimal Then Return left.DecimalValue.Value = right.DecimalValue.Value
                    Return BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(left.BinaryValue.Value) = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(right.BinaryValue.Value)
                Case Else : Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported Office output scalar.")
            End Select
        End Function
    End Class

Private Shared Function SameCell(left As OutputCell, right As OutputCell) As Boolean
            If right Is Nothing OrElse left.Kind <> right.Kind OrElse left.NumberKind <> right.NumberKind Then Return False
