Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public Enum OutputCellKind
        Blank = 0
        Number = 1
        Text = 2
        BooleanValue = 3
        [Error] = 4
        Formula = 5
    End Enum

    Public Enum OutputNumberKind
        Binary64 = 1
        ExactDecimal = 2
    End Enum

    Public Enum OutputErrorKind
        Unknown = 0
        NullIntersection = 1
        DivisionByZero = 2
        InvalidValue = 3
        InvalidReference = 4
        UnknownName = 5
        InvalidNumber = 6
        NotAvailable = 7
        GettingData = 8
        NonFinite = 9
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Immutable scalar union. Only the fields selected by Kind/NumberKind are populated.
    ''' ExactDecimal retains every CLR integer/Decimal without binary rounding. Binary64
    ''' retains finite Single/Double values, including the sign bit of negative zero.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OutputCell
        Private Sub New(kind As OutputCellKind, Optional numberKind As OutputNumberKind? = Nothing,
                        Optional binaryValue As Double? = Nothing, Optional decimalValue As Decimal? = Nothing,
                        Optional text As String = Nothing, Optional booleanValue As Boolean? = Nothing,
                        Optional errorKind As OutputErrorKind? = Nothing, Optional errorCode As String = Nothing,
                        Optional originalError As String = Nothing, Optional nativeCode As Integer? = Nothing,
                        Optional safeDetail As String = Nothing, Optional formulaExpression As String = Nothing,
                        Optional formulaLanguage As String = Nothing)
            Me.Kind = kind
            Me.NumberKind = numberKind
            Me.BinaryValue = binaryValue
            Me.DecimalValue = decimalValue
            Me.TextValue = text
            Me.BooleanValue = booleanValue
            Me.ErrorKind = errorKind
            Me.ErrorCode = errorCode
            Me.OriginalError = originalError
            Me.NativeErrorCode = nativeCode
            Me.SafeErrorDetail = safeDetail
            Me.FormulaExpression = formulaExpression
            Me.FormulaLanguage = formulaLanguage
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As OutputCellKind
        Public ReadOnly Property NumberKind As OutputNumberKind?
        Public ReadOnly Property BinaryValue As Double?
        Public ReadOnly Property DecimalValue As Decimal?
        Public ReadOnly Property TextValue As String
        Public ReadOnly Property BooleanValue As Boolean?
        Public ReadOnly Property ErrorKind As OutputErrorKind?
        Public ReadOnly Property ErrorCode As String
        Public ReadOnly Property OriginalError As String
        ''' <summary>Only a code supplied by the caller; no native codes are synthesized.</summary>
        Public ReadOnly Property NativeErrorCode As Integer?
        Public ReadOnly Property SafeErrorDetail As String
        Public ReadOnly Property FormulaExpression As String
        Public ReadOnly Property FormulaLanguage As String

        Public Shared Function BlankCell() As OutputCell
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Blank)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NumberCell(value As Double) As OutputCell
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(value), "Number cells must be finite.")
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Number, OutputNumberKind.Binary64, binaryValue:=value)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function DecimalCell(value As Decimal) As OutputCell
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Number, OutputNumberKind.ExactDecimal, decimalValue:=value)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TextCell(value As String) As OutputCell
            If value Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(value))
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Text, text:=value)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BooleanCell(value As Boolean) As OutputCell
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.BooleanValue, booleanValue:=value)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Explicit standard token mapping, ordinal and case sensitive. Unknown tokens retain
        ''' their original spelling and optional supplied native code. Strings in FromRaw never
        ''' enter this mapping. safeDetail must already be safe for downstream display.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function SpreadsheetError(token As String, Optional nativeCode As Integer? = Nothing,
                                                Optional safeDetail As String = Nothing) As OutputCell
            If token Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(token))
            Dim kind As OutputErrorKind
            Dim code As String
            Select Case token
                Case "#NULL!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NullIntersection : code = "spreadsheet.null"
                Case "#DIV/0!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.DivisionByZero : code = "spreadsheet.division-by-zero"
                Case "#VALUE!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidValue : code = "spreadsheet.value"
                Case "#REF!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidReference : code = "spreadsheet.reference"
                Case "#NAME?" : kind = OutputErrorKind.UnknownName : code = "spreadsheet.name"
                Case "#NUM!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidNumber : code = "spreadsheet.number"
                Case "#N/A" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NotAvailable : code = "spreadsheet.not-available"
                Case "#GETTING_DATA" : kind = OutputErrorKind.GettingData : code = "spreadsheet.getting-data"
                Case Else : kind = OutputErrorKind.Unknown : code = "spreadsheet.unknown"
            End Select
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=kind, errorCode:=code,
                                  originalError:=token, nativeCode:=nativeCode, safeDetail:=safeDetail)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Caller attests trusted intent. Language is an explicit logical dialect identifier;
        ''' no grammar parsing, reference translation or evaluation occurs. Future adapters
        ''' must explicitly support the dialect before executing. Never inferred from text.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function TrustedFormula(expression As String, language As String) As OutputCell
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expression) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Formula intent is required.", NameOf(expression))
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(language) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Formula language is required.", NameOf(language))
            For Each ch As Char In expression & language
                If Char.IsControl(ch) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Control characters are not supported in formula intent.")
            Next
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Formula, formulaExpression:=expression, formulaLanguage:=language)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Explicit bridge for the 02.01 whitelist. Unsupported inputs throw, never ToString.
        ''' Nonfinite floats become portable error codes (not Excel errors/native codes).
        ''' Integers and decimals remain exact; future binary-only adapters must check loss.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromRaw(value As Object) As OutputCell
            If value Is Nothing Then Return BlankCell()
            Dim valueType As Type = value.GetType()
            If Not valueType.IsEnum Then
                Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(valueType)
                    Case TypeCode.String : Return TextCell(DirectCast(value, String))
                    Case TypeCode.Boolean : Return BooleanCell(DirectCast(value, Boolean))
                    Case TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16,
                         TypeCode.Int32, TypeCode.UInt32, TypeCode.Int64, TypeCode.UInt64, TypeCode.Decimal
                        Return DecimalCell(Convert.ToDecimal(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    Case TypeCode.Single, TypeCode.Double
                        Dim number As Double = Convert.ToDouble(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                        If Double.IsNaN(number) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(number) Then
                            Dim code As String = If(Double.IsNaN(number), "number.nan",
                                If(number > 0, "number.positive-infinity", "number.negative-infinity"))
                            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=OutputErrorKind.NonFinite, errorCode:=code)
                        End If
                        Return NumberCell(number)
                End Select
            End If
            Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported output cell payload type: " & valueType.FullName & ".", NameOf(value))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Probability-only preview projection to Core's Double policy. Out-of-[0,1] exact decimals
        ''' are rejected before conversion, so rounding cannot make them valid probabilities.
        ''' The exact primary value is never replaced by this projection.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Function TryGetProbability(ByRef value As Double) As Boolean
            value = 0
            If Kind <> OutputCellKind.Number Then Return False
            If NumberKind.Value = OutputNumberKind.ExactDecimal Then
                If DecimalValue.Value < 0D OrElse DecimalValue.Value > 1D Then Return False
                value = CDbl(DecimalValue.Value)
            Else
                value = BinaryValue.Value
            End If
            Return value >= 0 AndAlso value <= 1
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Single significance predicate: a typed probability <= finite alpha in (0,1).
        ''' Exact decimals compare as rational numbers against the actual binary64 alpha;
        ''' preview rounding to Double cannot turn a value just above alpha significant.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Function IsSignificantAt(alpha As Double) As Boolean
            If Double.IsNaN(alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(alpha))
            End If
            Dim probability As Double
            If Not TryGetProbability(probability) Then Return False
            If NumberKind.Value = OutputNumberKind.Binary64 Then Return probability <= alpha

            ' Decimal is a 96-bit integer / 10^scale. Alpha is significand * 2^exponent.
            ' Cross multiplication uses unbounded integers, avoiding overflow and rounding.
            Dim parts As Integer() = Decimal.GetBits(DecimalValue.Value)
            Dim magnitude As BigInteger = New BigInteger(CLng(parts(0)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(1)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 32) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(2)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 64)
            Dim denominator As BigInteger = BigInteger.Pow(10, (parts(3) >> 16) And &HFF)
            Dim alphaBits As Long = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(alpha)
            Dim exponentBits As Integer = CInt((alphaBits >> 52) And &H7FFL)
            Dim significand As Long = alphaBits And &HFFFFFFFFFFFFFL
            Dim exponent As Integer = -1074
            If exponentBits <> 0 Then
                significand = significand Or &H10000000000000L
                exponent = exponentBits - 1075
            End If
            ' Alpha < 1 guarantees a negative exponent, including subnormal alpha.
            Return (magnitude << -exponent) <= New BigInteger(significand) * denominator
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Independent canonical matrix snapshot; coordinates are zero-based array coordinates.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OutputCellTable
        Private ReadOnly _cells As OutputCell(,)

        Public Sub New(artifact As OutputTableArtifact)
            If artifact Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(artifact))
            ArtifactId = artifact.Id
            RowCount = artifact.RowCount
            ColumnCount = artifact.ColumnCount
            _cells = New OutputCell(RowCount - 1, ColumnCount - 1) {}
            Dim raw As Object(,) = artifact.Model.Values
            For row As Integer = 0 To RowCount - 1
                For column As Integer = 0 To ColumnCount - 1
                    _cells(row, column) = OutputCell.FromRaw(raw(row, column))
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property ArtifactId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property RowCount As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property ColumnCount As Integer

        Public Function CellAt(row As Integer, column As Integer) As OutputCell
            If row < 0 OrElse row >= RowCount Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(row))
            If column < 0 OrElse column >= ColumnCount Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(column))
            Return _cells(row, column)
        End Function
    End Class

            Dim kind As OutputErrorKind
            Dim code As String
            Select Case token
                Case "#NULL!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NullIntersection : code = "spreadsheet.null"
                Case "#DIV/0!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.DivisionByZero : code = "spreadsheet.division-by-zero"
                Case "#VALUE!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidValue : code = "spreadsheet.value"
                Case "#REF!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidReference : code = "spreadsheet.reference"
                Case "#NAME?" : kind = OutputErrorKind.UnknownName : code = "spreadsheet.name"
                Case "#NUM!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidNumber : code = "spreadsheet.number"
                Case "#N/A" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NotAvailable : code = "spreadsheet.not-available"
                Case "#GETTING_DATA" : kind = OutputErrorKind.GettingData : code = "spreadsheet.getting-data"
                Case Else : kind = OutputErrorKind.Unknown : code = "spreadsheet.unknown"
            End Select
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=kind, errorCode:=code,
                                  originalError:=token, nativeCode:=nativeCode, safeDetail:=safeDetail)

            For Each ch As Char In expression & language
                If Char.IsControl(ch) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Control characters are not supported in formula intent.")

        End Function

        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function FromRaw(value As Object) As OutputCell
            If value Is Nothing Then Return BlankCell()
            Dim valueType As Type = value.GetType()
            If Not valueType.IsEnum Then
                Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(valueType)
                    Case TypeCode.String : Return TextCell(DirectCast(value, String))
                    Case TypeCode.Boolean : Return BooleanCell(DirectCast(value, Boolean))
                    Case TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16,
                         TypeCode.Int32, TypeCode.UInt32, TypeCode.Int64, TypeCode.UInt64, TypeCode.Decimal
                        Return DecimalCell(Convert.ToDecimal(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    Case TypeCode.Single, TypeCode.Double
                        Dim number As Double = Convert.ToDouble(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                        If Double.IsNaN(number) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(number) Then
                            Dim code As String = If(Double.IsNaN(number), "number.nan",
                                If(number > 0, "number.positive-infinity", "number.negative-infinity"))
                            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=OutputErrorKind.NonFinite, errorCode:=code)
                        End If
                        Return NumberCell(number)
                End Select
            End If
            Throw New ArgumentException("Unsupported output cell payload type: " & valueType.FullName & ".", NameOf(value))
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Probability-only preview projection to Core's Double policy. Out-of-[0,1] exact decimals
        ''' are rejected before conversion, so rounding cannot make them valid probabilities.
        ''' The exact primary value is never replaced by this projection.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Function TryGetProbability(ByRef value As Double) As Boolean
            value = 0
            If Kind <> OutputCellKind.Number Then Return False
            If NumberKind.Value = OutputNumberKind.ExactDecimal Then
                If DecimalValue.Value < 0D OrElse DecimalValue.Value > 1D Then Return False
                value = CDbl(DecimalValue.Value)
            Else
                value = BinaryValue.Value
            End If
            Return value >= 0 AndAlso value <= 1
        End Function

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Single significance predicate: a typed probability <= finite alpha in (0,1).
        ''' Exact decimals compare as rational numbers against the actual binary64 alpha;
        ''' preview rounding to Double cannot turn a value just above alpha significant.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Function IsSignificantAt(alpha As Double) As Boolean
            If Double.IsNaN(alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(alpha))
            End If
            Dim probability As Double
            If Not TryGetProbability(probability) Then Return False
            If NumberKind.Value = OutputNumberKind.Binary64 Then Return probability <= alpha

            ' Decimal is a 96-bit integer / 10^scale. Alpha is significand * 2^exponent.
            ' Cross multiplication uses unbounded integers, avoiding overflow and rounding.
            Dim parts As Integer() = Decimal.GetBits(DecimalValue.Value)
            Dim magnitude As BigInteger = New BigInteger(CLng(parts(0)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(1)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 32) +
                (New BigInteger(CLng(parts(2)) And &HFFFFFFFFL) << 64)
            Dim denominator As BigInteger = BigInteger.Pow(10, (parts(3) >> 16) And &HFF)
            Dim alphaBits As Long = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(alpha)
            Dim exponentBits As Integer = CInt((alphaBits >> 52) And &H7FFL)
            Dim significand As Long = alphaBits And &HFFFFFFFFFFFFFL
            Dim exponent As Integer = -1074
            If exponentBits <> 0 Then
                significand = significand Or &H10000000000000L
                exponent = exponentBits - 1075
            End If
            ' Alpha < 1 guarantees a negative exponent, including subnormal alpha.
            Return (magnitude << -exponent) <= New BigInteger(significand) * denominator
        End Function

    Public NotInheritable Class OutputLayoutPlanner
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Stacks complete matrices vertically in document order. Zero-area/nonspatial entries
        ''' consume neither rows nor gaps. All reservations refer to the same resolved logical
        ''' destination; no sheet-name comparisons establish physical identity. Invalid inputs
        ''' throw ArgumentException; collisions throw InvalidOperationException before return.
        ''' Semantic identity/shape validation is optional and never recomputes cell semantics.
        ''' Inputs must not be mutated concurrently while this snapshot is being constructed.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Create(document As OutputDocument, Optional target As SpreadsheetOutputTarget = Nothing,
                                      Optional options As OutputLayoutOptions = Nothing,
                                      Optional occupiedRectangles As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing,
                                      Optional semanticPlan As OutputSemanticPlan = Nothing) As OutputLayoutPlan
            If document Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(document))
            Dim requested As SpreadsheetOutputTarget = If(target, New SpreadsheetOutputTarget())
            Dim resolved As New SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {
                .Destination = requested.Destination,
                .WorksheetName = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requested.WorksheetName), "BESHStat_Result", requested.WorksheetName),
                .StartRow = requested.StartRow, .StartColumn = requested.StartColumn}
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetOutputDestination), resolved.Destination) Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(target), "Unknown requested output destination.")
            End If
            Dim limits As OutputLayoutOptions = If(options, New OutputLayoutOptions())
            If resolved.StartRow < 1 OrElse resolved.StartRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse
               resolved.StartColumn < 1 OrElse resolved.StartColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(target), "Requested one-based start cell is outside the configured grid.")
            End If
            Dim reservations As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            If occupiedRectangles IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each rectangle As OutputRectangle In occupiedRectangles
                    If rectangle Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null occupied rectangle.", NameOf(occupiedRectangles))
                    CheckGrid(rectangle, limits, NameOf(occupiedRectangles))
                    reservations.Add(rectangle)
                Next
            End If
            If semanticPlan IsNot Nothing AndAlso semanticPlan.Artifacts.Count <> document.Artifacts.Count Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Semantic artifact count does not match the document.", NameOf(semanticPlan))
            End If
            Dim placements As New List(Of OutputBlockPlacement)()
            Dim placedBounds As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            Dim previousEndRow As Long = 0
            Dim rightmost As Integer = resolved.StartColumn
            For index As Integer = 0 To document.Artifacts.Count - 1
                Dim artifact As OutputArtifact = document.Artifacts(index)
                Dim table As OutputTableArtifact = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim rows As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount)
                Dim columns As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount)
                If rows < 0 OrElse columns < 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Negative table dimensions: " & artifact.Id, NameOf(document))
                If semanticPlan IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim styled As OutputArtifactStylePlan = semanticPlan.Artifacts(index)
                    If Not String.Equals(styled.ArtifactId, artifact.Id, StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                       styled.Kind <> artifact.Kind OrElse styled.RowCount <> rows OrElse styled.ColumnCount <> columns Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Semantic identity/order/shape mismatch at artifact: " & artifact.Id, NameOf(semanticPlan))
                    End If
                End If
                Dim bounds As OutputRectangle = Nothing
                Dim gap As Integer = 0
                If rows > 0 AndAlso columns > 0 Then
                    gap = If(placedBounds.Count = 0, 0, limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables)
                    ' Every operand is Int32-bounded; these Int64 sums cannot overflow Int64.
                    ' Check grid limits before narrowing to Int32. No worksheet-sized allocation.
                    bounds = OutputSpatialGeometry.NextBounds(resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn,
                        previousEndRow, rows, columns, limits, New OutputRectangle() {})
                    For reservationIndex As Integer = 0 To reservations.Count - 1
                        If bounds.Intersects(reservations(reservationIndex)) Then
                            Throw New InvalidOperationException(String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                "Artifact '{0}' at {1} collides with reservation[{2}] at {3}.", artifact.Id, bounds, reservationIndex, reservations(reservationIndex)))
                        End If
                    Next
                    For Each prior As OutputRectangle In placedBounds
                        If bounds.Intersects(prior) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Internal layout overlap: " & artifact.Id & " at " & bounds.ToString())
                    Next
                    placedBounds.Add(bounds)
                    previousEndRow = bounds.EndRow
                    rightmost = Math.Max(rightmost, bounds.EndColumn)
                End If
                placements.Add(New OutputBlockPlacement(artifact, index, rows, columns, bounds, resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn, gap))
            Next
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If placedBounds.Count > 0 Then used = New OutputRectangle(resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn, CInt(previousEndRow), rightmost)
            Return New OutputLayoutPlan(resolved, limits, placements, used, reservations)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub CheckGrid(rectangle As OutputRectangle, options As OutputLayoutOptions, parameter As String)
            If rectangle.EndRow > options.MaxRows OrElse rectangle.EndColumn > options.MaxColumns Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(parameter, "Occupied rectangle " & rectangle.ToString() & " exceeds the configured grid.")
            End If
        End Sub
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class OutputLayoutPlanner
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Stacks complete matrices vertically in document order. Zero-area/nonspatial entries
        ''' consume neither rows nor gaps. All reservations refer to the same resolved logical
        ''' destination; no sheet-name comparisons establish physical identity. Invalid inputs
        ''' throw ArgumentException; collisions throw InvalidOperationException before return.
        ''' Semantic identity/shape validation is optional and never recomputes cell semantics.
        ''' Inputs must not be mutated concurrently while this snapshot is being constructed.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function Create(document As OutputDocument, Optional target As SpreadsheetOutputTarget = Nothing,
                                      Optional options As OutputLayoutOptions = Nothing,
                                      Optional occupiedRectangles As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing,
                                      Optional semanticPlan As OutputSemanticPlan = Nothing) As OutputLayoutPlan
            If document Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(document))
            Dim requested As SpreadsheetOutputTarget = If(target, New SpreadsheetOutputTarget())
            Dim resolved As New SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {
                .Destination = requested.Destination,
                .WorksheetName = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requested.WorksheetName), "BESHStat_Result", requested.WorksheetName),
                .StartRow = requested.StartRow, .StartColumn = requested.StartColumn}
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetOutputDestination), resolved.Destination) Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(target), "Unknown requested output destination.")
            End If
            Dim limits As OutputLayoutOptions = If(options, New OutputLayoutOptions())
            If resolved.StartRow < 1 OrElse resolved.StartRow > limits.MaxRows OrElse
               resolved.StartColumn < 1 OrElse resolved.StartColumn > limits.MaxColumns Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(target), "Requested one-based start cell is outside the configured grid.")
            End If
            Dim reservations As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            If occupiedRectangles IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each rectangle As OutputRectangle In occupiedRectangles
                    If rectangle Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null occupied rectangle.", NameOf(occupiedRectangles))
                    CheckGrid(rectangle, limits, NameOf(occupiedRectangles))
                    reservations.Add(rectangle)
                Next
            End If
            If semanticPlan IsNot Nothing AndAlso semanticPlan.Artifacts.Count <> document.Artifacts.Count Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Semantic artifact count does not match the document.", NameOf(semanticPlan))
            End If
            Dim placements As New List(Of OutputBlockPlacement)()
            Dim placedBounds As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            Dim previousEndRow As Long = 0
            Dim rightmost As Integer = resolved.StartColumn
            For index As Integer = 0 To document.Artifacts.Count - 1
                Dim artifact As OutputArtifact = document.Artifacts(index)
                Dim table As OutputTableArtifact = TryCast(artifact, OutputTableArtifact)
                Dim rows As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.RowCount)
                Dim columns As Integer = If(table Is Nothing, 0, table.ColumnCount)
                If rows < 0 OrElse columns < 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Negative table dimensions: " & artifact.Id, NameOf(document))
                If semanticPlan IsNot Nothing Then
                    Dim styled As OutputArtifactStylePlan = semanticPlan.Artifacts(index)
                    If Not String.Equals(styled.ArtifactId, artifact.Id, StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse
                       styled.Kind <> artifact.Kind OrElse styled.RowCount <> rows OrElse styled.ColumnCount <> columns Then
                        Throw New ArgumentException("Semantic identity/order/shape mismatch at artifact: " & artifact.Id, NameOf(semanticPlan))
                    End If
                End If
                Dim bounds As OutputRectangle = Nothing
                Dim gap As Integer = 0
                If rows > 0 AndAlso columns > 0 Then
                    gap = If(placedBounds.Count = 0, 0, limits.BlankRowsBetweenTables)
                    ' Every operand is Int32-bounded; these Int64 sums cannot overflow Int64.
                    ' Check grid limits before narrowing to Int32. No worksheet-sized allocation.
                    bounds = OutputSpatialGeometry.NextBounds(resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn,
                        previousEndRow, rows, columns, limits, New OutputRectangle() {})
                    For reservationIndex As Integer = 0 To reservations.Count - 1
                        If bounds.Intersects(reservations(reservationIndex)) Then
                            Throw New InvalidOperationException(String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                "Artifact '{0}' at {1} collides with reservation[{2}] at {3}.", artifact.Id, bounds, reservationIndex, reservations(reservationIndex)))
                        End If
                    Next
                    For Each prior As OutputRectangle In placedBounds
                        If bounds.Intersects(prior) Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Internal layout overlap: " & artifact.Id & " at " & bounds.ToString())
                    Next
                    placedBounds.Add(bounds)
                    previousEndRow = bounds.EndRow
                    rightmost = Math.Max(rightmost, bounds.EndColumn)
                End If
                placements.Add(New OutputBlockPlacement(artifact, index, rows, columns, bounds, resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn, gap))
            Next
            Dim used As OutputRectangle = Nothing
            If placedBounds.Count > 0 Then used = New OutputRectangle(resolved.StartRow, resolved.StartColumn, CInt(previousEndRow), rightmost)
            Return New OutputLayoutPlan(resolved, limits, placements, used, reservations)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub CheckGrid(rectangle As OutputRectangle, options As OutputLayoutOptions, parameter As String)
            If rectangle.EndRow > options.MaxRows OrElse rectangle.EndColumn > options.MaxColumns Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(parameter, "Occupied rectangle " & rectangle.ToString() & " exceeds the configured grid.")
            End If
        End Sub
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Immutable snapshot of the existing Core display policy, not a second algorithm.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OutputPValuePolicy
        Public Sub New(settings As PValuePresentationSettings)
            Dim safe As PValuePresentationSettings = CopySettings(settings)
            DecimalPlaces = safe.DecimalPlaces
            SmallValueDisplay = safe.SmallValueDisplay
            UseUpperBound = safe.UseUpperBound
            LowerThreshold = Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.LowerThreshold(safe)
            UpperThreshold = Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.UpperThreshold(safe)
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property DecimalPlaces As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property SmallValueDisplay As PValueSmallValueDisplay
        Public ReadOnly Property UseUpperBound As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property LowerThreshold As Double
        Public ReadOnly Property UpperThreshold As Double

        Friend Shared Function CopySettings(settings As PValuePresentationSettings) As PValuePresentationSettings
            Dim safe As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If settings IsNot Nothing Then
                safe.DecimalPlaces = settings.DecimalPlaces
                safe.SmallValueDisplay = settings.SmallValueDisplay
                safe.UseUpperBound = settings.UseUpperBound
            End If
            safe.EnsureDefaults()
            Return safe
        End Function

        Public Function Preview(value As Double, culture As CultureInfo) As String
            If culture Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(culture))
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) OrElse value < 0 OrElse value > 1 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(value), "A preview requires a probability.")
            End If
            Return Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.FormatForDisplay(value,
                New PValuePresentationSettings With {.DecimalPlaces = DecimalPlaces,
                    .SmallValueDisplay = SmallValueDisplay, .UseUpperBound = UseUpperBound}, culture)

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Existing shared-table plus supplementary-table geometry. It consumes canonical
    ''' layout/regions and preserves the legacy one-unused-row and next-cursor rules.
    ''' It neither creates destinations nor obtains consent, writes cells or rolls back.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class ResultTableSequencePolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function PreflightBounds(layout As OutputLayoutPlan,
                                               supplementary As IEnumerable(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel),
                                               maxRows As Integer, maxColumns As Integer) As OutputRectangle
            If layout Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(layout))
            Dim used = layout.UsedBounds
            If used Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("This UI workflow requires occupied shared tables.")
            Dim rowLimit As Integer = Math.Min(maxRows, layout.Options.MaxRows)
            Dim columnLimit As Integer = Math.Min(maxColumns, layout.Options.MaxColumns)
            If used.EndRow >= rowLimit Then Throw New ArgumentException("Output leaves no next Windows cursor row.")
            Dim endRow As Long = used.EndRow
            Dim endColumn As Long = used.EndColumn
            If supplementary IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each model In supplementary
                    If model Is Nothing OrElse model.RowCount < 1 OrElse model.ColumnCount < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid supplementary table.")
                    endRow += 1L + model.RowCount
                    endColumn = Math.Max(endColumn, CLng(used.StartColumn) + model.ColumnCount - 1L)
                    If endRow >= rowLimit OrElse endColumn > columnLimit Then Throw New ArgumentException("Combined output exceeds the Windows grid or leaves no next cursor row.")
                Next
            End If
            Return New OutputRectangle(used.StartRow, used.StartColumn, CInt(endRow), CInt(endColumn))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function OrderedRegions(layout As OutputLayoutPlan,
                                              supplementary As IEnumerable(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel),
                                              chartIds As IEnumerable(Of String),
                                              maxRows As Integer, maxColumns As Integer) As IReadOnlyList(Of WriteRegion)
            If layout Is Nothing OrElse layout.UsedBounds Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Shared output requires spatial tables.")
            Dim regions = layout.Placements.Where(Function(p) p.IsPlaced).Select(Function(p) New WriteRegion(p.ArtifactId, p.Bounds)).ToList()
            Dim lastRow As Integer = layout.UsedBounds.EndRow
            If supplementary IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim index As Integer = 0
                For Each model In supplementary
                    If model Is Nothing OrElse model.RowCount < 1 OrElse model.ColumnCount < 1 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid supplementary table.")
                    Dim start As Long = CLng(lastRow) + 2
                    Dim finish As Long = start + model.RowCount - 1L
                    Dim right As Long = CLng(layout.StartColumn) + model.ColumnCount - 1L
                    If finish >= maxRows OrElse right > maxColumns Then Throw New ArgumentException("Supplementary output exceeds grid.")
                    regions.Add(New WriteRegion("supplementary-" & index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        New OutputRectangle(CInt(start), layout.StartColumn, CInt(finish), CInt(right))))
                    lastRow = CInt(finish) : index += 1
                Next
            End If
            If chartIds IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each id In chartIds
                    regions.Add(New WriteRegion(id, Nothing, nonCellMutation:=True))
                Next
            End If
            Return regions.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
    End Class

                                      pvalueSettings As PValuePresentationSettings,
                                      alpha As Double,
                                      outputTarget As SpreadsheetOutputTarget) As ResultTableWriteRequest
            If model Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(model))
            If model.Values Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("The result table has no values.", NameOf(model))

            Dim safeTarget As SpreadsheetOutputTarget = If(outputTarget, New SpreadsheetOutputTarget())
            safeTarget.EnsureDefaults()

            Dim safeAlpha As Double = alpha
            If Double.IsNaN(safeAlpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(safeAlpha) OrElse safeAlpha <= 0.0 OrElse safeAlpha >= 1.0 Then
                safeAlpha = 0.05
            End If

            Dim request As New ResultTableWriteRequest With {
                .Values = ToRows(model.Values),
                .HeaderTopRows = model.HeaderTopRows,
                .HeaderLeftColumns = model.HeaderLeftColumns,
                .FooterRows = model.FooterRows,
                .TitleRows = model.TitleRows,
                .IsResultTable = model.IsResultTable,
                .PvalueNumberFormat = Global.BESHStatNG.PValuePresentation.BuildExcelNumberFormat(pvalueSettings),
                .PvalueHighlightAlpha = safeAlpha,
                .OutputTarget = New SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {
                    .Destination = safeTarget.Destination,
                    .WorksheetName = safeTarget.WorksheetName,
                    .StartRow = safeTarget.StartRow,
                    .StartColumn = safeTarget.StartColumn
                },
                .AutoFit = True
            }

            If model.PvalueColumns IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each bodyColumn As Integer In model.PvalueColumns
                    request.PvalueColumns.Add(bodyColumn)
                Next
            End If

                For Each address As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableCellAddress In model.PvalueCells

            For Each model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel In models
                If model Is Nothing Then

            Next

            Return requests
        End Function

            Dim rows As New List(Of List(Of Object))(values.GetLength(0))

            For rowIndex As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim row As New List(Of Object)(values.GetLength(1))
                For columnIndex As Integer = 0 To values.GetLength(1) - 1
                    row.Add(NormalizeValue(values(rowIndex, columnIndex)))
                Next
                rows.Add(row)
            Next

            Return rows

            If value Is Nothing Then Return Nothing

            If TypeOf value Is Double Then
                Dim d As Double = DirectCast(value, Double)
                If Double.IsNaN(d) Then Return "#N/A"
                If Double.IsPositiveInfinity(d) Then Return "#Pinf"
                If Double.IsNegativeInfinity(d) Then Return "#Ninf"
                Return d
            End If

            If TypeOf value Is Single Then
                Dim f As Single = DirectCast(value, Single)
                If Single.IsNaN(f) Then Return "#N/A"
                If Single.IsPositiveInfinity(f) Then Return "#Pinf"
                If Single.IsNegativeInfinity(f) Then Return "#Ninf"
                Return f
            End If

            Return value
        End Function
    End Class

    Public Enum OutputStyleRole
        Body = 0
        Title = 1
        TopColumnHeader = 2
        LeftRowHeader = 3
        Footer = 4
        DiagnosticWarning = 5
        DiagnosticFault = 6
    End Enum

    Public Enum OutputNumberFormatKind
        General = 0
        Numeric = 1
        Percentage = 2
        Scientific = 3
        PValue = 4
    End Enum

    ''' <summary>Semantic intent only; never a host number-format string.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OutputNumberFormatIntent
        Public Sub New(kind As OutputNumberFormatKind, Optional decimalPlaces As Integer? = Nothing)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(OutputNumberFormatKind), kind) Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(kind))
            If kind = OutputNumberFormatKind.General Then
                If decimalPlaces.HasValue Then Throw New ArgumentException("General format has no precision.", NameOf(decimalPlaces))
            Else
                If Not decimalPlaces.HasValue OrElse decimalPlaces.Value < 0 OrElse decimalPlaces.Value > 16 Then
                    Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(decimalPlaces))
                End If
                If kind = OutputNumberFormatKind.PValue AndAlso decimalPlaces.Value < 2 Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(decimalPlaces))
            End If
            Me.Kind = kind
            Me.DecimalPlaces = decimalPlaces
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Kind As OutputNumberFormatKind
        Public ReadOnly Property DecimalPlaces As Integer?
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' One resolved directive per cell. ArtifactId + Row + Column is its composite identity;
    ''' LocalId is stable within that artifact. All indices are zero-based table-relative,
    ''' never worksheet addresses. Body role survives a p-value overlay.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class OutputCellStyle
        Friend Sub New(artifactId As String, row As Integer, column As Integer, cell As OutputCell,
                       role As OutputStyleRole, numberFormat As OutputNumberFormatIntent,
                       isPValue As Boolean, significant As Boolean, preview As String)
            Me.ArtifactId = artifactId
            Me.Row = row
            Me.Column = column
            Me.LocalId = row.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & ":" & column.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            Me.Cell = cell
            Me.Role = role

    Public NotInheritable Class TargetPlanner
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Create(requested As SpreadsheetOutputTarget, host As HostCapabilitySnapshot,
                                      Optional facts As OutputTargetFacts = Nothing) As OutputTargetDecision
            Dim observed = If(facts, New OutputTargetFacts())
            Dim check = HostCapabilityPreflight.CheckOutput(host, requested)
            If check.IsSupported Then
                Dim message As String = Nothing
                Dim code As String = CapabilityPreflightCodes.InvalidTarget
                If observed.MaxRows < 1 OrElse observed.MaxColumns < 1 OrElse
                    requested.StartRow > observed.MaxRows OrElse requested.StartColumn > observed.MaxColumns Then
                    message = "The requested start cell is outside the host grid. Choose a valid row and column."
                ElseIf requested.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook AndAlso observed.WorkbookAvailable = False Then
                    message = "The target workbook is missing or inaccessible. Open a writable workbook and retry."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet AndAlso
                    (observed.SheetExists = False OrElse observed.IdentityUnambiguous = False) Then
                    message = "The intended worksheet is missing, inaccessible or ambiguous. Select it explicitly and retry."
                ElseIf observed.WorksheetNameValid = False Then
                    message = "The host rejected the worksheet name. Choose a valid name."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet AndAlso observed.NewWorksheetNameCollision = True Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.SheetNameCollision
                    message = "No unused worksheet name could be resolved. Choose another new worksheet name."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet AndAlso observed.CanCreateWorksheet = False Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget
                    message = "The workbook does not allow adding a worksheet. Choose another writable destination."
                ElseIf observed.ProtectedSheet = True OrElse observed.Writable = False Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget
                    message = "The target is protected or known to be unwritable. Choose an unprotected writable destination."
                ElseIf observed.MergedConflict = True Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.MergedTarget
                    message = "The planned output intersects merged cells. Choose an unmerged destination."
                End If
                If message IsNot Nothing Then check = CapabilityPreflightResult.Rejected(code, message)
            End If
            Return New OutputTargetDecision(requested, host, observed, check)
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class TargetPlanner
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function Create(requested As SpreadsheetOutputTarget, host As HostCapabilitySnapshot,
                                      Optional facts As OutputTargetFacts = Nothing) As OutputTargetDecision
            Dim observed = If(facts, New OutputTargetFacts())
            Dim check = HostCapabilityPreflight.CheckOutput(host, requested)
            If check.IsSupported Then
                Dim message As String = Nothing
                Dim code As String = CapabilityPreflightCodes.InvalidTarget
                If observed.MaxRows < 1 OrElse observed.MaxColumns < 1 OrElse
                    requested.StartRow > observed.MaxRows OrElse requested.StartColumn > observed.MaxColumns Then
                    message = "The requested start cell is outside the host grid. Choose a valid row and column."
                ElseIf requested.Destination <> SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook AndAlso observed.WorkbookAvailable = False Then
                    message = "The target workbook is missing or inaccessible. Open a writable workbook and retry."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet AndAlso
                    (observed.SheetExists = False OrElse observed.IdentityUnambiguous = False) Then
                    message = "The intended worksheet is missing, inaccessible or ambiguous. Select it explicitly and retry."
                ElseIf observed.WorksheetNameValid = False Then
                    message = "The host rejected the worksheet name. Choose a valid name."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet AndAlso observed.NewWorksheetNameCollision = True Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.SheetNameCollision
                    message = "No unused worksheet name could be resolved. Choose another new worksheet name."
                ElseIf requested.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet AndAlso observed.CanCreateWorksheet = False Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget
                    message = "The workbook does not allow adding a worksheet. Choose another writable destination."
                ElseIf observed.ProtectedSheet = True OrElse observed.Writable = False Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget
                    message = "The target is protected or known to be unwritable. Choose an unprotected writable destination."
                ElseIf observed.MergedConflict = True Then
                    code = CapabilityPreflightCodes.MergedTarget
                    message = "The planned output intersects merged cells. Choose an unmerged destination."
                End If
                If message IsNot Nothing Then check = CapabilityPreflightResult.Rejected(code, message)
            End If
            Return New OutputTargetDecision(requested, host, observed, check)
        End Function
    End Class

Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public Enum OutputOccupancy
        Empty = 0
        Occupied = 1
        Unknown = 2
        Rejected = 3
    End Enum

    Public Enum OutputWriteState
        Completed = 0
        CancelledByUser = 1
        RejectedBeforeWrite = 2
        FailedBeforeWrite = 3
        PartiallyWritten = 4
    End Enum

    Public NotInheritable Class WriteCodes
        Public Const Completed As String = "output.completed"
        Public Const Cancelled As String = "output.cancelled"
        Public Const Empty As String = "output.occupancy-empty"
        Public Const Occupied As String = "output.occupancy-occupied"
        Public Const Unverified As String = "output.occupancy-unverified"
        Public Const Rejected As String = "output.rejected"
        Public Const Changed As String = "output.consent-stale"
        Public Const ConfirmationRequired As String = "output.confirmation-required"
        Public Const Failed As String = "output.host-failed"
        Public Const MutationUncertain As String = "output.mutation-uncertain"
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Ordered artifact identity; Nothing bounds means no cell mutation (e.g. a logical plot).
    ''' Addresses are host-neutral one-based inclusive rectangles, never envelopes.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class WriteRegion
        Public Sub New(artifactId As String, bounds As OutputRectangle, Optional nonCellMutation As Boolean = False)
            Me.ArtifactId = WriteIntent.CheckedText(artifactId, 256)
            If bounds IsNot Nothing AndAlso (bounds.EndRow > 1048576 OrElse bounds.EndColumn > 16384) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Write region outside Excel grid.")
            Me.Bounds = bounds
            MayMutate = bounds IsNot Nothing OrElse nonCellMutation
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property ArtifactId As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Bounds As OutputRectangle
        Public ReadOnly Property MayMutate As Boolean
    End Class

    ''' <summary>One execution snapshot. PlanIdentity identifies the complete payload, including styles,
    ''' supplied by the adapter, not just its geometry. Unknown physical identities remain Nothing.
    ''' Guards are additional conservative inspection areas for host-positioned charts; never cleared.
    ''' An adapter must reject uncertainty it cannot safely inspect.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class WriteIntent
        Public Sub New(planIdentity As String, targetIdentity As String, target As SpreadsheetOutputTarget,
                       regions As IEnumerable(Of WriteRegion), Optional reservations As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing,
                       Optional guards As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle) = Nothing,
                       Optional workbookIdentity As String = Nothing, Optional worksheetIdentity As String = Nothing)
            Me.PlanIdentity = CheckedText(planIdentity, 256)
            Me.TargetIdentity = CheckedText(targetIdentity, 1024)
            If target Is Nothing OrElse Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(SpreadsheetOutputDestination), target.Destination) OrElse
                target.StartRow < 1 OrElse target.StartRow > 1048576 OrElse target.StartColumn < 1 OrElse target.StartColumn > 16384 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid write target.")
            WorksheetName = CheckedText(target.WorksheetName, 256)
            Destination = target.Destination : StartRow = target.StartRow : StartColumn = target.StartColumn
            Me.WorkbookIdentity = If(workbookIdentity Is Nothing, Nothing, CheckedText(workbookIdentity, 1024))
            Me.WorksheetIdentity = If(worksheetIdentity Is Nothing, Nothing, CheckedText(worksheetIdentity, 1024))
            If regions Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(regions))
            Dim items As New List(Of WriteRegion)()
            Dim ids As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each item In regions
                If item Is Nothing OrElse items.Count >= 256 OrElse Not ids.Add(item.ArtifactId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid ordered write identities.")
                If item.Bounds IsNot Nothing AndAlso items.Any(Function(p) p.Bounds IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Bounds.Intersects(item.Bounds)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Overlapping writes.")
                items.Add(item)
            Next
            Me.Regions = items.AsReadOnly()
            Me.Reservations = CopyRectangles(reservations)
            Me.Guards = CopyRectangles(guards)
            If Me.Reservations.Any(Function(r) items.Any(Function(p) p.Bounds IsNot Nothing AndAlso p.Bounds.Intersects(r))) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Write intersects reservation.")
        End Sub
        Friend Shared Function CheckedText(value As String, maximum As Integer) As String
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) OrElse value.Length > maximum OrElse value.Any(Function(c) Char.IsControl(c)) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid bounded output identifier/message.")
            Return value
        End Function
        Private Shared Function CopyRectangles(source As IEnumerable(Of OutputRectangle)) As IReadOnlyList(Of OutputRectangle)
            Dim result As New List(Of OutputRectangle)()
            If source IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each item In source
                    If item Is Nothing OrElse result.Count >= 256 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid rectangle list.")
                    Dim checked = New WriteRegion("bounds", item)
                    result.Add(checked.Bounds)
                Next
            End If
            Return result.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
        Public ReadOnly Property PlanIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property TargetIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorkbookIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property WorksheetName As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Destination As SpreadsheetOutputDestination
        Public ReadOnly Property StartRow As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property StartColumn As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Regions As IReadOnlyList(Of WriteRegion)
        Public ReadOnly Property Reservations As IReadOnlyList(Of OutputRectangle)
        Public ReadOnly Property Guards As IReadOnlyList(Of OutputRectangle)
    End Class

    ''' <summary>ObservationIdentity is an opaque adapter snapshot token, never workbook cell data.
    ''' It must change whenever inspected values, formulas, target facts or identity change.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class WriteInspection
        Public Sub New(intent As WriteIntent, state As OutputOccupancy, observationIdentity As String,
                       occupiedRegionIds As IEnumerable(Of String), Optional hasValues As Boolean = False,
                       Optional hasFormulas As Boolean = False, Optional explanation As String = Nothing)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(OutputOccupancy), state) Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(state))
            Me.Intent = intent : Me.State = state
            Message = WriteIntent.CheckedText(If(explanation, DefaultMessage(state)), 1024)
            Me.ObservationIdentity = WriteIntent.CheckedText(observationIdentity, 256)
            Dim ids As New List(Of String)()
            If occupiedRegionIds IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each id In occupiedRegionIds
                    If ids.Count >= 256 OrElse ids.Contains(id) OrElse Not intent.Regions.Any(Function(r) r.ArtifactId = id AndAlso r.MayMutate) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid occupied identities.")
                    ids.Add(id)
                Next
            End If
            If (state = OutputOccupancy.Empty AndAlso (ids.Count > 0 OrElse hasValues OrElse hasFormulas)) OrElse
               (state = OutputOccupancy.Occupied AndAlso ids.Count = 0) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Contradictory occupancy.")
            Me.OccupiedRegionIds = ids.AsReadOnly() : Me.HasValues = hasValues : Me.HasFormulas = hasFormulas
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Intent As WriteIntent
        Public ReadOnly Property State As OutputOccupancy
        Public ReadOnly Property ObservationIdentity As String
        Public ReadOnly Property OccupiedRegionIds As IReadOnlyList(Of String)
        Public ReadOnly Property HasValues As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property HasFormulas As Boolean
        Public ReadOnly Property Message As String
        Private Shared Function DefaultMessage(state As OutputOccupancy) As String
            Select Case state
                Case OutputOccupancy.Empty : Return "No values or formulas observed. Output formatting may change."
                Case OutputOccupancy.Occupied : Return "Existing values or formulas require explicit overwrite confirmation."
                Case OutputOccupancy.Unknown : Return "Destination occupancy could not be verified."
                Case Else : Return "The host rejected the destination before writing."
            End Select
        End Function
        Public ReadOnly Property ConfirmationRequired As Boolean
            Get
                Return State = OutputOccupancy.Occupied
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Code As String
            Get
                Select Case State
                    Case OutputOccupancy.Empty : Return WriteCodes.Empty
                    Case OutputOccupancy.Occupied : Return WriteCodes.Occupied
                    Case OutputOccupancy.Unknown : Return WriteCodes.Unverified
                    Case Else : Return WriteCodes.Rejected
                End Select
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Consent is tied to this exact immutable intent AND observation, not a preference.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class WriteConsent
        Public Sub New(inspection As WriteInspection, approved As Boolean)
            If inspection Is Nothing OrElse inspection.State <> OutputOccupancy.Occupied Then Throw New ArgumentException("Consent requires known occupancy.")
            Me.Inspection = inspection : Me.Approved = approved
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property Inspection As WriteInspection
        Public ReadOnly Property Approved As Boolean
        Public Function Authorizes(current As WriteInspection) As Boolean
            Return Approved AndAlso current IsNot Nothing AndAlso Object.ReferenceEquals(Inspection.Intent, current.Intent) AndAlso
                current.State = OutputOccupancy.Occupied AndAlso Inspection.ObservationIdentity = current.ObservationIdentity AndAlso
                Inspection.OccupiedRegionIds.SequenceEqual(current.OccupiedRegionIds) AndAlso
                Inspection.HasValues = current.HasValues AndAlso Inspection.HasFormulas = current.HasFormulas
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>Additive outcome envelope v1; existing analysis/table/composite wire contracts are unchanged.
    ''' ConfirmedWritten includes only operations whose completion the adapter actually observed.
    ''' No adapter in 02.08 supplies undo or rollback. Partial includes mutation-uncertain failures.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class WriteResult
        Public Sub New(state As OutputWriteState, code As String, message As String, intent As WriteIntent,
                       mutationMayHaveOccurred As Boolean, Optional confirmedWrittenIds As IEnumerable(Of String) = Nothing,
                       Optional confirmationRequired As Boolean? = Nothing, Optional overwriteApproved As Boolean? = Nothing)
            If Not [Enum].IsDefined(GetType(OutputWriteState), state) Then Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(state))

    ''' <summary>Small synchronous host-neutral gate. Inspection/revalidation are read-only delegates.
    ''' Each action is treated as possibly mutated BEFORE invocation. Never retries or rolls back.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class SafeWrite
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Execute(intent As WriteIntent, inspect As Func(Of WriteInspection),
                                       confirm As Func(Of WriteInspection, Boolean), writes As IReadOnlyList(Of Action),
                                       Optional destinationCreated As Boolean = False) As WriteResult
            If intent Is Nothing OrElse inspect Is Nothing OrElse confirm Is Nothing OrElse writes Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("write seam")
            If writes.Count <> intent.Regions.Count OrElse writes.Any(Function(a) a Is Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Write actions must match ordered intent.")
            Dim mutation As Boolean = destinationCreated
            Dim confirmed As New List(Of String)()
            Dim required As Boolean? = Nothing, approved As Boolean? = Nothing
            Try
                Dim observed = inspect()
                If observed Is Nothing OrElse Not Object.ReferenceEquals(observed.Intent, intent) OrElse observed.State = OutputOccupancy.Unknown OrElse observed.State = OutputOccupancy.Rejected Then
                    Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite),
                        If(observed Is Nothing, WriteCodes.Unverified, observed.Code),
                        If(observed Is Nothing, "Destination occupancy could not be verified.", observed.Message), intent, mutation)
                End If
                Dim consent As WriteConsent = Nothing
                required = observed.ConfirmationRequired
                If observed.ConfirmationRequired Then
                    consent = New WriteConsent(observed, confirm(observed))
                    approved = consent.Approved
                    If Not consent.Approved Then Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser), WriteCodes.Cancelled, If(mutation, "Overwrite cancelled; created destination may remain.", "Output overwrite cancelled. No writes performed."), intent, mutation, confirmationRequired:=required, overwriteApproved:=approved)
                End If
                Dim current = inspect()
                If current Is Nothing OrElse Not Object.ReferenceEquals(current.Intent, intent) OrElse
                    current.ObservationIdentity <> observed.ObservationIdentity OrElse current.State <> observed.State OrElse
                    (consent IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not consent.Authorizes(current)) Then
                    Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite), WriteCodes.Changed, "Destination changed. Inspect and confirm again.", intent, mutation, confirmationRequired:=required, overwriteApproved:=approved)
                End If
                For i As Integer = 0 To writes.Count - 1
                    If Not intent.Regions(i).MayMutate Then Continue For
                    mutation = True : writes(i)() : confirmed.Add(intent.Regions(i).ArtifactId)
                Next
                Return New WriteResult(OutputWriteState.Completed, WriteCodes.Completed, "Output completed.", intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            Catch ex As HostCapabilityException
                Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite),
                    ex.Code, ex.Message, intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' Native exception text may contain workbook data; keep it out of the portable result.
                Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.FailedBeforeWrite),
                    If(mutation, WriteCodes.MutationUncertain, WriteCodes.Failed),
                    If(mutation, "Output may be partially written. No rollback was attempted.", "Host inspection failed before writing."), intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            End Try
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class SafeWrite
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Execute(intent As WriteIntent, inspect As Func(Of WriteInspection),
                                       confirm As Func(Of WriteInspection, Boolean), writes As IReadOnlyList(Of Action),
                                       Optional destinationCreated As Boolean = False) As WriteResult
            If intent Is Nothing OrElse inspect Is Nothing OrElse confirm Is Nothing OrElse writes Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException("write seam")
            If writes.Count <> intent.Regions.Count OrElse writes.Any(Function(a) a Is Nothing) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Write actions must match ordered intent.")
            Dim mutation As Boolean = destinationCreated
            Dim confirmed As New List(Of String)()
            Dim required As Boolean? = Nothing, approved As Boolean? = Nothing
            Try
                Dim observed = inspect()
                If observed Is Nothing OrElse Not Object.ReferenceEquals(observed.Intent, intent) OrElse observed.State = OutputOccupancy.Unknown OrElse observed.State = OutputOccupancy.Rejected Then
                    Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite),
                        If(observed Is Nothing, WriteCodes.Unverified, observed.Code),
                        If(observed Is Nothing, "Destination occupancy could not be verified.", observed.Message), intent, mutation)
                End If
                Dim consent As WriteConsent = Nothing
                required = observed.ConfirmationRequired
                If observed.ConfirmationRequired Then
                    consent = New WriteConsent(observed, confirm(observed))
                    approved = consent.Approved
                    If Not consent.Approved Then Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser), WriteCodes.Cancelled, If(mutation, "Overwrite cancelled; created destination may remain.", "Output overwrite cancelled. No writes performed."), intent, mutation, confirmationRequired:=required, overwriteApproved:=approved)
                End If
                Dim current = inspect()
                If current Is Nothing OrElse Not Object.ReferenceEquals(current.Intent, intent) OrElse
                    current.ObservationIdentity <> observed.ObservationIdentity OrElse current.State <> observed.State OrElse
                    (consent IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not consent.Authorizes(current)) Then
                    Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite), WriteCodes.Changed, "Destination changed. Inspect and confirm again.", intent, mutation, confirmationRequired:=required, overwriteApproved:=approved)
                End If
                For i As Integer = 0 To writes.Count - 1
                    If Not intent.Regions(i).MayMutate Then Continue For
                    mutation = True : writes(i)() : confirmed.Add(intent.Regions(i).ArtifactId)
                Next
                Return New WriteResult(OutputWriteState.Completed, WriteCodes.Completed, "Output completed.", intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            Catch ex As HostCapabilityException
                Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite),
                    ex.Code, ex.Message, intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' Native exception text may contain workbook data; keep it out of the portable result.
                Return New WriteResult(If(mutation, OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten, OutputWriteState.FailedBeforeWrite),
                    If(mutation, WriteCodes.MutationUncertain, WriteCodes.Failed),
                    If(mutation, "Output may be partially written. No rollback was attempted.", "Host inspection failed before writing."), intent, mutation, confirmed, required, approved)
            End Try
        End Function
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Portable, ordered, read-only result envelope. Tables/metrics are snapshots; typed details
    ''' are reference semantics until the family-specific DTO contract is implemented in 02.xx.
    ''' No workbook placement, formatting, COM or Office.js state appears here.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class AnalysisResultDocument
        Public Const SchemaVersion As Integer = 1
        Private ReadOnly _artifacts As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisResultArtifact)
        Private ReadOnly _warnings As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisWarning)
        Private ReadOnly _faults As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisFault)
        Private ReadOnly _tables As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisTableArtifact)
        Private ReadOnly _metrics As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)
        Private ReadOnly _detail As AnalysisDetailArtifact

        Public Sub New(analysisId As String,
                       tables As IEnumerable(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel),
                       metrics As IEnumerable(Of KeyValuePair(Of String, Double)),
                       detail As AnalysisDetailArtifact,
                       Optional warnings As IEnumerable(Of AnalysisWarning) = Nothing,
                       Optional faults As IEnumerable(Of AnalysisFault) = Nothing)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(analysisId) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Analysis ID is required.", NameOf(analysisId))
            If tables Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(tables))
            If metrics Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(metrics))
            Me.AnalysisId = analysisId

            Dim warningsList As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)()
            If warnings IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each item As AnalysisWarning In warnings
                    If item Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null warning.", NameOf(warnings))
                    warningsList.Add(item)
                Next
            End If
            Dim faultList As New List(Of AnalysisFault)()
            If faults IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each item As AnalysisFault In faults
                    If item Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null fault.", NameOf(faults))
                    faultList.Add(item)
                Next
            End If
            _warnings = warningsList.AsReadOnly()
            _faults = faultList.AsReadOnly()
            Status = If(faultList.Count > 0, AnalysisDocumentStatus.Failed, AnalysisDocumentStatus.Succeeded)

            Dim outputTables As New List(Of AnalysisTableArtifact)()
            For Each model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel In tables
                If model Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Null result table.", NameOf(tables))
                outputTables.Add(New AnalysisTableArtifact(outputTables.Count, model))
            Next
            _tables = outputTables.AsReadOnly()

            Dim outputMetrics As New List(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)()
            Dim names As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of String, Double) In metrics
                If Not names.Add(pair.Key) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Duplicate metric: " & pair.Key, NameOf(metrics))
                Dim role As AnalysisMetricRole = If(IsKnownPValue(pair.Key), AnalysisMetricRole.PValue, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic)
                outputMetrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(pair.Key, pair.Value, role))
            Next
            outputMetrics.Sort(Function(a, b) StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a.Name, b.Name))
            _metrics = outputMetrics.AsReadOnly()
            _detail = detail

            Dim allArtifacts As New List(Of AnalysisResultArtifact)()
            For Each table As AnalysisTableArtifact In outputTables
                allArtifacts.Add(table)
            Next
            For Each metric As AnalysisMetricArtifact In outputMetrics
                allArtifacts.Add(metric)
            Next
            If detail IsNot Nothing Then allArtifacts.Add(detail)
            _artifacts = allArtifacts.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Status As AnalysisDocumentStatus
        Public ReadOnly Property Artifacts As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisResultArtifact)
            Get
                Return _artifacts
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property Tables As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisTableArtifact)
            Get

            End Get

        Public ReadOnly Property Metrics As IReadOnlyList(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)
