    Public NotInheritable Class UserFaultMapper
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function FromAnalysisFault(fault As AnalysisFault) As UserFault
            If fault Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Select Case fault.Code
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Input, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Check analysis options", "The analysis request is invalid.",
                        "Check the grouped numeric input and select options supported by this analysis.", fault.Code, SafeField(fault.FieldPath))
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Analysis, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Analysis unavailable", "This analysis is not supported by the current host.",
                        "Select a supported analysis and try again.", fault.Code, SafeField(fault.FieldPath))
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.ExecutionFailed
                    ' This signal proves only an analysis failure, not singularity/convergence.
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Analysis, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Analysis could not complete", "No usable analysis result was produced.",
                        "Review the input and model options. If this repeats, report the code and run reference.", fault.Code)
                Case Else
                    Return Unexpected()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromValidation(issue As SpreadsheetValidationIssue) As UserFault
            If issue Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Dim severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error
            Dim code = UserFaultCodes.InvalidInput
            If issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning Then
                severity = UserFaultSeverity.Warning : code = UserFaultCodes.InputWarning
            ElseIf issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information Then
                severity = UserFaultSeverity.Information : code = UserFaultCodes.InputInformation
            End If
            Dim action = "Check the selected range, group layout and numeric observations, then retry."
            Dim original As String = Nothing
            Select Case issue.Code
                Case "cell.not-numeric", "cell.invalid-value", "cell.excel-error"
                    action = "Correct the numeric observation in the selected location, then retry."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "groups.too-few", "range.too-few-groups", "groups.too-few-observations"
                    action = "Select at least two groups with enough numeric observations in each group."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "options.invalid", "options.long-columns"
                    action = "Choose a supported input orientation and distinct category and value columns."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "header.invalid-cell", "header.excel-error", "header.ambiguous"
                    action = "Check the header setting and use valid group headers."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "groups.category-error", "groups.category-invalid", "groups.category-missing", "groups.category-collision"
                    action = "Check the category column and provide distinct valid group identifiers."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "cell.missing-skipped", "rows.blank-skipped"
                    action = "Review the skipped observations before using the results."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "header.inferred"
                    action = "Review the inferred header setting before using the results."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "range.null", "range.shape", "range.not-rectangular"
                    original = issue.Code
            End Select
            Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Input, severity,
                If(severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error, "Check analysis input", "Review analysis input"),
                If(severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error, "The selected input needs correction.", "The input parser reported a nonfatal notice."),
                action, original, SafeField(issue.FieldPath), SafeOffset(issue.SelectedRow, 1048576), SafeOffset(issue.SelectedColumn, 16384))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromReport(report As SpreadsheetValidationReport) As IReadOnlyList(Of UserFault)
            Dim result As New List(Of UserFault)()
            If report IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each issue In report.Issues
                    result.Add(FromValidation(issue))
                Next
            End If
            Return result.AsReadOnly()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromWarning(warning As AnalysisWarning) As UserFault
            Dim known = warning IsNot Nothing AndAlso String.Equals(warning.Code, AnalysisWarningCodes.AlphaDefaulted, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.InputWarning, UserFaultCategory.Input, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                "Review analysis options", If(known, "The default significance level was used.", "The analysis reported a nonfatal warning."),
                "Review the analysis options before using the results.", If(known, AnalysisWarningCodes.AlphaDefaulted, Nothing),
                If(warning Is Nothing, Nothing, SafeField(warning.FieldPath)))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromException(failureException As Exception) As UserFault
            If TypeOf failureException Is DocumentLifecycleException Then Return LifecycleFault()
            ' Deliberately closed whitelist. No base ArgumentException/InvalidOperationException,
            ' JS exception, message matching, inner exception inspection or inferred convergence.
            Dim validation = TryCast(failureException, SpreadsheetInputValidationException)
            If validation IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation.Report)
                If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            End If
            Dim host = TryCast(failureException, HostCapabilityException)
            If host IsNot Nothing Then
                Select Case host.Code
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnknownAnalysis, CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis
                        Return FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis, "Unsupported"))
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.InvalidTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.SheetNameCollision,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MergedTarget,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedDestination
                        Return FromWriteState(OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite, WriteCodes.Rejected)
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.HostUnavailable, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MissingCapability
                        Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.HostUnavailable, UserFaultCategory.Host, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                            "Spreadsheet operation unavailable", "The host cannot perform this operation.",
                            "Open a supported Excel host and check the required operation is available.")
                End Select
            End If
            Return Unexpected()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromWriteResult(result As WriteResult) As UserFault
            If result Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Return FromWriteState(result.State, result.Code, result.MutationMayHaveOccurred)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Host adapters may project an existing writer envelope here without changing it.
        ''' State takes precedence over code. Uncertain mutation takes precedence over a safe failure.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromWriteState(state As OutputWriteState, code As String,
                                              Optional mutationMayHaveOccurred As Boolean = False) As UserFault
            If state = OutputWriteState.Completed Then Return Nothing
            If state = OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten OrElse mutationMayHaveOccurred Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.MutationUncertain, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                    "Output may remain", "Output may be partially written. No rollback was attempted.",
                    "Inspect the destination for remaining output before retrying.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                    "Overwrite cancelled", "No output was written.", "Choose another destination or run again to review overwrite consent.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.FailedBeforeWrite Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Failed, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                    "Output could not start", "The host failed before writing output.", "Check the destination and host availability, then retry.")
            End If
            If state <> OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite Then Return Unexpected()
            Select Case code
                Case "output.lifecycle-stale"
                    Return LifecycleFault()
                Case WriteCodes.Changed
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination changed", "The previous overwrite consent is no longer valid. No output was written.",
                        "Inspect the destination and confirm again.")
                Case WriteCodes.Unverified
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination not verified", "Destination occupancy could not be verified. No output was written.",
                        "Check the destination or choose a new empty worksheet.")
                Case WriteCodes.ConfirmationRequired, WriteCodes.Occupied
                    Return AwaitingConfirmation()
                Case Else
                    Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Rejected, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Choose another destination", "The destination was rejected before writing.",
                        "Select a supported writable destination without merged cells, then retry.")
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function AwaitingConfirmation() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.ConfirmationRequired, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                "Confirm overwrite", "The output destination contains existing content.",
                "Choose Overwrite to approve this destination, or Cancel to keep its content.")
        End Function

        Private Shared Function LifecycleFault() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.DocumentChanged, UserFaultCategory.Host, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                "Document or selection changed", "The original source or destination could not be verified.",
                "Refresh the source and destination and run again. Review any remaining output before retrying.")
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Authoritative write outcome first, then confirmed terminal state, errors,
        ''' mapped fault, unexpected failure, and finally nonfatal validation notices.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromOutcome(snapshot As ExecutionSnapshot, Optional writeResult As WriteResult = Nothing,
                                           Optional failureException As Exception = Nothing, Optional fault As AnalysisFault = Nothing,
                                           Optional validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport = Nothing) As UserFault
            If writeResult IsNot Nothing Then Return FromWriteResult(writeResult)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing Then
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Completed Then Return Nothing
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Cancelled Then
                    Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                        "Execution cancelled", "No further analysis or output will start.", "Run again when ready.")
                End If
            End If
            Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation)
            If validation IsNot Nothing AndAlso validation.HasErrors Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            If fault IsNot Nothing Then Return FromAnalysisFault(fault)
            If failureException IsNot Nothing Then Return FromException(failureException)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing AndAlso snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Failed Then Return Unexpected()
            If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            Return Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FormatDisplay(fault As UserFault, Optional runId As String = Nothing) As String
            If fault Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty
            Dim result = fault.Title & " [" & fault.Code & "] " & fault.Summary & " " & fault.Action
            If fault.SelectedRow > 0 Then result &= " Selected row " & fault.SelectedRow.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "."
            If fault.SelectedColumn > 0 Then result &= " Selected column " & fault.SelectedColumn.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "."
            Dim run As Guid
            If Guid.TryParseExact(runId, "N", run) AndAlso run <> Guid.Empty Then result &= " Run " & run.ToString("N") & "."
            Return result
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Unexpected() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.Unexpected, UserFaultCategory.Unexpected, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                "Operation could not complete", "An unexpected failure occurred.",
                "Retry the operation. If it repeats, report the code and run reference.")
        End Function
        Private Shared Function PrimaryIssue(report As SpreadsheetValidationReport) As SpreadsheetValidationIssue
            If report Is Nothing OrElse report.Issues.Count = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim primary = report.Issues(0)
            For Each issue In report.Issues
                If CInt(issue.Severity) > CInt(primary.Severity) Then primary = issue
            Next
            Return primary
        End Function
        Private Shared Function SafeOffset(value As Integer, maximum As Integer) As Integer
            Return If(value > 0 AndAlso value <= maximum, value, 0)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function SafeField(value As String) As String
            Select Case value
                Case "input", "request", "analysisId", "options", "options.columns", "options.alpha", "observations", "groups", "rows", "header", "category", "execution", "output"
                    Return value
            End Select
            If value IsNot Nothing AndAlso value.Length <= 13 AndAlso value.StartsWith("groups[", StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso value.EndsWith("]", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                Dim index As Integer
                Dim digits = value.Substring(7, value.Length - 8)
                If Integer.TryParse(digits, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, index) AndAlso index >= 0 AndAlso index < 16384 AndAlso
                    String.Equals(digits, index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            End If
            Return Nothing
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

Public NotInheritable Class UserFaultMapper
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function FromAnalysisFault(fault As AnalysisFault) As UserFault
            If fault Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Select Case fault.Code
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Input, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Check analysis options", "The analysis request is invalid.",
                        "Check the grouped numeric input and select options supported by this analysis.", fault.Code, SafeField(fault.FieldPath))
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Analysis, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Analysis unavailable", "This analysis is not supported by the current host.",
                        "Select a supported analysis and try again.", fault.Code, SafeField(fault.FieldPath))
                Case AnalysisFaultCodes.ExecutionFailed
                    ' This signal proves only an analysis failure, not singularity/convergence.
                    Return New UserFault(fault.Code, UserFaultCategory.Analysis, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Analysis could not complete", "No usable analysis result was produced.",
                        "Review the input and model options. If this repeats, report the code and run reference.", fault.Code)
                Case Else
                    Return Unexpected()
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromValidation(issue As SpreadsheetValidationIssue) As UserFault
            If issue Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Dim severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error
            Dim code = UserFaultCodes.InvalidInput
            If issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Warning Then
                severity = UserFaultSeverity.Warning : code = UserFaultCodes.InputWarning
            ElseIf issue.Severity = SpreadsheetValidationSeverity.Information Then
                severity = UserFaultSeverity.Information : code = UserFaultCodes.InputInformation
            End If
            Dim action = "Check the selected range, group layout and numeric observations, then retry."
            Dim original As String = Nothing
            Select Case issue.Code
                Case "cell.not-numeric", "cell.invalid-value", "cell.excel-error"
                    action = "Correct the numeric observation in the selected location, then retry."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "groups.too-few", "range.too-few-groups", "groups.too-few-observations"
                    action = "Select at least two groups with enough numeric observations in each group."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "options.invalid", "options.long-columns"
                    action = "Choose a supported input orientation and distinct category and value columns."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "header.invalid-cell", "header.excel-error", "header.ambiguous"
                    action = "Check the header setting and use valid group headers."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "groups.category-error", "groups.category-invalid", "groups.category-missing", "groups.category-collision"
                    action = "Check the category column and provide distinct valid group identifiers."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "cell.missing-skipped", "rows.blank-skipped"
                    action = "Review the skipped observations before using the results."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "header.inferred"
                    action = "Review the inferred header setting before using the results."
                    original = issue.Code
                Case "range.null", "range.shape", "range.not-rectangular"
                    original = issue.Code
            End Select
            Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Input, severity,
                If(severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error, "Check analysis input", "Review analysis input"),
                If(severity = UserFaultSeverity.Error, "The selected input needs correction.", "The input parser reported a nonfatal notice."),
                action, original, SafeField(issue.FieldPath), SafeOffset(issue.SelectedRow, 1048576), SafeOffset(issue.SelectedColumn, 16384))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromReport(report As SpreadsheetValidationReport) As IReadOnlyList(Of UserFault)
            Dim result As New List(Of UserFault)()
            If report IsNot Nothing Then
                For Each issue In report.Issues
                    result.Add(FromValidation(issue))
                Next
            End If
            Return result.AsReadOnly()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromWarning(warning As AnalysisWarning) As UserFault
            Dim known = warning IsNot Nothing AndAlso String.Equals(warning.Code, AnalysisWarningCodes.AlphaDefaulted, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.InputWarning, UserFaultCategory.Input, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                "Review analysis options", If(known, "The default significance level was used.", "The analysis reported a nonfatal warning."),
                "Review the analysis options before using the results.", If(known, AnalysisWarningCodes.AlphaDefaulted, Nothing),
                If(warning Is Nothing, Nothing, SafeField(warning.FieldPath)))
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromException(failureException As Exception) As UserFault
            If TypeOf failureException Is DocumentLifecycleException Then Return LifecycleFault()
            ' Deliberately closed whitelist. No base ArgumentException/InvalidOperationException,
            ' JS exception, message matching, inner exception inspection or inferred convergence.
            Dim validation = TryCast(failureException, SpreadsheetInputValidationException)
            If validation IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation.Report)
                If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            End If
            Dim host = TryCast(failureException, HostCapabilityException)
            If host IsNot Nothing Then
                Select Case host.Code
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnknownAnalysis, CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis
                        Return FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis, "Unsupported"))
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.InvalidTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.SheetNameCollision,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MergedTarget,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedDestination
                        Return FromWriteState(OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite, WriteCodes.Rejected)
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.HostUnavailable, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MissingCapability
                        Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.HostUnavailable, UserFaultCategory.Host, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                            "Spreadsheet operation unavailable", "The host cannot perform this operation.",
                            "Open a supported Excel host and check the required operation is available.")
                End Select
            End If
            Return Unexpected()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FromWriteResult(result As WriteResult) As UserFault
            If result Is Nothing Then Return Unexpected()
            Return FromWriteState(result.State, result.Code, result.MutationMayHaveOccurred)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Host adapters may project an existing writer envelope here without changing it.
        ''' State takes precedence over code. Uncertain mutation takes precedence over a safe failure.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromWriteState(state As OutputWriteState, code As String,
                                              Optional mutationMayHaveOccurred As Boolean = False) As UserFault
            If state = OutputWriteState.Completed Then Return Nothing
            If state = OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten OrElse mutationMayHaveOccurred Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.MutationUncertain, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                    "Output may remain", "Output may be partially written. No rollback was attempted.",
                    "Inspect the destination for remaining output before retrying.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                    "Overwrite cancelled", "No output was written.", "Choose another destination or run again to review overwrite consent.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.FailedBeforeWrite Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Failed, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                    "Output could not start", "The host failed before writing output.", "Check the destination and host availability, then retry.")
            End If
            If state <> OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite Then Return Unexpected()
            Select Case code
                Case "output.lifecycle-stale"
                    Return LifecycleFault()
                Case WriteCodes.Changed
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination changed", "The previous overwrite consent is no longer valid. No output was written.",
                        "Inspect the destination and confirm again.")
                Case WriteCodes.Unverified
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination not verified", "Destination occupancy could not be verified. No output was written.",
                        "Check the destination or choose a new empty worksheet.")
                Case WriteCodes.ConfirmationRequired, WriteCodes.Occupied
                    Return AwaitingConfirmation()
                Case Else
                    Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Rejected, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Choose another destination", "The destination was rejected before writing.",
                        "Select a supported writable destination without merged cells, then retry.")
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function AwaitingConfirmation() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.ConfirmationRequired, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                "Confirm overwrite", "The output destination contains existing content.",
                "Choose Overwrite to approve this destination, or Cancel to keep its content.")
        End Function

        Private Shared Function LifecycleFault() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.DocumentChanged, UserFaultCategory.Host, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                "Document or selection changed", "The original source or destination could not be verified.",
                "Refresh the source and destination and run again. Review any remaining output before retrying.")
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Authoritative write outcome first, then confirmed terminal state, errors,
        ''' mapped fault, unexpected failure, and finally nonfatal validation notices.</summary>
        Public Shared Function FromOutcome(snapshot As ExecutionSnapshot, Optional writeResult As WriteResult = Nothing,
                                           Optional failureException As Exception = Nothing, Optional fault As AnalysisFault = Nothing,
                                           Optional validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport = Nothing) As UserFault
            If writeResult IsNot Nothing Then Return FromWriteResult(writeResult)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing Then
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Completed Then Return Nothing
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Cancelled Then
                    Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                        "Execution cancelled", "No further analysis or output will start.", "Run again when ready.")
                End If
            End If
            Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation)
            If validation IsNot Nothing AndAlso validation.HasErrors Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            If fault IsNot Nothing Then Return FromAnalysisFault(fault)
            If failureException IsNot Nothing Then Return FromException(failureException)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing AndAlso snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Failed Then Return Unexpected()
            If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            Return Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FormatDisplay(fault As UserFault, Optional runId As String = Nothing) As String
            If fault Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty
            Dim result = fault.Title & " [" & fault.Code & "] " & fault.Summary & " " & fault.Action
            If fault.SelectedRow > 0 Then result &= " Selected row " & fault.SelectedRow.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "."
            If fault.SelectedColumn > 0 Then result &= " Selected column " & fault.SelectedColumn.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "."
            Dim run As Guid
            If Guid.TryParseExact(runId, "N", run) AndAlso run <> Guid.Empty Then result &= " Run " & run.ToString("N") & "."
            Return result
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Unexpected() As UserFault
            Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.Unexpected, UserFaultCategory.Unexpected, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                "Operation could not complete", "An unexpected failure occurred.",
                "Retry the operation. If it repeats, report the code and run reference.")
        End Function
        Private Shared Function PrimaryIssue(report As SpreadsheetValidationReport) As SpreadsheetValidationIssue
            If report Is Nothing OrElse report.Issues.Count = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim primary = report.Issues(0)
            For Each issue In report.Issues
                If CInt(issue.Severity) > CInt(primary.Severity) Then primary = issue
            Next
            Return primary
        End Function
        Private Shared Function SafeOffset(value As Integer, maximum As Integer) As Integer
            Return If(value > 0 AndAlso value <= maximum, value, 0)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function SafeField(value As String) As String
            Select Case value
                Case "input", "request", "analysisId", "options", "options.columns", "options.alpha", "observations", "groups", "rows", "header", "category", "execution", "output"
                    Return value
            End Select
            If value IsNot Nothing AndAlso value.Length <= 13 AndAlso value.StartsWith("groups[", StringComparison.Ordinal) AndAlso value.EndsWith("]", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                Dim index As Integer
                Dim digits = value.Substring(7, value.Length - 8)
                If Integer.TryParse(digits, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, index) AndAlso index >= 0 AndAlso index < 16384 AndAlso
                    String.Equals(digits, index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), StringComparison.Ordinal) Then Return value
            End If
            Return Nothing
        End Function
    End Class

Public Shared Function FromException(failureException As Exception) As UserFault
            If TypeOf failureException Is DocumentLifecycleException Then Return LifecycleFault()
            ' Deliberately closed whitelist. No base ArgumentException/InvalidOperationException,
            ' JS exception, message matching, inner exception inspection or inferred convergence.
            Dim validation = TryCast(failureException, SpreadsheetInputValidationException)
            If validation IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation.Report)
                If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            End If
            Dim host = TryCast(failureException, HostCapabilityException)
            If host IsNot Nothing Then
                Select Case host.Code
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnknownAnalysis, CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis
                        Return FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.UnsupportedAnalysis, "Unsupported"))
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.InvalidTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.SheetNameCollision,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnwritableTarget, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MergedTarget,
                         CapabilityPreflightCodes.UnsupportedDestination
                        Return FromWriteState(OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite, WriteCodes.Rejected)
                    Case CapabilityPreflightCodes.HostUnavailable, CapabilityPreflightCodes.MissingCapability
                        Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.HostUnavailable, UserFaultCategory.Host, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                            "Spreadsheet operation unavailable", "The host cannot perform this operation.",
                            "Open a supported Excel host and check the required operation is available.")
                End Select
            End If
            Return Unexpected()
        End Function

Public Shared Function FromWriteState(state As OutputWriteState, code As String,
                                              Optional mutationMayHaveOccurred As Boolean = False) As UserFault
            If state = OutputWriteState.Completed Then Return Nothing
            If state = OutputWriteState.PartiallyWritten OrElse mutationMayHaveOccurred Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.MutationUncertain, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                    "Output may remain", "Output may be partially written. No rollback was attempted.",
                    "Inspect the destination for remaining output before retrying.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                    "Overwrite cancelled", "No output was written.", "Choose another destination or run again to review overwrite consent.")
            End If
            If state = OutputWriteState.FailedBeforeWrite Then
                Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Failed, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                    "Output could not start", "The host failed before writing output.", "Check the destination and host availability, then retry.")
            End If
            If state <> OutputWriteState.RejectedBeforeWrite Then Return Unexpected()
            Select Case code
                Case "output.lifecycle-stale"
                    Return LifecycleFault()
                Case WriteCodes.Changed
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination changed", "The previous overwrite consent is no longer valid. No output was written.",
                        "Inspect the destination and confirm again.")
                Case WriteCodes.Unverified
                    Return New UserFault(code, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Warning,
                        "Destination not verified", "Destination occupancy could not be verified. No output was written.",
                        "Check the destination or choose a new empty worksheet.")
                Case WriteCodes.ConfirmationRequired, WriteCodes.Occupied
                    Return AwaitingConfirmation()
                Case Else
                    Return New UserFault(WriteCodes.Rejected, UserFaultCategory.Output, UserFaultSeverity.Error,
                        "Choose another destination", "The destination was rejected before writing.",
                        "Select a supported writable destination without merged cells, then retry.")
            End Select
        End Function

Public Shared Function FromOutcome(snapshot As ExecutionSnapshot, Optional writeResult As WriteResult = Nothing,
                                           Optional failureException As Exception = Nothing, Optional fault As AnalysisFault = Nothing,
                                           Optional validation As SpreadsheetValidationReport = Nothing) As UserFault
            If writeResult IsNot Nothing Then Return FromWriteResult(writeResult)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing Then
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Completed Then Return Nothing
                If snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Cancelled Then
                    Return New UserFault(UserFaultCodes.Cancelled, UserFaultCategory.Cancellation, UserFaultSeverity.Information,
                        "Execution cancelled", "No further analysis or output will start.", "Run again when ready.")
                End If
            End If
            Dim primary = PrimaryIssue(validation)
            If validation IsNot Nothing AndAlso validation.HasErrors Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            If fault IsNot Nothing Then Return FromAnalysisFault(fault)
            If failureException IsNot Nothing Then Return FromException(failureException)
            If snapshot IsNot Nothing AndAlso snapshot.State = ExecutionState.Failed Then Return Unexpected()
            If primary IsNot Nothing Then Return FromValidation(primary)
            Return Nothing
        End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Detached review descriptor only. Prediction positions are Core cluster-concatenated;
    ''' input positions are the axis used by the existing Predictions policy. No new GUI
    ''' sorting, text-cluster interpretation, worksheet row label or correction is activated.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class GeePredictionOutputAxis
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Describe(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent) As IReadOnlyList(Of GeePredictionOutputRow)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim rows = intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds
            Dim clusters = intent.Cluster.Values
            Dim order = intent.Order.ClusteredToInputIndices
            Dim result As New List(Of GeePredictionOutputRow)()
            For prediction As Integer = 0 To order.Length - 1
                Dim input As Integer = order(prediction)
                result.Add(New GeePredictionOutputRow(prediction + 1, input + 1, rows(input), clusters(input)))
            Next
            Return result.AsReadOnly()

    ''' <summary>Immutable Core response snapshot. Core prediction and input/residual axes
    ''' remain explicit. No model, callbacks, Excel cells or native chart is retained.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class GeeReport
        Private ReadOnly _observed, _weights, _corePredictions As Double()
        Private ReadOnly _correlation As Double(,)
        Friend Sub New(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, report As RegressionReportPlan, corePredictions() As Double,
                       observed() As Double, weights() As Double, correlation(,) As Double)
            Me.Intent = intent : MeanReport = report
            _observed = Copy(observed) : _weights = Copy(weights) : _corePredictions = Copy(corePredictions)
            _correlation = If(correlation Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(correlation.Clone(), Double(,)))
            Dim warnings = report.Document.Warnings.Concat(intent.Validation.Diagnostics.Where(Function(d) Not d.Blocking).
                Select(Function(d) New AnalysisWarning(d.Code, d.Message, d.FieldPath)))
            Dim faults = If(report.Document.Tables.Count = 0 AndAlso corePredictions Is Nothing,
                New AnalysisFault() {New AnalysisFault("gee.fit.unavailable", "Core supplied no usable fit/report payload.")}, Array.Empty(Of AnalysisFault)())
            Document = New AnalysisResultDocument("regression.gee", report.Document.Tables.Select(Function(t) t.Model),
                Array.Empty(Of KeyValuePair(Of String, Double))(), Nothing, warnings, faults)
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Copy(values() As Double) As Double()
            Return If(values Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(values.Clone(), Double()))
        End Function

        Public ReadOnly Property MeanReport As RegressionReportPlan
        Public ReadOnly Property Document As AnalysisResultDocument

            End Get

        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property CorePredictionRowIds As Integer()
            Get
                Return Intent.Order.CorePredictionRowIds
            End Get
        End Property
        Public ReadOnly Property CorePredictions As Double()

            Get

    Public NotInheritable Class GeeReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>Core predictions are cluster-concatenated, unlike observed/residual arrays.
        ''' This explicit map is identity for the actual sorted Windows import. No inverse link.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Predictions(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, corePredictions() As Double) As Double()
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If corePredictions Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim rows = intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds, permutation = intent.Order.ClusteredToInputIndices
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse corePredictions.Length <> rows.Length OrElse permutation.Length <> rows.Length OrElse permutation.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.prediction.alignment: Actual Core predictions and cluster/source axes must agree.")
            Dim aligned(rows.Length - 1) As Double
            For i = 0 To rows.Length - 1 : aligned(permutation(i)) = corePredictions(i) : Next
            Return aligned
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Residuals(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, residual(,) As Object) As Object(,)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If residual Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            If residual.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse residual.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse residual.GetLength(0) <> intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds.Length + 1 OrElse residual.GetLength(1) <> 6 Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.residuals.axes: Core GEE residuals require one explicit header row and six columns in input order.")
            For c = 0 To 5
                If Not TypeOf residual(0, c) Is String Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.residuals.headers: Core residual headers are not observation rows.")
            Next
            Return DirectCast(residual.Clone(), Object(,))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Compose(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), corePredictions() As Double,
                                       residuals(,) As Object, observed() As Double, weights() As Double,
                                       Optional workingCorrelation(,) As Double = Nothing) As GeeReport
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim ids = intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds, predicted = Predictions(intent, corePredictions)
            If observed IsNot Nothing AndAlso observed.Length <> ids.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.observed.alignment")
            If weights IsNot Nothing AndAlso weights.Length <> ids.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.weights.alignment")
            Dim matrix As Double(,) = Nothing
            If predicted IsNot Nothing Then
                ReDim matrix(predicted.Length - 1, 0)
                For i = 0 To predicted.Length - 1 : matrix(i, 0) = predicted(i) : Next
            End If
            Dim rows As New RegressionRowOutput(ids, matrix, GeeReportPolicy.Residuals(intent, residuals))
            Dim report = RegressionReportPolicy.Compose(intent.MeanRequest, tables, rows)
            Return New GeeReport(intent, report, corePredictions, observed, weights, workingCorrelation)
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Call only at the original post-fit UI read boundary. Request-time controls
        ''' are not reused; Windows supplies its weighted-event-rate helper and owns charts.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Classification(report As GeeReport, postFitOptions As RegressionOptions,
                                              Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN) As GeeClassificationPlan
            If report Is Nothing OrElse postFitOptions Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException()
            Dim o = postFitOptions.Copy()
            ' Classification belongs to the actual fitted family. A post-fit UI change
            ' is not evidence that a different model was fitted. Windows quarantines
            ' its legacy mismatch path separately pending exact native timing authority.
            o.Family = report.Intent.MeanRequest.Options.Family
            If o.Family <> RegressionFamily.Binomial OrElse report.Rows.Fitted Is Nothing OrElse report.Observed Is Nothing Then o.Classification = False
            Dim p As Double() = Nothing
            If report.Rows.Fitted IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim values = report.Rows.Fitted
                p = Enumerable.Range(0, values.GetLength(0)).Select(Function(i) values(i, 0)).ToArray()
            End If
            Return New GeeClassificationPlan(report.Rows.RowIds, o,
                RegressionClassificationPolicy.Compose(report.Observed, p, report.ObservationWeights, o, eventRate, "GEE Binary Classification"))
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

Public NotInheritable Class GeeReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        ''' <summary>Core predictions are cluster-concatenated, unlike observed/residual arrays.
        ''' This explicit map is identity for the actual sorted Windows import. No inverse link.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Predictions(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, corePredictions() As Double) As Double()
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If corePredictions Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim rows = intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds, permutation = intent.Order.ClusteredToInputIndices
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse corePredictions.Length <> rows.Length OrElse permutation.Length <> rows.Length OrElse permutation.Distinct().Count() <> rows.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.prediction.alignment: Actual Core predictions and cluster/source axes must agree.")
            Dim aligned(rows.Length - 1) As Double
            For i = 0 To rows.Length - 1 : aligned(permutation(i)) = corePredictions(i) : Next
            Return aligned
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Residuals(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, residual(,) As Object) As Object(,)
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            If residual Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            If residual.GetLowerBound(0) <> 0 OrElse residual.GetLowerBound(1) <> 0 OrElse residual.GetLength(0) <> intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds.Length + 1 OrElse residual.GetLength(1) <> 6 Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.residuals.axes: Core GEE residuals require one explicit header row and six columns in input order.")
            For c = 0 To 5
                If Not TypeOf residual(0, c) Is String Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.residuals.headers: Core residual headers are not observation rows.")
            Next
            Return DirectCast(residual.Clone(), Object(,))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Compose(intent As GeeWorkflowIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), corePredictions() As Double,
                                       residuals(,) As Object, observed() As Double, weights() As Double,
                                       Optional workingCorrelation(,) As Double = Nothing) As GeeReport
            If intent Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(intent))
            Dim ids = intent.MeanRequest.Primary.RowIds, predicted = Predictions(intent, corePredictions)
            If observed IsNot Nothing AndAlso observed.Length <> ids.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.observed.alignment")
            If weights IsNot Nothing AndAlso weights.Length <> ids.Length Then Throw New ArgumentException("gee.output.weights.alignment")
            Dim matrix As Double(,) = Nothing
            If predicted IsNot Nothing Then
                ReDim matrix(predicted.Length - 1, 0)
                For i = 0 To predicted.Length - 1 : matrix(i, 0) = predicted(i) : Next
            End If
            Dim rows As New RegressionRowOutput(ids, matrix, GeeReportPolicy.Residuals(intent, residuals))
            Dim report = RegressionReportPolicy.Compose(intent.MeanRequest, tables, rows)
            Return New GeeReport(intent, report, corePredictions, observed, weights, workingCorrelation)
        End Function
        ''' <summary>Call only at the original post-fit UI read boundary. Request-time controls
        ''' are not reused; Windows supplies its weighted-event-rate helper and owns charts.</summary>
        Public Shared Function Classification(report As GeeReport, postFitOptions As RegressionOptions,
                                              Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN) As GeeClassificationPlan
            If report Is Nothing OrElse postFitOptions Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException()
            Dim o = postFitOptions.Copy()
            ' Classification belongs to the actual fitted family. A post-fit UI change
            ' is not evidence that a different model was fitted. Windows quarantines
            ' its legacy mismatch path separately pending exact native timing authority.
            o.Family = report.Intent.MeanRequest.Options.Family
            If o.Family <> RegressionFamily.Binomial OrElse report.Rows.Fitted Is Nothing OrElse report.Observed Is Nothing Then o.Classification = False
            Dim p As Double() = Nothing
            If report.Rows.Fitted IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim values = report.Rows.Fitted
                p = Enumerable.Range(0, values.GetLength(0)).Select(Function(i) values(i, 0)).ToArray()
            End If
            Return New GeeClassificationPlan(report.Rows.RowIds, o,
                RegressionClassificationPolicy.Compose(report.Observed, p, report.ObservationWeights, o, eventRate, "GEE Binary Classification"))
        End Function
    End Class

        Friend Shared Function Rehydrate(m As ResultTableOutputModel) As ResultTable
            Dim t As New ResultTable With {.bLeftHeaderAdjustUp = True}
            Dim values = m.Values
            Dim firstBody = m.TitleRows + m.HeaderTopRows
            Dim endBody = m.RowCount - m.FooterRows
            Dim body(endBody - firstBody - 1, m.ColumnCount - m.HeaderLeftColumns - 1) As Object
            For r = firstBody To endBody - 1
                For c = m.HeaderLeftColumns To m.ColumnCount - 1
                    body(r - firstBody, c - m.HeaderLeftColumns) = values(r, c)
                Next
            Next
            t.SetBody(body)
            For r = 0 To m.TitleRows - 1 : t.AddTitle(DirectCast(values(r, 0), String)) : Next
            For r = m.TitleRows To firstBody - 1
                Dim header(m.ColumnCount - 1) As String
                For c = 0 To m.ColumnCount - 1 : header(c) = DirectCast(values(r, c), String) : Next
                t.AddHeaderTopRow(header)
            Next
            For c = 0 To m.HeaderLeftColumns - 1
                Dim header(endBody - m.TitleRows - 1) As String
                For r = m.TitleRows To endBody - 1 : header(r - m.TitleRows) = DirectCast(values(r, c), String) : Next
                t.AddHeaderLeftRow(header)
            Next
            For r = endBody To m.RowCount - 1 : t.AddFootnote(DirectCast(values(r, 0), String)) : Next
            For Each col In m.PvalueColumns : t.AddPvalueToFormat(col) : Next
            For Each cell In m.PvalueCells : t.AddPvalueCellToFormat(cell.BodyRow, cell.BodyColumn) : Next
            Return t
        End Function

    ''' <summary>Detached scalar status; availability flags describe supplied Core state,
    ''' not independent scientific qualification. No matrix/workspace/fit is retained.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelDiagnosticSnapshot
        Friend Sub New(result As MixedModelResult, alpha As Double)
            ' Metadata projection of the existing internal Core alpha fallback;
            ' actual interval/probability calculations still normalize inside Core.
            RequestedAlpha = alpha : EffectiveAlpha = If(Double.IsNaN(alpha) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(alpha) OrElse alpha <= 0 OrElse alpha >= 1, 0.05, alpha)
            Dim warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            If result Is Nothing Then
                State = MixedModelFitState.Unavailable
            Else
                State = If(result.Cancelled, MixedModelFitState.Cancelled, If(result.Interrupted, MixedModelFitState.Interrupted,
                    If(result.Converged, MixedModelFitState.Converged, If(result.Beta Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta.Length = 0, MixedModelFitState.Failed, MixedModelFitState.Nonconverged))))
                FitMethod = result.FitMethod : Inference = result.FixedInferenceMethod
                Iterations = result.Iterations : MaximumIterations = result.ControlMaxIter
                Optimizer = result.ControlCovarianceOptimizerMode : Gradient = result.ControlCovarianceGradientMode
                GradientNorm = result.GradNorm : Message = result.Message
                HasKrWorkspace = result.KenwardRogerWorkspace IsNot Nothing
                HasAdjustedCovariance = result.KenwardRogerAdjustedVarBeta IsNot Nothing
                HasSatterthwaiteWorkspace = result.InferenceWorkspace IsNot Nothing
                HasOptimizerTrace = result.OptimizerTrace IsNot Nothing
                HasSupportDiagnostics = result.VisitSupportDiagnostics IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.VisitSupportDiagnostics.Enabled
                HasRestartDiagnostics = result.RestartDiagnostics IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.RestartDiagnostics.Enabled
                HasKrFiniteDifferenceDiagnostics = HasKrWorkspace AndAlso result.KenwardRogerWorkspace.FiniteDifferenceDiagnostics IsNot Nothing
                KrStatusMessage = result.KenwardRogerStatusMessage
                If result.PerformanceDiagnostics IsNot Nothing Then
                    ActualOptimizer = result.PerformanceDiagnostics.ActualCovarianceOptimizerName
                    ActualGradientProvider = result.PerformanceDiagnostics.ActualCovarianceGradientProviderName
                    AnalyticGradientFallback = result.PerformanceDiagnostics.AnalyticGradientFallbackUsed
                End If
                If State <> MixedModelFitState.Converged Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit." & State.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), "Core fit status: " & State.ToString() & "."))
                CoefficientsAvailable = result.Beta IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.Beta.Length > 0
                OrdinaryCovarianceAvailable = result.VarBeta IsNot Nothing
                If Not CoefficientsAvailable Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.coefficients.unavailable", "Core coefficients are unavailable."))
                If result.Beta IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.Beta.Any(Function(v) Double.IsNaN(v) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(v)) Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.coefficients.nonfinite", "Core coefficients contain unavailable or nonfinite values."))
                If result.VarBeta Is Nothing Then
                    warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.covariance.unavailable", "Ordinary fitted coefficient covariance is unavailable."))
                ElseIf result.VarBeta.Cast(Of Double)().Any(Function(v) Double.IsNaN(v) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(v)) Then
                    warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.covariance.nonfinite", "Core coefficient covariance contains nonfinite values."))
                Else
                    For i = 0 To Math.Min(result.VarBeta.GetLength(0), result.VarBeta.GetLength(1)) - 1
                        If result.VarBeta(i, i) < 0 Then
                            warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.covariance.negative", "Core coefficient covariance has a negative diagonal value.")) : Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                End If
                If result.UserWarnings IsNot Nothing Then
                    For Each warningText As String In result.UserWarnings
                        If warnings.Count >= MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then Exit For
                        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(warningText) Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.fit.warning", warningText))
                    Next
                End If
            End If
            If Not alpha.Equals(EffectiveAlpha) AndAlso warnings.Count < MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning(AnalysisWarningCodes.AlphaDefaulted, "Core uses its existing alpha fallback."))
            Me.Warnings = warnings.AsReadOnly()
        End Sub

    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelDiagnosticPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Capture(result As MixedModelResult, alpha As Double) As MixedModelDiagnosticSnapshot
            Return New MixedModelDiagnosticSnapshot(result, alpha)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function DescribeTables(document As AnalysisResultDocument) As IReadOnlyList(Of MixedModelReportSection)
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelReportSection)
            Dim known As New Dictionary(Of String, String)(StringComparer.Ordinal) From {
                {"Fixed effects", "fixed-effects"}, {"Kenward-Roger term-level F tests", "kr-term-tests"}, {"Covariance parameters", "covariance-parameters"},
                {"Fit statistics", "fit-statistics"}, {"Performance diagnostics", "performance"}, {"MMRM support diagnostics", "support"},
                {"Optimizer restart diagnostics", "restart"}, {"KR finite-difference diagnostics", "kr-finite-difference"},
                {"Convergence", "convergence"}, {"Optimizer trace", "optimizer-trace"}, {"BLUPs / random effects", "random-effects"},
                {"Class Level Information", "class-information"}, {"Class level information", "class-information"},
                {"Reference-grid estimated marginal means", "reference-means"}, {"Reference-grid group contrasts", "reference-group-contrasts"}}
            For Each artifact In document.Tables
                Dim model = artifact.Model, label = If(model.RowCount > 0 AndAlso model.ColumnCount > 0, TryCast(model.Values(0, 0), String), Nothing)
                Dim code As String = Nothing
                If label Is Nothing OrElse Not known.TryGetValue(label, code) Then
                    code = "core-or-supplemental"
                    If label IsNot Nothing Then
                        If label = "Estimated marginal means by visit" Then code = "means-by-visit"
                        If label.StartsWith("Estimated marginal means by visit and ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "means-by-group"
                        If label = "MMRM change from baseline by visit" Then code = "change-by-visit"
                        If label.StartsWith("MMRM change from baseline by visit and ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "change-by-group"
                        If label = "MMRM pairwise group differences by visit" OrElse label = "MMRM selected group difference by visit" OrElse label = "MMRM group differences vs control by visit" Then code = "group-differences"
                        If label.StartsWith("MMRM difference in change from baseline by ", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse label.StartsWith("MMRM selected difference in change from baseline by ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "difference-in-change"
                    End If
                End If
                sections.Add(New MixedModelReportSection(artifact.Index, If(label, String.Empty), "mixed.section." & code))
            Next
            Return sections.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
    End Class

        End Function
        Public Shared Function DescribeTables(document As AnalysisResultDocument) As IReadOnlyList(Of MixedModelReportSection)
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelReportSection)
            Dim known As New Dictionary(Of String, String)(StringComparer.Ordinal) From {
                {"Fixed effects", "fixed-effects"}, {"Kenward-Roger term-level F tests", "kr-term-tests"}, {"Covariance parameters", "covariance-parameters"},
                {"Fit statistics", "fit-statistics"}, {"Performance diagnostics", "performance"}, {"MMRM support diagnostics", "support"},
                {"Optimizer restart diagnostics", "restart"}, {"KR finite-difference diagnostics", "kr-finite-difference"},
                {"Convergence", "convergence"}, {"Optimizer trace", "optimizer-trace"}, {"BLUPs / random effects", "random-effects"},
                {"Class Level Information", "class-information"}, {"Class level information", "class-information"},
                {"Reference-grid estimated marginal means", "reference-means"}, {"Reference-grid group contrasts", "reference-group-contrasts"}}
            For Each artifact In document.Tables
                Dim model = artifact.Model, label = If(model.RowCount > 0 AndAlso model.ColumnCount > 0, TryCast(model.Values(0, 0), String), Nothing)
                Dim code As String = Nothing
                If label Is Nothing OrElse Not known.TryGetValue(label, code) Then
                    code = "core-or-supplemental"
                    If label IsNot Nothing Then
                        If label = "Estimated marginal means by visit" Then code = "means-by-visit"
                        If label.StartsWith("Estimated marginal means by visit and ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "means-by-group"
                        If label = "MMRM change from baseline by visit" Then code = "change-by-visit"
                        If label.StartsWith("MMRM change from baseline by visit and ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "change-by-group"
                        If label = "MMRM pairwise group differences by visit" OrElse label = "MMRM selected group difference by visit" OrElse label = "MMRM group differences vs control by visit" Then code = "group-differences"
                        If label.StartsWith("MMRM difference in change from baseline by ", StringComparison.Ordinal) OrElse label.StartsWith("MMRM selected difference in change from baseline by ", StringComparison.Ordinal) Then code = "difference-in-change"
                    End If
                End If
                sections.Add(New MixedModelReportSection(artifact.Index, If(label, String.Empty), "mixed.section." & code))
            Next
            Return sections.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
    End Class
