    Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelPostEstimationPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Const ComparisonUnavailable As String = "Selected comparison could not be resolved. Choose a comparison/treatment level different from the control/reference level."
        Private Shared Sub Log(sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice), message As String, Optional warning As Boolean = False)
            If sink IsNot Nothing Then sink(New MixedModelPostEstimationNotice(message, warning))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function EmptyReport(Optional warning As AnalysisWarning = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport({}, {}, If(warning Is Nothing, Array.Empty(Of AnalysisWarning)(), {warning}))
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub OptionalTable(section As MixedModelSupplementalSection, label As String, factory As Func(Of ResultTable),
                                         sections As List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As List(Of ResultTable), warnings As List(Of AnalysisWarning),
                                         sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice))
            If factory Is Nothing Then Return
            Try
                Dim table = factory()
                If table Is Nothing Then
                    Log(sink, "MMRM optional table not created: " & label)
                    If warnings.Count < MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.table.unavailable", "Optional table was not created: " & label, section.ToString()))
                    Return
                End If
                sections.Add(section) : tables.Add(table)
                Log(sink, "MMRM optional table added: " & label)
            Catch ex As Exception
                Log(sink, "MMRM optional table failed: " & label & ": " & ex.ToString(), True)
                If warnings.Count < MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.table.failed", "Optional table could not be created: " & label, section.ToString()))
            End Try
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ProjectMMRM(result As MixedModelResult, x(,) As Double, intent As MixedModelPostEstimationIntent,
                                            Optional classFactory As Func(Of ResultTable) = Nothing,
                                            Optional referenceFactory As Func(Of MixedModelSupplementalReport) = Nothing,
                                            Optional sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice) = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            If intent Is Nothing OrElse result Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            If intent.Kind <> MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.kind.unsupported", "The observed MMRM orchestration is not an LMM GUI feature."))
            Dim visit = intent.Reference.Visits, groups = intent.Reference.Groups, o = intent.Options
            If visit Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta.Length = 0 OrElse result.VarBeta Is Nothing OrElse x.GetLength(0) <> visit.Length Then
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            End If
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As New List(Of ResultTable), warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            Dim plan = MixedModelReportPolicy.Plan(MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, o, intent.HasGroup)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation, "Class Level Information", classFactory, sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If Not o.EstimatedMeans Then
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables finished after class-level output because estimated means are disabled.")
                Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
            End If
            Dim baseline = If(o.BaselineVisit.HasValue, o.BaselineVisit.Value, ResolveLevel(visit, o.BaselineSelection, "(Smallest)"))
            Dim control = If(intent.HasGroup, If(o.ControlLevel.HasValue, o.ControlLevel.Value, ResolveLevel(groups, o.ControlSelection, "(First)")), Double.NaN)
            Dim mode = ContrastText(o), direction = DirectionText(o)
            If o.MeansMode = MixedModelMeansMode.ReferenceGrid Then
                Try
                    Dim report = If(referenceFactory IsNot Nothing, referenceFactory(), ProjectReference(result, intent.Reference.CreateCoreSpec(), intent, sink))
                    If report IsNot Nothing Then
                        sections.AddRange(report.Sections) : tables.AddRange(report.LegacyTables()) : warnings.AddRange(report.Document.Warnings)
                    End If
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables used reference-grid mode; observed-design-grid tables skipped.")
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables failed: " & ex.ToString(), True)
                    warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.failed", "Reference-grid specification or row construction failed."))
                End Try
                Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
            End If
            Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables options. baseline=" & baseline.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                "; contrastMode='" & mode & "'; direction='" & direction & "'; controlLevel=" & control.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.MeansByVisit, "Estimated marginal means by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildEstimatedMeansByVisitTable(result, x, visit, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit, "MMRM change from baseline by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineTableControlled(result, x, visit, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If intent.HasGroup Then
                OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.MeansByVisitAndGroup, "Estimated marginal means by visit and group", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildEstimatedMeansByVisitAndGroupTable(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences, "MMRM group differences by visit", Function() BuildObservedContrast(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, control, o, False), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup) Then
                    OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup, "MMRM change from baseline by visit and group", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineByGroupTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                    If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.DifferenceInChange) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.DifferenceInChange, "MMRM difference in change from baseline", Function() BuildObservedContrast(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, control, o, True), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                End If
            Else
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables: no grouping factor resolved; group-specific LS-means/contrast tables skipped.")
            End If
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ProjectReference(result As MixedModelResult, spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, intent As MixedModelPostEstimationIntent,
                                                Optional sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice) = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            If result Is Nothing OrElse intent Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            If spec Is Nothing Then
                Log(sink, "Reference-grid LS-means skipped: specification could not be built.", True)
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.unavailable", "Reference-grid specification could not be built."))
            End If
            Dim rows = MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildReferenceGridRows(spec)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
                Log(sink, "Reference-grid LS-means skipped: no reference-grid rows were created.", True)
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.empty", "No reference-grid rows were created."))
            End If
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As New List(Of ResultTable), warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ReferenceMeans, "Reference-grid estimated marginal means", Function() MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildEstimatedMeansTable("Reference-grid estimated marginal means", rows, result, spec), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            Dim o = intent.Options
            If Not o.ControlLevel.HasValue Then o.ControlLevel = ResolveLevel(intent.Reference.Groups, o.ControlSelection, "(First)")
            If intent.HasGroup AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(intent.Reference.GroupKey) AndAlso o.Contrast <> MixedModelContrastSelection.None Then
                OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ReferenceGroupContrasts, "Reference-grid group contrasts", Function() BuildReferenceContrasts(result, rows, spec, intent.Reference.GroupKey, o), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            End If
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ContrastText(o As MixedModelReportOptions) As String
            If o.RequestedContrastText IsNot Nothing Then Return o.RequestedContrastText
            Select Case o.Contrast
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.None : Return "None"
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.EachVsControl : Return "Each group vs control"
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.SelectedComparison : Return "Selected comparison only"
                Case Else : Return "Pairwise among group levels"
            End Select
        End Function
        Public Shared Function DirectionText(o As MixedModelReportOptions) As String
            If o.RequestedDirectionText IsNot Nothing Then Return o.RequestedDirectionText
            Select Case o.Direction
                Case MixedModelContrastDirection.TreatmentMinusControl : Return "Treatment - control"
                Case MixedModelContrastDirection.ControlMinusTreatment : Return "Control - treatment"
                Case Else : Return "Higher level - lower level"
            End Select
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ResolveLevel(values() As Double, selection As String, placeholder As String) As Double
            Dim levels = MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(values)
            If levels Is Nothing OrElse levels.Length = 0 Then Return Double.NaN
            Dim text = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selection), placeholder, selection)
            If String.Equals(text, placeholder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return levels(0)
            For Each value In levels
                If String.Equals(MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(value), text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return value
            Next
            Dim parsed As Double
            If Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, parsed) Then Return parsed
            If Double.TryParse(text, parsed) Then Return parsed
            Return levels(0)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ResolveComparison(levels() As Double, control As Double, selection As String, ByRef comparison As Double) As Boolean
            comparison = Double.NaN
            If levels Is Nothing OrElse levels.Length = 0 Then Return False
            Dim text = If(selection, "(Auto)").Trim()
            If text.Length = 0 OrElse text.Equals("(Auto)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                For Each value In levels
                    If Not MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(value, control) Then comparison = value : Return True
                Next
                Return False
            End If
            Dim parsed As Double
            If Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, parsed) OrElse Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, parsed) Then
                If MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(parsed, control) Then Return False
                comparison = parsed : Return True
            End If
            For Each value In levels
                If String.Equals(MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(value), text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    If MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(value, control) Then Return False
                    comparison = value : Return True
                End If
            Next
            Return False
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ResolveContrastComparison(levels() As Double, control As Double, o As MixedModelReportOptions) As Double
            Dim value = If(o.ComparisonLevel.HasValue, o.ComparisonLevel.Value, Double.NaN)
            If String.Equals(ContrastText(o), "Selected comparison only", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso
                Not ResolveComparison(levels, control, If(o.ComparisonLevel.HasValue, value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), o.ComparisonSelection), value) Then Throw New ApplicationException(ComparisonUnavailable)
            Return value
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildObservedContrast(result As MixedModelResult, x(,) As Double, visit() As Double, groups() As Double, groupKey As String,
                                                     baseline As Double, control As Double, o As MixedModelReportOptions, differenceInChange As Boolean) As ResultTable
            Dim comparison = ResolveContrastComparison(MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(groups), control, o)
            If differenceInChange Then Return MMRMPostEstimation.BuildDifferenceInChangeFromBaselineTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, groupKey, baseline, o.Alpha, ContrastText(o), control, comparison, DirectionText(o))
            Return MMRMPostEstimation.BuildVisitGroupDifferencesTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, groupKey, o.Alpha, ContrastText(o), control, comparison, DirectionText(o))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildReferenceContrasts(result As MixedModelResult, rows As List(Of MixedModelReferenceGridRow), spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, groupKey As String, o As MixedModelReportOptions) As ResultTable
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(groupKey), mode = ContrastText(o)
            If String.Equals(mode, "Pairwise among group levels", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildPairwiseContrastsByFactor(rows, result, spec, name, "Reference-grid group contrasts")
            Dim control = If(o.ControlLevel.HasValue, o.ControlLevel.Value, Double.NaN)
            Dim comparison = ResolveContrastComparison(MixedModelReferenceGridService.GetLevelsFromRows(rows, name), control, o)
            Return MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildContrastsAgainstControlByFactor(rows, result, spec, name, control, comparison,
                String.Equals(mode, "Selected comparison only", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), DirectionText(o), "Treatment - control", "Control - treatment", "Reference-grid group contrasts")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ReferenceColumnIncluded(key As String, visitProfile As String, groupProfile As String) As Boolean
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(key)
            Return Not String.Equals(name, visitProfile, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso
                (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(groupProfile) OrElse Not String.Equals(name, groupProfile, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub AddReferenceColumn(spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, column As MixedModelReferenceColumn, visitProfile As String, groupProfile As String, o As MixedModelReportOptions)
            If Not ReferenceColumnIncluded(column.Key, visitProfile, groupProfile) Then Return
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(column.Key), values = column.Values
            If column.Role = MixedModelReferenceColumnRole.MarginalFactor Then
                Dim levels = MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(values)
                If levels IsNot Nothing AndAlso levels.Length > 1 Then spec.AddMarginalFactor(name, levels, values)
            ElseIf o.CovariateMode = MixedModelCovariateReferenceMode.ObservedMean Then
                spec.AddCovariateMean(name, values)
            Else
                spec.AddCovariateValue(name, values, 0.0) ' Shipping GUI supports mean or zero only.
            End If
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ClassInformation(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, rows As IEnumerable(Of MixedModelClassLevel)) As ResultTable
            If rows Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim materialized = rows.Where(Function(row) row IsNot Nothing).ToArray()
            If materialized.Length = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim mmrm = kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, body(materialized.Length - 1, If(mmrm, 2, 4)) As Object
            For i = 0 To materialized.Length - 1
                Dim row = materialized(i)
                If mmrm Then
                    body(i, 0) = row.Name : body(i, 1) = row.Count : body(i, 2) = row.Levels
                Else
                    body(i, 0) = row.ModelPart : body(i, 1) = row.Name : body(i, 2) = "Categorical main effect" : body(i, 3) = row.Levels : body(i, 4) = row.Count
                End If
            Next
            Dim table As New ResultTable
            table.AddTitle(If(mmrm, "Class Level Information", "Class level information")) : table.SetBody(body)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(If(mmrm, New String() {"Class", "Levels", "Values"}, New String() {"Model part", "Variable", "Term kind", "Levels", "No. levels"}))
            table.AddFootnote(If(mmrm, "Class levels are shown for the subject ID and, when available, the grouping factor used by MMRM LS-means/contrast output.", "Levels are observed numeric/coded values in the cleaned analysis data for variables used as categorical effects."))
            Return table
        End Function
        Public Shared Function LmmClassReport(rows As IEnumerable(Of MixedModelClassLevel)) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            Dim table = ClassInformation(MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM, rows)
            If table Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport()
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport({MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation}, {table}, {})
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BetterGroupingCandidate(levelCount As Integer, bestCount As Integer) As Boolean
            Return HasGroupingLevels(levelCount) AndAlso levelCount < bestCount
        End Function
        Public Shared Function HasGroupingLevels(levelCount As Integer) As Boolean
            Return levelCount >= 2
        End Function
        Public Shared Function GroupingChoice(text As String) As MixedModelGroupingChoice
            If String.Equals(text, "(None)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.None
            If String.Equals(text, "(Auto)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.Automatic
            Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.Explicit
        End Function
        Public Shared Function MainEffectKeys(selected As IEnumerable(Of String), specs As IDictionary(Of String, TermSpec), scale As PredictorScale,
                                               Optional excludeBase As String = Nothing, Optional singleBaseOnly As Boolean = True) As List(Of String)
            Dim keys As New List(Of String)
            If selected Is Nothing OrElse specs Is Nothing Then Return keys
            For Each key In selected
                If (singleBaseOnly AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key)) OrElse Not specs.ContainsKey(key) Then Continue For
                Dim spec = specs(key)
                If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse Not String.Equals(spec.Kind, "MainEffect", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse spec.Scale <> scale Then Continue For
                If singleBaseOnly AndAlso spec.BaseVarKeys.Count <> 1 Then Continue For
                For Each baseKey In spec.BaseVarKeys
                    If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(excludeBase) AndAlso String.Equals(RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(baseKey), excludeBase, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Continue For
                    If Not keys.Contains(baseKey) Then keys.Add(baseKey)
                Next
            Next
            Return keys
        End Function

Public NotInheritable Class MixedModelPostEstimationPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Const ComparisonUnavailable As String = "Selected comparison could not be resolved. Choose a comparison/treatment level different from the control/reference level."
        Private Shared Sub Log(sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice), message As String, Optional warning As Boolean = False)
            If sink IsNot Nothing Then sink(New MixedModelPostEstimationNotice(message, warning))
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function EmptyReport(Optional warning As AnalysisWarning = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport({}, {}, If(warning Is Nothing, Array.Empty(Of AnalysisWarning)(), {warning}))
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub OptionalTable(section As MixedModelSupplementalSection, label As String, factory As Func(Of ResultTable),
                                         sections As List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As List(Of ResultTable), warnings As List(Of AnalysisWarning),
                                         sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice))
            If factory Is Nothing Then Return
            Try
                Dim table = factory()
                If table Is Nothing Then
                    Log(sink, "MMRM optional table not created: " & label)
                    If warnings.Count < MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.table.unavailable", "Optional table was not created: " & label, section.ToString()))
                    Return
                End If
                sections.Add(section) : tables.Add(table)
                Log(sink, "MMRM optional table added: " & label)
            Catch ex As Exception
                Log(sink, "MMRM optional table failed: " & label & ": " & ex.ToString(), True)
                If warnings.Count < MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.MaximumDiagnostics Then warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.table.failed", "Optional table could not be created: " & label, section.ToString()))
            End Try
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ProjectMMRM(result As MixedModelResult, x(,) As Double, intent As MixedModelPostEstimationIntent,
                                            Optional classFactory As Func(Of ResultTable) = Nothing,
                                            Optional referenceFactory As Func(Of MixedModelSupplementalReport) = Nothing,
                                            Optional sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice) = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            If intent Is Nothing OrElse result Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            If intent.Kind <> MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.kind.unsupported", "The observed MMRM orchestration is not an LMM GUI feature."))
            Dim visit = intent.Reference.Visits, groups = intent.Reference.Groups, o = intent.Options
            If visit Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta.Length = 0 OrElse result.VarBeta Is Nothing OrElse x.GetLength(0) <> visit.Length Then
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            End If
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As New List(Of ResultTable), warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            Dim plan = MixedModelReportPolicy.Plan(MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, o, intent.HasGroup)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation, "Class Level Information", classFactory, sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If Not o.EstimatedMeans Then
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables finished after class-level output because estimated means are disabled.")
                Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
            End If
            Dim baseline = If(o.BaselineVisit.HasValue, o.BaselineVisit.Value, ResolveLevel(visit, o.BaselineSelection, "(Smallest)"))
            Dim control = If(intent.HasGroup, If(o.ControlLevel.HasValue, o.ControlLevel.Value, ResolveLevel(groups, o.ControlSelection, "(First)")), Double.NaN)
            Dim mode = ContrastText(o), direction = DirectionText(o)
            If o.MeansMode = MixedModelMeansMode.ReferenceGrid Then
                Try
                    Dim report = If(referenceFactory IsNot Nothing, referenceFactory(), ProjectReference(result, intent.Reference.CreateCoreSpec(), intent, sink))
                    If report IsNot Nothing Then
                        sections.AddRange(report.Sections) : tables.AddRange(report.LegacyTables()) : warnings.AddRange(report.Document.Warnings)
                    End If
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables used reference-grid mode; observed-design-grid tables skipped.")
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables failed: " & ex.ToString(), True)
                    warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.failed", "Reference-grid specification or row construction failed."))
                End Try
                Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
            End If
            Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables options. baseline=" & baseline.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                "; contrastMode='" & mode & "'; direction='" & direction & "'; controlLevel=" & control.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.MeansByVisit, "Estimated marginal means by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildEstimatedMeansByVisitTable(result, x, visit, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit, "MMRM change from baseline by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineTableControlled(result, x, visit, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If intent.HasGroup Then
                OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.MeansByVisitAndGroup, "Estimated marginal means by visit and group", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildEstimatedMeansByVisitAndGroupTable(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences, "MMRM group differences by visit", Function() BuildObservedContrast(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, control, o, False), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup) Then
                    OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup, "MMRM change from baseline by visit and group", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineByGroupTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                    If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.DifferenceInChange) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.DifferenceInChange, "MMRM difference in change from baseline", Function() BuildObservedContrast(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, control, o, True), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                End If
            Else
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables: no grouping factor resolved; group-specific LS-means/contrast tables skipped.")
            End If
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ProjectReference(result As MixedModelResult, spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, intent As MixedModelPostEstimationIntent,
                                                Optional sink As Action(Of MixedModelPostEstimationNotice) = Nothing) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            If result Is Nothing OrElse intent Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            If spec Is Nothing Then
                Log(sink, "Reference-grid LS-means skipped: specification could not be built.", True)
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.unavailable", "Reference-grid specification could not be built."))
            End If
            Dim rows = MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildReferenceGridRows(spec)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
                Log(sink, "Reference-grid LS-means skipped: no reference-grid rows were created.", True)
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.empty", "No reference-grid rows were created."))
            End If
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As New List(Of ResultTable), warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ReferenceMeans, "Reference-grid estimated marginal means", Function() MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildEstimatedMeansTable("Reference-grid estimated marginal means", rows, result, spec), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            Dim o = intent.Options
            If Not o.ControlLevel.HasValue Then o.ControlLevel = ResolveLevel(intent.Reference.Groups, o.ControlSelection, "(First)")
            If intent.HasGroup AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(intent.Reference.GroupKey) AndAlso o.Contrast <> MixedModelContrastSelection.None Then
                OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ReferenceGroupContrasts, "Reference-grid group contrasts", Function() BuildReferenceContrasts(result, rows, spec, intent.Reference.GroupKey, o), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            End If
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ContrastText(o As MixedModelReportOptions) As String
            If o.RequestedContrastText IsNot Nothing Then Return o.RequestedContrastText
            Select Case o.Contrast
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.None : Return "None"
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.EachVsControl : Return "Each group vs control"
                Case MixedModelContrastSelection.SelectedComparison : Return "Selected comparison only"
                Case Else : Return "Pairwise among group levels"
            End Select
        End Function
        Public Shared Function DirectionText(o As MixedModelReportOptions) As String
            If o.RequestedDirectionText IsNot Nothing Then Return o.RequestedDirectionText
            Select Case o.Direction
                Case MixedModelContrastDirection.TreatmentMinusControl : Return "Treatment - control"
                Case MixedModelContrastDirection.ControlMinusTreatment : Return "Control - treatment"
                Case Else : Return "Higher level - lower level"
            End Select
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ResolveLevel(values() As Double, selection As String, placeholder As String) As Double
            Dim levels = MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(values)
            If levels Is Nothing OrElse levels.Length = 0 Then Return Double.NaN
            Dim text = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selection), placeholder, selection)
            If String.Equals(text, placeholder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return levels(0)
            For Each value In levels
                If String.Equals(MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(value), text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return value
            Next
            Dim parsed As Double
            If Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, parsed) Then Return parsed
            If Double.TryParse(text, parsed) Then Return parsed
            Return levels(0)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ResolveComparison(levels() As Double, control As Double, selection As String, ByRef comparison As Double) As Boolean
            comparison = Double.NaN
            If levels Is Nothing OrElse levels.Length = 0 Then Return False
            Dim text = If(selection, "(Auto)").Trim()
            If text.Length = 0 OrElse text.Equals("(Auto)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                For Each value In levels
                    If Not MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(value, control) Then comparison = value : Return True
                Next
                Return False
            End If
            Dim parsed As Double
            If Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, parsed) OrElse Double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, parsed) Then
                If MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(parsed, control) Then Return False
                comparison = parsed : Return True
            End If
            For Each value In levels
                If String.Equals(MixedModelPostEstimation.FormatProfileValue(value), text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    If MixedModelPostEstimation.NearlyEqual(value, control) Then Return False
                    comparison = value : Return True
                End If
            Next
            Return False
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ResolveContrastComparison(levels() As Double, control As Double, o As MixedModelReportOptions) As Double
            Dim value = If(o.ComparisonLevel.HasValue, o.ComparisonLevel.Value, Double.NaN)
            If String.Equals(ContrastText(o), "Selected comparison only", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso
                Not ResolveComparison(levels, control, If(o.ComparisonLevel.HasValue, value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), o.ComparisonSelection), value) Then Throw New ApplicationException(ComparisonUnavailable)
            Return value
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildObservedContrast(result As MixedModelResult, x(,) As Double, visit() As Double, groups() As Double, groupKey As String,
                                                     baseline As Double, control As Double, o As MixedModelReportOptions, differenceInChange As Boolean) As ResultTable
            Dim comparison = ResolveContrastComparison(MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(groups), control, o)
            If differenceInChange Then Return MMRMPostEstimation.BuildDifferenceInChangeFromBaselineTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, groupKey, baseline, o.Alpha, ContrastText(o), control, comparison, DirectionText(o))
            Return MMRMPostEstimation.BuildVisitGroupDifferencesTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, groupKey, o.Alpha, ContrastText(o), control, comparison, DirectionText(o))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildReferenceContrasts(result As MixedModelResult, rows As List(Of MixedModelReferenceGridRow), spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, groupKey As String, o As MixedModelReportOptions) As ResultTable
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(groupKey), mode = ContrastText(o)
            If String.Equals(mode, "Pairwise among group levels", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildPairwiseContrastsByFactor(rows, result, spec, name, "Reference-grid group contrasts")
            Dim control = If(o.ControlLevel.HasValue, o.ControlLevel.Value, Double.NaN)
            Dim comparison = ResolveContrastComparison(MixedModelReferenceGridService.GetLevelsFromRows(rows, name), control, o)
            Return MixedModelReferenceGridService.BuildContrastsAgainstControlByFactor(rows, result, spec, name, control, comparison,
                String.Equals(mode, "Selected comparison only", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), DirectionText(o), "Treatment - control", "Control - treatment", "Reference-grid group contrasts")
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ReferenceColumnIncluded(key As String, visitProfile As String, groupProfile As String) As Boolean
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(key)
            Return Not String.Equals(name, visitProfile, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso
                (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(groupProfile) OrElse Not String.Equals(name, groupProfile, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End Function
        Public Shared Sub AddReferenceColumn(spec As MixedModelReferenceGridSpec, column As MixedModelReferenceColumn, visitProfile As String, groupProfile As String, o As MixedModelReportOptions)
            If Not ReferenceColumnIncluded(column.Key, visitProfile, groupProfile) Then Return
            Dim name = MixedModelReferenceGridService.NormalizeProfileName(column.Key), values = column.Values
            If column.Role = MixedModelReferenceColumnRole.MarginalFactor Then
                Dim levels = MixedModelPostEstimation.UniqueSortedFiniteValues(values)
                If levels IsNot Nothing AndAlso levels.Length > 1 Then spec.AddMarginalFactor(name, levels, values)
            ElseIf o.CovariateMode = MixedModelCovariateReferenceMode.ObservedMean Then
                spec.AddCovariateMean(name, values)
            Else
                spec.AddCovariateValue(name, values, 0.0) ' Shipping GUI supports mean or zero only.
            End If
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function ClassInformation(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, rows As IEnumerable(Of MixedModelClassLevel)) As ResultTable
            If rows Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim materialized = rows.Where(Function(row) row IsNot Nothing).ToArray()
            If materialized.Length = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim mmrm = kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, body(materialized.Length - 1, If(mmrm, 2, 4)) As Object
            For i = 0 To materialized.Length - 1
                Dim row = materialized(i)
                If mmrm Then
                    body(i, 0) = row.Name : body(i, 1) = row.Count : body(i, 2) = row.Levels
                Else
                    body(i, 0) = row.ModelPart : body(i, 1) = row.Name : body(i, 2) = "Categorical main effect" : body(i, 3) = row.Levels : body(i, 4) = row.Count
                End If
            Next
            Dim table As New ResultTable
            table.AddTitle(If(mmrm, "Class Level Information", "Class level information")) : table.SetBody(body)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(If(mmrm, New String() {"Class", "Levels", "Values"}, New String() {"Model part", "Variable", "Term kind", "Levels", "No. levels"}))
            table.AddFootnote(If(mmrm, "Class levels are shown for the subject ID and, when available, the grouping factor used by MMRM LS-means/contrast output.", "Levels are observed numeric/coded values in the cleaned analysis data for variables used as categorical effects."))
            Return table
        End Function
        Public Shared Function LmmClassReport(rows As IEnumerable(Of MixedModelClassLevel)) As MixedModelSupplementalReport
            Dim table = ClassInformation(MixedModelWorkflowKind.LMM, rows)
            If table Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport()
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport({MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation}, {table}, {})
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BetterGroupingCandidate(levelCount As Integer, bestCount As Integer) As Boolean
            Return HasGroupingLevels(levelCount) AndAlso levelCount < bestCount
        End Function
        Public Shared Function HasGroupingLevels(levelCount As Integer) As Boolean
            Return levelCount >= 2
        End Function
        Public Shared Function GroupingChoice(text As String) As MixedModelGroupingChoice
            If String.Equals(text, "(None)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.None
            If String.Equals(text, "(Auto)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.Automatic
            Return MixedModelGroupingChoice.Explicit
        End Function
        Public Shared Function MainEffectKeys(selected As IEnumerable(Of String), specs As IDictionary(Of String, TermSpec), scale As PredictorScale,
                                               Optional excludeBase As String = Nothing, Optional singleBaseOnly As Boolean = True) As List(Of String)
            Dim keys As New List(Of String)
            If selected Is Nothing OrElse specs Is Nothing Then Return keys
            For Each key In selected
                If (singleBaseOnly AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key)) OrElse Not specs.ContainsKey(key) Then Continue For
                Dim spec = specs(key)
                If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse Not String.Equals(spec.Kind, "MainEffect", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse spec.Scale <> scale Then Continue For
                If singleBaseOnly AndAlso spec.BaseVarKeys.Count <> 1 Then Continue For
                For Each baseKey In spec.BaseVarKeys
                    If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(excludeBase) AndAlso String.Equals(RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(baseKey), excludeBase, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Continue For
                    If Not keys.Contains(baseKey) Then keys.Add(baseKey)
                Next
            Next
            Return keys
        End Function
    End Class

            If intent Is Nothing OrElse result Is Nothing OrElse x Is Nothing Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            If intent.Kind <> MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM Then Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.kind.unsupported", "The observed MMRM orchestration is not an LMM GUI feature."))
            Dim visit = intent.Reference.Visits, groups = intent.Reference.Groups, o = intent.Options
            If visit Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta Is Nothing OrElse result.Beta.Length = 0 OrElse result.VarBeta Is Nothing OrElse x.GetLength(0) <> visit.Length Then
                Return EmptyReport(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.inputs.unavailable", "Post-estimation inputs are unavailable."))
            End If
            Dim sections As New List(Of MixedModelSupplementalSection), tables As New List(Of ResultTable), warnings As New List(Of AnalysisWarning)
            Dim plan = MixedModelReportPolicy.Plan(MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, o, intent.HasGroup)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ClassInformation, "Class Level Information", classFactory, sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If Not o.EstimatedMeans Then
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables finished after class-level output because estimated means are disabled.")

            If o.MeansMode = MixedModelMeansMode.ReferenceGrid Then
                Try
                    Dim report = If(referenceFactory IsNot Nothing, referenceFactory(), ProjectReference(result, intent.Reference.CreateCoreSpec(), intent, sink))
                    If report IsNot Nothing Then
                        sections.AddRange(report.Sections) : tables.AddRange(report.LegacyTables()) : warnings.AddRange(report.Document.Warnings)
                    End If
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables used reference-grid mode; observed-design-grid tables skipped.")
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables failed: " & ex.ToString(), True)
                    warnings.Add(New AnalysisWarning("mixed.post.reference.failed", "Reference-grid specification or row construction failed."))
                End Try
                Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
            End If
            Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables options. baseline=" & baseline.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                "; contrastMode='" & mode & "'; direction='" & direction & "'; controlLevel=" & control.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.MeansByVisit, "Estimated marginal means by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildEstimatedMeansByVisitTable(result, x, visit, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
            If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByVisit, "MMRM change from baseline by visit", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineTableControlled(result, x, visit, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)

                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences) Then OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.GroupDifferences, "MMRM group differences by visit", Function() BuildObservedContrast(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, control, o, False), sections, tables, warnings, sink)
                If plan.Includes(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup) Then
                    OptionalTable(MixedModelSupplementalSection.ChangeByGroup, "MMRM change from baseline by visit and group", Function() MMRMPostEstimation.BuildChangeFromBaselineByGroupTableControlled(result, x, visit, groups, intent.Reference.GroupKey, baseline, o.Alpha), sections, tables, warnings, sink)

                End If
            Else
                Log(sink, "AppendMMRMEstimatedMeanTables: no grouping factor resolved; group-specific LS-means/contrast tables skipped.")
            End If
            Return New MixedModelSupplementalReport(sections, tables, warnings)
        End Function

Public Shared Function ClassInformation(kind As MixedModelWorkflowKind, rows As IEnumerable(Of MixedModelClassLevel)) As ResultTable
            If rows Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim materialized = rows.Where(Function(row) row IsNot Nothing).ToArray()
            If materialized.Length = 0 Then Return Nothing
            Dim mmrm = kind = MixedModelWorkflowKind.MMRM, body(materialized.Length - 1, If(mmrm, 2, 4)) As Object
            For i = 0 To materialized.Length - 1
                Dim row = materialized(i)
                If mmrm Then
                    body(i, 0) = row.Name : body(i, 1) = row.Count : body(i, 2) = row.Levels
                Else
                    body(i, 0) = row.ModelPart : body(i, 1) = row.Name : body(i, 2) = "Categorical main effect" : body(i, 3) = row.Levels : body(i, 4) = row.Count
                End If
            Next
            Dim table As New ResultTable
            table.AddTitle(If(mmrm, "Class Level Information", "Class level information")) : table.SetBody(body)
            table.AddHeaderTopRow(If(mmrm, New String() {"Class", "Levels", "Values"}, New String() {"Model part", "Variable", "Term kind", "Levels", "No. levels"}))
            table.AddFootnote(If(mmrm, "Class levels are shown for the subject ID and, when available, the grouping factor used by MMRM LS-means/contrast output.", "Levels are observed numeric/coded values in the cleaned analysis data for variables used as categorical effects."))
            Return table
        End Function

Public Shared Function MainEffectKeys(selected As IEnumerable(Of String), specs As IDictionary(Of String, TermSpec), scale As PredictorScale,
                                               Optional excludeBase As String = Nothing, Optional singleBaseOnly As Boolean = True) As List(Of String)
            Dim keys As New List(Of String)
            If selected Is Nothing OrElse specs Is Nothing Then Return keys
            For Each key In selected
                If (singleBaseOnly AndAlso String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key)) OrElse Not specs.ContainsKey(key) Then Continue For
                Dim spec = specs(key)
                If spec Is Nothing OrElse spec.BaseVarKeys Is Nothing OrElse Not String.Equals(spec.Kind, "MainEffect", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse spec.Scale <> scale Then Continue For
                If singleBaseOnly AndAlso spec.BaseVarKeys.Count <> 1 Then Continue For
                For Each baseKey In spec.BaseVarKeys
                    If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(excludeBase) AndAlso String.Equals(RegressionDesignCore.GetCoefBaseName(baseKey), excludeBase, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Continue For
                    If Not keys.Contains(baseKey) Then keys.Add(baseKey)
                Next
            Next
            Return keys
        End Function

                If options.CovariateMode = MixedModelCovariateReferenceMode.UserSpecified AndAlso Not MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Finite(options.CovariateValue) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "report.covariate", "User reference covariate must be finite.")

                If options.ControlLevel.HasValue AndAlso groupLevels IsNot Nothing AndAlso Not groupLevels.Contains(options.ControlLevel.Value) Then MixedModelWorkflowPolicy.Issue(issues, "report.control", "Selected control is absent from group levels.")

    Public NotInheritable Class MultivariatePointSeries37
        Private ReadOnly _x As Double(), _y As Double(), _labels As String(), _ordinals As Integer(), _modelRowIds As Integer?()
        Private ReadOnly _axisKind As MultivariateSemanticAxis
        Friend Sub New(name As String, x As Double(), y As Double(), labels As String(), ordinals As Integer(), role As MultivariatePlotDataRole,
                       Optional ordinalKind As MultivariateOrdinalKind37 = MultivariateOrdinalKind37.ModelPositionZeroBased,

                       Optional modelRowIds As Integer?() = Nothing)
            Me.Name = name : Me.Role = role : Me.OrdinalKind = ordinalKind
            _x = Clone(x) : _y = Clone(y) : _labels = Clone(labels) : _ordinals = Clone(ordinals)
            _axisKind = axisKind : _modelRowIds = Clone(modelRowIds)
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Clone(Of T)(values As T()) As T()
            Return If(values Is Nothing, Nothing, DirectCast(values.Clone(), T()))
        End Function
        Public ReadOnly Property Name As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Role As MultivariatePlotDataRole
        Public ReadOnly Property OrdinalKind As MultivariateOrdinalKind37

            Get
                Return Clone(_x)

        ''' <summary>Actual Core model RowIds where supplied. These are separately identified;
        ''' this payload makes no claim that a model ID is a physical worksheet row.</summary>

            Get

            Get

            Get
                Return Clone(_labels)

            Get
                Return Clone(_ordinals)
            End Get

        ''' <summary>Reuse the accepted semantic axis contract. Model positions remain
        ''' model result indices with unavailable input/physical mapping. Leaf input
        ''' ordinals are known; physical worksheet rows are never synthesized.</summary>
        Public ReadOnly Property SourceAxis As MultivariateAxisMap
            Get
                If _ordinals Is Nothing OrElse OrdinalKind = MultivariateOrdinalKind37.ClusterSlotZeroBased Then Return Nothing
                Dim leaf As Boolean = OrdinalKind = MultivariateOrdinalKind37.InputOrdinalOneBased
                Dim kind = If(leaf, MultivariateSemanticAxis.Observations, _axisKind)
                Dim items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)
                For i As Integer = 0 To _ordinals.Length - 1
                    items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(If(leaf, i, _ordinals(i)), Nothing,
                        sourcePosition:=If(leaf, CType(_ordinals(i) - 1, Integer?), Nothing),
                        displayLabel:=If(_labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < _labels.Length, _labels(i), Nothing),
                        state:=If(leaf, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
                Next
                Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class

        Public Shared Function PercentLabel(value As Double) As String
            'VB Format$ suppresses the sign of zero, including on modern runtimes whose
            'Double custom formatting otherwise retains it. Numerical vectors keep their bits.
            If value = 0.0 Then value = 0.0
            Return value.ToString("#0.0#", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ComponentCaption(percent As Double, component As Integer, scoreCapitalization As Boolean) As String
            Dim prefix As String = If(component = 0, If(scoreCapitalization, "1St", "1st"), If(component = 1, "2nd", If(scoreCapitalization, "3Rd", "3rd")))
            Return prefix & " Component Scores [" & PercentLabel(percent) & "%]"

            If c = 0.0 Then Return "GH, or column-metric preserving"
            If c = 1.0 Then Return "JK, or row-metric preserving"
            If c = 0.5 Then Return "SQ, or symmetric"
            Return String.Empty
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ScoreLabels(model As PCA, rowLabels As String()) As String()
            Dim n As Integer = model.ObservationCount
            Dim rowIds() As Integer = model.RowIds
            Dim result(n - 1) As String
            If rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length <> n Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("PCA row-label count must match the number of observations.", NameOf(rowLabels))
            End If
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim text As String = String.Empty
                If rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels(i) IsNot Nothing Then text = rowLabels(i).Trim()
                If text = String.Empty Then text = rowIds(i).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
                result(i) = text
            Next
            Return result
        End Function
        Public Shared Function NormalizeGroups(groupLabels As String(), expectedCount As Integer) As String()
            If groupLabels Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            If groupLabels.Length <> expectedCount Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("PCA grouping-label count must match the number of observations.", NameOf(groupLabels))
            End If
            Dim result(expectedCount - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                Dim text As String = If(groupLabels(i), String.Empty).Trim()
                If text = String.Empty Then text = "(missing)"
                result(i) = text
            Next
            Return result
        End Function
        Public Shared Function ScoreSeries(x As Double(), y As Double(), labels As String(), groups As String(),
                                           Optional ungroupedName As String = "Score plot", Optional modelRowIds As Integer() = Nothing) As IReadOnlyList(Of MultivariatePointSeries37)
            Dim result As New List(Of MultivariatePointSeries37)
            If groups Is Nothing Then
                Dim ordinals = Enumerable.Range(0, x.Length).ToArray()
                result.Add(New MultivariatePointSeries37(ungroupedName, x, y, labels, ordinals, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores,
                    modelRowIds:=ModelIds(modelRowIds, ordinals)))
                Return result.AsReadOnly()
            End If
            Dim names As New List(Of String), seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each name As String In groups
                If seen.Add(name) Then names.Add(name)
            Next
            For Each name As String In names
                Dim xs As New List(Of Double), ys As New List(Of Double), texts As New List(Of String), ordinals As New List(Of Integer)
                For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                    'Original /optioncompare:text membership, with ordinal distinct-name discovery.
                    If CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.CompareInfo.Compare(groups(i), name,
                        CompareOptions.IgnoreCase Or CompareOptions.IgnoreKanaType Or CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth) = 0 Then
                        xs.Add(x(i)) : ys.Add(y(i)) : texts.Add(labels(i)) : ordinals.Add(i)
                    End If
                Next
                result.Add(New MultivariatePointSeries37(name, xs.ToArray(), ys.ToArray(), texts.ToArray(), ordinals.ToArray(), MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores,
                    modelRowIds:=ModelIds(modelRowIds, ordinals.ToArray())))
            Next
            Return result.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
        Private Shared Function ModelIds(ids As Integer(), ordinals As Integer()) As Integer?()
            If ids Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Return ordinals.Select(Function(i) If(i >= 0 AndAlso i < ids.Length, CType(ids(i), Integer?), Nothing)).ToArray()
        End Function

            Return model.PlotLabels(row, String.Concat(Convert.ToChar(13), Convert.ToChar(10)))

            Return model.PlotLabels(row, Nothing)(ordinal)

        Public Shared Function CorrespondenceSeries(model As CA, row As Boolean) As MultivariatePointSeries37
            Dim x = If(row, model.RowFactors(0), model.ColFactors(0))
            Dim y = If(row, model.RowFactors(1), model.ColFactors(1))
            Return New MultivariatePointSeries37(If(row, "Rows", "Columns"), x, y, Nothing,
                Enumerable.Range(0, x.Length).ToArray(), MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreCorrespondence,
                axisKind:=If(model.IsMultiple, MultivariateSemanticAxis.Categories, If(row, MultivariateSemanticAxis.ContingencyRows, MultivariateSemanticAxis.ContingencyColumns)))

                    If xs(i).Length = 0 OrElse ys(i).Length = 0 Then Continue For

        Public Shared Function ScoreSeries(x As Double(), y As Double(), labels As String(), groups As String(),
                                           Optional ungroupedName As String = "Score plot", Optional modelRowIds As Integer() = Nothing) As IReadOnlyList(Of MultivariatePointSeries37)
            Dim result As New List(Of MultivariatePointSeries37)
            If groups Is Nothing Then
                Dim ordinals = Enumerable.Range(0, x.Length).ToArray()
                result.Add(New MultivariatePointSeries37(ungroupedName, x, y, labels, ordinals, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores,
                    modelRowIds:=ModelIds(modelRowIds, ordinals)))
                Return result.AsReadOnly()
            End If
            Dim names As New List(Of String), seen As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            For Each name As String In groups
                If seen.Add(name) Then names.Add(name)
            Next
            For Each name As String In names
                Dim xs As New List(Of Double), ys As New List(Of Double), texts As New List(Of String), ordinals As New List(Of Integer)
                For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                    'Original /optioncompare:text membership, with ordinal distinct-name discovery.
                    If CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.CompareInfo.Compare(groups(i), name,
                        CompareOptions.IgnoreCase Or CompareOptions.IgnoreKanaType Or CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth) = 0 Then
                        xs.Add(x(i)) : ys.Add(y(i)) : texts.Add(labels(i)) : ordinals.Add(i)
                    End If
                Next
                result.Add(New MultivariatePointSeries37(name, xs.ToArray(), ys.ToArray(), texts.ToArray(), ordinals.ToArray(), MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores,
                    modelRowIds:=ModelIds(modelRowIds, ordinals.ToArray())))
            Next

    ''' <summary>Post-fit metadata only; no mutable Core model/arrays or raw N x P matrix
    ''' is retained. Membership and merge/leaf order are copied from actual Core outcomes.
    ''' This never changes legacy OriginalRow cells to physical source RowIds.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class MultivariateClusteringProjection
        Friend Sub New(input As MultivariateInputIntent, report As MultivariateReport,
                       active() As Integer, activeLabels() As String, removed() As Integer, removedLabels() As String,
                       membership() As Integer, leafOrder() As Integer, variables() As String,
                       centers As MultivariateArrayShape, merges As IEnumerable(Of MultivariateClusterMerge),
                       Optional seed As Integer? = Nothing, Optional starts As Integer? = Nothing,
                       Optional converged As Boolean? = Nothing, Optional iterations As Integer? = Nothing,
                       Optional requestedClusters As Integer? = Nothing, Optional workingCenters As MultivariateArrayShape = Nothing)
            Me.Input = input : Me.Report = report : Me.CenterShape = centers
            Me.EffectiveSeed = seed : Me.StartsEvaluated = starts : Me.Converged = converged : Me.Iterations = iterations
            Me.RequestedClusterCount = requestedClusters : Me.WorkingCenterShape = workingCenters
            Me.Centers = If(centers Is Nothing, New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem),
                Enumerable.Range(0, centers.Rows).Select(Function(i) New MultivariateAxisItem(i, "Cluster " & (i + 1).ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture))).ToList()).AsReadOnly()
            Me.Merges = New List(Of MultivariateClusterMerge)(merges).AsReadOnly()
            Me.Sections = report.Document.Tables.Select(Function(t) New MultivariateClusterSection(t)).ToList().AsReadOnly()
            Dim columns = input.Columns
            Me.Variables = variables.Select(Function(name, j) New MultivariateAxisItem(j, name,
                sourcePosition:=j, sourceKey:=If(j < columns.Count, columns(j).SourceKey, Nothing))).ToList().AsReadOnly()
            Dim rows = input.SourceRowIds, labels = input.RowLabels
            Dim activePositions As New Dictionary(Of Integer, Integer), removedPositions As New Dictionary(Of Integer, Integer), leafPositions As New Dictionary(Of Integer, Integer)
            For j = 0 To active.Length - 1 : activePositions(active(j)) = j : Next
            For j = 0 To removed.Length - 1 : removedPositions(removed(j)) = j : Next
            If leafOrder IsNot Nothing Then
                For j = 0 To leafOrder.Length - 1 : leafPositions(leafOrder(j)) = j : Next
            End If
            Dim observations As New List(Of MultivariateClusterObservation)
            For i = 1 To input.RowCount
                Dim a = If(activePositions.ContainsKey(i), activePositions(i), -1), r = If(removedPositions.ContainsKey(i), removedPositions(i), -1)
                Dim display = If(a >= 0, activeLabels(a), If(r >= 0, removedLabels(r), Nothing))
                Dim position = If(leafPositions.ContainsKey(i), leafPositions(i), -1)
                observations.Add(New MultivariateClusterObservation(i,
                    If(rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i <= rows.Length, CType(rows(i - 1), Integer?), Nothing),
                    If(a >= 0, CType(a + 1, Integer?), Nothing), If(r >= 0, CType(r + 1, Integer?), Nothing),
                    If(labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso i <= labels.Length, labels(i - 1), Nothing), display,
                    If(a >= 0 AndAlso a < membership.Length, CType(membership(a), Integer?), Nothing),
                    If(leafOrder IsNot Nothing AndAlso a >= 0, CType(a + 1, Integer?), Nothing),
                    If(position >= 0, CType(position + 1, Integer?), Nothing)))
            Next
            Me.Observations = observations.AsReadOnly()
            Dim diagnostics As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            If observations.Any(Function(o) o.SourceRowId.HasValue AndAlso o.SourceRowId.Value <> o.InputOrdinal) Then
                diagnostics.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("C19-CLUSTER-ROWID-DISPLAY-01", "rows", "Data OriginalRow uses source RowIds; legacy result OriginalRow uses Core input ordinals. No output correction is activated.", blocking:=False))
            End If
            If activeLabels.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() <> activeLabels.Length Then
                diagnostics.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("clustering.labels.duplicate", "labels", "Duplicate display labels are preserved as labels, never identities.", blocking:=False))
            End If
            Validation = New RegressionValidation(diagnostics.Take(32), 0, 0, {})
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function KMeans(request As MultivariateKMeansRequest, result As KMeansClusterResult,
                                      tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable)) As MultivariateClusteringProjection
            Return New MultivariateClusteringProjection(request.Input, MultivariateReportPolicy.Project(request.Input, tables),
                result.ActiveRowIndices, result.ActiveRowLabels, result.RemovedRowIndices, result.RemovedRowLabels,
                result.ClusterAssignments, Nothing, result.VariableNames, MultivariateArrayShape.Matrix(result.CentersOriginalScale),
                Array.Empty(Of MultivariateClusterMerge)(), result.RandomSeedUsed, result.StartsEvaluated, result.Converged, result.Iterations,
                request.Options.Clusters, MultivariateArrayShape.Matrix(result.CentersWorkingScale))
        End Function
        Public Shared Function Hierarchical(request As MultivariateHierarchicalRequest, cut As MultivariateClusterCutRequest,
                                            result As HierarchicalClusterResult, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable)) As MultivariateClusteringProjection
            Dim merges As New List(Of MultivariateClusterMerge)
            For j = 0 To result.MergeHeights.Length - 1
                merges.Add(New MultivariateClusterMerge(j + 1, result.ActiveRowIndices.Length + j + 1,
                    result.MergeLeftClusterIds(j), result.MergeRightClusterIds(j), result.MergeClusterSizes(j), result.MergeHeights(j)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateClusteringProjection(request.Input, MultivariateReportPolicy.Project(request.Input, tables),
                result.ActiveRowIndices, result.ActiveRowLabels, result.RemovedRowIndices, result.RemovedRowLabels,
                cut.Membership(result), result.LeafOrder, result.VariableNames, Nothing, merges)
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), code As String, message As String)

        Private Shared Function Observations(input As MultivariateInputIntent, count As Integer, kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis) As MultivariateAxisMap
            Dim rows = input.SourceRowIds, labels = input.RowLabels, items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)
            For i = 0 To Math.Max(0, count) - 1
                Dim position As Nullable(Of Integer) = If(i < input.RowCount, CType(i, Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing)
                Dim sourceId As Nullable(Of Integer) = If(position.HasValue AndAlso rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing)
                Dim label = If(labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < labels.Length, labels(i), Nothing)
                items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(i, Nothing, position, sourceId, displayLabel:=label,
                    state:=If(position.HasValue, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Variables(input As MultivariateInputIntent, count As Integer, kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis) As MultivariateAxisMap
            Dim columns = input.Columns, items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)
            For j = 0 To Math.Max(0, count) - 1
                Dim known = j < columns.Count
                items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(j, If(known, columns(j).Name, Nothing),
                    If(known, CType(j, Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing), sourceKey:=If(known, columns(j).SourceKey, Nothing),
                    state:=If(known, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function NamedAxis(kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis, count As Integer, names() As String,

            Dim items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)

                Dim known = names IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < names.Length
                items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(j, If(known, names(j), Nothing),
                    displayLabel:=If(display IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < display.Length, display(j), Nothing),
                    state:=If(known, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
        End Function

                NamedAxis(MultivariateSemanticAxis.RetainedComponents, scores.Columns, pcNames, reducedNames)}
            Dim eigenCount = If(model.Eigenvalues Is Nothing, 0, model.Eigenvalues.Length)
            Dim eigenIndices = If(eigenCount = 0, Array.Empty(Of Integer)(), model.XaxisComponents)
            axes.Add(NamedAxis(MultivariateSemanticAxis.EigenComponents, eigenCount, eigenIndices.Select(Function(i) i.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)).ToArray()))
            If raw.Rows <> standardized.Rows OrElse raw.Columns <> standardized.Columns Then Issue(issues, "multivariate.pca.standardized.shape", "Raw and Core standardized axes differ or are unavailable.")

            Body(sections, MultivariateSectionRole.ReducedScores, 2, first + 2 * p, scores, MultivariateSemanticAxis.ScoreObservations, MultivariateSemanticAxis.RetainedComponents)

        Private Sub New()

        Private Shared Sub Issue(issues As List(Of RegressionDiagnostic), code As String, message As String)
            If issues.Count < 32 Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic(code, "projection", message, blocking:=False))
        End Sub
        Private Shared Function Observations(input As MultivariateInputIntent, count As Integer, kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis) As MultivariateAxisMap
            Dim rows = input.SourceRowIds, labels = input.RowLabels, items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)
            For i = 0 To Math.Max(0, count) - 1
                Dim position As Nullable(Of Integer) = If(i < input.RowCount, CType(i, Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing)
                Dim sourceId As Nullable(Of Integer) = If(position.HasValue AndAlso rows IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rows.Length, CType(rows(i), Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing)
                Dim label = If(labels IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < labels.Length, labels(i), Nothing)
                items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(i, Nothing, position, sourceId, displayLabel:=label,
                    state:=If(position.HasValue, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function Variables(input As MultivariateInputIntent, count As Integer, kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis) As MultivariateAxisMap
            Dim columns = input.Columns, items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)
            For j = 0 To Math.Max(0, count) - 1
                Dim known = j < columns.Count
                items.Add(New MultivariateAxisItem(j, If(known, columns(j).Name, Nothing),
                    If(known, CType(j, Nullable(Of Integer)), Nothing), sourceKey:=If(known, columns(j).SourceKey, Nothing),
                    state:=If(known, MultivariateMappingState.Known, MultivariateMappingState.Unavailable)))
            Next
            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)
        End Function
        Private Shared Function NamedAxis(kind As MultivariateSemanticAxis, count As Integer, names() As String,
                                          Optional display() As String = Nothing) As MultivariateAxisMap
            Dim items As New List(Of MultivariateAxisItem)

                    displayLabel:=If(display IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < display.Length, display(j), Nothing),

            Return New MultivariateAxisMap(kind, items)

    Public NotInheritable Class MultivariateReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()

        Public Shared Function Project(input As MultivariateInputIntent, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), Optional dendrogram As Boolean = False) As MultivariateReport
            If input Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(input))
            If tables Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(tables))
            Return New MultivariateReport(input, tables, dendrogram)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function PlotPlan(kind As MultivariateAnalysisKind, Optional dendrogram As Boolean = False) As IReadOnlyList(Of MultivariatePlotIntent)
            Dim plots As New List(Of MultivariatePlotIntent)
            Select Case kind
                Case MultivariateAnalysisKind.PCA
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Scree, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreEigenvalues))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Scores2D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Loadings2D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreLoadings))
                    For Each scaling In {0.0, 0.5, 1.0}
                        plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Biplot, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreBiplot, scaling))
                    Next
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Scores3D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreScores))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Loadings3D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreLoadings))
                Case MultivariateAnalysisKind.MCA
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Correspondence, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreCorrespondence))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Contribution, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreContributions, axis:=0))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Contribution, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreContributions, axis:=1))
                Case MultivariateAnalysisKind.CA
                    For Each row In {True, False}
                        For axis = 0 To 1
                            plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Contribution, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreContributions, axis:=axis, rowContribution:=row))
                        Next
                    Next
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Correspondence, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreCorrespondence))
                Case MultivariateAnalysisKind.Factor
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Scree, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreEigenvalues))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Loadings2D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreLoadings))
                    plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Loadings3D, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreLoadings))
                Case MultivariateAnalysisKind.Hierarchical
                    If dendrogram Then plots.Add(New MultivariatePlotIntent(MultivariatePlotKind.Dendrogram, MultivariatePlotDataRole.CoreDendrogram))
                ' K-means and DA have report/membership/classification output, no GUI charts.
            End Select
            Return plots.AsReadOnly()
        End Function
