    Public NotInheritable Class ProportionsReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Analyze(request As ProportionsRequest) As ContingencyReportResult
            Dim tables As New List(Of ContingencySemanticTable), issues As New List(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue), metrics As New List(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)
            If request Is Nothing Then
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.input", "Validated proportions request is required.", "input"))
                Return New ContingencyReportResult(tables, issues)
            End If
            Dim n1 = request.Total1, r1 = request.Responders1, n2 = request.Total2, r2 = request.Responders2, alpha = request.Alpha
            Dim ciLabel = $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alpha):0.##}% CI"
            Try
                If request.Mode = ProportionsMode.SingleSample Then
                    Dim value = contingencytable.SingleProportion(r1, n1, alpha)
                    Dim p = Math.Min(1.0, distributions.BinomDist(Math.Min(r1, n1 - r1), n1, 0.5, True) * 2.0)
                    tables.Add(T("Single proportion", {{"Total Number of Subjects", n1}, {"Number of Responders", r1}, {"Proportion", value.Estimate},
                        {ciLabel, value.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)}, {"two-sided P-value", p}}, 5))
                    CI(metrics, "single", value)
                ElseIf request.Mode = ProportionsMode.Independent Then
                    Select Case request.Hypothesis
                        Case IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Noninferiority
                            Dim ni = equivalencetests.TestIndependentProportionsNonInferiority(r1, n1, r2, n2, request.Margin, alpha)
                            tables.Add(T("Two independent proportions - Noninferiority", {
                                {"Control / Reference sample size", ni.NumberOfControls}, {"Control / Reference responders", ni.ControlResponders}, {"Control / Reference proportion", ni.ControlProportion},
                                {"Experimental / Test sample size", ni.NumberOfExperimental}, {"Experimental / Test responders", ni.ExperimentalResponders}, {"Experimental / Test proportion", ni.ExperimentalProportion},
                                {"Difference (Experimental - Control)", ni.DifferenceExperimentalMinusControl}, {"Noninferiority margin", ni.NonInferiorityMargin}, {"Noninferiority limit", ni.NonInferiorityLimit},
                                {$"{100.0 * (1.0 - 2.0 * alpha):0.##}% CI for proportion difference", ni.TwoSidedEquivalentConfidenceInterval.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)},
                                {"Lower one-sided confidence limit", ni.LowerOneSidedConfidenceLimit}, {"Z statistic", ni.ZStatistic}, {"One-sided P-value", ni.PValue}, {"Conclusion", ni.Conclusion}}, 13))
                            CI(metrics, "noninferiority", ni.TwoSidedEquivalentConfidenceInterval)
                            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact("noninferiority.lower-one-sided", ni.LowerOneSidedConfidenceLimit, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
                        Case IndependentProportionsHypothesis.Equivalence
                            Dim eq = equivalencetests.TestIndependentProportionsEquivalence(r1, n1, r2, n2, -request.Margin, request.Margin, alpha)
                            tables.Add(T("Two independent proportions - Equivalence", {
                                {"Control / Reference sample size", eq.NumberOfControls}, {"Control / Reference responders", eq.ControlResponders}, {"Control / Reference proportion", eq.ControlProportion},
                                {"Experimental / Test sample size", eq.NumberOfExperimental}, {"Experimental / Test responders", eq.ExperimentalResponders}, {"Experimental / Test proportion", eq.ExperimentalProportion},
                                {"Difference (Experimental - Control)", eq.DifferenceExperimentalMinusControl}, {"Lower equivalence margin", eq.LowerMargin}, {"Upper equivalence margin", eq.UpperMargin},
                                {$"{100.0 * (1.0 - 2.0 * alpha):0.##}% CI for proportion difference", eq.EquivalentConfidenceInterval.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)},
                                {"Lower TOST Z statistic", eq.LowerComponentStatistic}, {"Lower TOST one-sided P-value", eq.LowerComponentPValue},
                                {"Upper TOST Z statistic", eq.UpperComponentStatistic}, {"Upper TOST one-sided P-value", eq.UpperComponentPValue}, {"TOST P-value", eq.TostPValue}, {"Conclusion", eq.Conclusion}}, 12, 14, 15))
                            CI(metrics, "equivalence", eq.EquivalentConfidenceInterval)
                        Case Else
                            Dim value = contingencytable.TwoIndependentProportions(r1, n1, r2, n2, alpha)
                            Dim tab = request.IndependentFisherTable()
                            Dim fisher = contingencytable.FisherExact2x2(tab(0, 0), tab(0, 1), tab(1, 0), tab(1, 1))
                            tables.Add(T("Two independent proportions", {{"Total Number of Subjects in Sample 1", n1}, {"Number of Responders in Sample 1", r1}, {"Proportion in Sample 1", r1 / n1},
                                {"Total Number of Subjects in Sample 2", n2}, {"Number of Responders in Sample 2", r2}, {"Proportion in Sample 2", r2 / n2},
                                {"Proportions Difference", value.Estimate}, {ciLabel, value.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)}, {"Exact two-sided P-value", fisher.Pvalue}, {"Exact Mid two-sided P-value", fisher.Pvalue2}}, 9, 10))
                            CI(metrics, "independent", value)
                    End Select
                ElseIf request.Mode = ProportionsMode.Paired Then
                    Dim interval = contingencytable.PairedProportions(n1, r1, r2, request.Both, alpha)
                    Dim exact = contingencytable.Liddell_McNemar(request.CoreLiddellTable(), alpha)
                    Return ProjectPaired(request, interval, exact.Item1)
                End If
            Catch ex As ArgumentException
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.core", ex.Message, "analysis"))
            Catch ex As ArithmeticException
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.core", ex.Message, "analysis"))
            Catch ex As InvalidOperationException
                issues.Add(ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.core", ex.Message, "analysis"))
            End Try
            Return New ContingencyReportResult(tables, issues, metrics)
        End Function

        ''' <summary>Owner-approved total responders/proportions; nine rows and p-value position retained.</summary>
        Public Shared Function ProjectPaired(request As ProportionsRequest, interval As ConfidenceIntervalResult, test As TestResult) As ContingencyReportResult
            If request Is Nothing OrElse request.Mode <> ProportionsMode.Paired OrElse interval Is Nothing OrElse test Is Nothing Then
                Return New ContingencyReportResult(Array.Empty(Of ContingencySemanticTable)(), {ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-evidence", "Paired request, Core interval and Core test evidence are required.", "analysis.paired")})
            End If
            If Not Finite(interval.Estimate) OrElse Not Finite(interval.LowerLimit) OrElse Not Finite(interval.UpperLimit) OrElse
                interval.LowerLimit > interval.UpperLimit OrElse Not Finite(test.Pvalue) OrElse test.Pvalue < 0 OrElse test.Pvalue > 1 Then
                Return New ContingencyReportResult(Array.Empty(Of ContingencySemanticTable)(), {ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-nonfinite", "Paired inference did not produce a finite ordered proportion interval and a valid exact p-value.", "analysis.paired")})
            End If
            Dim n = request.Total1, a = request.Responders1, b = request.Responders2, both = request.Both
            Dim table = T("Two paired proportions", {{"Total Number of Subjects", n}, {"Total Responders in the 1st Category", a + both},
                {"Proportion in the 1st Category", (a + both) / n}, {"Total Responders in the 2nd Category", b + both},
                {"Proportion in the 2nd Category", (b + both) / n}, {"Number of Responders in Both Categories", both},
                {"Proportions Difference", interval.Estimate}, {$"{100.0 * (1.0 - request.Alpha):0.##}% CI", interval.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)},
                {"Two-sided P-value", test.Pvalue}}, 9)
            Dim metrics As New List(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)
            CI(metrics, "paired", interval)
            Return New ContingencyReportResult({table}, Array.Empty(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)(), metrics)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function T(title As String, body As Object(,), ParamArray rows As Integer()) As ContingencySemanticTable
            Return New ContingencySemanticTable({title, ""}, body, rows)
        End Function
        Private Shared Sub CI(metrics As List(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact), name As String, value As ConfidenceIntervalResult)
            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".estimate", value.Estimate, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".lower", value.LowerLimit, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".upper", value.UpperLimit, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
        End Sub
    End Class
End Namespace

Public Shared Function ProjectPaired(request As ProportionsRequest, interval As ConfidenceIntervalResult, test As TestResult) As ContingencyReportResult
            If request Is Nothing OrElse request.Mode <> ProportionsMode.Paired OrElse interval Is Nothing OrElse test Is Nothing Then
                Return New ContingencyReportResult(Array.Empty(Of ContingencySemanticTable)(), {ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-evidence", "Paired request, Core interval and Core test evidence are required.", "analysis.paired")})
            End If
            If Not Finite(interval.Estimate) OrElse Not Finite(interval.LowerLimit) OrElse Not Finite(interval.UpperLimit) OrElse
                interval.LowerLimit > interval.UpperLimit OrElse Not Finite(test.Pvalue) OrElse test.Pvalue < 0 OrElse test.Pvalue > 1 Then
                Return New ContingencyReportResult(Array.Empty(Of ContingencySemanticTable)(), {ContingencyInputPolicy.ErrorIssue("proportions.paired-nonfinite", "Paired inference did not produce a finite ordered proportion interval and a valid exact p-value.", "analysis.paired")})
            End If
            Dim n = request.Total1, a = request.Responders1, b = request.Responders2, both = request.Both
            Dim table = T("Two paired proportions", {{"Total Number of Subjects", n}, {"Total Responders in the 1st Category", a + both},
                {"Proportion in the 1st Category", (a + both) / n}, {"Total Responders in the 2nd Category", b + both},
                {"Proportion in the 2nd Category", (b + both) / n}, {"Number of Responders in Both Categories", both},
                {"Proportions Difference", interval.Estimate}, {$"{100.0 * (1.0 - request.Alpha):0.##}% CI", interval.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)},
                {"Two-sided P-value", test.Pvalue}}, 9)
            Dim metrics As New List(Of AnalysisMetricArtifact)
            CI(metrics, "paired", interval)
            Return New ContingencyReportResult({table}, Array.Empty(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)(), metrics)
        End Function

Private Shared Function Finite(value As Double) As Boolean
            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)
        End Function

    ''' <summary>Composition only: Core owns every number and section. Document success describes
    ''' composition, not optimizer convergence. No inferred success from missing metadata.</summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class RegressionReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Compose(request As RegressionRequest, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable),
                                       rows As RegressionRowOutput, Optional converged As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing) As RegressionReportPlan
            If request Is Nothing OrElse request.Primary Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(request))
            If tables Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(tables))
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse request.Primary.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not rows.RowIds.SequenceEqual(request.Primary.RowIds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.rowIds: Fitted order differs from source identity order.")
            Dim models As New List(Of ResultTableOutputModel)
            For Each table In tables
                If table Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.table: Null result section.")
                Dim model = New OutputTableArtifact("table-" & models.Count.ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), table.ToOutputModel())
                models.Add(model.Model)
            Next
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            Dim state = RegressionConvergence.Unknown
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel Then
                state = RegressionConvergence.NotIterative
            Else
                ' Ordinal/multinomial expose convergence only in their existing diagnostic table.
                ' Read its exact Core label; do not derive convergence from the existence of results.
                If Not converged.HasValue Then
                    For Each m In models
                        For r = 0 To m.RowCount - 1
                            For c = 0 To m.ColumnCount - 2
                                If TypeOf m.Values(r, c) Is String AndAlso CStr(m.Values(r, c)) = "Converged?" Then
                                    Dim flag As Boolean
                                    If Boolean.TryParse(Convert.ToString(m.Values(r, c + 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), flag) Then converged = flag
                                End If
                            Next
                        Next
                    Next
                End If
                If converged.HasValue Then state = If(converged.Value, RegressionConvergence.Converged, RegressionConvergence.NotConverged)
                issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic(If(state = RegressionConvergence.Converged, "regression.fit.converged", If(state = RegressionConvergence.NotConverged, "regression.fit.not-converged", "regression.fit.convergence-unknown")),
                    "fit.convergence", If(state = RegressionConvergence.Converged, "Core reported convergence.", If(state = RegressionConvergence.NotConverged, "Core did not converge; results may be misleading.", "Core convergence metadata was not supplied.")), blocking:=False))
            End If
            If models.Count = 0 Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.output.no-tables", "output.tables", "No result tables were supplied.", blocking:=False))
            If request.Options.Residuals AndAlso rows.Residuals Is Nothing Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.output.no-residuals", "output.residuals", "Residual output was requested but Core supplied none.", blocking:=False))
            Dim warnings = issues.Where(Function(d) d.Code <> "regression.fit.converged").Select(Function(d) New AnalysisWarning(d.Code, d.Message, d.FieldPath))
            Dim document As New AnalysisResultDocument("regression." & request.Kind.ToString(), models, Array.Empty(Of KeyValuePair(Of String, Double))(), Nothing, warnings)
            Return New RegressionReportPlan(request, document, rows, state, issues)
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class RegressionReportPolicy
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub
        Public Shared Function Compose(request As RegressionRequest, tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable),
                                       rows As RegressionRowOutput, Optional converged As Nullable(Of Boolean) = Nothing) As RegressionReportPlan
            If request Is Nothing OrElse request.Primary Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(request))
            If tables Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(tables))
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse request.Primary.RowIds Is Nothing OrElse Not rows.RowIds.SequenceEqual(request.Primary.RowIds) Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.rowIds: Fitted order differs from source identity order.")
            Dim models As New List(Of ResultTableOutputModel)
            For Each table In tables
                If table Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("regression.output.table: Null result section.")
                Dim model = New OutputTableArtifact("table-" & models.Count.ToString(Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), table.ToOutputModel())
                models.Add(model.Model)
            Next
            Dim issues As New List(Of RegressionDiagnostic)
            Dim state = RegressionConvergence.Unknown
            If request.Kind = RegressionAnalysisKind.LinearModel Then
                state = RegressionConvergence.NotIterative
            Else
                ' Ordinal/multinomial expose convergence only in their existing diagnostic table.
                ' Read its exact Core label; do not derive convergence from the existence of results.
                If Not converged.HasValue Then
                    For Each m In models
                        For r = 0 To m.RowCount - 1
                            For c = 0 To m.ColumnCount - 2
                                If TypeOf m.Values(r, c) Is String AndAlso CStr(m.Values(r, c)) = "Converged?" Then
                                    Dim flag As Boolean
                                    If Boolean.TryParse(Convert.ToString(m.Values(r, c + 1), Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), flag) Then converged = flag
                                End If
                            Next
                        Next
                    Next
                End If
                If converged.HasValue Then state = If(converged.Value, RegressionConvergence.Converged, RegressionConvergence.NotConverged)
                issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic(If(state = RegressionConvergence.Converged, "regression.fit.converged", If(state = RegressionConvergence.NotConverged, "regression.fit.not-converged", "regression.fit.convergence-unknown")),
                    "fit.convergence", If(state = RegressionConvergence.Converged, "Core reported convergence.", If(state = RegressionConvergence.NotConverged, "Core did not converge; results may be misleading.", "Core convergence metadata was not supplied.")), blocking:=False))
            End If
            If models.Count = 0 Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.output.no-tables", "output.tables", "No result tables were supplied.", blocking:=False))
            If request.Options.Residuals AndAlso rows.Residuals Is Nothing Then issues.Add(New RegressionDiagnostic("regression.output.no-residuals", "output.residuals", "Residual output was requested but Core supplied none.", blocking:=False))
            Dim warnings = issues.Where(Function(d) d.Code <> "regression.fit.converged").Select(Function(d) New AnalysisWarning(d.Code, d.Message, d.FieldPath))
            Dim document As New AnalysisResultDocument("regression." & request.Kind.ToString(), models, Array.Empty(Of KeyValuePair(Of String, Double))(), Nothing, warnings)
            Return New RegressionReportPlan(request, document, rows, state, issues)
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Shared Function BuildCoxSummaryTable(hdr As Boolean, p As Integer, varNames As String(), result As CoxResult, robust As Boolean, zCrit As Double, ciPct As String, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
            Dim rows As Integer = If(hdr, p + 1, p)
            Dim out(rows - 1, 7) As Object

            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Variable"
                out(0, 1) = "Coef"
                out(0, 2) = "SE"
                out(0, 3) = "Z"
                out(0, 4) = "P-value"
                out(0, 5) = "HR"
                out(0, 6) = "HR " & ciPct & " LCL"
                out(0, 7) = "HR " & ciPct & " UCL"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim beta As Double = result.Coefficients(i)
                Dim se As Double
                If robust AndAlso result.VarCovRobust IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.VarCovRobust.GetLength(0) = p Then
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCovRobust(i, i))
                Else
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCov(i, i))
                End If

                Dim z As Double = beta / se
                Dim pv As Double = 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z))
                Dim hr As Object = expForDisplay(beta)
                Dim lcl As Object = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                Dim ucl As Object = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = varNames(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = beta
                out(r0 + i, 2) = se
                out(r0 + i, 3) = z
                out(r0 + i, 4) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 5) = hr
                out(r0 + i, 6) = lcl
                out(r0 + i, 7) = ucl
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, beta.Length + 1, beta.Length)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
            Dim ciLabel As String = (100.0R * (1.0R - alphaValue)).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "%"
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

                out(0, 7) = ciLabel & " CI Upper"
                r0 = 1

            For i As Integer = 0 To beta.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, beta(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = beta(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 6) = beta(i) - zCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = beta(i) + zCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildFactorEigen(model As Multivariate.FactorAnalysis, ByRef includeHeader As Object, matrixTrace As Func(Of Double(,), Double), readHeader As Func(Of Object, Boolean, Boolean)) As Object(,)
            Dim initialEigen() As Double = model.InitialEigenvalues
            Dim unrotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.UnrotatedLoadings, model.UnrotatedLoadings)
            Dim rotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.PatternMatrix, model.StructureMatrix)
            Dim totalVar As Double = matrixTrace(model.WorkingMatrix)
            Dim initPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(initialEigen, totalVar)
            Dim initCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(initPct)
            Dim extrPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(unrotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim extrCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(extrPct)
            Dim rotPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(rotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim rotCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(rotPct)

            Dim rows As Integer = Math.Max(initialEigen.Length, model.NumberOfFactors)
            Dim hdr As Boolean = readHeader(includeHeader, True)
            Dim out(rows - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 9) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Factor"
                out(0, 1) = "Initial Eigenvalue"
                out(0, 2) = "Initial %"
                out(0, 3) = "Initial Cumulative %"
                out(0, 4) = "Extraction SS Loadings"
                out(0, 5) = "Extraction %"
                out(0, 6) = "Extraction Cumulative %"
                out(0, 7) = "Rotation SS Loadings"
                out(0, 8) = "Rotation %"
                out(0, 9) = "Rotation Cumulative %"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = i + 1
                If i < initialEigen.Length Then
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = initialEigen(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = initPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = initCum(i)
                End If
                If i < model.NumberOfFactors Then
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = unrotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = extrPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 6) = extrCum(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 7) = rotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 8) = rotPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 9) = rotCum(i)
                End If
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

            Dim initialEigen() As Double = model.InitialEigenvalues
            Dim unrotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.UnrotatedLoadings, model.UnrotatedLoadings)
            Dim rotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.PatternMatrix, model.StructureMatrix)
            Dim totalVar As Double = matrixTrace(model.WorkingMatrix)
            Dim initPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(initialEigen, totalVar)
            Dim initCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(initPct)
            Dim extrPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(unrotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim extrCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(extrPct)
            Dim rotPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(rotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim rotCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(rotPct)

            Dim rows As Integer = Math.Max(initialEigen.Length, model.NumberOfFactors)
            Dim hdr As Boolean = readHeader(includeHeader, True)

                out(0, 9) = "Rotation Cumulative %"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = i + 1
                If i < initialEigen.Length Then
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = initialEigen(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = initPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = initCum(i)

                    out(r0 + i, 6) = extrCum(i)

    ''' <summary>
    ''' A zero-based reference to a host-owned scalar, never a worksheet row or
    ''' an Excel object. Native cell identity remains at the Windows boundary.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfSourceCellReference38
        Public Sub New(sourceOrdinal As Integer)
            Me.SourceOrdinal = sourceOrdinal
        End Sub
        Public ReadOnly Property SourceOrdinal As Integer
    End Class

    ''' <summary>
    ''' Detached legacy report data using the accepted Core output model. Values
    ''' are report cells, with exact CLR scalar kinds and IEEE payloads retained.
    ''' Excel errors are represented by existing typed OutputCell error intent.
    ''' A fresh deep array copy is returned on every access. No native cell value
    ''' or model cache is retained; source references are ordinal intent only.
    ''' </summary>
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfReportProjection38
        Private ReadOnly _model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel

        Public Sub New(model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel,
                       Optional preparation As UdfReportPreparation38 = UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            If model Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(model))
            _model = CopyModel(model)
            Me.Preparation = preparation
            Fault = UdfReportFault38.None
        End Sub

        Private Sub New(fault As UdfReportFault38)
            Me.Fault = fault
        End Sub

        Public ReadOnly Property Fault As UdfReportFault38
        Public ReadOnly Property Preparation As UdfReportPreparation38

        Public Shared Function FromFault(fault As UdfReportFault38) As UdfReportProjection38
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(fault)
        End Function

        Public Function ToOutputModel() As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel
            If _model Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Return CopyModel(_model)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function SafeNumber(value As Double) As OutputCell
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Return OutputCell.SpreadsheetError("#NUM!")
            Return OutputCell.NumberCell(value)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function CopyModel(model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel) As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel
            Dim values As Object(,) = Nothing
            If model.Values IsNot Nothing Then values = DirectCast(CopyArray(model.Values), Object(,))
            Return New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(values, model.HeaderTopRows, model.HeaderLeftColumns,
                model.FooterRows, model.PvalueColumns, model.TitleRows, model.IsResultTable, model.PvalueCells)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function CopyArray(values As Array) As Array
            Dim copy As Array = DirectCast(values.Clone(), Array)
            Dim indices(values.Rank - 1) As Integer
            For dimension As Integer = 0 To indices.Length - 1
                indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
            Next
            If values.Length = 0 Then Return copy
            Do
                Dim value As Object = values.GetValue(indices)
                If TypeOf value Is Array Then
                    copy.SetValue(CopyArray(DirectCast(value, Array)), indices)
                Else
                    ValidateScalar(value)
                End If
                Dim dimension As Integer = indices.Length - 1
                Do While dimension >= 0
                    indices(dimension) += 1
                    If indices(dimension) <= values.GetUpperBound(dimension) Then Exit Do
                    indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
                    dimension -= 1
                Loop
                If dimension < 0 Then Exit Do
            Loop
            Return copy
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub ValidateScalar(value As Object)
            If value Is Nothing OrElse TypeOf value Is DBNull OrElse TypeOf value Is UdfSourceCellReference38 Then Return
            If TypeOf value Is OutputCell Then
                Dim kind As OutputCellKind = DirectCast(value, OutputCell).Kind
                If kind = OutputCellKind.Error OrElse kind = OutputCellKind.Number Then Return
                Throw New ArgumentException("Only typed numeric/error intent is used by legacy report projections.")
            End If
            Dim valueType As Type = value.GetType()
            If Not valueType.IsEnum Then
                Select Case Type.GetTypeCode(valueType)
                    Case TypeCode.String, TypeCode.Boolean, TypeCode.Byte, TypeCode.SByte, TypeCode.Int16, TypeCode.UInt16,
                         TypeCode.Int32, TypeCode.UInt32, TypeCode.Int64, TypeCode.UInt64, TypeCode.Single, TypeCode.Double,
                         TypeCode.Decimal, TypeCode.DateTime, TypeCode.Char
                        Return
                End Select
            End If
            Throw New ArgumentException("A legacy portable report cannot contain a native or mutable scalar payload.")
        End Sub
    End Class

            Dim result As New List(Of UdfSpillCell38)()
            Dim firstBodyRow As Integer = model.TitleRows + model.HeaderTopRows
            Dim lastBodyRow As Integer = rows - model.FooterRows - 1
            For Each bodyColumn As Integer In model.PvalueColumns
                Dim columnIndex As Integer = model.HeaderLeftColumns + bodyColumn - 1
                If columnIndex < 0 OrElse columnIndex >= columns Then Continue For
                For rowIndex As Integer = Math.Max(0, firstBodyRow) To Math.Min(lastBodyRow, rows - 1)
                    result.Add(New UdfSpillCell38(rowIndex, columnIndex))

                Dim rowIndex As Integer = firstBodyRow + address.BodyRow - 1
                Dim columnIndex As Integer = model.HeaderLeftColumns + address.BodyColumn - 1
                If rowIndex < firstBodyRow OrElse rowIndex > lastBodyRow Then Continue For
                If columnIndex < 0 OrElse columnIndex >= columns Then Continue For
                result.Add(New UdfSpillCell38(rowIndex, columnIndex))
            Next
            Return result.ToArray()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildKaplanMeierStepTablePrepared(rawCurves As Object(), countRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), fillRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), noteTable As Func(Of String, String, Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count
            Next

            If totalRows <= 1 Then
                Return noteTable("Kaplan-Meier", "No survival-curve rows were returned.")
            End If

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, 6) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            out(0, 1) = "PlotOrder"
            out(0, 2) = "Time"
            out(0, 3) = "Survival"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "AtRisk"

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim groupName As String = recs(0).strGroup
                Dim prevProb As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevLL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim plotOrder As Integer = 1

                out(row, 0) = groupName
                out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                out(row, 2) = 0.0R
                out(row, 3) = 1.0R
                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildWelchAnovaTable(data()() As Double, names() As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)

            Return t
        End Function

        ' Invalid selectors are resolved only AFTER construction/compute, as originally.
        ' wrapResults always supplies a non-null List in the pinned Core engine.
        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayMcpTables(data()() As Double, names() As String, which As String, alphaValue As Double, ByRef stackAll As Boolean) As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable)
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            stackAll = False
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(which, New String() {"", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK", "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES", "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD", "BONF", "BONFERRONI", "ALL", "BOTH"})
                Case "", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK"
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                Case "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES"
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                Case "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                Case "BONF", "BONFERRONI"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                Case "ALL", "BOTH"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                    stackAll = True
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
            Return mdl.wrapResults()
        End Function

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)

                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1

                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Dim t As New ResultTable

        Public Shared Function BuildRosnerTable(alpha As Double, outliers() As Double, addCaution As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim nOut As Integer = If(outliers Is Nothing, 0, outliers.Length)
            Dim rows As Integer = 3 + Math.Max(1, nOut)
            Dim body(rows - 1, 1) As Object
            body(0, 0) = "Alpha"
            body(0, 1) = alpha
            body(1, 0) = "Number of outliers"
            body(1, 1) = nOut
            body(2, 0) = "List of outliers"
            If nOut > 0 Then
                body(2, 1) = outliers(0)
            Else
                body(2, 1) = ""
            End If
            For i As Integer = 1 To nOut - 1
                body(2 + i, 0) = ""
                body(2 + i, 1) = outliers(i)
            Next
            If nOut = 0 Then
                body(3, 0) = ""
                body(3, 1) = ""
            End If

            Dim t As New ResultTable
            t.SetBody(body)
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Rosner Generalized ESD Test", ""})
            If addCaution Then
                t.AddFootnote("Interpret with caution for sample sizes below 25.")
            End If
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(t.ToOutputModel(), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildClusterPreprocessingTable(varNames() As String, locations() As Double, scales() As Double,
                                                        mode As Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim varCount As Integer = 0
            If varNames IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = varNames.Length
            ElseIf locations IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = locations.Length
            ElseIf scales IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = scales.Length
            End If

            If mode = Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode.None OrElse varCount <= 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Standardization"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(varCount, 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Variable"
            out(0, 1) = "Location"
            out(0, 2) = "Scale"
            For i As Integer = 0 To varCount - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = If(varNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < varNames.Length, CType(varNames(i), Object), CType("X" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
                out(i + 1, 1) = If(locations IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < locations.Length, CType(locations(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(scales IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < scales.Length, CType(scales(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38
            If rowIds Is Nothing OrElse rowIds.Length = 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object

                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Removed rows"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim hasLabels As Boolean = (rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length = rowIds.Length)
            Dim out(rowIds.Length, If(hasLabels, 2, 1)) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If hasLabels Then
                out(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
                out(0, 2) = "Reason"
            Else
                out(0, 1) = "Reason"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowIds(i)
                If hasLabels Then
                    out(i + 1, 1) = rowLabels(i)
                    out(i + 1, 2) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 1) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                End If
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildHierarchicalLeafOrderTable(result As Multivariate.HierarchicalClusterResult) As UdfReportProjection38
            If result Is Nothing Then Return Nothing

            Dim n As Integer = If(result.ActiveRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, result.ActiveRowIndices.Length)
            Dim out(Math.Max(n, 1), 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "DisplayOrder"
            out(0, 1) = "OriginalRow"
            out(0, 2) = "RowLabel"
            If n = 0 Then
                out(1, 0) = 1
                out(1, 1) = Nothing
                out(1, 2) = Nothing
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim labelByRow As New Dictionary(Of Integer, String)
            If result.ActiveRowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.ActiveRowLabels.Length = n Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    labelByRow(result.ActiveRowIndices(i)) = result.ActiveRowLabels(i)
                Next
            End If

            Dim displayOrder() As Integer = If(result.LeafOrder IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.LeafOrder.Length = n,
                                               result.LeafOrder,
                                               result.ActiveRowIndices)
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim rowId As Integer = displayOrder(i)
                out(i + 1, 0) = i + 1
                out(i + 1, 1) = rowId
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(labelByRow.ContainsKey(rowId), CType(labelByRow(rowId), Object), CType("Obs " & rowId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available

Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1

                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next

        Public Shared Sub AppendZipSummaryRows(rows As List(Of Object()), componentLabel As String, predictorNames() As String, coeffs() As Double, ses() As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean, ciAlpha As Double)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse coeffs Is Nothing OrElse ses Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            If coeffs.Length <> ses.Length Then Exit Sub
            
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(ciAlpha)
            For i As Integer = 0 To coeffs.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, coeffs(i) / ses(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                rows.Add(New Object() {
                    componentLabel,
                    predictorNames(i),
                    If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope"),
                    coeffs(i),
                    ses(i),
                    z,
                    pv,
                    coeffs(i) - zCrit * ses(i),
                    coeffs(i) + zCrit * ses(i)
                })
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function MaterializeZipRows(rows As List(Of Object()), includeHeader As Boolean, headers() As String) As Object
            Dim bodyCols As Integer = If(headers Is Nothing, If(rows.Count > 0, rows(0).Length, 1), headers.Length)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rows.Count + If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            If outRows < 1 Then outRows = 1
            Dim out(outRows - 1, bodyCols - 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            
            If includeHeader AndAlso headers IsNot Nothing Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1
                    out(0, j) = headers(j)
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If
            
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim rowVals() As Object = rows(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To Math.Min(bodyCols, rowVals.Length) - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j) = rowVals(j)
                Next
            Next
            
            Return out
        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildMultinomialSummary(result As LMresult, names() As String, predictorCount As Integer, hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
                Dim q As Integer = result.Coeffs_est.Length
                Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, q + 1, q)
                Dim out(outRows - 1, 8) As Object

                Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
                Dim r0 As Integer = 0

                If hdr Then
                    out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                    out(0, 1) = "Type"
                    out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                    out(0, 3) = "SE"
                    out(0, 4) = "Z"
                    out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                    out(0, 6) = "OR"
                    out(0, 7) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " LCL"
                    out(0, 8) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " UCL"
                    r0 = 1
                End If

                For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                    Dim beta As Double = result.Coeffs_est(i)
                    Dim se As Double = result.Coeffs_SEs(i)
                    Dim z As Double = If(se > 0.0, beta / se, Double.NaN)
                    Dim pv As Double = If(se > 0.0, 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                    Dim pname As String = names(i)
                    Dim isInterceptParam As Boolean = pname IsNot Nothing AndAlso pname.Trim().EndsWith(": Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

                    out(r0 + i, 0) = pname
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = If(isInterceptParam, "Intercept", "Slope")
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = beta
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = se
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = pv

                    If isInterceptParam Then
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = ""
                    Else
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = expForDisplay(beta)
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)
                    End If
                Next

                Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Sub AppendZipSummaryRows(rows As List(Of Object()), componentLabel As String, predictorNames() As String, coeffs() As Double, ses() As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean, ciAlpha As Double)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse coeffs Is Nothing OrElse ses Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            If coeffs.Length <> ses.Length Then Exit Sub
            
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(ciAlpha)
            For i As Integer = 0 To coeffs.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, coeffs(i) / ses(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                rows.Add(New Object() {
                    componentLabel,
                    predictorNames(i),
                    If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope"),
                    coeffs(i),
                    ses(i),
                    z,
                    pv,
                    coeffs(i) - zCrit * ses(i),
                    coeffs(i) + zCrit * ses(i)
                })
            Next
        End Sub

Public Shared Sub AppendZipSummaryRows(rows As List(Of Object()), componentLabel As String, predictorNames() As String, coeffs() As Double, ses() As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean, ciAlpha As Double)
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse coeffs Is Nothing OrElse ses Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            If coeffs.Length <> ses.Length Then Exit Sub
            
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(ciAlpha)
            For i As Integer = 0 To coeffs.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, coeffs(i) / ses(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(ses(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                rows.Add(New Object() {
                    componentLabel,
                    predictorNames(i),
                    If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope"),
                    coeffs(i),
                    ses(i),
                    z,
                    pv,
                    coeffs(i) - zCrit * ses(i),
                    coeffs(i) + zCrit * ses(i)
                })
            Next
        End Sub

Public Shared Function BuildMultinomialSummary(result As LMresult, names() As String, predictorCount As Integer, hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
                Dim q As Integer = result.Coeffs_est.Length
                Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, q + 1, q)
                Dim out(outRows - 1, 8) As Object

                Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
                Dim r0 As Integer = 0

                If hdr Then
                    out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                    out(0, 1) = "Type"
                    out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                    out(0, 3) = "SE"
                    out(0, 4) = "Z"
                    out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                    out(0, 6) = "OR"
                    out(0, 7) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " LCL"
                    out(0, 8) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " UCL"
                    r0 = 1
                End If

                For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                    Dim beta As Double = result.Coeffs_est(i)
                    Dim se As Double = result.Coeffs_SEs(i)
                    Dim z As Double = If(se > 0.0, beta / se, Double.NaN)
                    Dim pv As Double = If(se > 0.0, 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)
                    Dim pname As String = names(i)
                    Dim isInterceptParam As Boolean = pname IsNot Nothing AndAlso pname.Trim().EndsWith(": Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

                    out(r0 + i, 0) = pname
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = If(isInterceptParam, "Intercept", "Slope")
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = beta
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = se
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = pv

                    If isInterceptParam Then
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = ""
                    Else
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = expForDisplay(beta)
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)
                    End If
                Next

                Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildOrdinalSummary(result As LMresult, names() As String, predictorCount As Integer, hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
                Dim q As Integer = result.Coeffs_est.Length
                Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, q + 1, q)
                Dim out(outRows - 1, 8) As Object

                Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
                Dim r0 As Integer = 0

                If hdr Then
                    out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                    out(0, 1) = "Type"
                    out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                    out(0, 3) = "SE"
                    out(0, 4) = "Z"
                    out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                    out(0, 6) = "OR"
                    out(0, 7) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " LCL"
                    out(0, 8) = "OR " & $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}%" & " UCL"
                    r0 = 1
                End If

                For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                    Dim beta As Double = result.Coeffs_est(i)
                    Dim se As Double = result.Coeffs_SEs(i)
                    Dim z As Double = If(se > 0.0, beta / se, Double.NaN)
                    Dim pv As Double = If(se > 0.0, 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                    Dim isSlope As Boolean = (i < predictorCount)

                    out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = If(isSlope, "Slope", "Threshold")
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = beta
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = se
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = pv

                    If isSlope Then
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = expForDisplay(beta)
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)
                    Else
                        out(r0 + i, 6) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 7) = ""
                        out(r0 + i, 8) = ""
                    End If
                Next

                Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildZipPredictionRows(countExpandedX(,) As Double, zeroExpandedX(,) As Double, betaCount() As Double, betaZero() As Double, countIntercept As Boolean, zeroIntercept As Boolean, offsetVals() As Double, nRows As Integer, safeNumber As Func(Of Double, Object)) As List(Of Object())
                Dim rows As New List(Of Object())
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    Dim etaCount As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ComputeLinearPredictor(countExpandedX, i, betaCount, countIntercept, offsetVals)
                    Dim lambda As Double = Math.Exp(etaCount)
                    Dim etaZero As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ComputeLinearPredictor(zeroExpandedX, i, betaZero, zeroIntercept, Nothing)
                    Dim pi As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.regression.Logit.LogisticStable(etaZero)
                    Dim mu As Double = (1.0R - pi) * lambda

                    rows.Add(New Object() {
                        safeNumber(mu),
                        safeNumber(lambda),
                        safeNumber(pi),
                        safeNumber(etaCount),
                        safeNumber(etaZero)
                    })
                Next
